source_text:
We did it!
I gotta admit, this auction
stuff is pretty fun!\var2:00\\end\

Not half as fun as getting
my hands on the spoils is
going to be. Heh heh.\var2:00\\end\

That was so close I could
taste it! I really thought
we had 'em...\var2:00\\end\

To the victor the spoils,
I suppose. Well, maybe next
time.\var2:00\\end\

Who, me? Not a word.\endPage\\end\So, what do you say we find
ourselves another auction,
or even a quest?\var2:00\\end\

Yeah, sure. But there was
something I wanted to go
looking for first.\var2:00\\end\

Lavenicalia flowers.
I don't really know where to
start looking for them, though.\endPage\\end\See, if you grind up the leaves
and the petals, it's supposed to
make a good medicine.\endPage\\end\Thought I'd make some for Cid.\var2:00\\end\

Lavenicalia flowers?
Doesn't sound familiar.\endPage\\end\But I know how to make another
medicine that might do the trick.
If only we had some pearl moss...\endPage\\end\What day is it?\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
If the auctions were open today,
that quest should be up by now.\var2:00\\end\

Here's what we'll do,
\varA:00\.\endPage\\end\I'll help you make that
medicine, but you have to
find me some pearls.\var2:00\\end\

I don't believe this!
Your friend needs your help, and
all you can think about is jewelry!\endPage\\end\If that's how you're
going to be, I don't even
-want- your help.\var2:00\\end\

Would you stop talking
for a minute and listen?\endPage\\end\The pearl moss and the pearls are
in the same place. No sense mucking
around for moss and passing up pearls.\var2:00\\end\

I guess if they're right there,
it can't hurt. But still...\var2:00\\end\

That wasn't so
hard, was it?\endPage\\end\Now, the pearlsーand the mossーare
in the Galerria Deep.\endPage\\end\Oh, and we can't just go picking
up pearlsーthey'll lock us away
for poaching.\endPage\\end\So we need to accept a
pearl hunting quest before
we go. Got it?\var2:00\\end\

Good day, sir!
It's a pleasure to have
you with us.\endPage\\end\Pardon me for saying so, sir, but
you look a mite nervous. First time
at the auction house, is it?\var2:00\\end\

Well, there's no hurry.
I'll be happy to explain
the house rules to you.\var2:00\\end\

Where shall we begin?
\defaultOption:20\What are areas?\endOption\What are tokens?\endOption\How do you become area champ?\endOption\I don't need to hear the rules.\endOption\\end\

Clans bid against each other
to gain control of an area.\endPage\\end\If you'll look up, you'll see the
auction board, which lists the areas
up for bid at this auction house.\endPage\\end\To bid for an area not listed,
you'll need to travel to the
auction house for that region.\endPage\\end\But the auction season
doesn't last forever, so you'll
have to hurry!\var2:00\\end\

All bidding is done
with tokens.\endPage\\end\Once you've paid the entry
fee, I'll hand you your tokens
here.\endPage\\end\If you'll glance up, you'll see the
auction board, which displays your
tokens and the areas up for bid.\endPage\\end\A separate auction is held for each
area listed. These auctions are held
one immediately after the other.\endPage\\end\It is, therefore, impossible
to purchase more tokens between
auctions.\endPage\\end\Take care not to use too many
tokens early on, or the later auctions
will become quite difficult!\var2:00\\end\

The clan that wins control of
an area is referred to as that
area's champion, or "champ."\endPage\\end\This carries with it any number
of benefits, but I'm not at liberty
to go into details.\endPage\\end\Once you've become the champ of
an area, you'll just have to pay it
a visit and see for yourself.\endPage\\end\A clan remains area champ until
the next auction season opens.\var2:00\\end\

Are you sure, sir? It's no trouble.
\defaultOption:01\I'm sure.\endOption\Well, it couldn't hurt.\endOption\\end\

Enough talk, then.
One never knows until one
tries, as they say.\var2:00\\end\

You can now view the current area champs by
selecting Clan Territory from the Clan Menu.\var2:00\\end\

Ack! I completely forgot
to get that instrument made!\endPage\\end\I'll have to remember to
do that next time I'm near
a shop.\var2:00\\end\

Oops! The instrument!
It was all ready to go
and I forgot to buy it...\endPage\\end\Next time, no forgetting!\var2:00\\end\

Good day.\endPage\\end\I'm afraid our selection
isn't very good at the moment.\endPage\\end\Still, we might have something
you'd like, if you'd care to take
a look.\var2:00\\end\

I can't help but notice
you have some loot on you.\endPage\\end\If you'd like, I can put your
loot up on the bazaar and see what
I can get for it in return.\var2:00\\end\

Loot can be almost anything,
from a rat pelt to a precious gem.\endPage\\end\Hunters and clans usually come
into a fair bit of loot while
questing.\var2:00\\end\

So that's what all that
stuff we've been finding is.\endPage\\end\Meaning this lump of metal
here...is a piece of loot?\var2:00\\end\

That's a piece of loot
if ever there was one.\endPage\\end\Since you seem a bit...confused
about all of this, perhaps a more
detailed explanation would help?\var2:00\\end\

You see, traders at the bazaar
are always interested in acquiring
new, exotic pieces of loot.\endPage\\end\The better the loot, the better the
item they'll give in return.\endPage\\end\Just tell me when you have some
loot you'd like to put on the bazaar,
and I'll take care of the rest.\endPage\\end\I'll add any items I can get from
the bazaar to the stock of items you
can purchase here at the shop.\var2:00\\end\

All right, I'll give it
a try!\var2:00\\end\

I've a new item
in stock now.\endPage\\end\Next time you feel
like making a purchase,
take a look!\var2:00\\end\

We carry all manner of
weapons and armor.\endPage\\end\You seem rather new to all this,
so perhaps I should tell you a
little about the equipment we sell.\var2:00\\end\

Some pieces of equipment
bestow new abilities on their
wearer.\endPage\\end\With these pieces equipped,
you can use the abilities, whether
you've seen them before or not.\var2:00\\end\

There's no better way to give
a new ability a try before
deciding whether to learn it.\endPage\\end\Of course, you'll need a variety
of equipment, and that's where we
come in. *chuckle*\var2:00\\end\

I'll tell you what
I'll do.\endPage\\end\I'm going to write up a
summary of our discussion
about the bazaar and equipment.\endPage\\end\I'll post it on the pub's
rumor board so you can read
it whenever you like.\endPage\\end\Not much of a rumor, really,
but it might be helpful.\endPage\\end\I hope we'll see you
again soon!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Kupo!
You have the instrument
I wanted! Thank you!\var2:00\\end\

No problem!
Just seeing how happy you
are is thanks enough for me.\var2:00\\end\

Actually, there was one
thing I wanted to ask youーif
you don't mind.\var2:00\\end\

You've seen a lot of people...
been to a lot of places,
right?\endPage\\end\Well, there's this place I'm
trying to find. It's covered in a really
thick fogーMist, I guess.\endPage\\end\It's all rockーnothing living.
It feels like it's underground,
but you can't see the ceiling.\endPage\\end\For some reason, it makes me
think of a graveyard. You ever
heard of any place like that?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:01\You seem to know a lot
about it! Are you sure don't
know where it is?\var2:00\\end\

No, wellーthe thing is,
I saw it in a dream.\endPage\\end\For all I know it
doesn't even exist.
But it was so real.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\I've never been anywhere
like that before. Sorry
I can't help, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

Nah, it's okay.
I'm sorry for asking such
a stupid question.\endPage\\end\Anyway, I can't wait to
hear you play again.\endPage\\end\That last thing you played
for us was great!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\It's not every day you
meet someone looking for a place
from their dreams, kupo.\endPage\\end\\varE:01\I bet you have all sorts
of interesting stories just
waiting to be told!\endPage\\end\\varE:00\As it happens, I don't just sing
songs. I write them, too!\endPage\\end\\varE:01\There's nothing like hearing
about exciting adventures to
set the quill scribbling, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

You came to the right person,
that's for sure.\endPage\\end\I don't know anyone else who
came to Ivalice from another world
through a magick book.\var2:00\\end\

Yeah... That's why I'm doing
quests and looking for adventure.
To get back to my own world.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\Do you suppose
I might ask you a favor?\endPage\\end\\varE:01\Could I travel with you?
Kupo?\endPage\\end\\varE:02\I've decided I want -you-
to be the subject of my
next song!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\I'm small, I won't
get in the way!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\And you may not know it
to look at me, but I'm not
a half-bad fighter, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

We've never been a clan
to turn people away.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Thank you, kupo!
You won't regret it!
My name's Hurdy.\var2:00\\end\

I'm \varA:00\.
And this is Cid,
and Adelle.\var2:00\\end\

Oh, there's word from
the appraiser about the
stone, \varA:00\.\var2:00\\end\

I was wondering when
they'd be done.\endPage\\end\Guess we're off to Moorabella
to pick it up then.\var2:00\\end\

He's always running off
somewhere. You get used
to it, though.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\That's perfect!
Just what I need!\endPage\\end\\varE:00\Something tells me this
song is going to be epic!
Kupo-po!\var2:00\\end\

I was wondering when
they'd be done.\endPage\\end\Guess I'll head over to
the appraiser and pick it
up.\var2:00\\end\

So you really do find
work in pubs...\endPage\\end\I always pictured a pub
as someplace to kick back
and grab a snack.\var2:00\\end\

What better place? People gather
to share a meal, and where there
are people, there's talk.\endPage\\end\Clans pay good money for the sort
of talk that leads to workーthe quests
I mentioned before.\var2:00\\end\

So if we need to make money
or find something to do,
the pub is the place to go.\var2:00\\end\

That's right.
We have a new member in
need of training.\var2:00\\end\

Talk to the barman,
\varA:00\.
Find us a good quest.\endPage\\end\The best way to learn
is to do, lad.\var2:00\\end\

So you're Cid's new recruit?\endPage\\end\Well, if you're looking for a quest,
the first thing you'll want to do
is ask to see the quest roster.\endPage\\end\The roster lists all the quests
on record at the pub.\endPage\\end\Once you've found a quest that
catches your eye, simply pay the
finder's fee and you're done.\endPage\\end\It's not enough to read the quest and
go running off. If you haven't paid
the fee, you'll be on a fool's errand.\var2:00\\end\

Now some quests you can take as long
as you please to finish. Others you'll
have a set number of days to do it in.\endPage\\end\It's all there on the quest roster,
so just pay close attention and you'll
avoid any unpleasant surprises.\endPage\\end\That's all there is to it.
Ready to have a go?\var2:00\\end\

Select "Quest Roster" to see a list of available
quests.\var2:00\\end\

I got us a quest.
"A Paw Full of Feathers".\endPage\\end\They want us to chase
off some wolves.\var2:00\\end\

Let's see...
That ranch isn't far
from the village.\endPage\\end\No hurry, though.
There's no deadline
written on the bill.\var2:00\\end\

Sounds like they're in a
tight spot. I don't wanna
keep 'em waiting.\endPage\\end\I'll go get the others!\var2:00\\end\

See that you're ready before
you go running off!\var2:00\\end\

That boy needs to get his
priorities straight.\endPage\\end\At this rate he's like to
stay here forever.\var2:00\\end\

It's so nice to be
on my own again.\var2:00\\end\

No worrying about anyone but
myself...and no sharing treasure!\endPage\\end\I forgot how good a
little solitude could be.\var2:00\\end\

And what's wrong with that?\endPage\\end\I'm a woman of many gifts.
There's nothing I can't handle!\var2:00\\end\

Indeed, you are most gifted.
Gifts which have lain dormant
for far too long.\var2:00\\end\

Welcome to the Fluorgis
aerodrome.\endPage\\end\We're pleased to offer
skyferry service to the
city of Moorabella.\var2:00\\end\

Welcome to the Moorabella
aerodrome.\endPage\\end\We're pleased to offer
skyferry service to the
city of Fluorgis.\var2:00\\end\

Passage to Moorabella for you and
your companions will be \varA:13\ gilー
return fare not included.\endPage\\end\Would you like to purchase a ticket?
\defaultOption:01\Yes\endOption\No\endOption\\end\

Thank you, sir.
Please take your ticket to the gate.
The skyferry will be leaving soon.\var2:00\\end\

I'm sorry, but you don't
seem to have enough gil.\var2:00\\end\

Welcome to Moorabella, city
of scholars. I hope your journey
was a pleasant one.\endPage\\end\It's quite cold out, so take care
to bundle up before venturing far.
Enjoy your stay!\var2:00\\end\

Welcome to Fluorgis, the city
of fountains. I trust you had
a pleasant journey.\endPage\\end\If your plans lead you
outside the city, do mind
the heat!\var2:00\\end\

I hope we'll see
you again soon!\var2:00\\end\

If you change your mind,
I'll be more than happy to
assist you. Good day.\var2:00\\end\

Passage to Fluorgis for you and
your companions will be \varA:13\ gilー
return fare not included.\endPage\\end\Would you like to purchase a ticket?
\defaultOption:01\Yes\endOption\No\endOption\\end\

\varA:00\, was it?
Ah, yes, here we are.\endPage\\end\The raffle ship delivered
your prize.\endPage\\end\To claim your prize, you'll
need to pay the entry fee.
\varA:13\ gil, all together.\var2:00\\end\

A prize, eh?
\defaultOption:01\Can't say no to that!\endOption\Maybe next time.\endOption\\end\

Very good.
Here you are.\endPage\\end\Do come again soon!\var2:00\\end\

If you decide you'd like
to take delivery, we'll be
holding your prize for you.\endPage\\end\Just speak with me or any
member of our staff.\var2:00\\end\

If you've come to book passage
on the skyferry, you'll need to
make other arrangements.\endPage\\end\All of the ships traveling
to Fluorgis have been grounded,
I'm afraid.\endPage\\end\I don't know when service
will resume, but it shouldn't
be long.\var2:00\\end\

So that's all there is
to it, huh? I had myself all
worked up for...well, more.\var2:00\\end\

The skyferry between Moorabella and
Fluorgis is just that: a ferry, not
much else.\endPage\\end\The cities aren't all that far
apartーhundreds of people travel
between them every day.\var2:00\\end\

Booking a longer trip takes
much more workーnot to mention
money.\var2:00\\end\

Guess ya learn something
every day.\var2:00\\end\

Looks like I got here
just in time.\var2:00\\end\

Are you sure you should
be up and about so soon?\var2:00\\end\

I'm fit as I've ever been, thanks
to the two of you. The doctor's even
given me a clean bill of health.\var2:00\\end\

I was afraid you'd already
left for Fluorgis.\endPage\\end\But then I heard about this
business with the airships and
thought I might find you here.\endPage\\end\So here I am.\var2:00\\end\

Even if I'd missed you,
Moorabella's as good a place
to wait as any.\var2:00\\end\

Well, your guess sure
paid off!\var2:00\\end\

This is great!\endPage\\end\With all of us here
this'll be twice the fun!\var2:00\\end\

Well, let's hear it.
What did you think
of the airship?\var2:00\\end\

It was incredible!
Feeling the wind on your face,
seeing the ocean way down below...\var2:00\\end\

It's the best time
I've ever had!\var2:00\\end\

I suppose we head for the
fens next, then. That's where
these sky pirates said to go, yes?\var2:00\\end\

Yeah. Tramdine Fens.
They said we'd find some
sort of treasure there.\var2:00\\end\

-If- they can be trusted.\endPage\\end\I wouldn't be the least bit
surprised if all we come back
with is muddy boots.\var2:00\\end\

I don't know why, but I
believe 'em. Either way,
we'll find out soon enough.\endPage\\end\But first I wanna take a
look around town and get
ready before we head out.\var2:00\\end\

Now, what is there to
see in Fluorgis...?\var2:00\\end\

I know! We should have some roasted
zignuts and a cup of nua teaーit's
supposed to be great here.\var2:00\\end\

Oh, and I want to stop by the
Anne Salier store. It's affiliated
with Galmia Pepe, you know.\endPage\\end\Don't worry, I only want a little
peek.\var2:00\\end\

She sure didn't waste
any time.\var2:00\\end\

She'll waste plenty of
ours before this is over,
you mark my words.\var2:00\\end\

Have you come to take part
in the raffle?\var2:00\\end\

The drawing can only be
held when there are enough
participants.\endPage\\end\Oh, and there's a small
entry fee, payable when
you claim your prize.\endPage\\end\Would you like me to
see if there's anyone
waiting to enter?\var2:00\\end\

A raffle, huh?
\defaultOption:01\\sprite:0A\ Sure, I'll enter!\endOption\Maybe some other time.\endOption\\end\

You're in luck!\endPage\\end\I've made contact with the
raffle ship, and there are enough
participants to start.\endPage\\end\I'll have your raffle ticket
ready in just a moment.\var2:00\\end\

Thank you for waiting.
Here's you ticket.\var2:00\\end\

I'm sorry, but I wasn't
able to contact any interested
parties.\endPage\\end\Perhaps if you try again
some other time.\var2:00\\end\

If you change your mind,
I'll be more than happy to
assist you. Good day.\var2:00\\end\

I'll hold your prize
for you here as soon as
it arrives.\endPage\\end\Just present your raffle
ticket and have some gil on
hand to cover the entry fee.\endPage\\end\Good luck!\var2:00\\end\

I'm terribly sorry, but there's
been some trouble processing your
raffle ticket.\endPage\\end\Please try again later.\var2:00\\end\

I'm terribly sorry, but there's
been some trouble processing your
raffle ticket.\endPage\\end\Please try again later.\var2:00\\end\

I'm terribly sorry, but there's
been some trouble processing your
raffle ticket.\endPage\\end\Please try again later.\var2:00\\end\

I'm terribly sorry, but there's
been some trouble processing your
raffle ticket.\endPage\\end\Please try again later.\var2:00\\end\

Whew... How did
I get so tired?\endPage\\end\Maybe I need
a little rest.\var2:00\\end\

That's just what I needed.
Now back to it!\var2:00\\end\

Hmm, how tired am I?
\defaultOption:20\Just a little.\endOption\Pretty tired.\endOption\Exhausted!\endOption\Aw, forget the whole thing.\endOption\\end\

Summer vacation's so close
I can taste it.\endPage\\end\I'm out that door as soon as
the teacher stops talking.\var2:00\\end\
translation:
暑假就要到了，
我都等不及了。\endPage\\end\老师一讲完，
我就冲出教室。\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
Summer homework: keep a journal.
That's not too bad.\endPage\\end\Better write my name on my
notebook before I forget.\var2:00\\end\
translation:
暑假作业是写日记。
这倒不算太糟。\endPage\\end\得趁没忘记，先在
本子上写好名字。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; layout and encoding unverified

source_text:
Don't get me wrong, I'm not crazy about
homework. Just, it could be worse.\endPage\\end\And I can already guess what my
first entry's going to be:\endPage\\end\"Summer Vacation, Day 1: Aunt chewed
me out. Grounded for a week."\var2:00\\end\
translation:
别误会，我可不喜欢
作业。只是这还算好的。\endPage\\end\我已经猜到第一篇
日记要写什么了：\endPage\\end\“暑假第一天：被姨妈骂了，
禁足一周。”\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; layout and encoding unverified

source_text:
Maybe this journal thing's not
such a great idea after all.\endPage\\end\Oh, we got another assignment, due
today: "My Summer Vacation."\endPage\\end\We're supposed to write our goals for
the summer. Well, here goes...\var2:00\\end\
translation:
也许写日记这主意
没那么好了。\endPage\\end\对了，还有一份今天交的
作业：《我的暑假》。\endPage\\end\老师要我们写暑假目标。
好吧，开始写……\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; layout and encoding unverified

source_text:
Heh, that all sounds pretty convincing.
Summer vacation, here I come!\var2:00\\end\
translation:
嘿，写得还挺像那么回事。
暑假，我来了！\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; layout and encoding unverified

source_text:
...Not that I have any idea
what I'm doing this summer.\var2:00\\end\
translation:
……其实我没想好
暑假做什么。\var2:00\\end\

But, I guess not having any
expectations isn't all bad.\var2:00\\end\
translation:
不过，没有期待
也不全是坏事。\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
I mean, whatever ends up happening,
it'll be a surprise!\var2:00\\end\
translation:
不管最后发生什么，
都是惊喜嘛！\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
The most populous race in Ivalice,
there are few places where humes
have not made their mark.
A well-rounded race, humes are
equally suited to swordplay and
magery.\var2:00\\end\

Scales cover the bodies of this
reptilian race. Muscled and
powerful, bangaa are physically
imposing. Their rough, bellicose
temperament leads them to pursue
warrior-like jobs.\var2:00\\end\

With a doglike face and ears
that drag along the ground,
there's no mistaking a nu mou.
Extremely intelligent, they make
for powerful mages, but their frail
bodies are ill-suited for physical
combat.\var2:00\\end\

Members of this tall race with
hair of spun silver are often
called the People of the Wood.
Viera are lithe of limb and
tremendously quick. Their slender
bodies belie superior strength and
masterful combat skill.\var2:00\\end\

A fluffy pom-pom and bat-like
wings set this race apart.
Their small stature lends itself to
leaping out and surprising people,
in which they take great delight.
With tiny, nimble hands, moogles
excel at a number of unusual jobs.\var2:00\\end\

A portly, porcine race with
stubby legs, one would not
expect seeq to be quick, yet few
can match their speed. Though
dim-witted and unscrupulous, their
knowledge of battle is formidable.\var2:00\\end\

Wings of a dragon and a powerful
tail distinguish this unique race.
Outwardly small, some might even
say cute, gria make vicious foes
in battle. They have a fierce,
competitive spirit.\var2:00\\end\

Using the area map, you may travel
from one location to the next.\endPage\\end\A blue balloon over a location
indicates your next destination.\endPage\\end\First, try going to Wood Village,
marked with a balloon on your map.\var2:00\\end\

Towns are convenient places to
prepare for your adventures.\endPage\\end\Select a town and press \sprite:04\ to see
a menu of that town's facilities.\endPage\\end\First, try going to the pub, where
you can undertake quests.\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
Let's take a trip down
memory lane...to this
morning!\endPage\\end\When you were late to my
class for theーhow many

source_text:
This... This is the
place from my dream!\var2:00\\end\

And Illua is nowhere to
be seen. Quite a run-in
she had with your book.\var2:00\\end\

Speaking of which,
\varA:00\...\endPage\\end\You don't happen to have
your journal...do you.\var2:00\\end\

No. When she hit it with
her sword, I let go...
It's gone.\var2:00\\end\

Well, that's just great.
What are we supposed to
do now!?\endPage\\end\We don't even know
where we are!\var2:00\\end\

If I'd known this was going
to be this kind of quest,
I'd have stayed in Graszton.\endPage\\end\One of those chiffon cakes
down at the Gateau Kaldi cafe
sounds good about now...\var2:00\\end\

Quit your grousing.
You're making me hungry.\var2:00\\end\

Forgive a girl for needing a
distraction...this Mist ties
my stomach in knots.\var2:00\\end\

I do sort of wonder what
we're supposed to do now.\endPage\\end\Somehow, this doesn't seem
like the kind of place you
can just walk home from.\var2:00\\end\

\varA:00\...
You must leave at once.
This place is dangerous.\var2:00\\end\

Follow the path I shall
make plain for you...
Come back...\var2:00\\end\

The demon...you must
not let it through!\var2:00\\end\

Eeek!
Why do these things
always happen to me!?\var2:00\\end\

Ha!
You're not the only one
here, princess.\var2:00\\end\

Bind it? You mean we have
to defeat that thing!?
Us!?\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 7; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
When you put it that
way...\var2:00\\end\

That's right,
\varA:00\ Clemens
is the name!\endPage\\end\And fighting impossibly
huge demonic hands is
my game... *gulp*\var2:00\\end\

Ahh, you're all right!
I am relieved.\var2:00\\end\

If you call battered,
bruised and scarred for life
"all right," then, yes.\var2:00\\end\

So...what is this place?\endPage\\end\I've seen it before,
but only in dreams.\endPage\\end\Oh, and you remember that
magick journal of mine...?\var2:00\\end\

There will be time for
talk later. First, you
must leave this place.\var2:00\\end\

To the east you will
find a large crystal...\endPage\\end\A gate crystal.\endPage\\end\Touch it, and you
will come back.\var2:00\\end\

As I'm sure you are aware,
this place is unnatural.
It will not do to linger.\endPage\\end\I will be waiting beyond
the gate.\var2:00\\end\

You don't have to tell me
to get out of here twice!\var2:00\\end\

You've been through
much. More than I could
have imagined.\var2:00\\end\

So...this stone created
the judges?\endPage\\end\That's some powerful
magick in there.\var2:00\\end\

Yes, but magick so powerful
is not lightly used.\endPage\\end\In order to use a stone of
such power, one must pay
a commensurate price.\var2:00\\end\

And this stone, this has
been forcefully reduced
to its original state.\endPage\\end\If whoever did this released
all the energies within...\endPage\\end\It must have drained them
terribly. They wouldn't be
able to cast for days.\var2:00\\end\

Apparently, a risk worth
taking to send Baron
Beltorey a message.\endPage\\end\Makes you wonder what
the baron did to deserve
such attention?\var2:00\\end\

...Never mind.
Unraveling the mystery of
that stone is enough for now.\endPage\\end\I've said my piece.
Now tell us about that
place we were sent.\var2:00\\end\

The name I suppose.
You were in Jagd Zellea.\endPage\\end\One of the many jagds in
this worldーplaces where
the Mist is unstable indeed.\var2:00\\end\

Jagd Zellea?
Where have I heard that?\var2:00\\end\

Wait, I know!
The Forbidden Keep!\var2:00\\end\

Quite a famous place in
pirating circles...\endPage\\end\Something about a treasure
there that, when held, would
let one rule the world.\var2:00\\end\

...Quite.
A power of immense proportions
sleeps in that land.\endPage\\end\You saw it, did you not?
The rift, and the demon
that emerged from it?\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 7; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
Jagd is known for rifts
of this natureーgateways
to other worlds.\endPage\\end\They open now and then,
sometimes letting in great
evils.\var2:00\\end\

It was the power of the rifts
that cast Zellea off on its
own, a barren waste.\endPage\\end\No rift has been known to open
full-way, yet if one did, the
effects would be catastrophic.\var2:00\\end\

The mages who knew of
the rifts were wary of
their power.\endPage\\end\They created magicks to
bind the rifts closed.\endPage\\end\Your magick tome is one such
book.\var2:00\\end\

You mean...my journal?
But Illua, she cut it
in two...\var2:00\\end\

The Grimoire of the Rift.
So is your book named.\var2:00\\end\

Well that clears up a great
many things...including what
Illua's been after.\var2:00\\end\

She wants to use the power
that flows in through the
rifts, I'd wager.\endPage\\end\And Baron Beltorey must have
known something about it.
That's why he was attacked.\var2:00\\end\

She called us out because
of the whitesilver magicite...\endPage\\end\But when she realized what
\varA:00\ was holding,
she tried to destroy it.\endPage\\end\After all, that book has
the power to seal the rifts.\var2:00\\end\

This may be true.\endPage\\end\Yet, that book is not
something to be ruined
by brand or blade.\endPage\\end\It is protected by a
magick most potent.\endPage\\end\And the source of
that magick's power...
is you, \varA:00\.\var2:00\\end\

Yes. The words written
upon its pagesーthe telling
of your life.\endPage\\end\That proof of your being
protects the grimoire.\endPage\\end\The power you and that
book generate is far
greater than you imagine.\var2:00\\end\

So this book, this
Grimoire of the Rift thing...\var2:00\\end\

What am I supposed
to do with it?\endPage\\end\What if I don't do
the right thing, and
that rift opens?\endPage\\end\What will happen to
this world?\var2:00\\end\

I mean, if this were just
about me not being able to
go home, that's one thing.\endPage\\end\But you're talking about
a whole world!\var2:00\\end\

Think naught of these things.
Continue filling in the pages
as you have thus far.\endPage\\end\Worry not, for you have
that of which the grimoire
has need.\endPage\\end\Did you not protect the
book from Illua's blade?\var2:00\\end\

Do as you will.
Meet those you will.\endPage\\end\Live life, for life
lived is the source
of the book's power.\var2:00\\end\

Okay...I just, I'm just
not sure I have what it
takes to finish the thing.\var2:00\\end\

When the times comes, you
will write the final words.\endPage\\end\And so will end your story
in this world.\endPage\\end\I believe you know why.\endPage\\end\Another world, still beyond
your sight, awaits you.\var2:00\\end\

The grimoire chose your
life to be its wellspring.\endPage\\end\Live your life as you
would. The book wants
nothing more than this.\var2:00\\end\

Let's go back to town.
I've got to check the
bills up in the pub.\endPage\\end\And I don't know all I'd
like to know about Khamja
yet, either.\var2:00\\end\

Um, I was wondering if
I could ask you something...\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Actually, there was
this quest I found a bit
intriguing, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\A salvage run in
the town of Goug!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:01\I should explain, kupo.
This sort of salvaging's
got nothing to do with ships.\endPage\\end\\varE:02\They're looking for old
machineries in the depths of
the Goug undertown. Really old!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Goug's a moogle town.
Mooglecraft's quite popular
there, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:01\Moogle machinists as far
as the eye can see! Lots of
quirky old machineries, too.\endPage\\end\\varE:01\And the weirdest ones,
they've been dumped beneath
the town for centuries!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\Some of them use technology
long since lost, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\That's why, every so often,
they do a survey, kupo.
See what they can dig up.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\Of course, I'd be going
to look for instruments, kupo.\endPage\\end\\varE:01\Something I could use
in a song for you,
\varA:00\!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Just think, maybe I'll
find an old instrument no
one's ever seen before!\var2:00\\end\

Well, what are we waiting
for?\endPage\\end\I'm sure a moogle town's
got lots to see you can't
find anywhere else.\endPage\\end\That's not something
I'm likely to pass up!\var2:00\\end\

I'll go run it by Cid.\endPage\\end\If there's nothing else
that needs doing, let's
go salvaging!\var2:00\\end\

Huh?\endPage\\end\What are those weird
purple glowing things?\var2:00\\end\

Is this...some kind of weapon?\endPage\\end\Hey! Maybe something like this
could put that demon back in
its place and keep it there!\var2:00\\end\

What? More!?
How many of these do
we have to kill?\var2:00\\end\

Those glowing lights...
Maybe we can use them
somehow...?\var2:00\\end\

It went out once, but
now it's glowing again.\endPage\\end\So, what, we give it a
little power when it's
glowing like that...\endPage\\end\..and it blasts away
for us!\var2:00\\end\
Energy flows into the mage cannon...\var2:00\\end\
Energy suffuses the area...\endPage\\end\The mage cannon fires!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Let's go and find the queue to
get into a survey team, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Mooglebanes, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\Oh, they're very, very
horrible. And they love to
eat our *gulp* pom-poms.\var2:00\\end\

You mean that thing on your
head!? They eat those!?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Kupo-po! Speak of it no
more, I beg you!
It's too frightening, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\You up there! You tell the
next shaft over about
the mooglebane, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

Hey! Look at that!
Cool, it's a robot!!!\var2:00\\end\

...Any longer down here
and I'll be saying "kupo"
myself.\var2:00\\end\

Are they really worried,
or just hyper-active...?\var2:00\\end\

Guess it's up to us to
clear these out.\var2:00\\end\

Well, that was a close one.
And I don't mean the battle.\endPage\\end\I was on the verge of saying
"kupo!" the whole time.\var2:00\\end\

Look at all the strange things
they're finding. I've never
seen anything like this!\var2:00\\end\

Huh? Check this out!
Looks like a portable
game machine!\endPage\\end\They have those here, too?
Hmm...not that I've seen
anyone playing one.\endPage\\end\Maybe it's one of those
forgotten technologies.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Kupo! A strange lump of metal
was found in Shaft 57!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\It's awfully heavy. The team's
requesting assistance, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Moogles!
I need you to come with me!\var2:00\\end\

I got to admit, all these
wacky artifacts are pretty
entertaining.\endPage\\end\I could get to like
this place!\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
Nothing important.
What's wrong? You hit your
head during that battle?\var2:00\\end\

No, it's not that...
I'm just...
Maybe I'm just tired.\var2:00\\end\

The constant kupos -can- get
a little wearisome.\var2:00\\end\

Look, I'm going to head home.
You stick here with Hurdy,
\varA:00\.\endPage\\end\Don't worry about me.
I'll be fine.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\\varA:00\!!!
We found something down here.
I think it's an instrument!\var2:00\\end\

This is just like back
home, sneaking into the
school lab...\endPage\\end\Or going through the closets
looking for presents...\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\Calm down, kupo!
You look scary enough
to kill, Cid!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\\varA:00\!
Your timing's impeccable.
Cid's in a bad way.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\K-Kupo!?\endPage\\end\\varE:02\What's wrong, \varA:00\?
You look scarier than Cid!\var2:00\\end\
I always look like this!\endPage\\end\So what's Cid's problem?\var2:00\\end\

Problem? Catastrophe, more like.
I'd been saving up to buy a
new cloak, and it's gone!\var2:00\\end\

That would be Adelle.
Look at this.\var2:00\\end\

"Thank you for everything,
 but I'm striking out alone.
 Don't try to follow me."\endPage\\end\...What's this!?\var2:00\\end\

She says all the stuff with
Khamja and the grimoire was
getting to be too much...\var2:00\\end\

"It is too hard to say goodbye
 in person, so with this letter
 I take my leave."\endPage\\end\Her leave? More like my
money, that thief!\var2:00\\end\

Man, I knew she was bad,
but I never thought she
was capable of this!\var2:00\\end\

C'mon, Cid, let's go do
a quest. Something quick
and dirty that pays.\endPage\\end\Times like this, you just
gotta fight the good fight,
make some gil, and eat a ton!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:01\You aren't going to go
after Adelle, kupo?\var2:00\\end\
Let the girl go, I say.\var2:00\\end\

Yeah, who cares what she
does?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\Some of them use technology
long since lost, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\That's why, every so often,
they do a survey, kupo.
See what they can dig up.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Just think, maybe I'll
find an old instrument no
one's ever seen before!\var2:00\\end\

Um, I was wondering if
I could ask you something...\var2:00\\end\

You know about me,
don't you.\endPage\\end\You know...I'm not
like other humes.\var2:00\\end\

Ever since I was little, I've
been good at everything I do.
Reading, running, all of it.\endPage\\end\Even as a child, I could
watch a dance once and mimic
it perfectly. Songs, too.\var2:00\\end\

The other kids used to
pick on me...but I paid
them no mind.\endPage\\end\I didn't believe I was
any different from them.
Not really.\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
It was a plague. It swept
through the whole village.\endPage\\end\So many took ill, and nothing
could be done for them.
They died, one after another.\var2:00\\end\

But...I didn't die.
I lived on. Alone.\var2:00\\end\

That was when I realized
I'm not like the others.\var2:00\\end\

Sometimes, the vagaries of
lineage and location come
together.\endPage\\end\And a child is born.
One with great powers.\endPage\\end\They are the "gifted ones."\var2:00\\end\

Within their blood lies
the seeds of an incredible,
unknowable power.\endPage\\end\And with the prompting
of circumstance, wondrous
talent can bloom.\var2:00\\end\

Wondrous talent?
How do you mean?\endPage\\end\It's been nothing but
misery for me.\var2:00\\end\

If you know of someone who
-wants- this, by all means,
let me know! It's theirs.\var2:00\\end\

Yet, this is a dream
that cannot be.\endPage\\end\You are what you are,
and none of us may become
that which we are not.\var2:00\\end\

Yet, you can accept what
you are, and in turn, be
accepted.\var2:00\\end\

...I'm sorry I brought
it up. Sorry I thought
you could help.\var2:00\\end\

Should you ever have need
of me, please come again.\var2:00\\end\
Bring Adelle back to her senses!\var2:00\\end\

I came...
I came for the grimoire.
She...she wants it.\endPage\\end\You'll...give it to me?\var2:00\\end\

You don't mean -her-!
That blue-haired Khamja chick!?\var2:00\\end\

It's like that you're
right. She's ensorcelled!
Feh!\var2:00\\end\

What do we do?
I can't give her my
journal, that's for sure.\endPage\\end\And we can't let her
wander around like this!\var2:00\\end\

We've got to find
some way to bring Adelle
back to her senses.\var2:00\\end\

You try talking to her.
The first time might fail,
but the second, or third...\endPage\\end\Better than doing naught.\var2:00\\end\

If it doesn't work, we'll
worry about that then.\endPage\\end\I'll handle the rest of
this lot.\var2:00\\end\

Right.
I'll do what I can.\var2:00\\end\

Hey, Adelle!
Snap out of it!\endPage\\end\Do you even have any idea
what you're doing!?\var2:00\\end\

Yes... The grimoire.
I'm trying to get
the grimoire.\endPage\\end\I told you...
She wants it.\var2:00\\end\

So what? Who cares
what she wants?
Just ignore her!\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 7; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
...Bah!
It's like talking
to a rock!\var2:00\\end\

Hey! Adelle!
Wake up!\endPage\\end\Look, if you go back to normal,
I'll get you anything you want!
S-Some cake, or...or Pepe clothes!\endPage\\end\Hey, how about a zingu pearl!
Anything, I mean it!
Just stop this!\var2:00\\end\

No... I don't want those
things. Just... Just the
grimoire...\var2:00\\end\

There's nothing to talk
about. The grimoire...
give it to me.\var2:00\\end\

Why are you all obsessed
about that book, anyway!?
She's just using you!\endPage\\end\Don't you remember what
Khamja did to us? Huh?\var2:00\\end\

I... Did I...
forget something?\endPage\\end\No. There is nothing
else. Nothing...\var2:00\\end\

Wait, do you remember anything
at all!? C'mon, anything!?\endPage\\end\All those adventures...
And how you ripped Cid and me

Th-This...

I get t-to choose how...\endPage\\end\I t-told you...
I'm n-not helping
Kh-Khamja!!!\var2:00\\end\

I'm n-not helping
Kh-Khamja!!!\var2:00\\end\

She's sleeping.\endPage\\end\But I think she's back
to the old Adelle.\var2:00\\end\

When you leave a clan,
you don't do it halfway,
do you, Adelle?\endPage\\end\Nice move, getting
possessed by that
Khamja chick.\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
Then again, you probably
deserved it, after stealing
Cid's money.\endPage\\end\But you know Cid. He talks
scary, but on the inside,
he's all warm and fuzzy.\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
He'll take you back.
We'll all take you back.\endPage\\end\C'mon, let's go.\var2:00\\end\

...Are you out of your mind?
Who said anything about
going back with you?\var2:00\\end\

I...I'm going to go it
alone. I don't need
friends, \varA:00\.\endPage\\end\They're just...baggage.
They slow me down.\var2:00\\end\

So why'd you join the
clan in the first place?\endPage\\end\And why'd you stay?\var2:00\\end\

Admit it: you had fun!\endPage\\end\I don't see why you
have to leave.\var2:00\\end\

Oh, you don't understand
anything!\endPage\\end\You saw me in that battle
just now? You saw my power!\endPage\\end\...Power enough to make
Khamja want me.\var2:00\\end\

I'm not like you.
I'm not normal.\endPage\\end\I live in a different
world from you and Cid.\endPage\\end\I can't be with you!
I just can't!\var2:00\\end\

What are you talking about!?
What, is this the reason
for your big sulk?\var2:00\\end\

My bigー
See? You're clueless!
Totally and utterly clueless!\var2:00\\end\

Well, of course I'm clueless!
Duh!\endPage\\end\For one thing, I'm new
to this world, and for
another, I'm not you!\var2:00\\end\

So you're not normal,
you're not like us.
So what!?\endPage\\end\Am I any different?
I mean, I -am- from
another world, y'know!\var2:00\\end\

And who cares? Nobody!
Not Cid, not Hurdy...\endPage\\end\You're just dreaming up
these horrible things in
your head...\endPage\\end\What was that called again?
Narci...sissy...um...
You're full of yourself!\var2:00\\end\

Yow! What'd you do
that for!?\var2:00\\end\

Hey, you hit me first!
I was just getting
you back!\var2:00\\end\

Hmph! This is why I don't
consort with children!\var2:00\\end\

Hey, who's acting like a
spoiled brat here?\endPage\\end\You pretend to be all that,
but in the end you're just
all talk. Hah!\var2:00\\end\

Look, figure it out for
yourself. I'm out of here.\var2:00\\end\

And...you're not coming
with me, are you?\endPage\\end\Shame. It's...too quiet
without you around. Makes
it hard to concentrate.\var2:00\\end\

I hear the Crest of the Four
was stolen from Viscount
Minymum's manse!\var2:00\\end\

Sounds like the work
of those folks from
the east...\endPage\\end\The dread sky pirates
Vaan and Penelo!\var2:00\\end\

Aye, the very same.
They laid low after the
botched assassination...\endPage\\end\Guess that didn't last long!
They're stealing everything
what's not nailed down!\var2:00\\end\

Fafnir's Tear, the
Glimmering Wyrmstone,
and now the Crest...\endPage\\end\Gems, all of them.
Guess they fancy that
sort of thing?\var2:00\\end\

Makes you wonder what
they'll go for next.\var2:00\\end\

You don't know? It's the
Black Cat, for sure. That
thing's covered in jewels!\endPage\\end\They even did the ownerー
one Lord Edenーthe service
of warning him!\var2:00\\end\

Which leads to that bill
in the pub requesting the
capture of them pirates!\var2:00\\end\

Huh, sounds like those
two are up to their
old tricks.\endPage\\end\So that means, if I were
to take that quest...I'd
be going up against them.\var2:00\\end\

And if I know you, you
can't wait for the chance!
You're so transparent.\var2:00\\end\

Hey, so I want to see who're
the better fighters?
Is that so wrong?\var2:00\\end\

If you ask me,
they're more trouble
than they're worth.\var2:00\\end\

Adelle...\endPage\\end\You met with that blue-haired
chick from Khamja, right?
She tell you anything?\var2:00\\end\

Nothing.
Or, I just forgot it.\endPage\\end\If you're curious, why not
ask Cid? He seems awfully
well informed about them.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\We're off to an outfitter
of my acquaintance to look
at a new cape!\var2:00\\end\

A cape...?
But you don't wear
capes, do you, Adelle?\var2:00\\end\

G-Got to keep my finger
on current trends!\endPage\\end\Look, \varA:00\,
why don't you go and find out about
those sky pirates, and leave us be?\var2:00\\end\

Yeah. Hurdy said something
about a cape...\var2:00\\end\

Ah ha, a cape!
Heh heh heh... A cape!\var2:00\\end\

If you mean some jest by
this, I'll have you know
I see no humor...\var2:00\\end\

Cid, if I were you, I'd wait
a while before buying yourself
a new cape.\var2:00\\end\

Well then, maybe I'll
see about these sky pirates.
Catch you around!\var2:00\\end\

Well, if they're true
to their word, they'll
be here soon.\var2:00\\end\

Hark! What yon personage doth
mine eyes see over yonder?\endPage\\end\Alas! I fear 'tis true!
The questers have become
the questees!\var2:00\\end\

Verily and forsooth!
Methinks our word-of-mouth
hath grown wings!\endPage\\end\Ooh, Vaan! Dost thou think
that mayhaps, we art marked!?\var2:00\\end\

Um...\endPage\\end\Why are you both
talking like that?\var2:00\\end\

Shew me an olde skye pirate
that dost not talk so, and
I'll shew you... Waitー!\endPage\\end\We're not actually olde,
mindeth you. That was
just a figure of speech.\var2:00\\end\

Less pontifaction and
more action, say I!
Out of our ways!\var2:00\\end\

Yay, mine nose doth
wrinkle at their land-
lubbing stench, o Vaan.\endPage\\end\Let us do for them
and be done with them
at once, posthaste!\var2:00\\end\

All right.
Who are you guys?\var2:00\\end\

No! The question is:
who art you, ham-planks!?
Shanks! I meant shanks!\var2:00\\end\

Only artless swine such
as thine...er, thee...
wouldn'st know Vaan and Penelo!\endPage\\end\Haven'st thou not seen our
names writ large on...large
pieces of paper?\var2:00\\end\

Vaan and Penelo?
You're kidding me.\var2:00\\end\

Nay, 'tis I, Vaan! Swiftest
sky pirate in all Ivalice!\endPage\\end\'Twere this a play, I'd
be leading man!\var2:00\\end\

If this is a play,
the acting's terrible.\var2:00\\end\

Change of plans, babe.
When the going gets rough,
the rough get lost.\var2:00\\end\

What!? You're just
giving up on the jewels?\var2:00\\end\

You want to go to the
brig so sorely, be
my guest.\var2:00\\end\

Prison? You must have me
mistaken for someone without
her own interests at heart.\var2:00\\end\

Ah, "wait." As if that's ever
stopped a fleeing pirate.\endPage\\end\Hmm?\var2:00\\end\

Hmph.
I have to admit, I like
the way they're dressed.\var2:00\\end\

Oh, lovely. It's the
last people I wanted
to see: us.\var2:00\\end\

Impostors are thick on the
ground these days.
They give us a bad name.\endPage\\end\The jewel thieves I can live
with. It's the ones that steal
from old ladies...*sigh*\var2:00\\end\

It's all on account of
that business with
Baron Beltorey.\var2:00\\end\

And what's all this about
the "swiftest sky pirate"?\var2:00\\end\

Not yet.\endPage\\end\Oh, I'll get there
soon enough, mind you.\var2:00\\end\

Well, either way, it's gotta
be nice being so popular
you have impersonators.\var2:00\\end\

I try not to worry too much
about what others choose to do.
But impersonation has its risk.\endPage\\end\We're not entirely without
enemies, after all.\var2:00\\end\

True, true.\endPage\\end\You can probably add one
more to that list, too.\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 8; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
Er, it's nothing.
Just sky pirate talk.\var2:00\\end\

Still, I'm glad these impostors
turned out to be small fry.\var2:00\\end\

And you being here helped,
to be sure.\var2:00\\end\

Actually, I came here
because I thought I'd
be going up against you.\var2:00\\end\

Well, we'll just have
to take a rain check
on that one.\var2:00\\end\

Busy schedule and all.
Pirating is a lot of work
you know.\var2:00\\end\

I trust you'll turn those
impostors in for us.\var2:00\\end\

Ah... Almost forgot.\endPage\\end\Since we've come all this
way, we'll be taking the
Black Cat with us.\var2:00\\end\

I'm sure our paths will
cross again. Soon.\var2:00\\end\

Grr...! You bring
that back! Hey!\var2:00\\end\

Actually, I have done
quite a lot, now that
I think about it.\endPage\\end\Not like I've gone out and
defeated the Lord of Darkness
or anything...\endPage\\end\But, it's been pretty cool.
Heh.\var2:00\\end\

I mean, this journal
started off practically
blank!\var2:00\\end\

Your future was a blank
slate, so to speak.\endPage\\end\Not that it's carven in
stone, now.\var2:00\\end\

Yeah, but I kind of like
it that way.\endPage\\end\I'm looking forward to
seeing how it turns out.\endPage\\end\Seeing what happens.\var2:00\\end\

It may yet be that you never
return home, \varA:00\...
You know this?\var2:00\\end\

Yeah...
But I'm not really
so worried after all.\endPage\\end\I guess I think it'll
all work itself out
somehow.\endPage\\end\At least I don't have
to go it alone, right?\var2:00\\end\

And that fool confidence
may well be your strength.\var2:00\\end\

Barman!
Some gedegg soup, if you don't
mind. And breadーthe hard stuff.\var2:00\\end\

Didn't you just take everyone
out to lunch?\endPage\\end\You went to that favorite
restaurant of yours, right?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Ate a big, big lunch,
too, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

We young lasses need
our energy, you know.\endPage\\end\I'm not lazy like this
old fogy yet.\var2:00\\end\

Watch who you call lazy,
lass.\endPage\\end\I wolfed through enough
hearty meals in my day.\endPage\\end\Illua kept me busy with
Khamja work, after all.\var2:00\\end\

Cid, can I ask why
you left Khamja?\var2:00\\end\

Organizations like thatー
they're not for me.\endPage\\end\It struck me one day.
The rules, the in-fightingー
it's all rubbish.\var2:00\\end\

You expected something more
inspiring? Romantic ideals,
perhaps?\var2:00\\end\

I'm more practical than that.
I've simple needs, that
simply weren't met.\endPage\\end\So I wheedled my way out,
and just when I thought
I was free...bang.\var2:00\\end\

I would've been happy
to die there.\endPage\\end\It would have made
little difference.\endPage\\end\But, as I lay there, dazed,
watering the dirt with my
blood, along he came...\var2:00\\end\

It's queer, but when I saw
the gleam off that silver helm,
suddenly, I wanted to live.\endPage\\end\My lips moved, and before I knew
it, I was croaking for help.\var2:00\\end\

So you almost died,
and were saved...\endPage\\end\And decided to devote
your life to a clan.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Guess what the barman
just told me, kupo.\endPage\\end\\varE:02\Another bill's come in
asking for our clan!\var2:00\\end\

Let's check it out.\endPage\\end\I've been wanting to settle
the score with her anyway.\endPage\\end\And something tells me,
I'll never get to the end
of my story until I do.\var2:00\\end\

I've a score to settle
with her myself.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\It's a request to take part
in a ceremony, kupo...\endPage\\end\\varE:03\And it's from you-know-who...
Kupo-po!\var2:00\\end\

Rather gloomy place for
a ceremony.\var2:00\\end\

I knew you'd come,
all the same.\var2:00\\end\

A completion, lady hunter.
The finishing of my storyー
the grimoire.\var2:00\\end\

I thought long and hard on
what was required to give
my story a fitting conclusion.\endPage\\end\Then I realized all that was
needed was a foeーan archrival,
if you willーto vanquish.\endPage\\end\Standard heroic fare,
don't you agree?\var2:00\\end\

And then this triumphant
hero would rule the land
as emperor, I suppose?\var2:00\\end\

And why not, when that
is the path I must walk?
My heart's true desire?\endPage\\end\I -am- the hero of this
tale, after all. A story
needs only one.\var2:00\\end\

You...you are merely
the chorus.\endPage\\end\Do not deceive yourselves
into believing you are
anything more.\var2:00\\end\

Funny, that's not what my
story says.\var2:00\\end\

...The story is already in
motion. Let us begin!\var2:00\\end\

Ishmi iye yarm vil...\endPage\\end\Know my power, hear
my command! Loose these
cursed constraints!\var2:00\\end\

Ezel's card!
It worked!\endPage\\end\That should keep her sticky
paws off our judge!\var2:00\\end\
