source_text:
Hrmm? It's over, Illua.
Admit it.\var2:00\\end\

Faros keos...
Deh bhanda zorda...
Lamd feorio...\endPage\\end\I have forged a pact
with Zomala, God of Time.\endPage\\end\I have compassed time and space,
navigated nothingness and every
shade of reality...\endPage\\end\Zomala, open your gates
unto me!\var2:00\\end\

It's a pretty good read,
too. Lots of supporting
characters.\endPage\\end\You could say we all kind
of wrote it together.\endPage\\end\So don't think I'm ready
to toss it just because
you like your story more!\var2:00\\end\

Jagd...
Zellea, the Forbidden Land,
no less.\var2:00\\end\

Illua is going to use
the rift's power whether
the rift wishes it or no.\var2:00\\end\

Either way, we don't have
time to hang out here!\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 7; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
\varE:01\Y-You're crying, kupo?
Are you hurt!?\endPage\\end\\varE:00\Wait here, I'll call Cid
and \varA:00\ back!\var2:00\\end\

I...I'll be fine.\endPage\\end\Don't call them,
please?\var2:00\\end\

I was just thinking,
once this is done, once
we win...he's leaving.\endPage\\end\And, I don't know,
I just felt like crying.
Hah! Stupid me...stupid!\var2:00\\end\

Really, just forget
about it, please.\var2:00\\end\

Hey!
What's taking you so long?\var2:00\\end\

Ishmi iye yarm vil...
Know my power, hear
my command!\endPage\\end\Loose these cursed constraints
and bind instead this judge!\var2:00\\end\

Alas, all is not yet
ready. Not until the
final battle is fought.\endPage\\end\Then, only then, will the
grimoire be complete.\var2:00\\end\

And you expect us to
go along with this!?\var2:00\\end\

Oh, it matters not
what you do, boy.
The magick will work.\var2:00\\end\

Whether I prevail or fall,
the grimoire will record
the truth of my life.\endPage\\end\It is not I, but the book
that will open the rift.\var2:00\\end\

Calm yourself,
\varA:00\.\endPage\\end\If the rift opens,
we'll just close it again.\var2:00\\end\

We've found it best
not to underestimate
\varA:00\.\endPage\\end\Haven't we, Cid?\var2:00\\end\

Wise words. You'd do well
to heed them, Illua.\var2:00\\end\

Leave your doubt behind,
\varA:00\. We won't
need it where we're going.\endPage\\end\You know your power
is the greater here.\var2:00\\end\

Maybe it is hard for you
to see this yourself...\endPage\\end\...but you possess strengths
beyond what you know.\endPage\\end\Strengths people like me and
Illua discarded long ago...
To our loss.\var2:00\\end\

Your future, too, is a blank
slateーlike the remaining
pages of your book.\endPage\\end\Have you ever feared, even
for a moment, what those
pages might hold? No.\var2:00\\end\

You go on ahead, into the
unknown, never slowing.\endPage\\end\It is something we could
never do.\var2:00\\end\

If that rift opens,
I'll close it.
We'll close it!\var2:00\\end\
Why would I worry?\endPage\\end\In the end, I win.\var2:00\\end\

You reap what you sow,
Illua. To think, we were
once comrades.\var2:00\\end\

You must have known,
Cid.\endPage\\end\You must have known
I'd follow when you left
us... Khamja.\var2:00\\end\

Did I not invite you
to join me?\var2:00\\end\

And I refused, as you
knew I would. We walk
different paths.\endPage\\end\Mine leads to the
summit of power.It always has.\var2:00\\end\

It was nice reminiscing,
Cid, but the time for talk
is past.\var2:00\\end\

Heh...
Pity me, Cid...\endPage\\end\Power...
Power is all I am.\var2:00\\end\

Power shaped me.\endPage\\end\Power sought me,
and I sought it...
Always...\var2:00\\end\

I feel it coming...
Time... Time is over.\var2:00\\end\

I no longer need a stone
to bind your judge...
So great is my power!\var2:00\\end\

Ishmi iye yarm vil...\endPage\\end\Know my power, hear
my command! Loose these
cursed constraints!\var2:00\\end\

Ezel's card!
It worked!\endPage\\end\That should keep her sticky
paws off our judge!\var2:00\\end\

Whoa... I'm not so
sure about this!\var2:00\\end\

Well, when in doubt,
fight, I guess!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\K-Kupo! Is running for our
lives sounding like a really
good idea, or is it just me?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\*gulp* Kupo...
Don't worry, I won't
run on you guys.\endPage\\end\\varE:00\Somebody has to play the
victory fanfare when we win,
right, kupo?\var2:00\\end\

What are you so scared
of, Hurdy?\endPage\\end\You didn't think we'd
finish this without getting
our hands dirty, did you?\var2:00\\end\

Hey, go easy on him.
I'm not doing so well
myself.\var2:00\\end\

Awh, you've nothing to
worry about! I'm here,
aren't I?\endPage\\end\Let's just get this done
with, shall we?\var2:00\\end\

Okay! Here goes!!!\endPage\\end\If anyone's gonna give
this story a happy ending,
it had better be me!\var2:00\\end\

Brings back old times,
huh, Penelo?\var2:00\\end\

The fight against the
Empire...our adventures
in Lemurés...\var2:00\\end\

I gotta say, we did pretty
good, considering what we
were up against.\var2:00\\end\

We make a good team,
that's why.\var2:00\\end\

You know, Vaan.
We should go back to Dalmasca
when things settle down again.\var2:00\\end\

I knew there was a reason
we were partners!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\All right, time to give that
monster some moogle mayhem
it won't forget, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:01\On second thought...\endPage\\end\\varE:02\I should probably stay back
to help out everyone else.
Yes, definitely, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Kupo-po! Actually, maybe
I will jump in there, kupo!
Offense is the best defense!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\\varA:00\!
Tell me what to do, kupo!!!\var2:00\\end\

Don't get so confident
you run out ahead of
your support, \varA:00\.\var2:00\\end\

Don't kid yourself.
The vagaries of battle aren't
novelties to me, boy.\var2:00\\end\

I've seen a lot in my days
is what it means.\endPage\\end\Too much to make
mistakes easily.\var2:00\\end\

Things are never boring
with you around.\endPage\\end\My first impression was
spot on.\var2:00\\end\

What, so you joined the clan
for a little excitement?\var2:00\\end\

What better reason
could there be?\endPage\\end\I certainly didn't join just
to low along with the herd!\var2:00\\end\

Hey, don't knock the herd.
Other people are what
keep things interesting.\var2:00\\end\

Ha! The old me would never
have agreed with that.
The new me? ...Grudgingly.\var2:00\\end\

All right...
Now how the heck do
I fight this thing?\var2:00\\end\

Guess I'll go for that
white spot of light.\endPage\\end\It's right in the middle
so it has to be important!\var2:00\\end\

It moved again!
Man, this is annoying.\var2:00\\end\

Okay, the white light's
out of commission!\var2:00\\end\

This thing's power
is so far beyond anything
I've seen here...\endPage\\end\...It'll make beating it
that much more satisfying!\var2:00\\end\

Right, now we can attack
from both sides!\var2:00\\end\

Wait a second...
Maybe that white light has
something to do with this.\endPage\\end\I'd better deal with
that first!\var2:00\\end\

Wh-What was that!?\endPage\\end\If that thing hits me,
I'm done for!\endPage\\end\There has to be a way
to stop it...but how!?\var2:00\\end\
The dark energies begin to fade...\var2:00\\end\
The Neukhia Core braces itself against attacks!\var2:00\\end\
The Neukhia Core goes on the offensive!\endPage\\end\The Core paling fades!\var2:00\\end\

I guess I owe you
thanks for a lot,
too, Your Honor.\var2:00\\end\

Wow, these clothes
seem so...so strange.\endPage\\end\I kinda got used to the
stuff you wear here.\var2:00\\end\

Heh, yeah, a little.\endPage\\end\But I've made up my mind.
I'm going home.\var2:00\\end\

Oh hey, Cid.
Just curious, but...\endPage\\end\...have you heard anything
about what's up with Khamja
now that Illua's gone?\var2:00\\end\

I spoke with an old friend
about just that the other
day...\endPage\\end\They were shaken, yes,
but not broken.\var2:00\\end\

It has nothing to
do with me now.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\I wrote a song for
you, \varA:00\.\endPage\\end\\varE:02\I just finished
it, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:00\I wanted you to hear
it before you left...\var2:00\\end\

You have time enough for
a song, don't you?\endPage\\end\It's not like anyone
is expecting you to
show up.\var2:00\\end\

A bit too good for the
likes of \varA:00\,
if you ask me.\var2:00\\end\

\varA:00\,
you know the words that
must end this?\var2:00\\end\

Don't worry.
There's only one way
to end a story.\var2:00\\end\

\varA:00\ Clemens.\endPage\\end\How did you find your
adventures in Ivalice?\var2:00\\end\

Fun... I can't believe
how much fun I had.
And meeting all of you...\var2:00\\end\

Though you may not see
it with your eyes, your
time here has changed you.\var2:00\\end\

I think, even if I forget
everything that happened here
when I go back home...\endPage\\end\...my adventures here will
always be a part of me.\var2:00\\end\

No matter where your path
may lead, heed your heart,
be true to yourself.\var2:00\\end\

Thank you, everyone.
Thanks so much!\var2:00\\end\

Go. And don't give your
aunt any more cause for
concern.\var2:00\\end\

Sorry, \varA:00\.
I found a few more
papers to grade, andー\var2:00\\end\

Up and at it,
\varA:00\!\endPage\\end\This is a library,
not a dormitory!\var2:00\\end\

Mr. Randell!
I...I just had the most
amazing adventure!\endPage\\end\I was in another world!
I-Ivalice! It was called
Ivalice!\var2:00\\end\

I did so many things!
Fighting monsters,
riding airships...!\var2:00\\end\

Mr. Randell...?
I'm not making this up!\var2:00\\end\

You see, I've been
there too.\var2:00\\end\

A world of swords...and
magick. It was a long
time ago.\var2:00\\end\

You can go home now.
Don't worry about
cleaning up today.\endPage\\end\You wouldn't want to waste
your summer vacation in here.\var2:00\\end\

Whoa...I didn't realize
how late it was.\endPage\\end\My aunt's gonna
kill me.\var2:00\\end\

Um, guess I'll head
home then.\var2:00\\end\

This notebook...doesn't
it belong to you?\var2:00\\end\

Thanks, Mr. Randell.
Um, see you later!\var2:00\\end\

There, that's good enough
for yesterday's entry.\var6:FF\\end\

Wonder what today's got in
store for me...\var6:FF\\end\

...You seem much more
at ease, my child.\var2:00\\end\

What, do they teach mind
reading in wizard school?\var2:00\\end\

You're right though.\endPage\\end\I've decided to accept that
I'm, well, one of the Gifted.
See how it fits me.\var2:00\\end\

You would. But I'm not
doing this for you.\var2:00\\end\

I want to be stronger.
Strong enough to look
after myself.\endPage\\end\...But not just myself.
I want to be strong enough to look
after the people around me too.\var2:00\\end\

Huh! I sound like a real
goodie-goodie, don't I?\var2:00\\end\

As you wish it,
so shall it be.\var2:00\\end\

There is a power that
only the Gifted may claim.\var2:00\\end\

What little I know was told
me by another of your kind,
long ago. A gentleman.\var2:00\\end\

You have surprising friends.
Suppose it comes with being
a wizard, eh?\var2:00\\end\

This man...
Where is he now?\var2:00\\end\

Who knows?
He chose a different
path than yours.\endPage\\end\He may well have passed
on by now.\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 7; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
You...could seek him out
though, if you wished it.\endPage\\end\Were you to find him,
he could aid you greatly.\var2:00\\end\

That's putting a lot of
faith in someone you don't
even think's alive.\var2:00\\end\

Thanks for the tip.
Maybe I'll go look up
this Lennart fellow...\var2:00\\end\

Just look at all
the stars!\var2:00\\end\

Whaddaya say we take
a little break?\var2:00\\end\

What's got into you?
Can't a guy relax for a
couple minutes?\var2:00\\end\

Looking at all these stars
just makes me think...\var2:00\\end\

It's not easy tracking down
one person out of all the people
out there.\endPage\\end\I'd been hoping we'd chance
upon him in the course of a
quest, but what are the odds?\var2:00\\end\

You mean Lennart? The one
who's supposed to know the
power of the Gifted Ones?\endPage\\end\He's an old friend of
Lezaford's, isn't he?\var2:00\\end\

Supposedly. I'm not really
certain.\endPage\\end\All I know is that
they met long ago.\var2:00\\end\

I wonder what he's
like...\endPage\\end\Lezaford's nice enough,
but ya never know.\var2:00\\end\

Something tells me
he's not like Lezaford
at all.\var2:00\\end\

Lezaford...
That name certainly
brings back memories.\endPage\\end\He still lives after
all these years?\var2:00\\end\

Him!? Look how young he is!
An old friend of Lezaford's
would have to be -really- old.\var2:00\\end\

He's...different from ordinary
people. Isn't that right?\var2:00\\end\

And this does not
surprise you?\var2:00\\end\

You wish to discover
your "instincts," yes?\var2:00\\end\

Is that what you
call the power of
the Gifted Ones?\endPage\\end\I don't really know
any more than that...
but I'd like to learn.\var2:00\\end\

And you shall.
Come with me.\var2:00\\end\

You have no Gift.
Your place is not
with us.\var2:00\\end\

Thanks for coming with
me, but I'll be okay.
Head back without me.\var2:00\\end\

Are you crazy? You think
you can just say "run along"
and I'll go marching off?\var2:00\\end\

If you won't let me come
with you, I'm going to wait
right here till you get back!\var2:00\\end\

Then I'll see you
back here.\endPage\\end\Don't worry, I'll try
not to be too long.\var2:00\\end\

Now I will test
your power.\endPage\\end\I must know whether
you are worthy of your
latent instincts.\var2:00\\end\

Give me a chance...
I'll prove my worth.\var2:00\\end\

I told you: I don't need
you to come with me.\var2:00\\end\

Quit the tough guy act.
I saw you when you came
back after the last time.\var2:00\\end\

I'll be all right.
I've got a score to
settle.\var2:00\\end\

Well, just be careful.
I'll be waiting right
here for you, okay?\var2:00\\end\

I did not think
to see you again.\var2:00\\end\

I've never been the
type to give up easily.\var2:00\\end\

Your brave words
belie your weakness.\endPage\\end\What good, giving you a
power you could not even
control?\var2:00\\end\

Perhaps it were better you
stopped seeking that power
altogether.\var2:00\\end\

I told you...
I never give up!\var2:00\\end\

Then return to me when
you think you are ready.
The way will be open to you.\var2:00\\end\

Over already?
If there's another test,
let's get on with it.\var2:00\\end\

Wouldn't do to keep
my friend waiting now,
would it?\var2:00\\end\

You think he still waits?
It's nearly dawn.\var2:00\\end\

He'll be there,
I know it. I know -him-.\var2:00\\end\

Tell me one thing:
why have you chosen
a life of solitude?\endPage\\end\There are people who
care for you who would
take you in.\var2:00\\end\

It is -because- there are
people who care for me that
I walk alone.\var2:00\\end\

I could not bear to lose
someone close to me.\var2:00\\end\

Look at me. I am not like
others. Time's fire leaves
no mark on me.\var2:00\\end\

There are some who cannot
accept me for what I am.
They leave, and all is well.\endPage\\end\It is far worse with those
who stay. I must watch as
they grow old...and die.\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 7; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
Oh, I might meet new
friends to replace the old.\endPage\\end\But I no longer have
the courage to face what
must always come again.\var2:00\\end\

And so I choose
to remain alone.\var2:00\\end\

Not an easy
decision.\endPage\\end\And not the one
I mean to make.\var2:00\\end\

You are an intriguing
young woman.\var2:00\\end\

Very well.
I will impart to you
these "instincts."\var2:00\\end\

I feel...strange.
Like someone's writing
something inside my head.\var2:00\\end\

The very fact we are different
creates a wall between us and
the rest.\endPage\\end\So long as you choose discourse
with them, that difference will
bring you only suffering.\endPage\\end\Yet if this is your choice,
embrace it.\var2:00\\end\

Do not regret that choice.
Walk with pride.\var2:00\\end\

You should go now.
Return where you belong.\var2:00\\end\

-You're- exhausted!?
Do you know how long I've
been waiting for you?\var2:00\\end\

I've been fighting for
my life, and that's all
you've got to say?\var2:00\\end\

I didn't even ask
you to wait for me.\var2:00\\end\

What, I was supposed
to walk away and leave
you? Not likely.\endPage\\end\I couldn't let you down.
You were counting on me!\var2:00\\end\

Did you hear what
we were talking about?\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 8; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
Come on, let's get
going. I'm starved.\endPage\\end\I could go for something
really rich. Maybe some
kelb kebabs.\var2:00\\end\

Now that you mention it,
I am kinda hungry too.\var2:00\\end\

Me? Smug?
I'm just glad to be
heading back is all.\var2:00\\end\

Yeah, I could hear you.
Must've been something
Lennart did.\var2:00\\end\

That meddling, no goodー
What was he thinking!?\var2:00\\end\

No matter what you say,
the clan really means
something to you, huh!\var2:00\\end\

\varA:00\!\endPage\\end\I'd choose my next words
carefully if I were you.
They may be your last!\var2:00\\end\

*Ahem*
Perhaps I might convince you
to stop right there.\var2:00\\end\

It is not my custom to extend
a hand to one so...unfeminine,
butー\var2:00\\end\

A member of Clan \varA:01\,
are you not?\var2:00\\end\

So bound was I by the enchantment
your beauty weaves, I neglected my
introductions.\var2:00\\end\

The flower that blooms rich
and full is stunning indeed.\endPage\\end\More enticing still is the fragrant
bud...and the sweet promise of
unsavored delights. Ah...ambrosia!\var2:00\\end\

It seems you already know
who we are, but I'll introduce
us all the same.\var2:00\\end\

I'm Adelle.\endPage\\end\And the one who ran into you
and fell on his behind is
\varA:00\.\var2:00\\end\

Just my name would have
been enough.\var2:00\\end\

So, you were looking for
someone from our clan?
Why?\var2:00\\end\

...though it gives me much
pain to make such a request
to one I've only just met...\endPage\\end\...I hoped you might be willing
to deliver this letter to
a particular person.\var2:00\\end\

Nay, in fact it is
a most simple task.\var2:00\\end\

And how would you know
that? I mean, we only
just met!\var2:00\\end\

My little birds...they tell
me many, many things.\var2:00\\end\

I don't see any little birds.
Look, buddy...\var2:00\\end\

Ah, I was not aware the hour
was...so late.\var2:00\\end\

Well? My proposalー
do you accept?\var2:00\\end\

You will be compensated for
your time, of course.\var2:00\\end\

This whole thing stinks
of a set-up...\var2:00\\end\

Then the fair maiden has
my undying gratitude.\var2:00\\end\

Yes, it seems there is
more to this bloom than
mere beauty.\var2:00\\end\

So...who are we supposed
to give this to?\var2:00\\end\

A pirate of the skies...
One who, I fear, is most
unpunctual.\endPage\\end\His companion, however, is
an enchanting lady beyond
compare...\endPage\\end\Present company excluded,
of course.\var2:00\\end\

The letter, see that it
reaches him.\var2:00\\end\

Man! Talk about an attitude!
I can't stand guys like that.\var2:00\\end\

I can't believe you agreed
toー Wait. He's not
your type, is he?\var2:00\\end\

Oh, he certainly piqued
my interest, if that's
what you mean.\endPage\\end\House Margrace...
Now that's a family I'd
not mind having in my debt.\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 8; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
Anyway, what's this about
an unpunctual sky pirate?\var2:00\\end\
I thought he might mean Vaan.\var2:00\\end\

It's not like we know
any other sky pirates.\var2:00\\end\

You haven't seen Vaan
around here, have you?\var2:00\\end\

Actually, we were sort
of looking for him, too.\var2:00\\end\

Some funky guy gave us
this letter...
I think it's for Vaan.\var2:00\\end\

A letter...?
Do you mind if
I take a look?\var2:00\\end\

This seal...\endPage\\end\The one who gave you
this...he wasn't tall,
with sunglasses...\endPage\\end\...and a little bit of an
attitude, was he?\var2:00\\end\

You're right about the glasses,
but this guy's attitude was
anything but "little."\endPage\\end\What'd he say his name was?
Al-Cid Margrace, or something?\var2:00\\end\

So it -was- Al-Cid...
And he's left already.\var2:00\\end\

Vaan must have completely
forgotten about their meeting.\var2:00\\end\

I wonder where he went...
The keep ruins, maybe?\var2:00\\end\

The ruins? You mean the ones
to the north of the aerodrome?
Want us to help look?\var2:00\\end\

We did promise to deliver
this letter.\var2:00\\end\

And I thought you were
the one who didn't want
to do this.\var2:00\\end\

...Fine, we're in.\endPage\\end\I've a feeling our patron's the
type to skimp on our reward if he
heard we didn't deliver in person.\var2:00\\end\

Well, what are we waiting for?
Let's go find him!\var2:00\\end\
Protect Vaan and defeat all foes!\var2:00\\end\

Letting this stray wander
in on our counsel was a grave
mistake.\var2:00\\end\

Of all the times
to get caught.\var2:00\\end\

This runt?
He won't give us no
trouble!\endPage\\end\Just need me a minute or
two alone with him to...
come to an understandin'.\var2:00\\end\

A pity. I thought the terms
of our agreement with your clan
most favorable, but now...\var2:00\\end\

I've no intention of
listening to your excuses.
Farewell.\var2:00\\end\

I sure hope I didn't
spoil your little get-
together.\var2:00\\end\

Not exactly light on your feet.
I'd go easy on the fodder if
I were you.\var2:00\\end\

Fodder is what you'll
be, boy...\var2:00\\end\

Just the chance
I was waiting for!\var2:00\\end\

Wake up, lazy mongrels!
Got a new toy for you to
chew on!\var2:00\\end\

Have a go at his
friends while you're
at it!\var2:00\\end\

What are you doing
here, anyway?\endPage\\end\And you've even brought
Red Cap with you.\var2:00\\end\

I was looking for you.\endPage\\end\When you weren't where
we were supposed to meet,
I got worried.\var2:00\\end\

I heard some choice
morsels about that group
we've been following.\endPage\\end\I couldn't just sit
back and let a chance
like that slip by.\var2:00\\end\

I know, I know.
Save the scolding for
later, okay?\var2:00\\end\

Phew. I was starting
to think we'd never
get 'em all.\var2:00\\end\

At least everybody's
all right.\endPage\\end\It was touch and go
for a minute there.\var2:00\\end\

It's a good thing
you showed up when you
did. Thanks.\var2:00\\end\

Every time I turn around
you run off and get yourself
into trouble!\endPage\\end\The least you could do is
tell me where you're going or
leave a note or...or something!\var2:00\\end\

Penelo, when are you
going to stop treating
me like a kid?\var2:00\\end\

When you stop acting like one!
You're being reckless, and if you
keep it up you're going to get hurt.\var2:00\\end\

The way I see it, you gotta
be a little reckless if you
wanna get the job done.\var2:00\\end\

Who ever heard of a
cautious sky pirate?\var2:00\\end\

There's a difference between
cautious and...suicidal!\endPage\\end\You could've been
really hurt...or worse.\var2:00\\end\

I guess I did come
out pretty lucky...\var2:00\\end\

Oh, right.
You had something
for Vaan.\var2:00\\end\

A letter.\endPage\\end\It's from a man
named Al-Cid Margrace.\var2:00\\end\

I completely forgot!
I was supposed to meet
up with him.\var2:00\\end\

*sigh* Vaan...\endPage\\end\That letter probably
has the answer we've
been waiting for.\var2:00\\end\

I'd rather have heard
it from him, but this's
better than nothing.\var2:00\\end\

Looks like things
are going to get
reckless again.\var2:00\\end\

"If you wish to learn
more about Khamja...\endPage\\end\"...you would do
well to seek out
Clan \varA:01\."\var2:00\\end\

Vaan, do you know
what this means!?\var2:00\\end\

It means the Fates
are at it again.\var2:00\\end\

What's he got
to do with this?\var2:00\\end\

We kept an ear to the
ground for any word about
the assassination attempt.\var2:00\\end\

Well, it wasn't long
after he recovered that
they caught the assassin.\endPage\\end\But something didn't seem
quite right.\var2:00\\end\

So we did a little poking
around to find out more about
this assassin.\var2:00\\end\

The more we looked,
the less things made
sense.\var2:00\\end\

We knew there was
something going on
behind the scenes.\var2:00\\end\

And guess who we
found waiting in the
wings?\endPage\\end\Khamja.\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 7; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
They keep to the shadows.\endPage\\end\We went to someone used to
looking into these things without
raising suspicion.\var2:00\\end\

If we weren't on their
blacklist before, I think
it's safe to say we are now.\var2:00\\end\

So they're your "one more"
enemy for the list.\var2:00\\end\

It's all starting
to make sense.\var2:00\\end\

Let me guess what your
silver-tongued, bespectacled
informant had to say.\var2:00\\end\

He told you that no one
knew Khamja better than
Clan \varA:01\.\var2:00\\end\

It's all pretty obvious,
when you think about it.\var2:00\\end\

Then you shouldn't have any
trouble figuring out what
we're going to ask you next.\var2:00\\end\

We want you to let us in to
Clan \varA:01\.\var2:00\\end\

Don't worry, you'll hardly
notice we're there.\var2:00\\end\

None of us is exactly on
Khamja's good side, so we
might as well stick together.\var2:00\\end\

It's just a lot to
take in all at once.\var2:00\\end\

Well, let's see what
Cid has to say.\endPage\\end\Something tells me
he'll be happy to have
you with us!\var2:00\\end\

Y'know what, I don't
think we've actually been
properly introduced.\var2:00\\end\

And I'm Vaan.
Nice to meecha!\var2:00\\end\

I'm \varA:00\.
Good to finally put
names to the faces!\var2:00\\end\

The kids let you go,
did they? Looks like
they kept you busy.\var2:00\\end\

Where do they get so much energy?
They must be sipping potions
when I'm not looking.\var2:00\\end\

I think I've had enough
of tag with that lot for
a while.\var2:00\\end\

Hmph. You make out like
it's a big hardship...\var2:00\\end\

...but you've always had
a soft spot for the
little ones, Vaan.\var2:00\\end\
That music...it's not bad.\endPage\\end\Kind of mellow.\var2:00\\end\

It reminds me of the old
days in Rabanastre.\var2:00\\end\

Running around with the
old gang all the time...
We had fun.\var2:00\\end\
I was thinking the same thing.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Kupo? Vaan!
Penelo!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\You...You weren't
listening to my performance,
were you, kupo?\var2:00\\end\

So that was you playing
up there. It was pretty
good, Hurdy!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Kupo... Thanks! That means a
lot to me. My reception wasn't
always so warm, you know.\endPage\\end\\varE:02\People used to throw tomatoes!
And then you'd have to -fight-
the tomatoes...\endPage\\end\\varE:02\I guess my journey in
search of musical inspiration
has paid off, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

Yeah, we'd heard about
that, actually.\endPage\\end\I was pretty surprised to
hear you'd joined up with
Clan \varA:01\.\var2:00\\end\

Looks like they're treating
you fine, at least.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Well, I'm just glad to see
you two looking well, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\I'd hear about your
adventures now and then
through the grapevine.\endPage\\end\\varE:01\Even before I joined
up with \varA:00\ and
the others, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\In a few more years, you two
will be some of the top
pirates in Ivalice, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:01\That reminds me!
Are you two in touch with
Nono at all, kupo?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\I got a letter from him
the other day. He really
misses you two, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

Now that you mention it,
we haven't seen Nono in
a long time, huh.\var2:00\\end\

It's been a while since
we parted ways in Lemurés.\var2:00\\end\

Is he still the chief
machinist on the Strahl?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\No, kupo! He saved up the
gil he made doing that and
built an airship of his own!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\He said she was ready
for her maiden voyage, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

How fast is it?
Faster than the Strahl!?
No way!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\Well, I don't know all
the details, kupo.\endPage\\end\\varE:00\You should really go and see
for yourselves, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

Right.
Maybe we'll fly by there,
sooner rather than later.\var2:00\\end\

You're such a little
boy when it comes to
airships, Vaan.\var2:00\\end\

Don't knock it.
Flying airships is
my job now, remember?\var2:00\\end\

And who doesn't dream of
building their own ship!?\var2:00\\end\

You know, Penelo, we should
hire our own machinist one
of these days.\var2:00\\end\

I mean, we're sky pirates.
We have our reputation to
think of, after all.\var2:00\\end\

Reputation...that's right!
We need a full time machinist!
He could teach me stuff...\var2:00\\end\

Have you forgotten how hard
it was just buying our ship?
Now you want to hire help!?\var2:00\\end\

If we had that much gil lying
around, I can think of a few
things I'd want before that.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:01\Well...if you can't
afford a machinist, how
about a bard, kupo?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Act now and I'll give you
a special friend price!\var2:00\\end\

First a dancer, now
a bard...?\var2:00\\end\

We're sky pirates,
not a chorus line!\var2:00\\end\

Oh, you know you wouldn't
have it any other way.\var2:00\\end\

*sigh* Guess there's nothing
to do but put our noses to the
grindstone and make some gil.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\No substitute for hard
work, I say, kupo!\var2:00\\end\

Who do you think you're
talking to!?\var2:00\\end\

All right, where'd that
scum slink off to?\var2:00\\end\

The foreman at the
Craftsmoogles' League is
saying you ripped him off!\var2:00\\end\
Meh. This is hardly the time...\var2:00\\end\

Ripped off?
I'll not have you besmirch
my name, stranger.\var2:00\\end\

I did the work I was
paid to do.
\var2:00\\end\

Well, why don't you come
and tell that to the
foreman?\endPage\\end\I, for one, would love to
hear how a 20,000 gil hammer
-isn't- a rip-off.\var2:00\\end\

We'll escort you back
to town.\var2:00\\end\

So that's how it's going to be!
Boys, we'll find that scum
after we deal with this lot!\var2:00\\end\

Nnggh...
I'm telling you, there's
bigger fish to fry than me.\var2:00\\end\

Come now, pick your snout up.
Walk straight.\var2:00\\end\

Sooner or later, you get
what's comin' to you.\var2:00\\end\

Truer words have ne'er
been spoke!\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 13 exceeds original allocation 10; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
Wh-Who're you!?
One of that alchemist's cronies!?\var2:00\\end\

No, no, quite the opposite.
They were after me, you see.\endPage\\end\I saw you capture them,
and thought I might speak
with you.\var2:00\\end\

Ezel Berbier's the name.
You've done me a great
service.\var2:00\\end\

Yes, erm...perhaps I've
ought with which I kin
repay you.\var2:00\\end\

Huh? Hey, no, don't worry
about it.
\var2:00\\end\

Ah, yer clan is adjudged,
eh? In that case, I've just
the thing 'ere!\var2:00\\end\

It is a protection...
a ward for yer judge.\var2:00\\end\

There are those of less
reputable natures who'd
filch away a clan's judge.\var2:00\\end\

I can have this?
You're sure?\var2:00\\end\

Of course. I did craft it
fer a client, but seeing as
you've just appre'ended him...\var2:00\\end\

He could hardly hope to
make it hisself. So he
hires me...then doesn't pay.\var2:00\\end\

So I asks him for 80,000,
straight up.\var2:00\\end\

That card right there's the
only thing in this world'll
stop anything comin' at a judge.\endPage\\end\Physical or magickal.\var2:00\\end\

It's one-of-a-kind.
My price was a bargain.\var2:00\\end\

Wait...so you're giving me
this card? ...For free?\var2:00\\end\

Ah, worried there might
be a catch, eh? If ye don't
need it, I won't force ye...\var2:00\\end\

Well, I'd best be on me way.\endPage\\end\Would love to chat,
but time's a scarce
commodity these days.\var2:00\\end\

Aye, it's tough when you've
genius o' my caliber. Every
lord in the land wants ye.\var2:00\\end\

A 20,000 gil hammer, or a
80,000 gil card...\endPage\\end\I can't decide which
is the bigger rip-off!\var2:00\\end\

Ah! He shows himself
at last!\var2:00\\end\

Ladies, there are many
stories I would share with
you...and more. Next time.\var2:00\\end\

You are...a goddess, sent down
to this world.\endPage\\end\How is it that, even left
untended for months, you grow
into such an enchanting bloom?\var2:00\\end\

Al-Cid. Your tongue is as
skilled as ever, I see.\var2:00\\end\

It does not require skill
to speak the truth.\var2:00\\end\

So, what's up?
You've come a long way just
to chat up my partner.\var2:00\\end\

Truth be told, I desired
respite from my affairs.
A diversion, shall we say.\var2:00\\end\

Work has been most
demanding of late.\endPage\\end\Normally, I sleep like a
babe, but they barely give
me time to close my eyes!\var2:00\\end\

And then came this sky
pirate, demanding I do
some "research" for him.\var2:00\\end\

So I do it. But when I go
to the appointed place,
at the appointed time...\endPage\\end\...he is nowhere to be found!\var2:00\\end\

So, we do not meet.\endPage\\end\Having no recourse,
I ask another to carry
my report to him.\var2:00\\end\

I'm sorry we weren't
able to send word...\var2:00\\end\

Sorry we're a little
late in thanking you.\var2:00\\end\

But...thanks.
You really came through
for us, Al-Cid.\var2:00\\end\

Ah, then I was of some
use after all. This is
good to hear.\var2:00\\end\

So, we've been spending our
free time with these Clan
\varA:01\ folks.\var2:00\\end\

It's been good, hasn't
it, Penelo. We've learned
a lot from them.\var2:00\\end\

Hey, we're glad to have
the company.\var2:00\\end\

I believe we have not
yet met.\endPage\\end\Al-Cid Margrace,
at your service.\var2:00\\end\

\varA:00\ has told
me much about you.\var2:00\\end\

I am pleased to see you
getting along so famously
with my pirate friends.\var2:00\\end\

My struggles to bring
you together were not
in vain, it seems.\var2:00\\end\

No, no thanks, please.\endPage\\end\I merely performed that
which was required of me.\var2:00\\end\

Yet, if you find that you cannot
rest until you have repaid me in
some small way, I will understand.\endPage\\end\Perhaps you would even take the
time to listen to my trifling
little problem.\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
Though it shames me to say so,
my affairs have not all been
in order, of late.\endPage\\end\In fact, should present
trends continue, things
could get quite...ugly.\var2:00\\end\

I thought to make myself
scarce a while and allow the
world to order itself anew.\endPage\\end\But I could not find a
suitable place to do so.\var2:00\\end\

Perhaps, if it was not
too much of a burden,
I could...join your clan?\var2:00\\end\

You want to...
You mean...
Um, Cid?\var2:00\\end\

Sorry, but our clan isn't
exactly set up to receive
gentlemen of leisure.\var2:00\\end\

Again, no cause for concern!\endPage\\end\I have no intention of
being a powdered guest
in your halls, sir.\var2:00\\end\

If there is need, I would be
happy to lend my considerable
talents at marksmanship.\var2:00\\end\

I won't have you injuring
yourself on my watch.\var2:00\\end\

Death...this would be a
problem. But I am no stranger
to cuts and bruises.\endPage\\end\And you do have a judge
amongst your ranks, yes?\var2:00\\end\

...Fine.\endPage\\end\I don't care what "disorder"
you're running from, we'll
take you in.\var2:00\\end\

You're letting him join?
Are you sure? This is Al-Cid
we're talking about!\var2:00\\end\

I think Cid knows
exactly who he's
dealing with, somehow.\var2:00\\end\

Ahh... This is a relief.
My quest for sanctuary was
longer than I expected.\var2:00\\end\

A little too conspicuous,
wouldn't you agree?\var2:00\\end\

True, it has been many years
since I traveled alone.\endPage\\end\Yet, I think I shall find the
experience...refreshing.\var2:00\\end\

Never thought I'd be rubbing
shoulders with a Margrace,
that's for sure.\var2:00\\end\

Margrace...
Adelle mentioned them
too. Who are they?\var2:00\\end\

House Margrace, rulers
of a mighty land off
east called Rozarria.\endPage\\end\Royalty, kid, to put it
plainly.\var2:00\\end\

What, so he's some kind of
prince!? Him? No way!\var2:00\\end\

Only one among many,
I assure you.\var2:00\\end\

Well, at least that
explains the attitude.\var2:00\\end\

Huh. How come now I know
you're a prince, you don't
seem so annoying?\var2:00\\end\

That, my friend, is a mystery.\endPage\\end\Yet the more of me you see, I
think, the more highly you will
regard this diamond in the rough.\endPage\\end\And we will be seeing much of
each other!\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 7; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
We are brothers now,
after all, yes?\var2:00\\end\

I wonder if Hurdy's
already here...\var2:00\\end\

Huh? What?
...I'm on my way
to meet someone.\var2:00\\end\

Not afore ye return what
ye took from me pouch,
y'aren't!\var2:00\\end\

What I took...?
You mean steal?
I didn't steal anything!\var2:00\\end\

Then perhaps ye'd like
to tell me just where
me magick medallion is?\var2:00\\end\

How should I know?
You probably just
dropped it somewhere.\var2:00\\end\

Think I'm clumsy, do ya,
hume-boy? Yer a thief
an' a liar!\var2:00\\end\

Look, I'm not lying and
I didn't take anything
you big fat lizー\var2:00\\end\

Hrah? A moogle?
This boy with you, moogle?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Oh yes. Did he run into
you? I'm sorry, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\He's always dashing here and
there. Must've been taken for
a thief a hundred times, kupo!\var2:00\\end\
I said I'm not a thief!\var2:00\\end\

What if I say y'are,
an' that this moogle
here's yer accomplice!?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Kupo-po! Why don't you
look down there first?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\You must've dropped it when
he ran into you, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:00\You see? He's no thief!\var2:00\\end\

Hrrah... Yer lucky yer
friend showed up when
he did, hume-boy.\var2:00\\end\

Um...thanks for helping me
out there.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\I had to, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\If you'd said "lizard" like you
were going to, we'd have had
a fight on our hands!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\No matter what they might call
you, -never- call a bangaa
a lizard, kupo! Got it?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Well, I'm off, kupo.
Bye for now!\var2:00\\end\

You're sorry?\endPage\\end\I almost had two bangaas
beat my head in!\var2:00\\end\

Who knows what would have
happened if that moogle
hadn't come along...\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\A moogle broke up a fight
with some bangaa? That took
nerve, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\Sounds like something my brother
would do, kupo. He could never
stand by and watch a bully.\endPage\\end\\varE:02\He's a nice guy, my brother.
You should meet him sometime.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\Anyway, enough about him.
Sorry I'm so late!\endPage\\end\\varE:00\I'll treat you to some
roasted zignuts, kupo.
Consider it my apology!\var2:00\\end\

I know just the place!\endPage\\end\There's a guy who sells
great zignuts in the square
over that-a-way.\var2:00\\end\

Wait a second, you're
that moogle from before!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Kupo kupo!
You two know each other!?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Sure do, kupo.
I'm in \varA:00\ here's
clan these days, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\Wait...how do you know
\varA:00\!?\var2:00\\end\

He cleared up a little
misunderstanding I had with
some bangaa in Fluorgis.\endPage\\end\I had no idea he was your
brother, Hurdy!\var2:00\\end\

Right, well, my name's
\varA:00\...
Which I guess you know.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\And I'm Montblanc.\endPage\\end\\varE:02\Small world, kupo-po!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\I certainly didn't expect my
own brother to come when I
posted that bill in the pub.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\I was surprised myself, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\The bill did say you were
traveling alone, but it didn't
have your name...\endPage\\end\\varE:01\Say, what -are- you doing all
the way out here alone, kupo?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\My brother's the leader of a
clan in this place called
Dalmasca, way to the east.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\I'm on personal business
as a matter of fact...a bit
of a treasure hunt, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:01\Have you ever heard of
something called the
"Gigas's Pendant," kupo?\endPage\\end\\varE:02\It's shaped like a gigas
of antiquity, and possesses
power most wonderous, kupo!\var2:00\\end\
You don't mean this, do you?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\Kupo...
I didn't know it had an owner.
Oh well.\var2:00\\end\
I could give it to you...\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Oh no, kupo! I'm sure there's
another treasure out there for
me to hunt...somewhere.\endPage\\end\\varE:02\Actually, there're some
earrings called the Reaper's
Rings that go with that pendant.\var2:00\\end\
You don't mean these, do you?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\No, no! Don't concern yourself
with me, kupo! There's still one
treasure left...\endPage\\end\The Bringer's Pin, kupo!
It's a hairpin. Goes quite
nicely with the other two.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\That is...you don't have
the pin too, right, kupo?\endPage\\end\\varE:03\Ah ha ha! Kupo! Of course you
don't! That'd be ridiculous!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Kupo-po!!! That's it!
What are you, kupo? Some sort of
repository of wrested relics!?\var2:00\\end\

No, nothing like that.\endPage\\end\I just happened to
come across these.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\This, this, this is most
unexpected. Kupo! I...I'm
beside myself, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Truth be told, I bought that
pendant once myself, a long
long time ago, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Well, it was a replica, but
it looked just like the real
thing, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:02\I was fond of adorning myself
with glittering trinkets back
in those days, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\It was my favorite accessoryー
I wore it always. That is,
until I lost it, kupo.\endPage\\end\\varE:03\A shock, to be sure, but I've
since recovered, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\I thought to myself, "better
to replace it than mope about
it! I'll go find the real one!"\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Which brings me to my current
quest for the Gigas's Pendant.\var2:00\\end\

Gee...I'm sorry.
If I'd known it was
so important to you...\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Please, kupo, let's be
realistic here. My life is
more than bauble-hunting!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:01\So...what are you going
to do now, Montblanc?\endPage\\end\\varE:01\Are you going back
to your clan, kupo?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Not after crossing a whole
continent to be here!
No, I'll linger a while.\var2:00\\end\

Well, why don't you join
-our- clan? You were looking
for companions, weren't you?\endPage\\end\Hurdy's with us, and there's
never a lack of places to
go or things to do!\var2:00\\end\

Hey, you're Hurdy's brother.
That practically makes you
family! Right, Hurdy?\var2:00\\end\
\varE:02\Well then, thanks, kupo!\endPage\\end\\varE:00\I accept your invitation!\var2:00\\end\
Good to have you with us!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:01\Kupo...but Montblanc,
is it okay to leave your
own clan leaderless, kupo?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Oh, Clan Centurio does fine
without me. Bansat keeps an eye
on things, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Besides, it's been a while
since I've done any real
questing myself, kupo.\endPage\\end\\varE:00\Kupo-po!
Look out, Ivalice!
Here I come!\var2:00\\end\

Whew... How did
I get so tired?\endPage\\end\Maybe I'll take a rest?
\defaultOption:01\Definitely!\endOption\No way, let's go!\endOption\\end\

I feel good as new!
Well, time's a-wastin'.\var2:00\\end\

Hmm, how tired am I?
\defaultOption:20\Just a little.\endOption\Pretty tired.\endOption\Exhausted!\endOption\Aw, forget the whole thing.\endOption\\end\
I know why you have come.\var2:00\\end\

\varA:00\.
I will leave this gate
crystal open.\endPage\\end\You may use it to pass
between here and the
Forbidden Land as you wish.\var2:00\\end\

Heh heh. What's the matter,
remembered something else
you should be doing?\endPage\\end\Don't worry. You can keep
Illua waiting as long as
you like for all I care.\var2:00\\end\

I sensed the Mist grow
denser...\endPage\\end\Someone's attempting to
use the rift's power.\var2:00\\end\

Well, they're out of luck
because I'm closing that
rift.\endPage\\end\But, before I do...\var2:00\\end\

Have you forgotten what
I told you?\endPage\\end\Do as you feel is best,
and you can do no wrong.\var2:00\\end\

Should you wish to return
to the Forbidden Land, all
you need do is come here.\var2:00\\end\

Your name isn't
Shoofa, is it?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:01\Oh, nothing, kupo.
My mistake! Who might
you be?\var2:00\\end\

We're Clan \varA:01\.\endPage\\end\We got a letter from
someone named Gade.\endPage\\end\It sounded like he was
looking for you.\var2:00\\end\

At last...
I have found you...\var2:00\\end\

Your power, Shoofa.
Lend me your...power...\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\Enough of this, kupo!
Is this what Viola would
have wanted, Gade?\var2:00\\end\

We got a letter
from a...ghost!?\var2:00\\end\

Your power...
I must have it...!\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Gade wants something
of mine.\endPage\\end\\varE:02\But I can't part with it,
kupo! It's a memento of
a dear friend.\var2:00\\end\

You don't have to convince
us. I can see who the bad guy
is here.\var2:00\\end\

Stand back, we'll
take care of this!\var2:00\\end\

Gade...
There is so much more than power...
Do not let it control you...\var2:00\\end\

Let it go, Gade.
It's time to rest.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\Viola, Gade and I
were traveling together,
kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Viola wasn't like other
people. She had strange
powers, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Strange and powerful powers, kupo!
I can't count how many times
she used them to save us!\endPage\\end\\varE:03\You wouldn't believe the things
she could do. ...Gade was fascinated.
He wanted to be powerful too.\endPage\\end\\varE:03\So he struck out on his own
in search of a way to get what
he craved.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\Viola passed away
a few years later. Kupo...\endPage\\end\\varE:03\Her power was too great
for her. It tore her apart
from within.\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 7; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
\varE:02\I set off looking
for Gade to tell him what
had happened to Viola.\endPage\\end\\varE:02\Before she died,
she had begun to worry
about him.\endPage\\end\\varE:03\She understood what it
meant to have true power, kupo.
But it was too late...\var2:00\\end\

His search for power had
already consumed him.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:03\Somehow he got the idea that this
keepsake contained her power, and
he's been trying to take it ever since.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\At least now he
can finally rest, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\Didn't you hear
what Viola said, kupo?\var2:00\\end\

I didn't hear a thing.
What about you, Adelle?\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\This was Viola's.
I want you to have it,
kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\I don't need a memento
to remember her, kupo.
She's in my heart.\endPage\\end\\varE:02\I think Viola would
be happier knowing it was
being put to use, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:02\And there's something about
you that reminds me of her...
No, this is for the best, kupo.\var2:00\\end\

I'll treasure it always.
Thank you.\var2:00\\end\

\varE:00\No, thank you, kupo!
You've done me a
great service!\var2:00\\end\

We don't have the potion
we were supposed to bring!
Better get one first.\var2:00\\end\

Are you the one who
sent for the potion?\var2:00\\end\

Well, you -are- a right
pretty thing, aren't ya?\endPage\\end\Hoo ahh!
Even better than
I'd hoped!\var2:00\\end\

You certainly are
frisky for someone
mortally wounded.\var2:00\\end\

Oh, don't you worry, that
twisted ankle of mine still
smarts good and proper.\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 7; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
It hurts like
the living blazes!
Oh, the pain!\var2:00\\end\

All right, all right.
Here's your potion.\var2:00\\end\

Drink this and get
a good night's sleep.\endPage\\end\Go ahead and rub this
on your ankle. It's a
special remedy of my own.\endPage\\end\Don't worry, it's on
me. Free of charge.\var2:00\\end\

Well, I think I'll be
going. Try to stay still
until your ankle's better.\endPage\\end\Take care.\var2:00\\end\

A little present for you.\endPage\\end\Something I've had since
I was quite young. Perhaps
you'll find a use for it.\var2:00\\end\

Thanks.
And stay off that ankle!\var2:00\\end\

I met the child.
She has a kind heart.\endPage\\end\Quite beautiful, too,
if I do say so.\var2:00\\end\

I gave her my power.
She'll use it right
if I'm any judge.\endPage\\end\I'm glad I got to
see her before it was
too late.\var2:00\\end\

If I'd only known
how beautiful she was...\endPage\\end\Sick or no, I'd have
made myself a touch more
presentable.\var2:00\\end\

Is that all you can
think to say at such a
time?\var2:00\\end\

Thank you for this
wonderful life.\endPage\\end\Even being a Gifted One,
it hasn't been all bad.\var2:00\\end\

Farewell, Ljda.
I'll be waiting for
you.\var2:00\\end\

She doesn't look
hurt. We made it just
in time!\var2:00\\end\

I had often thought
to visit you.\endPage\\end\Never did I think it
would be you who
would come to me.\var2:00\\end\

If you don't look out,
those monsters are gonna
have you for dinner!\var2:00\\end\

There is no need to worry.
These creatures hear my words,
and heed them.\var2:00\\end\

It is my power.
My Gift.\var2:00\\end\

She's one of the
Gifted Ones!\var2:00\\end\

And now I shall
test you.\endPage\\end\Wermut saw something
in you. Was he right?\var2:00\\end\

With it, you should be
able to make some small part
of my power your own.\var2:00\\end\

Your power?
You mean...talking to
beasts?\var2:00\\end\

Not only beasts.
All the beings of this
world, both great and small.\endPage\\end\It is this way for me, at least.
You lack some of my natural
charms, so who can say.\var2:00\\end\

Hmph. I'll just have to get
by on my youth and good looks,
then.\var2:00\\end\

If I didn't know
any better, I'd say
you were jealous.\var2:00\\end\

Ah, you are so young.\endPage\\end\But worry not. What you lack
in experience and ability,
you make up for in spirit.\var2:00\\end\

Wermut and I have met
many of the Gifted.\endPage\\end\Not all tame their powers.
Many are crushed by them.\var2:00\\end\

Wermut... He was a Gifted
One, too, wasn't he.\endPage\\end\I felt a great power in
the weapon he gave me, but
I couldn't be sure.\var2:00\\end\

You have learned to
wield the power he gave
you.\endPage\\end\Learn now to do the same
with mine.\var2:00\\end\

I have seen what is to
be seen, and said what is
to be said. I go.\endPage\\end\Good-bye.\var2:00\\end\

And who knows? With luck,
you may one day possess half
my charm.\var2:00\\end\

That's gonna take an
awful lot of luck.\var2:00\\end\

Do you really think
the story might be true?\var2:00\\end\

I bet that big one is
your Beast of Aisenfield
right there!\var2:00\\end\

That...creature was once
a man? It's hard to believe.\var2:00\\end\

A power no man has ever
known... Could it be?\var2:00\\end\

Long did I await your coming...
Gifted One.\var2:00\\end\

I...I hear its voice
inside my head.\endPage\\end\Then it really was a
hume...once.\var2:00\\end\

Do as I bid.\endPage\\end\Kill me while there is
yet time. So little of me
remains...\endPage\\end\I can control myself no longer.
I have wrought enough misery.
Free me...my friend.\var2:00\\end\

You were a Gifted One
too, weren't you.\endPage\\end\I'll do as you ask.
I will end this.\var2:00\\end\

Then, at last, dawn
will break this nightmare.\var2:00\\end\

Had my mind been but
stronger than my flesh...\endPage\\end\I might have used my
strength to protect,
rather than destroy.\var2:00\\end\

Your strength does not
die with you.\var2:00\\end\
Rekindle the power of the stones!\var2:00\\end\

They sure weren't wrong
about those monsters.\var2:00\\end\

I suppose this is a bit
much even for the Paling
Gods.\var2:00\\end\

Hey, Adelle.
What are all these
pillars for?\var2:00\\end\

Monuments honoring the
Paling Gods, I'd imagine.\var2:00\\end\

Waken the power sleeping
in the stones, and the beasts
will plague this land no more.\var2:00\\end\

The stone glowed,
and there was a voice.\endPage\\end\You didn't hear it?\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 7; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
Anyway, we need to
do something about these
monsters.\var2:00\\end\

We'll be here forever at
this rate.\endPage\\end\That voice said to waken
the power of the stones.
Maybe we should try that?\var2:00\\end\

The rune faded from
the stone...\endPage\\end\We must have to reach
all the stones before the
others fade.\var2:00\\end\

Overrun, my power had faltered.
Now it is restored once more.\endPage\\end\Go with my thanks.\var2:00\\end\

The voice of a
Paling God...?\var2:00\\end\

Ah. It is good to see my
warning has not fallen on
deaf ears.\var2:00\\end\

Have you been waiting here
all this time? Why?\var2:00\\end\

I will fight alongside you.
I have no intention of fiddling
while Goug burns.\var2:00\\end\

Whatever it is, it's standing
in a pool of lava.\endPage\\end\We'll never be able to
reach it there.\var2:00\\end\

This blade is called Chirijiraden
in the Eastern Kingdoms where it
was forged.\endPage\\end\The power it holds will enable
you to strike even distant foes.
Take it.\var2:00\\end\

Hey, how come -she-
gets the cool sword?\var2:00\\end\

I have looked on the face
of the one meant to wield
this blade.\var2:00\\end\

Then...you saw the outcome
of this battle?\var2:00\\end\

Do you truly want
to know?\var2:00\\end\

What, and ruin the
surprise? No thanks!\var2:00\\end\

That's just like you,
isn't it?\endPage\\end\Well, enough talk.
We've got a monster to
stop.\var2:00\\end\

This lava isn't doing us any
favors. If it would just move
a little closer, we could hit it.\var2:00\\end\

I don't think asking
nicely is going to help.\var2:00\\end\

It couldn't hurt.
Here goes nothing!\var2:00\\end\

I can fight no
further.\endPage\\end\If only I could have
seen this through to
the end...\var2:00\\end\

We've won.
The prophecy is
complete.\var2:00\\end\

The vision of Goug
in flames fades from
me.\var2:00\\end\

So, your gift is to
see into the future...\endPage\\end\I never knew the
Gifted Ones had so
many different powers.\var2:00\\end\

I sense a great power
sleeping within you.\var2:00\\end\

A power that will
soon awaken.\endPage\\end\The time draws near.\var2:00\\end\

notes: Preflight failed: Encoded length 10 exceeds original allocation 7; Page 0: wider than original text footprint

source_text:
What this power is,
you must see for yourself.\var2:00\\end\

Well, I should be going.
What should I do with the
sword?\var2:00\\end\

The deeds of men
ever shape and change
the future.\var2:00\\end\

It is time I left as well.
Too long have I dwelt in this
borrowed flesh.\var2:00\\end\
The creature begins absorbing the surrounding Mist...\var2:00\\end\
The stored Mist detonates in a powerful explosion!\var2:00\\end\
A mysterious force holds it fast.\var2:00\\end\

Just think, we're standing
somewhere no one else has
ever been before...\var2:00\\end\

My instincts aren't
half bad, if I do say
so myself.\var2:00\\end\

Hey, whaddaya think
you're doing, Adelle?\var2:00\\end\

As soon as you took a step
closer, all those creatures
appeared near the chest.\endPage\\end\I was just standing here the
whole time, so it couldn't have
been -my- fault.\endPage\\end\If you weren't chasing after
treasure all the time, this
wouldn't have happened.\var2:00\\end\

Excuse me?
Look who's talking!\endPage\\end\I can't be held responsible
for the doings of every monster
we come across!\endPage\\end\Look, we don't have time to
argue about this. Let's take care
of these monsters first, okay?\var2:00\\end\

Maybe one of the creatures

In the dark and distant past, the winding reaches
of the Neslowe Passage were once used as a
shipping lane for goods going to and from the
Clockwork City of Goug.

Countless shafts crisscross the passage depths,
yet no map exists that captures their intricacies,
and several unknown ways are said to exist.

There are rumors of a great treasure sleeping in
one of those darkened corridors, yet many who
have gone in search of it have never been seen
again. Gallant gold-seekers be warned!\end\
translation:
在遥远的过去，蜿蜒的内斯洛通道
曾是往返机关城古格的货运路线。
通道深处矿井纵横交错，没有地图能完整记录，
据说还有数条未知道路。
传闻某条黑暗走廊里沉睡着巨大宝藏，
但许多寻宝者一去不返。勇敢的寻金人，请当心！\end\

I done got myself hurt in the swamp! I tell you,
I thought I knew what pain was when my old
chocobo gave up the ghost, but this is something
else!
