source_text:
Dark times are these that such a beautiful lady
could find herself surrounded by such horrible
monsters in the woods near Moorabella.

I thought to rush to her rescue, of course, but...
well, when I came to, I looked around to find
myself quite alone.

I do hope nothing has befallen her.
Did I mention these are dark times?\end\
translation:
世道艰难，一位美丽女士在摩拉贝拉附近森林
被可怕的怪物包围。
我当然想冲上去救她，可……回过神来，
四周只剩我一个人。
希望她平安无事。我说过世道艰难吧？\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
A man it was, but with a power no man has ever
known. Thus was it despised and reviled.

Losing hope in both foolish men and its own
cursed self, it became that which they had dreamt
for it: a beast, heartless killer of men, its doom to
walk under welkin in Aisenfield for eternity.
 ーFrom "Dielson's Lay"\end\
translation:
那是个人，却拥有无人知晓的力量，
因此受到厌恶与辱骂。
他对愚昧的人和被诅咒的自己都失去希望，
最终变成他们想象中的模样：
一头无情杀人的野兽，注定永远游荡艾森原。
  ——摘自《迪尔森之歌》\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Is it just me, or are there more monsters in
Tramdine Fens now than ever before?

The shrine to the Paling Gods there should keep
those things at bay, at least during the daylight
hours...unless something has befallen the shrine!?\end\
translation:
是我的错觉，还是特拉姆丁沼泽的怪物
比以往更多了？
苍白诸神的神殿至少白天应该能挡住它们……
除非神殿出了什么事！？\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
In Tramdine Fens sits a shrine to the Paling Gods,
yet in fact it honors not those protector spirits
of myth, but a small girl who once lived in a
village near the fens. The girl's name was Elpe.
Elpe was said to possess wondrous powers with
which she mended the ill, and drove off all manner
of fell creatures.

Once, a great horde of demons most foul
descended upon her village, and so Elpe
bestowed her own strength upon three standing
pillars of stone, sacrificing herself to keep the
demons at bay.

Since that day, the stones have been known as
the Shrine of the Paling Gods, and not a day goes
by that the descendents of those villagers do
not bring fresh flowers there in rememberance
of their savior.
  ーExcerpt from "The Traditions of Ivalice"\end\
translation:
特拉姆丁沼泽有一座苍白诸神神殿，
实际供奉的不是传说中的守护神，
而是曾住在附近村庄的少女艾尔佩。
据说她有奇妙力量，能治病并驱赶魔物。
有一次，大群恶魔袭击村庄，
艾尔佩将自己的力量赋予三根石柱，
牺牲自己挡住恶魔。
从此石柱被称为苍白诸神神殿，
村民后代每天献上鲜花，纪念救命恩人。
  ——《伊瓦利斯传统》摘录\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
A great calamity comes for the city of Goug.

A terrible creature born here long ago has risen
from the flames once again.

If it is not stopped, all of Goug will surely be lost
beneath a sea of molten rock.
 The Prophet Hilo\end\
translation:
古格城即将遭遇大灾难。
很久以前诞生于此的可怕生物再次从火焰中复苏。
如果不阻止它，整个古格必将淹没在熔岩之海中。
  先知 希洛\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I was walking the Neslowe Passage, looking for
discarded odds and ends when it happened:
a great hole opened in the earth right beneath
my feet! I didn't linger long enough to know for
sure, but it's my hunch that hole leads to another
mine shaft...perhaps a forgotten one? Perhaps the
very one that contains the rumored treasure?\end\
translation:
我在内斯洛通道寻找别人丢弃的小东西时，
脚下突然出现一个大洞！
我没敢久留，但猜它通向另一条矿井……
也许是被遗忘的矿井？或许正是藏宝之处？\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I must apologize for this missive. It is not
my custom to entrust to quill and ink that
which might better be left to lip and tongue.

I have heard your recent troubles have been
resolved, and so I beg you come and meet me.
I wait in Targ Wood.

 Eternally yours,
 A.M.\end\
translation:
请原谅我写这封信。我通常不愿把
适合当面说的话诉诸笔墨。
听说你最近的麻烦已经解决，恳请前来见我。
我在塔格森林等候。
永远属于你的，A.M.\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My grandma told me once that, somewhere near
Graszton, there was this mysterious tower
that only appeared when the moon is shining.

Oh, the stories she told of the tower!

There were creatures strange and fantastic, and
a great treasure at the top!

She told me a story of a famous knight who
ventured in there once, too, but I forget
how that one went.
 Luma, Town Gossip\end\
translation:
奶奶曾说，格拉斯顿附近有座神秘高塔，
只在月光下出现。她讲过好多塔里的故事！
里面有奇异的生物，塔顶有巨大宝藏！
她还讲过一位著名骑士进去的故事，
可我忘了具体内容。
  镇上八卦达人 露玛\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My grandma told me about another tower that
only appeared on moonlit nights, but that one
was in Aisenfield.

Actually, it's the same tower as the one in
Graszton, but this is a different entrance, so
it opens in a different place. ...Does that make
sense? I guess that famous knight went up that
other way too.
 Luma, Town Gossip\end\
translation:
奶奶还说过另一座只在月夜出现的塔，
位于艾森原。其实它和格拉斯顿的是同一座塔，
只是入口不同，所以出现在不同地方。
……这说得通吗？那位著名骑士也走过这条路。
  镇上八卦达人 露玛\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Remember the tower that only appears on moonlit
nights? My grandma told me there's another
entrance from a place called the Forbidden Land!
That's the last way in.

I guess when that knight climbed the tower,
that's when he became a hero. And this
Forbidden Land place, I guess the Mist there
is really thick? You'd -have- to be a hero
to make it in a place like that!
 Luma, Town Gossip\end\
translation:
还记得只在月夜出现的塔吗？奶奶说
禁地还有一个入口！这是最后一条路。
那位骑士登塔时成为了英雄。
听说禁地的雾很浓，能在那里行动的人
肯定得是英雄！
  镇上八卦达人 露玛\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Having received the favor of the gods, the knight
Gaol began to travel the land with his companion,
the moogle Lini.

One moonlit night, Gaol spied a tower limned
with a strange light. Knowing his love, the Moon
Maiden Evelyn, was trapped at its top, he strode
toward that eerie spire and the trials that awaited
within.
 The Hero Gaol — The Book of Tomorrows\end\
translation:
得到诸神眷顾后，骑士加奥尔与
莫古伙伴莉妮一同周游各地。
一个月夜，加奥尔看到散发奇光的高塔。
他知道爱人月之少女伊芙琳被困在塔顶，
便向诡异的高塔和其中等待的试炼迈进。
  《明日之书·英雄加奥尔》\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
To the members of Clan \varA:01\,
aspirants to perfection in all walks of life:

I would like to formally invite your clan to
participate in our Masters of Combat tourney.
The tourney will be held during Blackfrost, on
Sant D'alsa Bluff.

I expect to see a performance worthy of the
tourney's title.\end\
translation:
致追求各方面完美的\varA:01\氏族成员：

我们正式邀请贵氏族参加战斗大师锦标赛。
比赛将在黑霜月的圣达尔萨断崖举行。
期待你们展现配得上赛事名称的表现。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
An Important Notice from The Wizard D'Tidle:

I'm sure there are some of you out there with
titles won through clan trials that you frankly
just don't need.

Well, you've come to the right placeーthat is, you
will have come to the right place when you come
to see me. I can get rid of those titles so fast,
you'll never know you had them!

Of course, you lose the benefits of said titles as
well, so give it some thought beforehand.\end\
translation:
魔法师迪泰德尔的重要通知：

想必有些人通过氏族试炼获得了不需要的称号。
来找我就对了，我能迅速帮你去掉称号，
快得像从未拥有过！
当然，称号带来的好处也会消失，请事先考虑清楚。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
When people want their monthly dose of the
goods on places to go, people to know, and
goings-on in society both high and low, they
turn to the Bonga Bugle.

Though their coverage is unparalleled in its
breadth and depth, rumors persist that the
Head Editor of the Bugle has been passing on
his own work by posting bills at the local pub...\end\
translation:
每月想了解去哪玩、认识谁、社会上下发生什么，
人们都会翻开《邦加号角》。
本报报道广泛深入，无人能及，
但传闻主编会在当地酒馆张贴告示，
把自己的工作交给别人……\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Happy New Year!

This Month in the Bugle:
Our New Year's Resolutions!
 1) Early to rise. *yawn*
 2) Don't be so forgetful...was it?
 3) Eat less. *belch*

Other Headlines:
- Head Editor Catches Cold On Assignment
- Head Editor Blows Nose On Assignment
- Head Editor Blows Nose Again
- Head Editor Makes Mess of Notes

A Word From Our Editor:
How many of us make New Year's resolutions but
never follow through on them? And why?

Beacuse we forget what they were.
That's why I never make resolutions.

At least, I don't -remember- making any!
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle\end\
translation:
新年快乐！

本期号角：新年愿望！
1）早起。*哈欠*
2）别再健忘……是这条吗？
3）少吃。*嗝*

其他头条：主编采访时感冒；
主编采访时擤鼻涕；主编又擤鼻涕；
主编弄乱笔记。

主编寄语：多少人立下新年愿望却从不履行？
为什么？因为忘了愿望是什么。
所以我从不许愿。至少我不记得许过！
  ——《邦加号角》主编\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
The Most Beautiful Spot In The World!
 Beauty without compare, faithful readers!
 I'd print the photographs I took, but to do
 so would be a disservice to the stunning
 beauty of the place!
 You must go there and see it for yourself!
 All of you! Now!

Other Headlines:
- Head Editor Takes 1,000 Photographs On
  Assignment
- Head Editor Contemplating Career As
  Photographer?
- Head Editor Leaves Lens Cap On
- "Night: A Study In 1,000 Images" Rocks Art
  World

A Word From Our Editor:
Why are famous places so popular? Maybe they
became famous -because- they were popular?
But what about those places where there isn't
anything to do, or anything good to eat. Just a
lot of scenery sitting around?

Who'd want to go there!?
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle\end\
translation:
本期号角：世界上最美的地方！
亲爱的读者，那是无与伦比的美！
我本想刊登照片，却觉得照片会辜负美景。
大家必须亲自去看！现在就去！

其他头条：主编采访拍摄一千张照片；
主编考虑转行摄影？主编忘摘镜头盖；
《夜：一千张影像的研究》震惊艺术界。

主编寄语：名胜为什么受欢迎？
也许正因受欢迎才出名？可如果一个地方
没什么可做，也没有好吃的，只有一堆风景，
谁会想去啊！？
  ——《邦加号角》主编\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
Obey The Law!
 Laws are made to be obeyed!
 "Obey? Like a dog? Never!" you say?
 "Woof!" I say!

Other Headlines:
- Secret Group More Than Rumor?
- Secret Group Members Disguised Among Us?
- Head Editor Member Of Secret Group?
- Clan \varA:01\ Seen In Secret Group?

A Word From Our Editor:
I recently polled our readers concerning their
favorite law, and was rather surprised to hear
that the most popular law with the young ladies
was that prohibiting standing still!

Apparently, following this law has the side benefit
of giving one an excellent workout, thereby killing
two fat birds with one legally laudable stone!

Incidentally, my favorite law is the one prohibiting
all harm to seeq...naturally! *snort*
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle\end\
translation:
本期号角：遵守法律！
法律就是用来遵守的！
“像狗一样服从？绝不！”你说？
我说：“汪！”

其他头条：秘密团体并非传闻？
秘密成员混在我们中间？主编是秘密成员？
\varA:01\氏族出现在秘密团体中？

主编寄语：我最近调查读者最喜欢的法律，
惊讶发现年轻女士最喜欢禁止原地不动！
遵守这条法律还能锻炼身体，
合法地一石二鸟！我最喜欢禁止伤害锡克族，
那当然啦！*哼哼*
  ——《邦加号角》主编\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
Workers! I Feel Your Pain!
 Special one-day report from the frontline of
 the retail industry: The Scoop From The Shop!
 What I learned: Work isn't all fun and games!

Other Headlines:
- Clerk Reveals Customer Care Secrets
  "The envy of all the other clerks."
  "I just wanted to see the customers smile."
- How To Shop, Head Editor Style
- That Cute Girl Who Came Into The Shop

A Word From Our Editor:
Shops. Be they ye olde shoppes, or just plain old
shops, you gotta love 'em! No purchase necessary,
either, you can just enjoy window shopping.
I certainly do!
Now and then I'll try a piece of gear on that
doesn't fit, and something will snap, and I'll have
to fork over my gil.
Maybe that's why those shopkeepers are always
yelling at me when I drop in.
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle\end\
translation:
本期号角：劳动者，我懂你的苦！
零售业前线一日特别报道：商店内幕！
我的收获：工作可不全是玩乐！

其他头条：店员揭晓服务秘诀：
“其他店员都羡慕我。”“只想看顾客微笑。”
主编式购物法；走进店里的可爱女孩。

主编寄语：商店，无论古老还是普通，
都让人喜爱！不买东西也能逛橱窗，我常这样！
偶尔试穿不合身的装备，弄坏了东西，
就得掏钱。难怪店主见我进门总要大喊。
  ——《邦加号角》主编\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
Master Craftsman Goes To Pot!
 Goes to make pots, that is! And I was with the
 miracle-maker himself, Master LePot the 3rd!
 Enjoy this tale of earth and effort in harmony
 with some very pretty pots.

Other Headlines:
- Competitive Pot Breaking Catches On With
   Youth
- Head Editor Celebrates Youth Culture, Breaks
   Pots
- Head Editor's Words To The Wise:
   "I just kicked it as hard as I could!"

A Word From Our Editor:
I tried making some pottery the other dayーwhoo
boy! It was just me and the clay for twenty-four
hours straight and in the end, I did it!

I made a lovely...
lump of clay.

Straightaway, I titled my work "The Lump: A
Study" and quickly discardedーer, displayed it
in my office.

Folks, art is hard.
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle\end\
translation:
本期号角：工匠大师玩壶！
是做壶！我和神奇的勒壶三世大师在一起！
请欣赏泥土与努力和谐交织的故事和美丽陶壶。

其他头条：砸壶比赛在年轻人中流行；
主编响应青年文化，砸壶；主编忠告：
“我只是用尽全力踢了一脚！”

主编寄语：前几天我也试着做陶器。
与泥土苦战二十四小时，终于做出一件漂亮的……
泥块。我立刻将作品命名为《泥块研究》，
然后迅速丢掉——呃，陈列在办公室。
艺术真难。
  ——《邦加号角》主编\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
O, Prima Donna!!!
 ...Let me just state here for the record:
 it was all worth it.

Other Headlines:
- Shocking! Man Sneaks Close To Prima Donna!
- Prima Donna Administers Painful Cheek Slap
- Prima Donna Throws Grown Man Like Rag Doll
- Prima Donna Unleashes Flurry Of Fists
- Mysterious Man In Infirmary With Serious
   Injuries

A Word From Our Editor:
Got any Prima Donna memorabilia?
I ran some ads for armbands, necklaces, badges,
towels and the like with the members' names on 
them, and they've been selling like hot cakes!

But I'm not selling my ultra-rare Prima Donna
Pillow. That one's mine!
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle, from the
  infirmary.\end\
translation:
本期号角：哦，歌姬乐团！！！
在此郑重声明：一切都值得。

其他头条：震惊！男子偷偷靠近歌姬；
歌姬赏他响亮耳光；歌姬像扔布娃娃一样
扔出成年男子；歌姬挥出连环拳；
神秘男子重伤住院。

主编寄语：你有歌姬纪念品吗？
印着成员名字的臂章、项链、徽章、毛巾
等商品经我打广告后热销！
但我的超稀有歌姬枕头不卖，那是我的！
  ——《邦加号角》主编，于医务室\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
Hunting The Haunts!
 A fierce battle to the undeath ensues between
 our heroic Head Editor and the forces of 
 ghostliness. We've got the scoop here!

Other Headlines:
- I Ain't Afeared Of No Poltergeists! Now Taking
  Orders For "Auntie's Anti-Haunt Charms"
- Debate: Is Our Head Editor Afraid of Ghosts!?
- Special Column: Our Head Editor Weighs In:
  "Me And Auntie — The Meaning Of After Life"

A Word From Our Editor:
My auntie's an awfully gentle soul. When I was
but a boy, I'd come home crying, and she'd sing
me a song, or give me a treat, and I'd feel all
right. I'll never forget your kindness, auntie!
Just stop haunting me!
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle\end\
translation:
本期号角：追寻幽灵！
英勇主编与幽灵势力展开不死不休的激战，
独家报道就在这里！

其他头条：我才不怕闹鬼！
“姨妈驱鬼符”接受订购；
辩论：主编怕鬼吗？
主编专栏：《我和姨妈——死后生活的意义》。

主编寄语：姨妈非常温柔。小时候我哭着回家，
她会唱歌或给我点心，让我好起来。
姨妈，我永远不会忘记你的好！
只是请别再来缠着我了！
  ——《邦加号角》主编\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
Field of Hidden Treasures!
 That's what they call it, but no matter how much
 I dig, I get nothing! Diddly-squat! Why!?

 That's the real mystery here.

Other Headlines:
- Dig Like You Mean It! Man Digs Hole After Hole,
  Finds Nothing
- Rescue Operation!
  Man Falls In Hole, Can't Get Out
- Hole-Digger Sent To Infirmary With
  Serious Injuries
- Head Editor's Words To The Wise:
  "Hole DiggingーJust Say No."

A Word From Our Editor:
Why do treasures come spilling from the depths of
the earth? Did some mysterious mage cast magicks
to put them there? Did some kindly soul sneak out
and bury them in the dark of night for our
amusement?

Some say it's just some rich house slinging
its rubbish. And you know what they say about
one man's rubbish!
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle, from the infirmary.\end\
translation:
本期号角：藏宝之地！
名字虽如此，我怎么挖都什么也没有！
一点都没有！为什么！？这才是真正的谜。

其他头条：卖力挖！男子挖遍地洞一无所获；
救援行动！男子掉进坑里爬不出来；
挖坑人重伤送医；主编忠告：“挖坑——拒绝它。”

主编寄语：宝藏为何从地下涌出？
是神秘魔法师施法放进去的？
是好心人半夜偷偷埋给我们玩？
有人说只是富豪家扔垃圾。
你知道的，别人的垃圾也许是宝！
  ——《邦加号角》主编，于医务室\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
 Head Editor Forever!
 Head Editor I am.
 Head Editor I be.
 Head Editor For Eternity!

Other Headlines:
Down To The Wire Special Report:
A Day In The Life Of Our Head Editor!
- Overslept, Lost Tourney By Default
- Got Lost On Way To Orienteering Seminar
- Bid At Auction, Then Withdrew All Bids. Scolded.

A Word From Our Editor:
Whenever I oversleep, I always have this bad
dream about being late to the office.
Every time!

That's right, my dreams predict reality! If that
isn't clairvoyance, tell me what is!

...Somehow, however, I failed to predict the lump
on the head I'd earn for telling the owner about
my dreams when I finally made it to my desk.
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle\end\
translation:
本期号角：主编万岁！
我是主编，我当主编，永远是主编！

其他头条：截稿前特别报道：主编的一天！
睡过头，锦标赛弃权；
去定向讲座的路上迷路；
拍卖出价后全部撤回，被训斥。

主编寄语：每当睡过头，我都会梦见上班迟到。
每次都是！没错，我的梦预知现实！
这不是千里眼是什么？
……不过终于到办公室告诉老板后，
我没预见到头上会挨一记。
  ——《邦加号角》主编\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
Galmia Pepe!!!
 An exclusive interview with a Pepe employee!

 Q. Tell us, what's your favorite direction?
 A. You mean, like...a compass direction?
     Um, North, I guess?

 Q. In your opinion, which eye would you say you
     blink more, the left or the right?
 A. Um...don't they blink at the same time?

 Q. Are you the kind who can't sleep without a
    light on in the room?
 A. When are you going to ask me real questions?

 Q. Why have you answered all my questions with
    questions?
 A. Right. Thanks for stopping by.
     Have a nice day.

Other Headlines:
- Mystery! The Case Of The Missing Memo Pad
- Hit Song: "Making It Up Is Hard To Do."
- Head Editor's Words To The Wise:
   "Unprepared? Be prepared to deal with angry
    people."

A Word From Our Editor:
Did you know that spiffy hat I'm always wearing
is a bona fide Galmia Pepe?

I got a discount, of course.
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle\end\
translation:
本期号角：加尔米亚佩佩！！！
佩佩员工独家采访！
问：你最喜欢哪个方向？
答：指南北那种？呃，北吧？
问：你觉得左眼和右眼哪个眨得多？
答：不是一起眨吗？
问：你是不是不开灯就睡不着？
答：你什么时候问正经问题？
问：为什么你总用问题回答问题？
答：好了，感谢来访，祝你愉快。

其他头条：神秘失踪的记事本；
热门歌曲《瞎编也不容易》；主编忠告：
“没准备？那就准备面对愤怒的人吧。”

主编寄语：我常戴的漂亮帽子可是正牌
加尔米亚佩佩！当然，我买时打了折。
  ——《邦加号角》主编\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
Power Beyond Reckoning, Reckoned!
 Clan \varA:01\ Results:
 "Wimpy To The Extreme"
 Reporter comments:
      They were wimpy with weapons,
      Wimpy with magicks too.
      They were wimpy, just wimpy.
      W-I-M-P-Y, it's true.

Other Headlines:
- Bizarre Stunts Don't Add Up To Battle Prowess
- Newcomers Take Heed: Common Battle Goofs
- What We've Learned From Our Utter Failure

A Word From Our Editor:
What's really important in the thick of battle?
Is it a good sword arm? A quick-thinking head?
Or is it bravery that will not bend or break?
No, the most important thing is to have enough
determination to open every last treasure chest.
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle\end\
translation:
本期号角：超乎想象的力量，测出来了！
\varA:01\氏族成绩：“弱到极点”
记者评论：武器弱，魔法弱，
弱就是弱，弱得货真价实。

其他头条：奇怪花招不等于战斗实力；
新人注意：常见战斗失误；
从彻底失败中学到了什么。

主编寄语：战斗中什么最重要？
剑术、机智，还是不屈的勇气？
不，最重要的是打开每一个宝箱的决心。
  ——《邦加号角》主编\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
Power Beyond Reckoning, Reckoned!
 Clan \varA:01\ Results:
 "Strong To The Extreme"
  I remember, he ran up to me and said:
 "Hey Head Editor, you okay?
  You just leave that big guy to me!
  You've got your back problems to think of!"
  (Want to read more? Look inside!)

Other Headlines:
- Required Reading: The Way To Win Battles
- Winning With Points For Style
- A Cheer For Strong-arm Headhunters,
  House Bowen!
  "Not bad, you guys!"

A Word From Our Editor:
Little did you know it, but this tourney is one
way to become truly famous as a clan.

No, -the- way!

Win big here, and you join an exclusive circle
of past winners that include such luminaries as the
100 Geniuses, Violene, the Arbiters of Death, and
many, many more!
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle\end\
translation:
本期号角：超乎想象的力量，测出来了！
\varA:01\氏族成绩：“强到极点”
我记得他跑过来说：“主编，你没事吧？
那个大家伙交给我！你还得顾着腰伤呢！”
（想看更多？请翻内页！）

其他头条：必读：战斗制胜之道；
漂亮取胜；为强大的猎人鲍恩家族喝彩！
“你们不错嘛！”

主编寄语：你可能不知道，这场比赛是
氏族真正成名的途径。不，是最佳途径！
在这里大胜，就能与百天才、维奥琳、
死亡仲裁者等历届冠军并列！
  ——《邦加号角》主编\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
Crime: It's More Organized Than You Think!
 Obtained: Rare Footage Of Syndicate Turf Wars!

 The Violent Syndicate
 VS.
 The Evil Syndicate

Other Headlines:
- Shocking! Boy Turns To Life Of Crime!
- Appalling! Battle Without Honor Or Mercy!
- Head Editor's Words To The Wise:
  "The barman's mad at me again."

A Word From Our Editor:
Our special on organized crime isn't selling very
well. I guess our fairer readers don't go for the
down and dirty reportage we've come to be known
for. So, why do we insist on doing a crime special
once a year? Is this someone's idea of a bad
joke!? Can't wait for next year's Emberleaf
edition...
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle\end\
translation:
本期号角：犯罪比你想的更有组织！
独家取得组织地盘争夺战珍贵影像！
暴力组织 对 邪恶组织。

其他头条：震惊！少年走上犯罪道路！
骇人！没有荣誉和怜悯的战斗！
主编忠告：“酒馆老板又生我的气了。”

主编寄语：有组织犯罪特辑卖得不好。
看来温柔的读者不喜欢本报直面阴暗的报道。
那我们为什么每年还要做犯罪特辑？
谁开的坏玩笑！？真期待明年余烬叶月刊……
  ——《邦加号角》主编\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This Month in the Bugle:
All Hail Our Owner!!!
 Master of sword in field and quill at desk!
 Superb on the attack, superfluous on defense!
 Quick to dine, and quicker to nap!
 What's the secret to his miraculous powers!?

Other Headlines:
- What Do Bugle Employees Think Of Our Owner?
  "Those pink neckties are...amazing."
  "His feet stinー smell incredible!"
  "His airship loan is second to none!"
  "I'm not sure how we're still in business."

A Word From Our Editor:
I did a little peeking into Our Owner's history for
this special feature and found a curious connection
between Our Owner, a member of the Clan Mates
Adventurer's Guild, and the Seeker of Slaughter!

That's right, these three individuals were once in
a clan together! Not only that, their clan was a
real go-getter, much like today's House Bowen.

I was sadly unable to discover why they
disbanded, or why Our Owner is such a wimー er,
so reserved these days.

Then again, with clan members like that, I suppose
it had to fall apart sooner or later!
 ーHead Editor, Bonga Bugle\end\
translation:
本期号角：老板万岁！！！
战场善剑，桌前善笔！擅长攻击，防御多余！
吃饭快，打盹更快！他神奇力量的秘密是什么？

其他头条：员工怎么看老板？
“粉色领带……太惊艳。”“他的脚臭——香极了！”
“他的飞空艇贷款无人能及！”
“我不知道报社怎么还没倒闭。”

主编寄语：为本期特辑调查老板过去，
我发现老板、伙伴冒险者公会的一位成员
和嗜杀的求道者之间有奇妙联系！
三人曾属于同一个氏族！那个氏族积极进取，
就像今天的鲍恩家族。
可惜我没查到他们为何解散，也不知道老板
如今为何如此胆小——呃，内敛。
话说回来，有那样的成员，迟早会散伙吧！
  ——《邦加号角》主编\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
A whisper on the streets: more information is
sought about a headhunting clan said to use
strange weapons called "mage cannons," to do
their violent work. Rumors abound, yet none
have seen this clan or their armaments,
leaving us with naught but conjecture.

Perhaps they lurk in the shadows, or perhaps
they are nothing but a rumor. Either way, if
you hear something, you will let us know?
 ーDomis Streetears\end\
translation:
街头传闻：有人正在寻找一个猎头氏族的情报。
据说他们用“魔法炮”这种奇特武器行凶。
传闻纷纷，却无人见过氏族或武器，只能猜测。
他们也许藏在暗处，也许只是传说。
无论如何，听到消息请告诉我们。
  ——多米斯街头耳目\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
A band of lowlifes has taken to advertising
false gemstones to attract gem dealers and
other people of means, then forcibly divesting
them of their wealth!

Why, they're even using the pubs to spread this
misinformation! The nerve!\end\
translation:
一群恶徒散布假宝石消息，
引来宝石商人和富人，再强行夺走财物！
他们甚至利用酒馆传播假消息，胆子真大！\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Honor to the brave adventurer who vanquished
the monster known as the Lord of the Flowsand
that long plagued the Galerria Deep.

That came to pass but recently, yet now we hear
whisperings that the beast has returned...
How can this be?

The reports say that the beast is bigger this
time, no less. What if, they say, what if it is
the lord's mother?\end\
translation:
向打倒长期祸害加雷里亚深处的
“流沙之主”的勇敢冒险者致敬。
这事才过去不久，却传闻野兽回来了……
怎么可能？据说这次体型更大。
有人猜，会不会是领主的母亲？\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Wolf-like creatures of a kind never seen before
are running rampant in the hills around Camoa!
A mark has been posted in hopes that there is
someone who can deal with this menace before
more lives are lost. Those who have faith in their
sword arm, come to our aid!
 ーCamoa Bureau of Safety\end\
translation:
卡莫亚周围山丘出现前所未见的狼形生物，
四处肆虐！悬赏已经发布，希望在更多人
丧命前消除威胁。剑术高超者请助我们一臂之力！
  ——卡莫亚安全局\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The four Lang Brothers, members of the
Moorabella region guild, the Arbiters of Death,
fled after seriously wounding an astounding
twenty-eight of their clanmates.

"Those Lang Brothers were trouble from the
start, everyone knew it. Just one look in those
cold, cruel eyes and you'd know it too," one
surviving clan member told us on condition of
anonymity.

The Defenders of the Peace have posted a mark
for the capture of these four dangerous criminals.

Those aspiring to the challenge should note that
the Arbiters of Death are a battle-hardened clan.
That four could wound so many is a testament
to just how adept these Lang Brothers are at the
business of battle.

Beware!\end\
translation:
摩拉贝拉地区“死亡仲裁者”氏族的朗氏四兄弟，
重伤了惊人的28名同伴后逃走。
一名幸存成员匿名表示：“大家都知道他们
从一开始就是麻烦，看看那冰冷残酷的眼神就明白。”
治安维护队已发布通缉，缉拿四名危险罪犯。
挑战者请注意：死亡仲裁者身经百战，
四人能伤那么多人，足见朗氏兄弟战斗技术高超。
务必小心！\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
It was all dark outside, and ma says I'm supposed
to be in bed, but I'm not, and I look out at the
Aldanna Range, yeah? And there's all these eyes
and they're looking at me.
*gulp*

But I told ma, and she says they posted a bill
for a mark, so I shouldn't worry.

I'm not worried.
But who're Bill and Mark?
 Little Obu, Age 5\end\
translation:
外面黑漆漆的，妈妈说我该睡觉了，
但我没有。我看向阿尔达纳山脉，
好多眼睛在盯着我。*咽口水*

我告诉妈妈，她说已经发布悬赏，不用担心。
我才不担心呢。
不过，“悬赏”是谁呀？
  五岁的小奥布\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Heard what everyone in Jylland is whispering?
A burglar of exceptional skill has been hitting
shop after shop across the realm.

Restaurants, armories, clotheries, no place is
safe...

This is nothing new to me...but when I heard
that the burglar is a monster...!

Oh, worry not. A bill will be posted soon enough.
 ーDomis Streetears\end\
translation:
听到休兰德各地的传闻了吗？
一名技艺高超的窃贼接连洗劫商店，
餐馆、武器店、服装店，无处安全……
这本不新鲜，可听说窃贼竟是怪物……！
别担心，悬赏很快就会发布。
  ——多米斯街头耳目\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
So many years, I have hated.

Hated them, hated you, hated until I grew weary
of hating.

How many of my comrades have fallen?
Gone to a place whence they shall never return?

Their hatred is mine.
Once more, I pick up my knife.
I'm coming for you.
 (Poster Unknown)\end\
translation:
这么多年来，我一直憎恨。
恨他们，恨你，恨到疲惫。
多少同伴倒下，去了再也回不来的地方？
他们的恨就是我的恨。
我再一次拿起刀。我要来找你。
  （张贴者不明）\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The perpetrators in the malicious encasement in
ice of a Fluorgis merchant manse and said manse's
inhabitants have been located and contained.

Due to the remarkable durability of the iceーten
days from the date of the incident, and it remains
entirely unmeltedーwe were able to closely examine
the scene, leading us to conclude that the
perpetrators were indeed several in number, and
possessing of an incredible capacity for creating
and manipulating large quantities of ice.

Knowing that to lose them in the cold, western
reaches of Jylland would be to lose them forever,
the Defenders came out in force to stop them
in the east. We were successful in containing them
within the Kthili Sands.

Though their motives are still unclear, what is
clear is that this opportunity to bring them to
justice must not be missed.
 ーJylland Defenders of the Peace\end\
translation:
将弗洛吉斯一座商人宅邸及住户恶意冰封的
犯人已被发现并围困。
冰异常坚固，事发十天后仍未融化，
让我们得以仔细调查现场。结论是犯人不止一名，
且拥有制造和操纵大量冰的惊人能力。
一旦让他们逃进休兰德西部寒冷地带，
就再难找到。维护队因此全力出动，
成功将其困在克提利沙地。
动机虽未明，但绝不能错过将其绳之以法的机会。
  ——休兰德治安维护队\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Oh, kupo! Have you heard? A giant plant thing is
going berserk out on Baptiste Hill and no traveler
is safe, kupo!

Kupo-po... I was supposed to pass that way, but
how can I now? I can't, that's how!

Anyway, I've posted a mark so it should only be
a matter of time.

Patience, kupo. Patience.\end\
translation:
哦，库啵！听说了吗？巴蒂斯特山有个
巨大植物怪发狂，旅行者都不安全！
我本来要走那条路，现在怎么走？根本走不了！
我已发布悬赏，解决只是时间问题。
耐心，库啵，耐心。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Kupo!!!
So what if they're cute? They're squatting on
my land! They've made a mess of the garden,
and there's no way in the Otherworld I'll ever
get those pumpkins growing again...

Kupo-po...

If you can't beat 'em, join 'em, right?
Oh, I asked, but they said "Your pom-pom's not
fluffy enough! Sorry, kupo!" Can you believe it?
I can't!

What am I supposed to do?
 Perplexed Moogle\end\
translation:
库啵！！！
可爱又怎样？他们占了我的地！
花园被弄得一团糟，南瓜再也种不出来了……
库啵……
打不过就加入，对吧？我问过了，
他们却说“你的绒球不够蓬松！抱歉，库啵！”
你能信吗？我不能！我该怎么办？
  困惑的莫古\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Strange things are afoot! When I heard a sieable
number of Fluorgis's fairer residents were off to
Sant D'alsa Bluff en masse, well, I thought that
the end had come at last.

Imagine my surprise when I discovered that they
were not abandoning our fine city, but instead
flocking to a particular house in the Bluff where
the five moogles known as the Moogle Rangers
have taken up residence...in the garden.

While the Moogle Rangers have not been known to
partake in violent acts, reports have shown that
they do nothing to discourage the considerable
donations of gil, jewelry, and consumables given
them by their smitten fans.

Some Moogle Ranger enthusiasts have raided
family fortunes, and even sunk to thievery to
fund their worship of these diminutive giants.

Others have been attacked by monsters en
route to see the rangers, causing problems of
a different sort.

Meanwhile, the fab five are heedless to calls of
"enough," or, indeed, the three eviction notices
already served them.

With the situation coming to a head, we can only
conclude that the Moogle Rangers' intent is
malicious, and a mark request has already been
issued for their pernicious pom-poms.
 Dolowat, Chief Director, Fluorgis Assembly\end\
translation:
怪事发生了！听说大批弗洛吉斯女性
前往圣达尔萨断崖，我还以为世界末日到了。
结果她们不是抛弃城市，而是涌向断崖某处宅邸，
因为五只自称莫古游侠队的莫古住进了花园。
游侠队虽未有暴力行为，却欣然接受迷妹们
捐赠的大量金钱、首饰和物品。
有粉丝为供奉他们掏空家产，甚至偷窃；
也有人探访途中被怪物袭击，造成其他问题。
这五人对“够了”的呼声以及三次驱逐通知
都置之不理。事态已到紧要关头，
我们只能认定他们居心不良，并已悬赏通缉。
  弗洛吉斯议会首席主任 多洛瓦特\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Listen now to this tale of a time long past.

It so happened that once upon a time, a great
horde of creatures descended upon the peaceful
people of Jylland.

The creatures sought to make a land for
themselves and so they leveled forests, dirtied
waters, and took the lives of countless men and
animals.

Then, one day, a piercing sound rolled across the
land, and a blinding light came down from the
heavens above.

The light burned the creatures where they
stood, leaving naught but ash behind.

When the sound and light had faded, three great
dragons were seen wheeling high in the sky
overhead, surveying the land below.

When they saw that none of the creatures
remained, off they flew to the Aldanna Range,
never to be seen in the skies again.

The people gave thanks to these three dragons,
worshipping them as protector spirits sent by
the gods themselves.\end\
translation:
听一段很久以前的故事。
从前，大群生物降临和平的休兰德。
它们想建立自己的国度，夷平森林、污染水源，
夺走无数人和动物的生命。
一天，刺耳的声音响彻大地，耀眼光芒从天而降，
将那些生物烧成灰烬。
声音与光消散后，三条巨龙在高空盘旋，俯瞰大地。
确认生物已被消灭，它们飞向阿尔达纳山脉，
从此不再现身。
人们感谢三龙，将它们奉为诸神派来的守护灵。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Whispers 'neath the eaves! Three dragons have
reared their fearsome heads in the vicinity of
the Aldanna Range, and they're attacking town
and traveler alike! Such lack of subtlety is sure
to earn them mark status shortly.

Mention of three dragons in the Aldannas might
recall stories of the protector dragons of old,
yet the only similarity here is their number.

These are base, feral creatures with naught but
menace on their minds.

Perhaps the thick Mist of the region is what drove
these typically reclusive wyrms to violence??
 ーDomis Streetears\end\
translation:
街头密闻！阿尔达纳山脉附近出现三条龙，
袭击城镇和旅人！如此张扬，很快就会被悬赏。
提起阿尔达纳三龙，也许会想到古代守护龙，
但它们唯一的共同点只有数量。
这些凶残野兽满脑子只有威胁。
是否当地浓雾让通常隐居的巨龙变得暴躁？
  ——多米斯街头耳目\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
A portion of a document apparently pertaining to
the development of an unmanned magick weapon
has been discovered, and here printed for the
edification of all.

----------------------------------------
ーPlumfrostー
Plans for the Design of the XII Obtained.
I shall Assay to, with these Plans as a Base,
Create a Weapon far more Powerful than the XII.

ーSkyfrostー
Development proceeds smoothly, thanks in no Small
Part to my possession of the XII plans.

The groundwork for the XII is almost Complete.
Intrigued by its Mist Absorption Functions, I have
Contrived means to convert this Mist, typically
used for Growth, into a Weapon. This shall then
serve as the Main Cannon.

ーGreenfireー
Considering other Options for the Mist Absorption
Growth Mechanism, so that it need not rely solely
upon Mist for its Working. If other Materials could
be used for Growth, said Growth would proceed at
a phenomenal Rate.

After testing many Substances, I found those
occurring in Nature to be most promising: Molten
Rock, Snow, Sea Water, &c.

ーBloodfireー
The Growth feature has been significantly
Expanded! I have succeeded in drawing sufficient
Energies for Growth from Molten Rock.

Tests have been highly encouraging, showing
no less than a tenfold Improvement over the
performance data of the original XII.

I must admit, not even I expected Progress on
such a superlative Scale!

In giving Consideration to future use in the Field,
I have taken Steps to camouflage the Weapon by
painting it Red in its Entirety.\end\
translation:
发现一份似乎与无人魔法兵器研发有关的文件，
现刊出供公众参考。

梅霜月：取得XII的设计图。我将以此为基础，
制造比XII强大得多的兵器。
天霜月：多亏拥有XII图纸，研发顺利，
基础结构即将完成。我对吸雾功能很感兴趣，
设计了将原用于生长的雾转为武器的方法，
作为主炮。
绿火月：考虑让吸雾生长机制不再只依赖雾。
若能用其他材料，生长速度将大幅提高。
测试多种物质后，熔岩、雪、海水等天然物质
最有希望。
血火月：生长功能大幅扩展！已成功从熔岩
提取足够能量。测试表现至少是原XII的十倍。
我也没想到进展如此惊人！考虑实际部署，
我将兵器全身涂红以作伪装。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
ーRosefireー
Of late, my "Superiors" (so are They called, 
though not by Me in my Privacy) have seen fit
to Sniff and Scrabble at my Laboratory Door like
so many Bloodhounds.

I fear what would become of my Research
should these Hounds espy the Fox. 

In Anticipation of such a misfortunate Event,
I have wisely created a Duplicate Model.
Since I used as a Base an unmanned Magickal
Weapon which I had fashioned prior to coming
into possession of the XII Plans, it was by
Comparison swift to complete.

In designing this second Unit, I sought to further
expand its Potential for growth fueled not by Mist
or Magma, but by common Snow. 

I have since painted it White to provide
Camouflage in what could rightly be considered
its Natural Habitat.

ーCoppersunー
It has come Time to Cease and Desist calling my
Creation this "Thing" and give it a proper Name.

The XII, for its Part, was called the Omega Mark
XII during Development, though many such as
Myself abbreviate this to a simple XII. 

According to the Records of the Researcher who
originally named it, "Omega" was the final Letter
in an Alphabet used in ancient Times.

Therefore, I, too, borrowed from the Ancients in
naming my Creation the "Upsilon."

Because I now find Myself with two of these
Devices, I shall call the first Upsilon, and the
second Upsilon-A2.

ーGoldsunー
As part of my continuing Efforts to power my
Devices with as much Efficiency as is Possible,
I have created yet another Upsilon, this one
deriving its energies from common Sea Water.

I have painted it a stunning Marine Blue,
and named it somewhat unimaginatively,
I confess, Upsilon-A3.\end\
translation:
玫火月：最近我的“上司”（私下我不这么叫）
像猎犬般在实验室门口嗅探。要是他们发现狐狸，
我的研究恐怕不保。为防万一，我明智地制造了
副本。它以取得XII图纸前制造的无人魔法兵器
为基础，因此完成得较快。
第二机的生长能量不是雾或岩浆，而是普通雪。
我将它涂白，便于在自然环境中伪装。
铜阳月：是时候给作品正式命名了。
XII研发时称为欧米茄Mark XII，许多人简称XII。
据最初命名者记录，“欧米茄”是古代字母表
最后一个字母。因此我也借古名，将作品称为
“宇普西隆”。既然已有两台，第一台叫宇普西隆，
第二台叫宇普西隆A2。
金阳月：为了提高供能效率，我又制造一台，
以普通海水为能量，涂上亮丽海蓝色。
名字不太有创意：宇普西隆A3。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
ーSilversunー
I have now attached Devices for the remote
Operation of all three Upsilons, and sent them to
Locations chosen for a plentiful Supply of the
Materials used by my Upsilons for their Growth.
Now begin the Tests.

An Incident befalls my Project.

A3 was sent to the Sea, whereupon it proceeded
to Run Wild and Explode in a rather exaggerated
Manner. I have narrowed down the Cause to an
over-Intake of Material, exceeding the Capacity
of the Growth Function.

ーAshleafー
My "Superiors" have begun work on a Mage
Cannon using for its Source of Power nothing
other than Mist. It is yet another Affront to my
Work. Upsilon will remind Them of their proper
Place.

ーMistleafー
I have attached a Sensor to A1 able to detect
the Mage Cannon in Operation. As soon as they
have found Success, A1 will destroy their Facility.
Only then will all be Well.

Anticipating the eventual Destruction of A1, I
have Installed a Self-Activation System into A2.
Should A1 fail, A2 will automatically wake from its
Watching and destroy the Target in its Brother's
stead.

ーEmberleafー
I have placed A1 and A2 in the Location where
they last tested their Mage Cannon. Now I only
need wait for the Destruction to come.

(The remainder of the document is charred
beyond legibility.)\end\
translation:
银阳月：已为三台宇普西隆装上远程操作装置，
送往适合获取生长材料的地点，开始测试。
项目发生事故。A3送到海里后失控并剧烈爆炸。
原因已缩小为材料摄入过多，超过生长功能容量。
灰叶月：“上司”开始开发以雾为能源的魔法炮，
再次冒犯我的研究。宇普西隆会让他们认清地位。
雾叶月：我给A1安装了探测魔法炮运作的传感器。
他们一成功，A1就会摧毁设施，如此才算妥当。
预见A1最终可能被毁，我给A2安装自动启动系统。
若A1失败，A2将自动苏醒，代兄弟摧毁目标。
余烬叶月：A1和A2已放在他们上次测试魔法炮的
地点。现在只需等待毁灭。
（文件其余部分烧焦，无法辨认。）\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Where else can you meet all variety of creatures
with no consequences but Grann's Menagerie?
So went the literature, but recently a spate of
escapes from the park has raised concerns for
visitor safety.

Fears continue to mount, with a significant
proportion of the park's escapees having run
riot, to the very great detriment of several
properties in the area.

Park head Mr. Grann has acknowledged the facts
of the situation, citing abnormal stress on the
monsters as a contributing factor to the rise in
escapes.

Probable causes of stress include any extremity
of treatment, such as abandonment or, still worse,
the administration of excessive affection.
Park workers and the Grann family have been
sternly cautioned by the Society for the
Protection of Monsters.\end\
translation:
除了格兰动物园，哪里还能毫无后果地见到
各种生物？宣传册如此写道，但近期多起逃逸
引发游客安全担忧。许多逃走的怪物四处闹事，
严重损坏附近财产，恐惧不断增加。
园长格兰先生承认事实，称怪物承受异常压力
是逃逸增加的原因之一。压力可能来自任何极端
对待，包括遗弃或更糟的过度溺爱。
怪物保护协会已严厉警告员工与格兰一家。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
They've done it! No one has ever managed to
liberate one of those ancient swords lodged
in the preternaturally hard shell of a blade
biter...until now!

The sword was immediately offered to renowned
metallurgist Mr. Steeling, yet the strength of
the metal was such that nothing could be done to
it.

It had been hoped that other weapons and armor
could make benefit of that incredible strength,
yet these proved to be nothing but empty
dreams.

The sword in question now inhabits a place of
honor on the wall in Mr. Steeling's manor.\end\
translation:
他们成功了！至今无人能从剑咬兽异常坚硬的
甲壳中取出古剑，现在终于有人做到了！
剑立刻送到著名冶金师斯蒂林先生手中，
但金属过于坚硬，根本无法加工。
人们原本希望将这种强度用于其他武器防具，
如今只能成为空想。
这把剑现被尊贵地挂在斯蒂林宅邸的墙上。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Thanks for the kupoppies the other day.
I made the tincture and swallowed it down just
before reaching Fluorgis, and lo and behold,
I was talking just like her in moments.

It's still unclear to me precisely what
quality of her speech is supposed by some
to differentiate her as "special" and "grown-up,"
however... Evidently, the same can be said of
her, as she severed all ties with me the moment
I opened my mouth.

It's not your fault, really. The blame is mine
for relying on such a crutch. I merely thought to
relay to you the outcome of things with this
letter, kupo.

...Kupo!?

Finally! The tincture's worn off! I'm back to
normal...and maybe it's for the best.

Maybe she'll think so too! I'm off to try again!
Wish me luck, kupo!
 Kolulu\end\
translation:
感谢前几天送来的库波比花。
我做成药剂，在抵达弗洛吉斯前喝下，
转眼间说话就像她一样。
我仍不明白她说话究竟哪里“特别”“成熟”……
显然她也不明白，因为我一开口她就与我断绝关系。
这不是你的错，怪我依赖这种手段。
写信只是告诉你结果，库啵。
……库啵！？终于！药效退了，我恢复正常了！
也许这样更好。也许她也这么想！
我要再试一次，祝我好运，库啵！
  库露露\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Thanks so much for the cactus fruit the other
day.

The medicine worked, and the boy was brought
back from death's doorstep and restored to full
health.

Much to my surprise, the boy hailed from a
wealthy family, and they were quite generous
in showing me their gratitude.

Though this was truly unexpected, I've resolved
to make the most of it by traveling to Moorabella,
there to refine my skills in magickal medicine.
 Mack Ocktor\end\
translation:
非常感谢前几天的仙人掌果实。
药物起效，男孩从死亡边缘恢复健康。
令我惊讶的是，他出身富裕家庭，
家人十分慷慨地表达了谢意。
这虽出乎意料，我决定善用机会前往摩拉贝拉，
钻研魔法医术。
  麦克·奥克托\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Mr. Ocktor, having developed countless new
medicines and applications, has been recognized
by the Ivalice Herbalists Association for his
contributions.

Mr. Ocktor has developed tinctures for treating
the most intractable ailments, worked in several
areas of medicine, and through his innovations,
saved many lives.

Rumors have now surfaced that the Rozarrian
Imperial League of Physicians, located in the
capital, have shown interest in working with
Mr. Ocktor in the future.\end\
translation:
奥克托先生开发无数新药及应用，
其贡献获得伊瓦利斯药草师协会认可。
他研制治疗疑难疾病的药剂，涉足多个医学领域，
以创新挽救了许多生命。
如今传闻首都的罗扎利亚帝国医师联盟
有意将来与他合作。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I thank you for your watchful eyes and strong
arms in Targ Wood. I owe my life to your dutiful
protection!

Still, the whole affair came as quite a shock.

I've given this a great deal of thought, and I've
decided to put off going to Rozarria, and quit my
research laboratory in Moorabella. It's really the
only option.
 Mack Ocktor\end\
translation:
感谢你们在塔格森林的警觉和保护，
我这条命多亏了你们！
不过整件事实在让我震惊。
经过深思熟虑，我决定推迟去罗扎利亚，
并离开摩拉贝拉的研究室。这是唯一的选择。
  麦克·奥克托\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Thank you so much for getting me my cake back
the other day.

On my father's birthday, I summoned up what
courage I had and, bringing him my homemade
carrot cake, I spoke to him at last.

I was...shy at first. But as we talked, it became
easier until I could hardly remember that we
had been fighting.

It seems strange to me now that we ever had a
falling out. Why was I fighting with my father,
anyway?

Was it because he ate all my favorite malboro
jelly?

Or maybe because he left the corral door open
one day when I had told him time and time again
to be careful, and my favorite chocobo got away?

...Well, all that's past us now, isn't it?
And I have you to thank.

Thank you, thank you so much!
 Lea\end\
translation:
非常感谢前几天帮我找回蛋糕。
父亲生日那天，我鼓起勇气带着亲手做的
胡萝卜蛋糕，终于和他说话了。
起初我很害羞，但越聊越自然，几乎忘了争吵。
现在想起来，曾经闹翻真奇怪。
我们到底为什么吵架？
是因为他吃光我最爱的魔界花果冻？
还是因为我再三叮嘱他小心，他却没关牧场门，
让最喜欢的陆行鸟跑了？
……总之都过去了，对吧？这一切都要感谢你。
真的，非常感谢！
  莉娅\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Nestled in the Rupie Mountains lie two villages,
at odds with each other for many years. One is
inhabited by the scaled bangaa, the other by the
shaggy mountain nu mou. The villages are rivals in
all things.

Nowhere is their rivalry more raw than in the
battle between the villages' elite clans: the
Bangaa Brotherhood, and the Nu Mou Nobles.

This battle, fought in fits and starts over years,
has come to be known as the Rivalry of the
Rupies, and many visitors to Jylland travel to the
mountains just to witness it.\end\
translation:
鲁皮山脉中有两个村庄，多年来彼此敌对。
一个住着有鳞的邦加族，另一个住着毛茸茸的
山地努穆族。双方事事竞争。
竞争最激烈的是各村精英氏族之间的战斗：
邦加兄弟会对努穆贵族。
这场断断续续多年的争斗被称为“鲁皮之争”，
许多休兰德游客专程到山中观看。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Word is that the Bangaa Brotherhood and Nu Mou
Nobles are at it again up in the Rupie Mountains!

Perhaps rumors of a growing desire to end the
conflict once and for all are true, for both sides
have been openly recruiting mercenaries in the
pubs of late.\end\
translation:
听说邦加兄弟会和努穆贵族又在鲁皮山脉开战！
传闻双方都想彻底结束争斗，或许是真的，
因为最近两边都在酒馆公开招募佣兵。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
A word in your ear: that trade magnate over
in Moorabella, Lord Parkay, is planning
something big up in the Rupie Mountains.

Now, the Rupie Mountains are known for their
natural beauty...but the terrain can be harsh on
the traveler. That's what Parkay wants to fix.
He wants to turn the place into some kind of
family resort!

The lord is already in negotiations with local
residents, buying up parcels of land...and word is
he plans to send in clans to deal with them what
don't want to sell...

But you didn't hear -that- from me.
 ーDomis Streetears\end\
translation:
悄悄告诉你：摩拉贝拉商业巨头帕凯大人
正在鲁皮山脉策划大事。
鲁皮山脉风景优美，地形却对旅人不友好。
帕凯想改变这一点，把那里变成家庭度假胜地！
他已与当地居民商谈收购土地，
据说还打算派氏族对付不愿出售的人……
不过这话不是我说的。
  ——多米斯街头耳目\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Just the other day, it finally happened.

The Bangaa Brotherhood and the Nu Mou Nobles
agreed on terms of peace, and the Rivalry of the
Rupies is finally over!

The two clans plan to devote themselves to the
protection of the Rupie Mountains.

Though the events that started the Rivalry of
the Rupies are shrouded in mystery, few want
to pry too deeply, for fear of reopening old
wounds that might prompt a return to hostilities.\end\
translation:
前几天，事情终于发生了。
邦加兄弟会与努穆贵族达成和平协议，
鲁皮之争终于结束！
两个氏族计划致力于保护鲁皮山脉。
争斗起因虽笼罩谜团，却少有人愿意深究，
以免揭开旧伤、再生敌意。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
It's me! Kuleek from the Akademy?
Thanks for the help with that love philtre!

Actually...the experiment was a failure.

It turns out someone had told her about
how I'd sat with her when she was in the
grip of the fever...and that's why she
fell in love with me!

It had nothing to do with the philtre at all!
Failure has never tasted so sweet!\end\
translation:
是我！学院的库利克！
谢谢你帮忙处理爱情药水！
其实……实验失败了。
原来有人告诉她，我在她发烧时一直陪伴，
她因此爱上了我！与药水毫无关系！
失败从未如此甜蜜！\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The crushatrice is known for its especially violent
temperament, but one in particular makes all the
rest look like docile hens.

Adventurers in the know call it Klesta, and its
name evokes fear deep in the cockles of their
hearts.

Klesta is mean, real mean. It attacks people,
animals, anything that gets in its way.

Surely, someone would have dealt with this
scourge a long time ago, were it not so
nefariously resilient.

Many are the hunters who claim to have taken
the beast to death's door only to have it escape
at the last moment, only to return a day or two
later fully restored to health!

And those hunters were the best of the best.
The rest that tried to take on this fell beast,
well...it's still alive, isn't it.\end\
translation:
碎击鸡以暴躁闻名，但其中一只
让其他同类看起来都像温顺母鸡。
资深冒险者称它克莱斯塔，名字令人胆寒。
它极其凶恶，攻击挡路的人、动物和一切事物。
若非它异常顽强，早有人除掉这祸害了。
许多顶尖猎人说曾将它逼到死亡边缘，
它却最后逃脱，一两天后便完全恢复归来！
至于其他挑战者……它不是还活着吗？\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
What other elite group of headhunters would do
anythingーprovided there's gil on the tableーbut
House Bowen?

What other clan has brought in more than four
hundred marks? That alone would qualify them
as one of Ivalice's top-tier teamsーand that's not
even taking into account the high demand for
their services as escorts for important personages,
sellswords for padding out forces during regional
conflicts, and gods-know-what goings-on taking
place behind drawn curtains.

Their leader, Bowen, is not only
a fearsome combatant, but a cool-headed thinker
as well, who takes on even the smallest request
with the utmost care and caution.

Yet Bowen is also known as someone who
would lay down his life to save a comrade. The
fervent loyalty this inspires is one of the secrets
to House Bowen's success.\end\
translation:
有钱就什么都做的精英猎头，还有谁比鲍恩家族
更出名？他们捉拿过四百多个悬赏目标，
仅此就足以跻身伊瓦利斯顶尖队伍。
更别说护送要人、在地区冲突中受雇作战，
以及幕后不为人知的行动都需求旺盛。
首领鲍恩不仅战力可怖，也头脑冷静，
再小的委托都谨慎处理。
他也愿意为救同伴舍命；由此赢得的忠诚
正是鲍恩家族成功的秘诀之一。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
It's been several years now since the lady
headhunter Friese made her name known among
the clans.

Slayer of countless marks, the beauty with
which she worked her sword-edge earned her
the title of Blademaiden Frieseーand a
position of honor next to Blademaster Frimelda as
one of Jylland's most celebrated women warriors.

While little is known about Friese the woman, it is
true she often traveled with several companions,
making it likely she was a member of a clan.

In her heyday, new tales of her derring-do
sprang up in the taverns with every new moon,
but of late, the bards sing little of her conquests.
Even the streetears have stopped whispering
her name.

One wonders what she is doing now, and where.\end\
translation:
女猎头芙莉丝在氏族间成名已有数年。
她斩获无数悬赏目标，剑术优美，
赢得“剑之少女芙莉丝”的称号，
与剑圣芙莉梅尔达并列休兰德著名女战士。
关于她本人所知甚少，但她常与数名伙伴同行，
很可能属于某个氏族。

近来吟游诗人却很少再唱她的事迹，

她现在身在何处，又在做什么呢？\end\

source_text:
ーCarm Mercantile House Reportー

We're a youthful house, in operation for what
some might consider a scant twenty years since
our beginnings wrighting ships in the port town
of Graszton.

Yet, our youthfulness has been our strength. We
have honed our techniques, built up an impressive
list of clients and successes, and since our entry
into the comestible freight business ten years
past, our support has grown among all the people
of the regions we serve, making us one of the
largest mercantile houses in all Jylland.

We look forward to continuing to support the
growth and prosperity of Jylland as we expand
our operations to accommodate future demand.

ーNOTICEー
To commemorate our first twenty years, we have
started a new branch of House operations
dedicated to a recently growing concern:
the protection and preservation of endangered
monsters.*

We will be releasing a report on our progress
shortly.

*Endangered monster: Any monster that, due to
its being a source of valuable or otherwise
efficacious materials, has been hunted to the
brink of extinction.

While monsters were previously considered to
exist for the sole purpose of felling, it has
become clear that the removal of certain monsters
from their habitat has caused irreversible damage
to the food chain, resulting in considerably
weakened ecological systems. Hence, the need for
their preservation.\end\
translation:
卡姆商会报告

本商会创立于格拉斯顿港造船业，
至今仅二十年，有人可能觉得年轻。
但年轻正是优势：我们精进技术、积累客户与业绩。
十年前进入食品运输业后，获得各地区人民支持，
成为休兰德最大的商会之一。
我们将继续扩展业务，满足未来需求，
支持休兰德的成长繁荣。

通知：为纪念成立二十年，
我们新设部门，致力于日益受到关注的
濒危怪物保护，将于近期公布进展。

濒危怪物指因提供珍贵或有效材料而被捕猎至
濒临灭绝的怪物。过去怪物被认为只能讨伐，
如今已知移除某些物种会不可逆地破坏食物链，
严重削弱生态系统，因此必须保护。\end\

source_text:
ーThe Jylland Free Press: Special Issueー

Graszton Mega-House Carm Mercantile's Big-Time
Blunder!

Only recently, Carm Mercantile began their
campaign to preserve endangered monsters,
which has apparently fueled interest in hunting
one rare breed!

The name of this endangered monster is the
cluckatrice: a white-feathered, red-wattled bird
creature.

As it so happens, the flavorsome, nutritious flesh
of this bird has made it widely popular, and the
meat now fetches a handsome price at market.

The adult cluckatrice's larger-than-hume size made
it even more of an attractive target among those
in the know, as one full-grown bird could supply a
sizeable quantity of meat. Further publicity on the
birds as a result of Carm Mercantile's misguided
efforts only served to raise public awareness of
the creatures, and hunting is now at a fever
pitch.

Soon after the monster preservation campaign
began, suspicious characters began popping up, 
looking for cluckatrices wherever they might
roamーa clear sign that something was amiss.
While the poachers certainly bear ultimate
responsibility for their immoral deeds, Carm
Mercantile must also bear blame for not having
foreseen this rather morbid turn of events.
 Anrias, Reporter of the Truth\end\
translation:
《休兰德自由报》特刊

格拉斯顿商业巨头卡姆商会的重大失误！
卡姆最近启动濒危怪物保护活动，
却似乎激起了对一种稀有物种的捕猎兴趣！
这种濒危怪物名为咯咯鸡，白羽红冠。
其肉美味且营养丰富，广受欢迎，市价高昂。
成年咯咯鸡比休姆族还大，一只可提供大量肉，
因此对知情者格外有吸引力。卡姆不当宣传
进一步提高知名度，捕猎如今已陷入狂热。
保护活动开始不久，可疑人物便四处寻找咯咯鸡，
清楚表明情况不妙。偷猎者固然应对恶行负责，
卡姆商会未预见这可悲后果也难辞其咎。
  真相记者 安里亚斯\end\

ーThe Jylland Free Press: Special Issueー

Graszton Mega-House Carm Mercantile:
An Ongoing Saga of Shame!

We recently looked into Carm Mercantile's
ill-considered campaign to protect endangered
monsters.

Carm Mercantile have admitted that poaching
continues unabated, but have expressed hope
that this is a temporary state of affairs
prompted by the spread of the story.
"We at Carm Mercantile would like to stress
that the purpose of our campaign was to raise
awareness of the plight of endangered monsters,
certainly not to encourage their further
endangering," a House Carm spokesperson stated
late last week.

If nothing else, this campaign and resulting
story certainly has raised awareness of
endangered monsters. Though whether this
will ultimately be to the monsters' betterment
or detriment is a matter for time to tell.
 Anrias, Reporter of the Truth\end\

格拉斯顿商业巨头卡姆商会：耻辱事件继续！

ーThe Jylland Free Press: Special Issueー

Graszton Mega-House Carm Mercantile:
The Shameful Saga Continues!

News flash! A mysterious group is behind the
recent poaching of endangered monsters!

This reporter, having spotted a clan capturing
endangered monsters in the Galerria Deep,
followed the poachers only to witness them
passing their catch off to a mysterious group
of traders in the pre-dawn light of the Bisga
Greenlands in exchange for a sizeable quantity
of gil.

This reporter would have inquired further as to
the identity of the traders, but the palpable
whiff of danger that came wafting from them
would have discouraged a berserker with a
death wish.
No everyday monster traffickers, these!

Though this reporter did not see what transpired
next, it is safe to say that this confirms the
presence of at least one organization paying
good gil for the endangered monsters, made
popular by Carm Mercantile's preservation
campaign.

As a reporter of the truth, I, Anrias, vow to get
to the bottom of these shady dealings, and
expose the identity of these traders in
contraband once and for all!
 Anrias, Reporter of the Truth\end\

卡姆商会耻辱事件继续！

ーThe Jylland Free Press: Special Issueー

Shady Group Behind Poaching of Endangered 
Monsters: Our Investigation Continues!

My continuing inquiry into the group behind the
poaching of endangered monsters has revealed a
stunning truth!

It turns out there's more to the endangered
monster in question, the cluckatrice, than we
previously suspected!

Apparently, the cluckatrice's wild demeanor when
angered made it perfectly suited for cock
fighting...a sport which the mysterious group or
should I say "syndicate" behind the cluckatrices'
capture has been promoting in secret!

Fans come to see the games, and the syndicate
reaps the profits from the betting booths.

Even more surprising is the clientele at these illicit
bouts. Not only do upstanding gentlemen knights
of Graszton and the nobles of Moorabella attend,
but crowds have come from the merchant families
of Eastern Jylland, and there have even been
sightings of ambassadors from the far and distant
empire of Rozarria in attendance.

I cannot hide my abject amazement that there
exists, today, an organization capable of carrying
out such a large-scale underground gambling
operation.

I would like to continue my reportage and uncover
the true face of this shadowy organization, but
now that the case is under the jurisdiction of the
Jylland Defenders of the Peace, I, along with
my faithful readers, can but await their
announcement.

So, in lieu of more truth-finding and
truth-revealing, I will leave you with a thought.

"Khamja, Khamja makes a brave boy weep,
cry too much and they'll come while you sleep."

What child of our generation did not grow up
knowing this rhyme? Yet few know that know
that Khamja was in fact a crime syndicate
that terrorized our land more than a hundred
years ago.

I believe it is no exaggeration to say that the
group behind this recent spate of criminal
activities is no less a threat to our way of life
than Khamja was in our ancestors' day. Gods
protect us all!
 Anrias, Reporter of the Truth, signing off.\end\

《休兰德自由报》特刊

濒危怪物偷猎幕后黑手：调查继续！
对幕后团体的持续调查揭露了惊人真相！
咯咯鸡还有我们之前不知道的一面：

捕捉它们的神秘团体，或者说犯罪组织，

甚至有人见到遥远的罗扎利亚帝国大使。

近期犯罪背后的团体对我们生活的威胁，

ーWorkshop Report: Chita's Weaponersー

A workshop located in the Aldanna Range, where
Mastersmith Chita and his apprentices toil daily
to produce new weapons to arm our stalwart
knights.

In the workshop, the air rings with the sound
of metal on metal, and occasionally Mastersmith
Chita's booming voice. When asked, one apprentice
said of his master: "He is more fiery than the
forge, has lungs bigger than the bellows, and
is sharper than our finest blade."

Yet, in contrast to his own heroic proportions,
Chita's blades are delicate, refined works of art.
Even their superlative beauty, however, cannot
outshine their terrifying effectiveness on the
battlefieldーthe latter quality being the one
which has won them so many admirers.

Truly, the arms of Chita's Weaponers shine
across all of Ivalice.\end\
translation:
工坊报道：奇塔武器队

阿尔达纳山脉的一座工坊里，
锻造大师奇塔和学徒每天辛勤制作新武器，
装备英勇的骑士。
工坊里金铁交鸣，偶尔响起大师洪亮的声音。
一名学徒说：“他比熔炉更火热，
肺活量比风箱还大，比最锋利的刀还敏锐。”
与他魁梧身形相反，奇塔的刀剑精致如艺术品。
但再美也比不上它们在战场上的可怕效力，
正是这一点赢得无数爱好者。
奇塔武器队的兵器确实闪耀整个伊瓦利斯。\end\

The foreign crime syndicate Duelhorn has been
spotted making inroads in Jylland of late.

From the large number of reports, we can assume
a great many operatives are now at large in
Jylland, though there has been no clear consensus
as to what business has brought them thither.
What could they want, and how could this mean
anything but trouble?\end\

近期有人发现外国犯罪组织双角进入休兰德。
大量报告表明许多成员正在各地活动，

ーNotice to all Clan Members!ー
Crime syndicate Duelhorn has been swallowing up
smaller clans right and left to fuel their ongoing
expansion.

Clans have been approached and asked if they
wish to join Duelhorn, only to be strong-armed
into joining when they refused.

Though their recruitment techniques may be harsh,
apparently their treatment of member clans is
quite evenhanded, and there have been no
reports of unrest among the ranks.

Still, there is ample cause for any clan member
to be wary of Duelhorn's activities.
Consider this a warning!\end\

致全体氏族成员的通知！
犯罪组织双角为扩张不断吞并小氏族。
他们询问氏族是否愿意加入，遭拒后便强迫加入。
尽管招募手段强硬，成员氏族似乎受到公平对待，
尚无内部动荡报告。
即便如此，各氏族成员仍有充分理由警惕双角。
请把这当作警告！\end\

ーNotice to all Clan Members!ー

We have received reports that Duelhorn is
stepping up its recruitment activities. While its aim
appears to remain the gathering of more clans
under their central command, their means have
gone from strong-arm to outright violent.

However, other reports suggest that this surge in
activity is not official Duelhorn policy, but rather
the result of actions taken by a group of
extremists within the Duelhorn organization.

Whoever's authority they are working on, they
have already been successful large number of
clans into Duelhorn, and we can only expect
the syndicate's power to grow even more in
coming months.

We advise continued caution when dealing with
anyone you suspect to be an agent of Duelhorn.\end\

致全体氏族成员的通知！
据报双角正在加强招募。目的似乎仍是将更多
氏族纳入统一指挥，但手段已从强迫升级为暴力。
另有报告称，活动激增并非双角官方政策，
而是组织内极端派的行动。
不论他们受谁指挥，已成功吸收大量氏族，

source_text:
Cid, long time no talk.

It sounds like you and yours have been dealing
with Duelhorn recently. It seems Khamja has their
eyes on your clan's connection to Duelhorn, no
less.

Speaking of Duelhorn, a certain Dewk
Snakeheart made a real mess of things at a
Khamja betting stand just the other day. You
can be sure neither Duelhorn nor Khamja will let
this go without getting more deeply...involved,
shall we say.

Knowing you, you'd never entertain the notion of
joining forces with Duelhorn, but not everyone
shares my faith.

Khamja too has grown, and there are many in
its ranks that have never even heard the name
"Cid."

I only wanted to warn you that Khamja will move
on this, and soon. Be careful.

Don't give me more cause to worry about you,
hmm?\end\
translation:
希德，好久不见。
听说你和同伴最近在与双角打交道，
卡姆贾似乎也盯上了你们氏族与双角的联系。
说到双角，前几天蛇心杜克在卡姆贾赌摊
大闹一场。可以肯定，双方都不会就此罢休，
会更加深入地……介入。
我了解你，知道你绝不会想与双角联手，
但不是所有人都像我这样相信你。
卡姆贾也壮大了，许多成员甚至没听过“希德”。
我只是想提醒你，卡姆贾很快会采取行动。
小心。别再让我为你担心，好吗？\end\

source_text:
Duelhorn, in the midst of a massive expansion,
has suffered setbacks from attacks in Western
Jylland.

The identity of the attackers is unknown. They
have left no scrap of information that might shed
light on their methods or motives. It is not even
entirely clear that the attacks have been the
work of a single group. The Jylland Defenders of
Peace have been mobilized, but for time being, are
well behind the perpetrators in their investigation.

Should these attacks continue at this level of
calculated ferocity, it is only a matter of time
before Duelhorn falters and fails.

Rumors persist that the wave of attacks was
prompted by an incident in Graszton several days
before, in which Duelhorn members set off on a
rampage which resulted in the destruction of
several town buildings.

Perhaps they incurred someone, or something's
wrath? Only time and continued investigation
can hope to tell.\end\
translation:
正在大规模扩张的双角在休兰德西部
遭受袭击，扩张受挫。
袭击者身份不明，没有留下任何能说明手法
或动机的线索，甚至无法确定是否同一团体所为。
治安维护队已出动，调查却远远落后于犯人。
若这种有计划的猛烈袭击持续下去，
双角衰败只是时间问题。
传闻这一波袭击由数日前格拉斯顿事件引发：
双角成员大肆破坏，毁掉数座建筑。
或许他们惹怒了某人或某种存在？
只有时间和进一步调查才能回答。\end\

source_text:
There was this guy, except he kinda looked like a
lady, and he saved the village!

See, it happened at night. There was this
incredible noise, and the house next door
collapsed. 

That's when I saw him...or her, helping the people
inside!

My friend, he seed it with his own eyes! He was
one of 'em what got saved! And the pretty guy
even gave him some candy! Of course, he ate the
candy so there's no proof of that...

So I hear that it was some Duelhorn folks who
wrecked our town, and I guess that guy was one
of them? But I heard him er...her shouting
something about not sacrificing the townspeople,
and he sounded pretty angry. That means he was
helping us, right?
 Crybaby Kocott\end\
translation:
有个人，长得有点像女士，救了村子！
那天夜里一声巨响，隔壁房子塌了。
我看到他……或者她，在帮助屋里的人！
我朋友亲眼看到，他就是获救的人之一！
漂亮哥哥还给他糖，不过他吃掉了，没证据……
听说是双角的人毁了城镇，那个人也是他们之一？
但我听见他，呃，她很生气地喊不能牺牲镇民。
这就是说他在帮我们，对吧？
  爱哭鬼 科科特\end\
