source_text:
Duelhorn's three-pronged attack striking Camoa,
Graszton, and Moorabella, while inflicting
considerable damage in each of those towns, has
ended in failure.

Though details are sparse, as the attacks occurred
during the night, and there were few witnesses,
it appears that the Duelhorn assailants were
themselves driven off by either a clan, or the
mysterious organization that has been targeting
Duelhorn operatives in recent days.

The whereabouts of the Four Bosses, leaders of
Duelhorn, is unknown at present. Bereft of their
leadership, the clan members have scattered, and
some from the old country have even begun to
pack up their belongings to return home. This, we
can safely say, ends any formal presence of
Duelhorn in Jylland.

In the wake of Duelhorn's offensive, influential
Graszton citizen Baron Beltorey has extended a
helping hand to those who lost their homes, while
denouncing Duelhorn's actions and calling for
more military strength in Jylland to fend off
such foreign incursions.\end\
translation:
双角对卡莫亚、格拉斯顿和摩拉贝拉的三路袭击
虽造成重大损失，最终却以失败告终。
袭击发生在夜间，目击者少，细节不多。
看来袭击者被某个氏族或近日针对双角的
神秘组织击退。
双角首领“四头目”下落不明。失去领导后，
成员四散，来自故乡的一些人甚至开始收拾行李
回家。可以说双角在休兰德的正式存在已终结。
袭击后，格拉斯顿有影响力的贝尔托雷男爵
向失去家园的人伸出援手，同时谴责双角，
呼吁加强休兰德军事力量，抵御外国入侵。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The Jylland Geological Survey Committee has
released the findings of their most recent survey.

According to the committee's report, new evidence
has been found supporting a theory behind the
increasing numbers of unusually aggressive
monsters.

The aggression has been linked to trace amounts
of a poisonous substance found in several of the
areas surveyed.

The substance is said to smell something like
chocobo talons, a scent that becomes stronger
at higher concentrations.

Monsters exposed to the scent exhibit signs of
mental instability, suffering delusions and 
periods of rampant, uncontrolled activity.

Worryingly, the survey also found that quarried
rocks bearing amounts of this substance have
been used for stonework which, beautiful though it
is, has the unfortunate disadvantage of being
mildly poisonous to people.

The survey committee has begun a campaign to
inform mines and stonecrafting workshops in the
areas where this substance is found, as well as
calling for increased caution when working
potentially tainted materials.\var2:00\\end\
translation:
休兰德地质调查委员会公布最新调查结果。
报告称，新增证据支持了关于异常凶暴怪物
数量增加的理论。攻击性与多个调查区域发现的
微量有毒物质有关。
据说这种物质有类似陆行鸟爪子的气味，
浓度越高气味越强。接触气味的怪物会精神不稳，
出现妄想及狂暴失控。
令人担忧的是，含此物质的采石被用于石工制品；
成品虽美，却对人有轻微毒性。
委员会已开始通知发现该物质地区的矿场及石工坊，
呼吁处理可能受污染材料时更加小心。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I am writing to thank you once again for scouting
out our proposed picnic location the other day.

Thanks to your findings, we decided to change our
picnic from a spelunking tour of the Nazan Mines
to a manufactory tour of Goug.

Though I had wished to expose the children to
the unique and remarkable beauty of the mines,
safety must always come first.

On our tour, I was able to introduce my
students to the fascination of a large scale
manufactory and the stoic beauty of the
exhaust pipe arrangements we saw there.

In short, you may rest assured that your
assistance has been to the very great benefit
of a number of young minds.
 Thil\end\
translation:
再次感谢你前几天勘察拟定的野餐地点。
根据你的发现，我们决定把纳赞矿山探洞游
改为古格工厂参观。
虽然我希望孩子们见识矿山独特而非凡的美，
安全始终第一。参观时，我向学生介绍了
大型工厂的魅力，以及排气管排列的朴素美感。
总之，请放心，你的帮助让许多年轻心灵受益良多。
  希尔\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Thank you so much for investigating my gardens.
I hear that the source of the noise was nothing
other than a lamia singing?

Thanks to you, I can rest easily and undisturbed
at night.

By the by, in the days after your investigation,
several of my neighbors came to tell me that the
strange headaches they'd been suffering had
abated quite miraculously! Perhaps the lamia's
song was troubling more than my beauty sleep?

Perhaps since I only recently moved here, I had
not been exposed to the song long enough to
develop the migraines my neighbors complained
of, and for that, I am quite grateful.
Yours,
 Lacado\end\
translation:
非常感谢你调查我的花园。听说噪声源头
竟然只是一只拉米亚在唱歌？
多亏你，我夜里能安心不受打扰地休息。
调查后几天，几个邻居告诉我，困扰他们的
奇怪头痛奇迹般减轻了！也许拉米亚的歌
影响的不只是我的美容觉？
我刚搬来，接触歌声时间不够长，
没患上邻居抱怨的偏头痛，真是万幸。
  拉卡多\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Hey, thanks for getting our well back for us!
It sure sucked not having a place to play.

Course now, our moms have taken over the place,
and they're always telling us to stop horsing
around and study our lessons. Bah!

Now we need someone to drive off our moms!\end\
translation:
嘿，谢谢你帮我们夺回井！没地方玩真难受。
当然，现在妈妈们占了那里，老叫我们
别胡闹、去学习。哼！
现在需要有人把妈妈们赶走！\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
You know the airship hijacking the other day?
Turns out that was some kind of exercise to
train staff how to deal with possible airship
attacks.

The airship terminal workers played the roles
of hijacker, victim, and rescue team. Just, the
rescue team was late in getting there.

I'd just arrived in town and, well, I was completely
fooled. I thought the airship was under attack!

Well, at least they finished their practice, so
no harm done, right?
Right?
 Neah\end\
translation:
知道前几天的飞空艇劫持吗？
原来那是训练员工应对可能袭击的演习。
航站员工扮演劫机者、受害者和救援队，
只是救援队来晚了。
我刚到镇上，完全被蒙住，以为飞空艇真的遇袭！
至少他们完成演习了，所以没什么损失吧？
对吧？
  妮娅\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
To all members of Clan \varA:01\:
I am in your debt.

After you helped me, I delivered everything
where it needed to go, and my house gave me
a bonus for my efforts!

My little sister Celestine is thrilled, just thrilled.

Now to grow a bit taller...then I'll be a real big
brother, to her, you know? I wish...
 Komodo Trader\end\
translation:
致\varA:01\氏族全体成员：
我欠你们一份人情。
得到你们帮助后，我把所有货物送到目的地，
家族还给了我奖金！妹妹塞莱丝汀高兴极了。
现在只要再长高一点……我就像她真正的哥哥了，
你懂吧？但愿如此……
  科莫多商人\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Did you know they're still finding old ruins and
hardened bones from ancient times out in Kthili
Sands?

There are several groups working out there,
excavating and doing surveys, including the
Akademy, but the team with the most dig sites
and the most unearthed artifacts is without
a doubt the Kthili Sands Surveyors.\end\
translation:
你知道克提利沙地仍不断发现古代遗迹
和石化骨骼吗？学院等几个团体正在那里
发掘调查，但发掘点和出土文物最多的，
无疑是克提利沙地调查队。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The unthinkable has happened. The Kthili Sands
Surveyors are no moreーdestroyed by forces
unknown.

Yet in the wake of this astonishing incident, an
even more astonishing truth has come to light:
the organization known as the Kthili Sands
Surveyors was nothing more than a front for
illegal trade in currencies and artifacts, and
many of their dig sites were unauthorizedーtheir
"unearthed" artifacts stolen!

The Surveyors were common thieves.
No more. No less.\end\
translation:
难以置信的事发生了：克提利沙地调查队
被不明势力摧毁，不复存在。
然而更惊人的真相随之曝光：
所谓调查队不过是非法交易钱币和文物的幌子，
许多发掘未经许可，“出土”文物其实是赃物！
调查队只是普通盗贼，仅此而已。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Thanks for gathering those machina scraps for me,
kupo!

Finally, my years of research in lost technologies
are going to pay off, kupo!

Bringing the metal giants back, that's what I'm
about, kupo. And thanks to you gathering those
scraps, I've finished my repairs!

Yes, my metal giant...though don't get me wrong,
he's not really all that big. He's about, well,
about my height, kupo.

He's not completely finished. I've got him walking
a bit, and carrying light loads though, kupo!

Yes, everything so far's gone with nary a hitch...
so far.

Kupo-po... I made some modifications, and thought
I had it all figured out, but when I hit the
switch...nothing. To be honest, I'm at wit's
end, kupo!

Maybe it's the manufacted magicite, I'm thinking.
Yes, I'm sure the natural variety's the way to go,
kupo! Either that or something involving
quickenings...? What to do! Kupo-po...
 Sheni\end\
translation:
感谢你帮我收集机械碎片，库啵！
我多年研究失落技术终于要有成果了！
我的目标是让金属巨人重生；多亏这些碎片，
修理终于完成！
别误会，我的金属巨人其实没那么大，
大约和我一样高，库啵。
它还没完全完工，但已能走几步、搬轻东西！
到目前为止一切顺利……目前为止。
库啵……我做了些改造，自以为弄明白了，
按下开关却毫无反应。说实话我束手无策！
也许是人造魔石的问题。对，一定要用天然魔石！
或者和觉醒有什么关系……？怎么办！库啵……
  谢妮\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Several items of jewelry and art were stolen the
other day from the residence of Baron Popple,
the so-called "wheat king" of Camoa. Blame for
the theft has been placed on the band known as
the Yellow Wings, currently fugitives from the law.

Baron Popple has allegedly hired an elite
headhunter to find them and retrieve his stolen
goods.\end\
translation:
前几天，卡莫亚“麦王”波普尔男爵宅邸
失窃数件珠宝和艺术品。被通缉的黄翼团
被认为是盗窃者。
据称男爵已雇用精英猎头追捕并找回失物。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
It's that time of year again! Yes, the old luck-
stick seller is making his rounds once more.

He shows up every year in Fluorgis, right around
Blackfrost, and then just seems to wander off...

If you catch sight of him, be sure to buy yourself
a luck-stick! Never know when you might get
another chance!\end\
translation:
又到一年一度的时间了！
卖幸运棒的老爷爷再次四处巡游。
他每年黑霜月前后出现在弗洛吉斯，
然后似乎就离开了……
见到他一定要买一根幸运棒！
谁知道下次还有没有机会！\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
It's that time of year again! Yes, the old luck-
stick trader is making her rounds once more.

She shows up every year in Fluorgis, right around
Goldsun, and then just seems to wander off...

If you've some luck-sticks knocking around
when she comes, be sure to go and see her!

You can swap those things for some really
great stuff, you know!\end\
translation:
又到一年一度的时间了！
交换幸运棒的老奶奶再次四处巡游。
她每年金阳月前后出现在弗洛吉斯，
然后似乎就离开了……
她来时如果你有幸运棒，一定去见她！
那些东西能换到很棒的物品！\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Did you know that the luck-stick seller who comes
in Blackfrost and the luck-stick trader who comes
in Goldsun are two different people?

It's true! The one in Blackfrost's an old man, and
the one in Goldsun's an old woman!

You'd never know it to look at 'em, though!
...Makes a fella wonder how exactly they're
related. Not that it's any of my business, mind
you.
 ーDomis Streetears\end\
translation:
你知道黑霜月卖幸运棒的人和金阳月
交换幸运棒的人是两个人吗？
真的！黑霜月的是老爷爷，金阳月的是老奶奶！
不过光看外表还真分不出来！
……不禁让人想知道他们是什么关系。
当然，这不关我的事。
  ——多米斯街头耳目\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
You know the Seeker of Slaughter?
He's a trader in...things. Thing is, nobody knows
what those "things" are.

What's more, you don't have to trade him
anything for 'em. Just information.
Information about battles fought, battles won,
battles lost...

He shows up in some ruins somewhere, every
year around Plumfrost.

Not very specific, I know...but hey,
you get what you pay for.
 ーDomis Streetears\end\
translation:
知道嗜杀的求道者吗？他交易……一些东西。
问题是谁也不知道“东西”是什么。
而且不需要用物品交换，只要情报：
打过多少仗、赢过多少、输过多少……
他每年梅霜月前后出现在某处遗迹。
我知道这不够具体……但消息免费嘛。
  ——多米斯街头耳目\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I was wrong.
That was no spirit whispering from beyond the
grave, but my friends, calling to me.
I...will not be saved. This I know.

All I wish now is that no one else should hear
this sad voice. Please, rid the mine of its spirits.
Let its rock walls and vaulted halls sleep in peace.

Give the spirits their freedom, for I will be
joining their number soon.\end\
translation:
我错了。那不是来自坟墓的幽灵低语，
而是我的朋友在呼唤我。
我……不会获救，我知道。
现在只希望不再有人听见这悲伤的声音。
请清除矿山里的幽灵，让岩壁与穹顶安眠。
让灵魂自由吧，因为我很快也将成为他们一员。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Heard about those fluffy pink flowers?
Seems like everyone wants one these days, eh?

I believe it was called the prima petal, or the like.

Looks pretty, and makes all sorts of other things
right pretty too. Quite popular with the lasses,
I hear. Oh, they used to grow all over the place
but now you'd be lucky to find one in a season,
if that.

That said, I hear they've been spotted up Targ
Wood way. Haven't seen 'em myself, though, so
go at yer own risk.\end\
translation:
听说过蓬松的粉花吗？如今人人都想要。
我记得叫歌姬花瓣之类。
花漂亮，也能让很多东西变漂亮，很受女孩欢迎。
以前到处都有，现在一整个季节能找到一朵
都算幸运。听说塔格森林附近有人见过，
但我没亲眼见，风险自负。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Countless accounts have come in of large
numbers of floating eyes suddenly appearing
without warning.

The rumors as to why these eyes are forming
are as many as the eyes themselves. Some
say it's due to a special material being used
for airship propulsion.

Others say it's a side effect of large scale
magicite excavation. Opinions are thick upon
the ground, yet facts are few and far between.

Concerning the incursion of floating eyes into
the aerodrome area, the leading theory is that
they encountered an airship en route, decided
it was prey, and followed it to port.\end\
translation:
大量报告称浮游眼突然成群出现。
关于原因的传闻和眼睛一样多：有人说
与飞空艇推进使用的特殊材料有关，
有人说是大规模魔石开采的副作用。
意见很多，事实却很少。
至于浮游眼进入飞空艇场，主要理论是
它们途中遇到飞空艇，将其视作猎物并跟到港口。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Everyone in Fluorgis knows that the fiery Mt.
Llavina is a breeding place for bombs.

While naturalists are uncertain as to why bombs
form there in such numbers, the phenomenon
is thought to have something to do with the site's
unique combination of underground magma and high
Mist concentration.

Concerning the incursion of bombs into the
aerodrome area, the leading theory is that they
encountered an airship en route, decided it was
prey, and followed it to port.\end\
translation:
弗洛吉斯人人都知道炽热的拉维纳山
是炸弹怪繁殖地。自然学家不确定为什么
数量如此之多，认为与地下岩浆和高浓度雾
这一独特组合有关。
至于炸弹怪进入飞空艇场，主要理论是
它们途中遇到飞空艇，将其视作猎物并跟到港口。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Mebbe you've heard this one already, but they
say there's ghosts a-floatin' in the sky...
right around where them airships be flyin'.
*hic*
People're sayin' that, long time ago, back when
we had all them airships up 'n' disappearin', why
them's what disappeared've come back now as
ghosts.
*hic*
Well, soon's I heard that story, I got meself
a ticket and took a ride on one o' them ships.
Had me nose pressed up against the window the
whole time, I reckon, and guess what? I saw one!
A gen-u-wine bone fide haunt!!!
*hic*
Oh, it was a specter o' death, lemme tell you.
Went away in the blink of an eye, but as sure
as I love my drink, that was a ghost. And if
there's one thing I know, it's spirits.
 Gonra the Drinker\end\
translation:
也许你听过，天上有幽灵飘啊飘……
就在飞空艇飞的地方。*嗝*
人们说很久以前好多飞空艇失踪，
失踪的人如今变成幽灵回来了。*嗝*
我一听就买票坐船，全程趴在窗上看。猜怎么着？
我看到了！货真价实的幽灵！！！*嗝*
那是死亡幽灵，一眨眼就消失。
我拿对酒的热爱发誓，那就是幽灵。
我最懂的就是酒精和灵体。
  酒鬼 冈拉\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
ーThe Wonders of Loar — Wayfarer's Logー

Visit all the below areas within the designated
time limit and receive a stamp in your wayfarer's
log to win valuable prizes!

List of Destinations:
 *Logged!*  Baptiste Hill
 *Logged!*  The Aldanna Range
 *Logged!*  The Rupie Mountains
 *Logged!*  The Ruins of Delgantua

————————
The Well-Informed Wayfarer

Many strange and rare flora can be found on the
slopes of the Aldanna Range.

The mountains' secret? Many are common species
that have mutated in the Mist that swirls across
the range.
 ーMarsa Wayfarers Association\end\
translation:
洛亚尔奇观——旅行日志

在规定时间内到访以下地区并盖章，赢取奖品！
已记录：巴蒂斯特山、阿尔达纳山脉、
鲁皮山脉、德尔甘图亚遗迹。

见多识广的旅行者：阿尔达纳山坡有许多奇异
稀有植物。秘密是其中许多原为普通物种，
在山脉弥漫的雾中变异。
  ——玛萨旅行协会\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
ーThe Lands of Loar — Wayfarer's Logー

Visit all the below areas within the designated
time limit and receive a stamp in your wayfarer's
log to win valuable prizes!

List of Destinations:
 *Logged!*  Baptiste Hill
 *Logged!*  The Bisga Greenlands
 *Logged!*  The Aldanna Range

————————
The Well-Informed Wayfarer

Local authorities have recently stepped up
efforts to ensure the safe passage of travelers
along the Vieg Highroad that runs between the
Bisga Greenlands and Graszton.
Surely good news for any wayfarer.
 ーMarsa Wayfarers Association\end\
translation:
洛亚尔大地——旅行日志

在规定时间内到访以下地区并盖章，赢取奖品！
已记录：巴蒂斯特山、比斯加绿地、阿尔达纳山脉。

见多识广的旅行者：当地部门近期加强措施，
保障比斯加绿地与格拉斯顿之间维格大道的
旅行安全。这对旅人一定是好消息。
  ——玛萨旅行协会\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
ーThe Forests of Loar — Wayfarer's Logー

Visit all the below areas within the designated
time limit and receive a stamp in your wayfarer's
log to win valuable prizes!

List of Destinations:
 *Logged!*  Targ Wood
 *Logged!*  The Bisga Greenlands
 *Logged!*  Zedlei Forest

————————
The Well-Informed Wayfarer

If you venture to Targ Wood, be sure to try the
freshly picked mushroom stew they eat there.
Naught compares to those steaming mounds of
fungi in creamy sauce. Mmm-mm!
 ーMarsa Wayfarers Association\end\
translation:
洛亚尔森林——旅行日志

在规定时间内到访以下地区并盖章，赢取奖品！
已记录：塔格森林、比斯加绿地、泽德雷森林。

见多识广的旅行者：去塔格森林一定要尝
新鲜采摘蘑菇做的炖菜。热气腾腾的菌菇
配奶油酱，无与伦比。嗯！
  ——玛萨旅行协会\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
ーThe Towns of Loar — Wayfarer's Logー

Visit all the below areas within the designated
time limit and receive a stamp in your wayfarer's
log to win valuable prizes!

List of Destinations:
 *Logged!*  Camoa
 *Logged!*  Graszton
 *Logged!*  Moorabella

————————
The Well-Informed Wayfarer

Reighlard Forestーa proud stand of virgin wood
that sprawls across the plains of Moorabella.

Shame that the general public is only allowed into
the outskirts. Beyond that is protected woodland.
 ーMarsa Wayfarers Association\end\
translation:

source_text:
House Ocktor has produced physicians for
generations now, and their accomplishments in the
realm of the curing arts are innumerable.

A collection of their techniques, "The Ocktor
Tome of Medicine," has been called the godsbook
of the profession, and there have been no lack
of aspirants to glory, both principled and
unprincipled, who have sought to claim it. 

Sadly, those who envied House Ocktor were
legion. In time, they drove the family out of
the medical profession with tarnished name, and
so was the book of arts lost to the knowledge
of man.

That is, until Mack Ocktor, twelfth in the House
Ocktor line, discovered the book in a hidden
passageway beneath the ruins of the Ocktor
Manse. The book is currently in his possession,
its secrets once again the property of the
family that first committed them to paper.\end\
translation:
奥克托家世代行医，治病救人功绩无数。
汇集家族技术的《奥克托医书》被称为医界圣典，
无论正派还是不择手段的求名者都想得到它。
可惜嫉妒奥克托家的人众多，最终败坏其名声，
将家族逐出医界，医书也随之失传。
直到第十二代麦克·奥克托在家族宅邸遗迹下
隐秘通道发现此书。它如今由他持有，
书中秘诀再次归于最初记录它的家族。\end\

source_text:
The history of Judges and the law began several
hundred years ago here, in Jylland.

There is a place in Jylland called the Wellspring
of Magick, and it is this source of power that
feeds the near immortal magickal constructs we
call Judges.

While the Judges and their laws hold sway over
all Jylland, it is the way of this magick that,
for one to benefit from its effects, one must
swear an oath to the Judges to uphold their laws.

It is thought this is intended to prevent misuse
of the Judges, and is at all times an entirely
voluntary oath. Only those who desire its benefits
need swear.

As we can see, there is nothing in the structure
of laws that cannot be explained by our modern
theory of magick.\end\
translation:
裁判官与法律的历史数百年前始于休兰德。
休兰德有一处“魔法源泉”，其力量供养着
我们称为裁判官的近乎不朽的魔法造物。
裁判官及其法律覆盖全休兰德，但依魔法规则，
要获得其效果，必须向裁判官宣誓遵守法律。
据认为这是为了防止滥用裁判官，
宣誓始终完全自愿，只有想获得好处的人才需宣誓。
可见法律结构的一切都能用现代魔法理论解释。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
That the existence of Judges is unique to Jylland
can be ascertained by looking at both their role
and their roots.

A Judge is a magickal creatureーa golem, if you
willーmade solely for the purpose of forming
contracts of law.

The Judges and their laws were first conceived
hundreds of years ago, by the court mages of
Archduke Beaudonis who then ruled all of western
Jylland.

His goals were nothing less than the adjudication
of war. With the Judges in direct control of 
combat, profitless battles could be avoided, and
peace preserved.

However, the people of his day rebelled against
the strong arm of the Judges' law, until it was
decided that the Judges' laws would be upheld and
their benefits received only by those who wished
to swear the Judge-oathーand so it remains
to this day.\end\
translation:
从职责与起源都可确认，裁判官是休兰德独有。
裁判官是一种魔法生物，也可称魔像，
专为建立法律契约而造。
数百年前，统治休兰德西部的博多尼斯大公
的宫廷魔法师首次构想裁判官与法律。
目标正是裁决战争：让裁判官直接控制战斗，
避免无益战争，维护和平。
然而当时人们反抗裁判官法律的强制统治，
最终决定只有自愿宣誓者才遵守法律并享受好处；
这一制度沿用至今。\end\

source_text:
There are worlds within our world of Ivalice that
we cannot touch or know as we know our own
bed, home, or town.

The Netherworld, the Empyreal Plain, the World of
Illusion...these are together known as otherworlds,
unseen by eye; untouched by hand.

The order of creatures known as scions hails from
these otherworlds. They are found in many places,
in many lands, and they count among their number
emissaries of the gods, protector spirits,
and even great doers of evil.

Though the otherworlds are not normally
accessible from Ivalice, if certain requirements
are met, it is possible to give otherworldly
power a physical manifestation in our world. This
is most commonly seen in the pact made by the
summoner who calls down an Esper to fight for
them.

From the legend of a great mage in the far
eastern realms who sundered a magickal seal,
thus receiving a scion as a servant, it would
seem that they, too, operate by these same
principles.

In Jylland, it has been discovered that the
summoning of scions is possible with the use of
a particular magickal device. However, it is certain
that the power manifested through this means is
only an echo of the scion's true power. To evoke
the true power of a scion, it would be necessary
to harmonize oneself to the scion's being, fusing
not only one's purpose with the scion, but one's
own body and mind.\end\
translation:
伊瓦利斯世界中还有我们无法像触摸床、
家或城镇那样触及和了解的世界。
冥界、天界原野、幻界等统称异世界，
肉眼不可见，双手不可触。
称为圣裔的生物来自这些异世界，分布于
许多地方，包括神使、守护灵乃至作恶者。
异世界通常无法从伊瓦利斯进入，
但满足特定条件后，可以让异世界力量
在我们世界实体化。最常见的是召唤师
订立契约，召唤召唤兽为其战斗。
传说远东一位大魔法师解除魔法封印后
获得圣裔侍从，似乎遵循同样原理。
休兰德已发现可用特定魔具召唤圣裔，
但由此呈现的力量必然只是其真正力量的回响。
要唤出圣裔的真正力量，必须与其存在协调，
不仅目标一致，身心也要融合。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We often hear stories of such-and-such grimoire,
but in truth, any and all books of magick can
rightly claim the name "grimoire."

Say, for instance, the tome a young mage might
consult to learn the intricacies of casting the
magick "fire." This, too, is a grimoire.

So we see, grimoires are everywhere. A part of
daily life in this Ivalice. So prevalent have they
become, we cease to call them by their proper
name, and instead treat them much as we might
treat a manual for cooking mushrooms, or a
book of fanciful illustrations for children.

...Yet there exists a magickal tome to which
the name of grimoire still rightfully, nay,
unquestionably belongs.\end\
translation:
我们常听说某某魔导书，事实上任何魔法书
都可称为魔导书。比如年轻魔法师学习
施放“火焰”的书，也是魔导书。
因此魔导书无处不在，是伊瓦利斯日常生活的一部分。
它们如此普遍，以至人们不再使用正式名称，
而像对待蘑菇烹饪手册或儿童图画书一样对待。
……然而确有一本魔法书，理所当然、
毫无疑问地配得上魔导书之名。\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The ultimate book of magickーThe Gran Grimoire. 

Who crafted it, and when? This is not known to
us. We do not even know if the Gran Grimoire is
a single weighty tome, or a roomful of such tomes.
Either is equally possible.

According to writings on the Gran Grimoire, he
who possesses this book has power enough to
shape the very fabric of the world. Yet, with
the mere existence of the book now passed
into legend, the truth can no longer be known.\end\
translation:
究极魔法之书——大魔导书。

谁在何时制作了它？我们不知道。
甚至不知道它是厚重的一册，还是满屋书卷，
两种可能都有。
据记载，拥有此书的人有足以塑造世界本身的力量。
但如今连它是否存在都已成传说，真相无从得知。\end\

source_text:
The four-woman clan Prima Donna have been
garnering much attention in Jylland of late, and
they've got the looks, incredible singing talent,
and enchanting coordinated dance moves to hold
it.

They count admirers among men, women, young,
and old alikeーsome so fervent in their enthusiastic
support, they will travel wherever Prima Donna
go, showing up in the crowds at every event.
Yet Prima Donna seem to welcome this, and the
attention they lavish upon their most devoted
fans has won them still more admirers.

What one must not forget is, while Prima Donna
have seen such success on the stage, and clearly
take their performances very seriously, they also
operate as a fully fledged clan, and boast
accomplishments in this theatre which are no
less impressive.

But this tribute to their enchanting qualities falls
short of the real thing. How can cold words on a
page compare to the majesty that is Prima Donna?
I only hope I have given my readers enough
cause to investigate this phenomenon themselves,
perhaps at a local stage near you.
 The Jylland Free PressーArts Section\end\
translation:
四人女子氏族歌姬乐团近期在休兰德备受关注。
她们拥有出众容貌、惊人歌唱才能和迷人的协调舞步。
男女老少都是她们的崇拜者；有些狂热支持者
不论她们去哪里都追随，每场活动都到场。
歌姬乐团似乎对此十分欢迎，对忠实粉丝关怀备至，
因此赢得更多仰慕者。
别忘了，她们虽在舞台成功、认真对待演出，
同时也是正式氏族，在这一领域的成就同样出色。
但这篇赞颂远不及亲眼所见：
纸上冰冷的文字怎能比得上歌姬乐团的风采？
希望我已给读者足够理由亲自一探究竟，
也许就在你附近的舞台。
  《休兰德自由报》艺术版\end\

source_text:

possessions of others his own.\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
WHITE MAGES work these magicks to heal and
restore their allies.\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
The elemental magicks of the BLACK MAGE strike
with the power of fire and ice.\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
The skills of the ARCHER do not call for brute
force, but deadly accuracy to fell a foe.\var2:00\\end\

notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:

allies with a practiced blade.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 圣骑士以娴熟剑技保护友军。\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
FIGHTERS use these abilities to attack with a
flurry of blades.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 斗士以疾风般的剑击攻击敌人。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The arsenal of the PARIVIR beats down foes
with blindingly fast swordstrikes of deadly
precision.\var2:00\\end\

source_text:

techniques learned from a distant land.\var2:00\\end\

source_text:

strike foes throughout the battlefield.\var2:00\\end\

BLUE MAGES learn the abilities of their foes

source_text:

Warm light plays through the canopy of this
beautiful forest. The Silenia river runs through the
heart of the wood on its eastward journey to the sea.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 暖光穿过美丽森林的树冠，西莱尼亚河穿林向东入海。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Countless tunnels make up this vast underground
cavern. It's known in some circles as the Pit of the
Larva.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 无数隧道构成巨大地下洞窟，有人称其幼虫深渊。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The magick city of Moorabella and its aerodrome sit
atop this high, forest-covered plateau.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 魔法之城穆拉贝拉及其机场坐落在森林覆盖的高原上。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Quaint shops and age-old houses line the streets of
Fluorgis. Beyond the city, ruins of once mighty
fortresses stand watch over the wilderness.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 弗洛吉斯街道两旁是古朴商店和老屋，城外古堡遗迹守望荒野。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The sun shines wanly over this desolate swampland.
A pervasive gloom falls on all who enter.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 苍白阳光照耀荒凉沼泽，进入者无不感到阴郁。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This magicite mine has lain dormant for long years.
Only creatures of the dark now crawl its passages.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 魔石矿山沉寂多年，如今只有黑暗生物爬行于矿道。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The legend of the Thirteen was born long ago on
this sweeping plain that time forgot.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 十三人的传说诞生于这片被时间遗忘的辽阔平原。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This high bluff looks down on the sea crashing
against the rocks far below. The region is
geologically active and warm the year round.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 高崖俯瞰海浪拍打下方礁石，地质活跃，四季温暖。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Said to have been raised in the age of myth, these
mountains have a stark, captivating beauty.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说神话时代隆起的山脉，拥有苍凉迷人的美。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This sprawling ruin is thought to date back to the
Galtean era. The lost arts of that time are
evident throughout.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 广阔遗迹据称可追溯至加尔提亚时代，处处可见失传技艺。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This island rising from the Mirhelian Sea is home
to the moogle city of Goug.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 米赫利安海中升起的岛屿，是莫古之城古格的所在地。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Waves of sand rise and fall in this barren waste.
The scorching sun burns bright in the sky.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 荒漠中沙浪起伏，烈日高照。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A cave passing beneath the narrow sea once
connected this volcanic island with the mainland.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 海底洞穴曾将这座火山岛与大陆连接。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The Mist runs thick in these forbidden reaches.
A treasure of immense power is said to lie here.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 禁地浓雾弥漫，据说藏有力量巨大的宝物。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending
Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A meandering road leading to Targ Wood.
Travelers come and go along the thoroughfare.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 通往塔格森林的蜿蜒道路，旅人来往不绝。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Many animals dwell among the towering trees
of this quiet wood.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 宁静森林的参天树木间住着许多动物。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A small village where time seems to stand still.
The fresh mushroom stew is not to be missed.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 时间仿佛静止的小村，新鲜蘑菇炖菜不容错过。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Chocobos lazily graze among the field's gently
swaying grasses.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 陆行鸟在轻摇的草丛中悠闲吃草。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Faeries are said to gather in this secluded
spot. The wind carries a faint, sweet scent.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说妖精聚集于此僻静之地，风中带着淡淡甜香。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads north to Camoa.
Delicate flowers dot its embankments.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向北通往卡莫亚，路堤点缀娇花。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This ancient city has long been a favorite
gathering spot for adventurers. Throngs of
people bustle along its streets.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古城长久以来深受冒险者喜爱，街上人潮熙攘。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This high plateau offers a splendid view of
Camoa. Take care should the weather turn foul:
the paths here can be treacherous in the rain.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 高原可俯瞰卡莫亚，雨天道路险滑，需小心。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Soft breezes caress this gently rolling
grassland. An idyllic resting spot for the
footsore adventurer.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 微风轻抚起伏草原，是疲惫冒险者的理想休憩处。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Narrow paths crisscross this airy plain.
The sun-weary traveler will find welcome shelter
in the cool shade of the trees.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 窄路纵横开阔平原，树荫为旅人遮阳纳凉。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Faeries are said to gather beneath the trees
of this secluded grove. The sound of rustling
leaves is borne upon the breeze.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说妖精聚集于僻静林间，风中传来树叶沙沙声。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads south to Targ Wood.
The level grade makes for an easy journey.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向南通往塔格森林，路面平坦易行。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The road climbs gradually north toward
Baptiste Hill.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路逐渐向北爬升，通往巴普蒂斯特丘陵。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads west to the Bisga Greenlands.
A sea of emerald grass glimmers on either side.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向西通往比斯加绿原，两侧翠绿草海闪耀。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Lush grasses carpet the hillside. Caravans mark
the progress of their journey as they pass the
solitary tree.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 茂草覆盖山坡，商队经过孤树时确认旅途进度。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A cool breeze blows in from the coast.
On clear days it's possible to make out the
continent across the narrow sea.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 海岸吹来凉风，晴日可望见海峡对岸大陆。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Sunlight dances through breaks in the canopy
covering this woodland trail. Clumps of
mushrooms sprout in the shade.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 阳光穿过林径树冠，阴处长着成簇蘑菇。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The many rocks jutting from this low-lying
mountain make it a popular proving ground for
adventurers with more lofty ambitions.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 低山上怪石突出，是志向远大的冒险者常来的试炼场。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads south toward Camoa, gradually
widening as it nears the city.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向南通往卡莫亚，接近城市时逐渐变宽。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads southwest to the Bisga
Greenlands. The way is rough, making progress
slow even on foot.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向西南通往比斯加绿原，路途崎岖，步行也缓慢。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads west to the Aldanna Range.
The loose soil littering the path slows
even the most sure-footed of wayfarers.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向西通往阿尔丹纳山脉，松土使旅人步履缓慢。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road follows the coast north to Zedlei
Forest. Mounds of green underbrush rise along
the verge.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路沿海岸向北通往泽德雷森林，路边灌木丛生。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Bright, open fields stretch to the horizon.
As the sun falls, monsters creep out of the
rising gloom.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 明亮开阔的田野延伸至地平线，日落后魔物从暗处出现。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A trail cut into the side of a steep cliff.
Travelers on chocoboback carefully pick their
way along the incline.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 陡峭悬崖侧面开出的路，骑陆行鸟的旅人小心前行。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Tall trees blot out the light in the deep
recesses of this forest. The air is heavy with
moisture from hidden pools and lush greenery.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 森林深处高树遮光，隐秘水池与繁茂植被使空气潮湿。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The Vieg Highroad is one of the region's busiest
corridors. It is not uncommon to find stalls and
tents offering sundry goods to passersby.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 维格大道交通繁忙，路边常有摊位帐篷贩卖杂货。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads north to Baptiste Hill.
The greater part of the travelers here can
be seen astride chocobos.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向北通往巴普蒂斯特丘陵，多数旅人骑着陆行鸟。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads east to Camoa. Passing storms
often leave the road rutted and cut across with
pools of water.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向东通往卡莫亚，暴雨常留下车辙和积水。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This busy road leads south to Graszton.
Even late at night the steady stream of
travelers does not abate.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 繁忙道路向南通往格拉斯顿，深夜旅人也络绎不绝。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads west to the caves of the
Galerria Deep. Even here, the ground is cold
and damp.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向西通往加莱里亚深谷洞穴，地面已冰冷潮湿。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Where there are travelers, there are
highwaymen. This road sees its fair share
of both.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 有旅人的地方就有劫匪，这条路两者都不少。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The sound of distant waves can just be heard
above the hard wind. Few plants find purchase
in the barren soil.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 狂风中隐约可闻远处海浪，贫瘠土地上植物稀少。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Awash with merchants and sailors, this lively
port town is an important center for trade and
commerce in the region.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 商人水手云集的热闹港城，是地区重要贸易中心。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This dark, unsettling forest is rumored to
serve as a hideout for brigands and thieves.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 阴暗令人不安的森林，据说是强盗和盗贼的藏身处。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Faeries are said to gather in this secluded
spot, where white flower petals dance on the
wind.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说妖精聚集在此僻静之处，白色花瓣随风飞舞。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads north to the Bisga Greenlands.
A group of volunteer watchmen patrols the
highway.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向北通往比斯加绿原，志愿守卫队在此巡逻。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The smooth clay along this trail can be
perilously slippery. Occasionally, a thin Mist
hangs in the air.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路上的光滑黏土十分湿滑，偶有薄雾弥漫。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Icy winds and magicked Mist swirl through these
mountain peaks. Many fierce beasts make their
home among the rocky crags.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 寒风与魔雾盘旋山峰，凶兽栖息于岩石之间。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This frozen pass lies under a perpetual
blanket of snow that shines a ghostly silver
in the moonlight.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 冰封隘口常年覆雪，在月光下泛着幽银。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The ground here is dusted white with snow,
broken only by the occasional track of some
unseen animal.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 地面覆着白雪，偶尔可见不知名动物的足迹。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This old cottage is nestled deep in the
mountains. The trail leading here bears little
sign of traffic.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古老小屋藏于深山，通往此地的小径鲜有人行。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads to the caves of the Galerria
Deep. Footing is treacherous on the dark,
uneven path.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路通往加莱里亚深谷，黑暗崎岖的路面难以立足。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads east to Baptiste Hill.
There is little vegetation to break the
monotony of this desolate trail.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向东通往巴普蒂斯特丘陵，荒凉路上植被稀少。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads north to Zedlei Forest.
Travelers' feet move with hushed whispers
through the soft carpet of fallen leaves.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向北通往泽德雷森林，旅人踩过柔软落叶沙沙作响。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A frigid stream of snowmelt from the mountains
enters the forest here. Many woodland animals
can be seen drinking along its banks.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 山间融雪汇成冰冷溪流入林，许多野兽在岸边饮水。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Magnificent trees reach skyward in this lush
forest. Some of the greater trees are said to
harbor powerful magick.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 繁茂森林中巨树直入云霄，据说其中一些蕴含强大魔法。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The trees of this forest provide the highest
quality timber. Once felled, the trunks are
taken to the lumbermills on giant sleds.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 森林出产上等木材，树木砍倒后由巨型雪橇运往锯木场。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This small hill peeks out above the forest.
The lord of the wood is said to dwell at its
rocky summit.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 小山高出林海，据说森林之主住在岩石山顶。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads southeast to Baptiste Hill.
The warm rays of the sun bathe the path in
golden light.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向东南通往巴普蒂斯特丘陵，温暖阳光洒下金辉。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road climbs southwest to the foothills
of the Aldanna Range. The quiet murmur of
running water delights the senses.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向西南爬升至阿尔丹纳山麓，流水低语令人愉悦。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads west to the city of Moorabella.
Arbors line the road, offering welcome shelter
to the tired traveler.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向西通往穆拉贝拉，路边凉棚为疲惫旅人遮风避雨。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A silence hangs over the frozen ground.
Not even the beasts of the wild dare break the
stillness here.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 冰冻土地一片寂静，连野兽也不敢打破。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Chill wind swirls in the cavern, its howl
echoing ceaselessly through the lightless
depths.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 寒风盘旋洞穴，呼啸声在无光深处不断回荡。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Something has dug a large, conical pit in the
floor of the cave. The earth at the bottom
seems to writhe and shift...\var2:00\\end\
translation: 洞底被什么东西挖出巨大圆锥坑，坑底泥土似乎在蠕动……\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Water trickles down the rough stone of the
cavern walls. The living rock at its base is
smooth and slick.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 水沿粗糙洞壁滴落，底部岩石光滑湿润。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads east to the Bisga Greenlands.
Snow and mud mix to form a nearly impassable
mire.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向东通往比斯加绿原，雪泥混成几乎无法通行的沼泽。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads northeast to the Aldanna Range.
At night the damp ground freezes solid.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向东北通往阿尔丹纳山脉，潮湿地面夜间冻硬。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads north to the Rupie Mountains.
Snow falls year-round along this icy trail.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向北通往鲁皮山脉，冰冷小径终年飘雪。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The sky shines bright blue above this high plain.
Snow falls here not by any work of nature, but
by the hand of magick.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 高原上空蔚蓝明亮，此处降雪并非自然，而是魔法所致。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The magick arts are studied and refined here
in this quaint town of neatly rowed houses and
snow-covered lanes.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古朴小镇房屋整齐、街道覆雪，人们在此钻研魔法。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Situated on the outskirts of Moorabella, this
airship terminal offers skyferry service to
Fluorgis.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 穆拉贝拉郊外的飞艇站提供通往弗洛吉斯的航班。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Sages often gather to talk alongside the small
river that runs through this peaceful wood.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 贤者常聚于宁静森林的小河旁交谈。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The private grounds of the grand duke of
Moorabella. The forest has remained largely
undisturbed by man.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 穆拉贝拉大公的私人领地，森林基本未受人为干扰。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Snow soft and white as cotton falls in this
lonely field. A wandering minstrel once called
it the Snowdustーnow none call it anything else.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 柔白如棉的雪落在孤寂原野，吟游诗人称其雪尘原，此名沿用至今。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads east to Zedlei Forest.
Wisps of magickal light glow in the night air.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向东通往泽德雷森林，夜空中闪烁魔法微光。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads southwest to the Rupie
Mountains. The bitter cold saps the strength
of travelers as they make their ascent.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向西南通往鲁皮山脉，严寒消耗登山旅人的体力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads west into the ruins of
Delgantua. Once a major thoroughfare, it's
now all but deserted.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向西通往德尔甘图亚遗迹，曾是要道，如今几近荒废。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Filled with fountains and greenery, the lively
city of Fluorgis thrives as a hub of air trade.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 弗洛吉斯喷泉绿树环绕，作为空中贸易枢纽繁荣兴盛。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Ivalice's first aerodrome, built soon after the
invention of the airship. It's a gateway for
all manner of goods from throughout Ivalice.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 伊瓦利斯首座机场，飞艇发明后不久建成，是各类货物的门户。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Not far to the north of Fluorgis lies Diegnot
Fortress. Her once proud walls have long since
crumbled into ruin.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 弗洛吉斯以北不远是迪格诺特要塞，昔日雄墙早已坍塌。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Named after the famed gria general, the ruins
of this holdfast are the grandest for many
leagues.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 以著名格里亚将军命名的要塞遗迹，是方圆数里最宏伟的一处。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The western gate of Cannol Keep. They said
none could breach its massive doors, and indeed,
it stood fast even as the keep proper fell.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 卡诺尔堡西门，据说无人能攻破巨门，城堡陷落时它仍屹立。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads to Sant D'alsa Bluff.
Airship after airship pass by overhead,
receding noiselessly into the distance.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路通往圣达尔萨悬崖，飞艇一艘接一艘无声飞向远方。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads southeast to Aisenfield.
Who can count the songs sung of heroes who
set out along this very highway?\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向东南通往艾森菲尔德，多少英雄曾沿此路出发，歌谣难以数尽。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads east into Tramdine Fens.
These days its traffic numbers more beasts
than men.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向东通往特拉姆丁沼泽，如今经过的野兽多于人。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The dying wind blows lazily, barely stirring
the grass. Rough stones lie strewn across the
ground.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 微弱的风懒懒吹拂，草叶几乎不动，粗石散落地面。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The spirits of the dead are said to wander this
dreary fen. Even at midday the sky is dark
and unsettling.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说亡灵徘徊于阴郁沼泽，即使正午天空也昏暗不安。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is difficult to say when this small workshop
was built, or by whom, but all are free to use
it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 小工坊的建造年代和建造者难以考证，但人人可用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This broad bog teems with life. A small shrine
built by the local villagers stands on one of the
higher patches of ground.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 广阔沼泽生机勃勃，较高地面上有当地村民建的小神龛。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Moss and water plants grow thick in this remote
place. Many of the stagnant pools dotting the
bog are deep beyond measure.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 偏远之地苔藓水草茂盛，沼泽中许多死水潭深不可测。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This trail leads west to the city of Fluorgis.
None are fool enough to walk it once the sun
has set.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 小径向西通往弗洛吉斯，日落后无人敢走。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This trail is mired in muck and mud for many
leagues on its southward march to Aisenfield.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 小径向南通往艾森菲尔德，数里路途尽是泥泞。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
More animal trail than footpath, this track rises
steep and narrow, leading east to the Nazan
Mines.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 窄陡小径更像兽道，向东通往纳赞矿山。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This magicite mine has been closed for decades.
Scores of men once labored to excavate the
precious stones.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 魔石矿已关闭数十年，曾有众多矿工挖掘宝石。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Built to protect the miners from the beasts of
the wild, this fortress was no longer needed
once the mines were closed.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 要塞曾保护矿工免受野兽侵袭，矿山关闭后便失去用途。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This mine once yielded all manner of magicite,
but was abandoned when the Gorday vein was
struck.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 此矿曾出产各种魔石，戈尔代矿脉发现后被废弃。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This shaft yielded vast quantities of skystone,
much of which found its way to Goug.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 此矿道曾产出大量天石，其中许多运往古格。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This shaft yielded spellstone of all varieties.
Though closed for many years, the mine still
sees occasional visits from Akademy scholars.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 矿道曾出产各类魔石，虽关闭多年，学院学者偶尔仍会造访。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This trail leads west to Tramdine Fens.
Smugglers once used it to traffic magicite from
the mines.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 小径向西通往特拉姆丁沼泽，走私者曾用它运输矿石。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Laid in the days of the great magicite rush,
this road leads southwest to Aisenfield.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路建于魔石热潮时期，向西南通往艾森菲尔德。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road was built to honor the hero Gaol,
one of the Thirteen Knights of Aisen.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 为纪念艾森十三骑士之一的英雄加奥尔而建。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Warm winds sweep across this rocky highland.
Below, the Mirhelian Sea stretches to the
horizon.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 暖风掠过岩石高地，下方米赫利安海延伸至地平线。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This peaceful green field unfolds as far as the
eye can see, a sight unchanging through the
ages.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 宁静绿野一望无际，景色历经岁月不变。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Grass sways in undulating waves across the
verdant expanse. The Thirteen are said to
have fought a great battle here.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 青草在翠绿原野翻浪，据说十三人曾在此大战。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads to the Neslowe Passage.
The bridge here spanning the narrow sea is only
open by day.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路通往内斯洛通道，跨越海峡的桥只在白天开放。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads east to Kthili Sands. At this
distance the great desert dunes seem only hills.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向东通往克西里沙漠，远望巨大沙丘仿佛小山。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads northwest to Fluorgis.
Bards can often be heard reciting their latest
verses, refining them as they approach the city.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向西北通往弗洛吉斯，常可听见诗人边走边打磨新诗。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This trail leads north to Tramdine Fens.
Chocobos that take fright easily make for ill
mounts in the bleak swampland ahead.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 小径向北通往特拉姆丁沼泽，易受惊的陆行鸟不适合作为坐骑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads northeast to the Nazan Mines.
Few pass this way since they closed.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向东北通往纳赞矿山，矿山关闭后行人稀少。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Seabirds light upon the grassy hillside to rest
their wings as waves crash against the cliffs far
below.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 海鸟落在草坡休息，下方海浪拍打悬崖。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The word "zegrots," meaning "that which
belongs to a giant man," seems particularly
appropriate for these massive stones.\var2:00\\end\
translation: “泽格罗兹”意为巨人之物，十分适合这些巨石。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These cliffs rise sharply from the Strait of
Lumes. The area is volcanically active, warming
the water that flows from its springs.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 悬崖从卢梅斯海峡陡然升起，火山活动使泉水温暖。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Several years past, this volcano stirred to life
once again. The strong coastal winds carry ash
from the eruptions high into the air.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 火山数年前再次活跃，强劲海风将火山灰吹向高空。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads east to the city of Fluorgis.
A strong, steady breeze blows in from the
ocean.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向东通往弗洛吉斯，海上持续吹来强风。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These mountains stand with a quiet dignity,
offering a breathtaking view on clear days.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 群山静穆庄严，晴天景色令人屏息。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Cold winds rush up from the depths, shaking the
timeworn bridges that span the chasm.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 寒风从深渊涌起，摇动横跨峡谷的古桥。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A blanket of snow rests on the ground, dotted
by the tracks of creatures who make this their
mountainous home.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 山地覆雪，点缀栖息于此的动物足迹。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Deep drifts of snow deter all but the most
determined travelers. The creatures living here
are of an ancient breed.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 深雪阻挡了除最坚定者外的一切旅人，栖息于此的是古老物种。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads south to the Galerria Deep.
Snow blows without relent along the rocky path.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向南通往加莱里亚深谷，岩路上风雪不断。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads north to Moorabella. Hollows
to the side of the road offer shelter against
the biting blizzard winds.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向北通往穆拉贝拉，路旁凹地可遮挡刺骨暴风雪。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The ruins of a great castle built during the
Galtean era. Its once mighty ramparts are now
cracked and tumbled.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 加尔提亚时代巨城遗迹，昔日雄墙如今开裂倒塌。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This wide passage encloses a broken courtyard.
Fragments of elegant ornamentation give silent
testimony to the ruin's former glory.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 宽阔通道围住破败庭院，精美装饰碎片默述昔日辉煌。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Divine light washes over this wide chamber,
illuminating prayers painstakingly carved into
the flagstones.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 神光照耀宽广厅室，映亮地砖上精心雕刻的祈祷文。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This grand throne room was once the seat of
power. Even its emptiness is imposing.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 宏伟王座厅曾是权力中心，空荡依然威严。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The wall at the end of this long, straight
passage is inscribed with images of fantastickal
creatures.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 笔直长廊尽头的墙刻有奇幻生物图像。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads east to Moorabella.
The way is broken and overgrown from disuse.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向东通往穆拉贝拉，因久无人行而破损荒芜。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
No ordinary mine, this network of tunnels holds
machineries found nowhere else. Expeditions are
often made in search of these ancient relics.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 非比寻常的矿道中藏着独一无二的机械，探险者常来寻古物。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This moogle city is the birthplace of tecknologies
found throughout Ivalice. Odd machineries perch
on every shelf and peer out from every corner.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 莫古之城是伊瓦利斯许多技术的发源地，奇特机器遍布角落。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Few plants grow in the barren soil here.
A mountain belches black smoke in the distance.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 贫瘠土地植物稀少，远山喷出黑烟。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Gouts of flame erupt from the living volcano.
They say beasts who breathe flame and scorch
the ground they walk live among the char.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 活火山喷发烈焰，据说会喷火灼地的野兽住在焦土中。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This majestic bridge leads west to the Neslowe
Passage. Its solid construction shrugs off
storm and tide with ease.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 雄桥向西通往内斯洛通道，坚固结构轻松抵御风暴潮汐。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads north to Kthili Sands. A great
iron drawbridge connects the island with the
mainland.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向北通往克西里沙漠，巨大铁吊桥连接岛屿与大陆。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
By day the sun beats down without mercy.
By night freezing winds bite into sun-seared
flesh.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 白日烈日无情，夜间寒风刺入晒伤的皮肤。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Images shimmer and blur above these scorching
sands, while bone-thin beasts prowl in search of
prey.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 灼热沙上幻影闪烁，瘦骨嶙峋的野兽四处寻猎。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Sands dance and whirl above the shifting dunes.
A dark ash taints the fine yellow grains.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 流动沙丘上沙尘飞舞，细黄沙粒混有黑灰。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Lava flows glowing hot from the volcano's maw,
and the air is thick with sulfur. The hellish
landscape stretches unbroken into the distance.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 熔岩从火山口流出，空气充满硫磺，地狱般景色延伸远方。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This road leads west to Aisenfield. The going is
slow, with the fine sand swallowing foot and
wheel alike.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 道路向西通往艾森菲尔德，细沙吞没脚步和车轮，行进缓慢。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This bridge leads south to the city of Goug.
Before its construction, boats ferried travelers
across the narrow channel.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 桥向南通往古格，建桥前旅人靠船渡过海峡。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This volcano has smoldered for many hundred
years. They say it once lay deep on the ocean
floor.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 火山阴燃数百年，据说曾深埋海底。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Countless lava flows have formed a natural
path sloping away from the volcano. With each
passing day it grows a little wider.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 无数熔岩流形成远离火山的天然斜坡，日渐变宽。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This network of caves passes under the
Mirhelian Sea. It was once possible to reach
the mainland, but these passages have collapsed.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 洞穴网络穿过米赫利安海底，通往大陆的通道已坍塌。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A long forgotten cavern that extends beneath
the Mirhelian Sea. It is impossible to tell
whether its passages were wrought by man.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 被遗忘已久的洞穴延伸至海底，无法判断通道是否人为开凿。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This bridge leads north to Aisenfield.
Water covers the bridge at night, making
passage impossible.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 桥向北通往艾森菲尔德，夜间被水淹没无法通行。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This majestic bridge leads east to Goug.
Ash gathers like snow in drifts along its span.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 雄桥向东通往古格，火山灰如雪般堆积。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Softly glowing crystals mark the entryway to
the Forbidden Land.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 柔光水晶标示禁地入口。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The ground here resonates with strong magicks,
as though it bears the memory of some terrible
battle.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 地面与强大魔法共鸣，仿佛记得某场可怕战斗。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Realm of silence and darkness. Magicked mist
hangs thick on the air, driving the unwary to
madness.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 寂静黑暗之境，魔雾浓重，使粗心之人发疯。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A Paw Full of Feathers
Drive off wolves harassing a corral and put the
chocobos' nerves at ease.\var2:00\\end\
translation:
一爪羽毛
赶走骚扰围栏的狼，让陆行鸟安心。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The Yellow Wings
Apprehend the band of brigands known as the
Yellow Wings and restore order to the highroad.\var2:00\\end\
translation:
黄色羽翼
