Its only impulse is to spread destruction.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 愤怒诞生的灵魂寄宿于兽，唯一冲动便是散播毁灭。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Some have called this violent monster "King of the
Beasts." Its massive fists pummel and crack the earth.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 有人称这种凶暴魔物为兽王，其巨拳能撼裂大地。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A curious monster possessed of both an incredibly
malleable body and piercing intellect. Rather fond
of pretty girls.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 兼具柔韧身躯与敏锐智慧的奇特魔物，十分喜欢漂亮女孩。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Glistening black plumage covers this monster.
It rips and tears into all those who would do it harm.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 黑色羽毛闪亮的魔物，会撕裂任何伤害它的人。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Chocobo knights harness the choco cure ability of
the yellow chocobo to heal their allies.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 陆行鸟骑士借黄陆行鸟治疗友军。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Chocobo knights harness the choco meteor ability of
the red chocobo to smite their foes.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 陆行鸟骑士借红陆行鸟的陨石攻击敌人。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Chocobo knights harness the innate ability of
the black chocobo to soar above the battlefield.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 陆行鸟骑士借黑陆行鸟天赋翱翔战场上空。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Chocobo knights harness the choco esuna ability of
the green chocobo to cleanse their allies.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 陆行鸟骑士借绿陆行鸟净化友军。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Chocobo knights harness the choco guard ability of
the brown chocobo to protect their allies.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 陆行鸟骑士借棕陆行鸟守护友军。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Chocobo knights harness the choco recharge ability of
the white chocobo to restore magick to their allies.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 陆行鸟骑士借白陆行鸟充能为友军恢复魔力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Ruthless assassins who dwell in shadow. There is no
sound as they draw their blades, only the deadly flash
of steel.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 潜伏暗影的无情刺客，拔剑无声，只见致命寒光。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text: The Gifted are born with uncommon ability and skill.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 天赋者生来便拥有非凡能力与技艺。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Swift and dextrous, sky pirates sail the skies in
search of treasure and adventure. Assuming this -is-
a sky pirate...\var2:00\\end\
translation: 敏捷灵巧的空贼航行天空寻找宝藏与冒险，前提是这真是空贼……\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An enchanting master of the dance who gyres and
gyrates to evoke an array of magickal effects.
This one seems to stagger and swoon, though...\var2:00\\end\
translation: 迷人的舞蹈大师以旋转舞动引发魔法效果，不过这位似乎摇摇欲坠……\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending
Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A knife small enough to conceal in one's hand,
or an enemy's rib cage.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 小巧到能藏在手中，也能藏进敌人的肋骨间。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Your enemy's gasp at the exquisite decorations
on the pommel of this knife will be their last.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 敌人为精美刀柄发出的惊叹，将是其最后一声。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The fastest way to a man's heart is his stomach.
The curve of this knife's blade makes it easy.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 通往心脏最快的路是腹部，弯刀刃正好派上用场。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The slender blade on this knife is keen enough
to shave the feathers off a chocobo.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 细长刀刃锋利得能刮掉陆行鸟羽毛。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This impressive knife is so large, it's often
mistaken for a shortsword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 这把大刀常被误认为短剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A knife with a unique pommel that prevents the
wielder's grip from slipping.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 独特刀柄能防止握持时打滑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A knife with a blade bent back like the horn
of a beast, but far sharper.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 刀刃如兽角般弯曲，却更为锋利。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The spike protruding from the guard of this
knife is designed to catch an enemy's blade.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 护手突出的尖刺用于卡住敌人的刀刃。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A knife forged from the legendary metal
orichalcum.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 用传说中的山铜锻造的刀。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A large knife with a blade shaped like
a man's hand.\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Decades of experience went into the forging
and tempering of this fine knife.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 数十年经验铸就这把精良匕首。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A knife designed for stabbing and slashing
again and again until no enemies remain.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 专为反复刺砍、直至敌人全灭而设计。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
What better knife to discourage marauding tonberries
than one fashioned in the image of their very own.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 仿照冬贝利之刀制成，最适合吓退它们。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending
Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending
Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The silver engraving on this sword is so exquisite,
it seems a shame to sully it with blood.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 银色雕饰如此精美，沾血实在可惜。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
If you're in the business of monster slaying,
you need look no further than this sword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 若以猎杀魔物为业，这把剑便已足够。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A larger sword favored by those with shifty eyes
and nimble fingers.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 眼神游移、手脚敏捷的人偏爱的大剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text: A sword so sharp, it cuts the very wind.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 锋利到连风都能斩断的剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Copious quantities of blood have stained this
sword's blade a rich crimson.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 大量鲜血将剑刃染成深红。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A wondrous sword said to restore lost power to
its wielder.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说能恢复持有者失去力量的神奇之剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A holy sword named the "Defender of Life" by
the many it has saved.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 被救之人称之为生命守护者的圣剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This sword was specially made for the Onion
Knight of legend.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 专为传说中的洋葱骑士打造。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Deemed too powerful, this sword was buried for
centuries in a remote corner of the world.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 因过于强大，曾被埋藏在世界偏远角落数百年。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Though lacking in destructive power, this
sword is light and easy to use.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 破坏力不足，但轻巧易用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sword made for cutting down enemies in great
swaths, as though they were naught but wheat.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 为大片收割敌人而制，仿佛敌人只是麦子。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The blade of this sword is dyed black for stealth
when fighting at night.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 剑刃染黑，便于夜战隐蔽。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The power of the sun nurtures life, yet through
this blade, it harvests it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 太阳之力孕育生命，此刃却用它收割生命。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
"Lightning split the sky in two, and the air
sang with thunder." ーLay of the Blade\var2:00\\end\
translation: “雷电劈开天空，空气中雷声作响。”——剑之歌\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
True to its name, this sword wavers and
dances like the voracious flames of a fire.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 此剑名副其实，如烈焰般摇曳舞动。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A keen blade; its form is that of a tempest
bound in steel.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 锋利的剑刃，形如被钢铁束缚的风暴。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The unmelting ice used to forge this blade was
stolen from the heart of a massive glacier.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 锻剑所用的永不融化之冰取自巨大冰川深处。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
With this sword in hand, even the most restless
heart might glimpse serenity.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 手持此剑，再躁动的心也能瞥见宁静。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A great sword is lifted not for battle, but for
victory. This scarlet blade is one such sword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 大剑为胜利而非战斗举起，这把红刃正是如此。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Never has the soft glow of pearl heralded such
pain.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 珍珠柔光从未预示过如此痛苦。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Gemstones fused into the steel make this blade
almost as costly as it is deadly.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 宝石熔入钢中，使此剑既昂贵又致命。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sword of stone; its blade radiates a faint
warmth.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 石制剑刃散发着淡淡暖意。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Materia crystals have been fused into the
blade of this sword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 剑刃中熔入了魔石水晶。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sword forged over black flame upon an obsidian
anvil and tempered in dark ichor.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 在黑曜石砧上以黑焰锻造、在暗血中淬火的剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A green-hued blade forged from adamantite.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 金刚石锻成的绿色剑刃。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The one-handed sword much beloved by the hero Gaol.
Its blade is like a living flame.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 英雄加奥尔钟爱的单手剑，剑刃宛如活焰。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The off-hand sword much beloved by the hero Gaol.
Its blade is like a shard of ice.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 英雄加奥尔钟爱的副手剑，剑刃宛如冰片。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Sometimes it's easier to crush a helm than cleave it.
On such occasions, reach for this sword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 有时砸碎头盔比劈开更容易，此剑正适合。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A blue saber, born of the deepest ocean.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 诞生于深海的蓝色军刀。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A wide saber with a markedly curved blade.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 刀刃弯曲明显的宽军刀。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sea-blue saber, tempered in a maelstrom and
possessing all its power.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 在漩涡中淬炼的海蓝军刀，拥有漩涡之力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
In a hero's hands, this saber once slew a fell
monster. What will it do in yours?\var2:00\\end\
translation: 英雄曾用此刀斩杀魔物，它在你手中又会如何？\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Face paints taken from the courtesans of slain
foes give this saber its peculiar bluish hue.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 取自敌方侍女的颜料赋予此刀独特蓝色。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A saber such as might be wielded by an
apprentice blue mage.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 适合青魔道士学徒使用的军刀。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This saber is a favorite of duelists. Its hilt
has a guard to protect the fist.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 决斗者喜爱的军刀，护手可保护拳头。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The light and heat that radiate from this blade
serve only those whom the sword has chosen.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 此刃散发的光与热只为被剑选中之人服务。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Frills are for dresses, not swords. A practical
sword for practical swordsmen.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 装饰适合裙子，不适合剑；这是实用剑士的剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
To draw this black blade is to know the horrors
of war and welcome them.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 拔出黑刃，便是迎接战争的恐怖。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sword wielded by knights loyal to a hero-king
of old.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古代英雄王的忠诚骑士所持之剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Common blades are drawn to begin battles.
Ragnarok is drawn to end them.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 普通剑用于开战，诸神黄昏用于终战。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sword befitting a noble knight, or a
squire with noble dreams.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 适合高贵骑士或怀抱崇高梦想的侍从。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Prayers are inscribed along the length of this
holy blade to ease the passing of its victims.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 圣剑刻满祈文，安抚死于其下的人。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Created by a noble family as a testament to their
enduring power. The blade remainsーthey do not.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 贵族家族为彰显权势而造；剑尚存，家族已逝。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Only a true knight may touch this sword's hilt.
The blade isn't half as discriminating.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 唯有真正骑士可握剑柄，剑刃却不挑人。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A suitable weapon for a knight apprentice.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An improvement upon perfection, this knight's
blade has been honed to a razor-sharp edge.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 更臻完美的骑士剑，剑刃磨得极为锋利。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Though modeled on its predecessor, this sword's
power far surpasses that of Ragnarok.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 虽仿照前作，其力量远超诸神黄昏。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Awoken from long slumber, this sword awaits the
right moment to reveal its powers.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 从长眠中苏醒，等待适当时刻展现力量。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Why sting like a bee, when you can do so like a man
with a sharp sword? Made for stabbing, not slashing.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 何必像蜜蜂蜇人？用利剑刺击更好。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Do not be deceived by its light heft and slender
bladeーthis sword can pierce the thickest armors.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 别被轻巧细刃迷惑，此剑能刺穿最厚重的铠甲。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sword made for sticking and stabbing, with a guard
on the hilt to protect the hands.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 专为刺击而制，护手可保护双手。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Men in their last moments have been enchanted by
the flames that seem to dance along this blade.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 临死之人常被剑刃上仿佛跳动的火焰迷住。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A thrusting sword with a blade shaped like a
single tongue of flame.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 剑刃形如一条火舌的刺剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Cleverly wrought lace-like metal cords protect the
hand of the one who wields this beautiful sword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 精巧蕾丝状金属护手保护持剑之手。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Inspired by a dust devil, this sword was born of
sand, sun, and wind.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 灵感来自尘旋风，诞生于沙、日与风。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This sword celebrates the joy of victory for its
wielder. On the matter of the victim, it is silent.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 此剑为持有者庆祝胜利，对受害者则一言不发。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A powerful sword once used for the persecution
of mages.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 曾用于迫害魔道士的强力之剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The cold steel of this sword stands between the
sanity of its wielder and the madness of war.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 冰冷钢刃隔开持有者的理智与战争的疯狂。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A Y-shaped sword with a split hilt.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 分叉剑柄的 Y 形剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An extra blade protrudes from the hilt of this
thrusting sword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 刺剑护手上额外伸出一片刀刃。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Ask ten men the color of this sword as it flies
through battle, and you will hear ten answers.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 问十个人战斗中此剑的颜色，会得到十种回答。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This slender sword is favored of viera warriors.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 维埃拉战士偏爱的细剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This brilliant white-steel rapier is the 26th
work of master bladesmith Pemiet.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 白钢细剑，是铸剑大师佩米耶的第 26 件作品。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The only thing more fearsome than the demon said to
live within this blood-red sword is you wielding it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 传说血红之剑中寄宿恶魔，而持剑的你更可怕。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Kings and kingdoms have risen and fallen at the whim
of this ensanguined sword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 无数王国与君王随此染血之剑兴衰。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Any rapier can cut a gallant swath through the air,
but only this sword can make the air sing.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 任何细剑都能划过空气，唯有此剑能让风歌唱。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This hefty sword is surprisingly agile in the hand.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 沉重的剑，挥舞起来却出奇灵活。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Massive is the only word adequate to describe this
cross-bladed sword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 唯有巨大一词足以形容这把十字剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Longtime wielders of this sword would be hard-pressed
to say whether they broke it in, or it broke them.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 长期持剑的人很难说清，是人磨合了剑还是剑磨合了人。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A large sword forged using methods passed down
from smith to smith since antiquity.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 以自古代代相传的工艺锻造的大剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Diamond dust mixed in with the steel of this blade
gives it an edge that lasts forever.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 钢中混入钻石粉，使剑刃永远锋利。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
What better symbol of courage and love than a
sword?\var2:00\\end\
translation: 还有什么比剑更能象征勇气与爱？\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This straight-bladed sword looks like a bar
of solid iron and is about as subtle.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 直刃剑看似铁条，风格也同样直白。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An ancient mageblade, hallowed at its forging by
the saints of a world long since forgotten.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古老魔剑，锻造时受早已遗忘的世界的圣者祝福。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Two hands may wield, but no scabbard can hold
this titanic blade.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 巨刃需双手持用，却没有剑鞘能容纳。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
With its beautiful sun-flared hilt, this large sword
cuts down all who stand in its way.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 拥有美丽的日耀剑柄，斩倒所有挡路者。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sword forged for a hero who cherished justice.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 为珍视正义的英雄锻造的剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Only the bravest and most skilled of swordsmen
are permitted to wield this sword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 唯有最勇敢、技艺最高超的剑士才可持用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is said this massive sword still reflects the
light of the full moon under which it was forged.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说巨剑仍映照着锻造时的满月光芒。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
One would have to be a hero of incredible strength
to swing a broadsword like this with any style.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 要挥舞这样的阔剑，必须拥有英雄般的力量。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
You could cut clean through a log with this hefty
broadsword, but you wouldn't want to.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 这把沉重阔剑能砍断圆木，但你不会想这样做。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is hard to say where the warrior's bloodlust
ends and the sword begins.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 很难分清战士的嗜血从何处结束、剑从何处开始。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Swing this greatsword once and the air will sing
of battle; twice, and it will sing of victory.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 挥舞一次，风歌唱战斗；挥舞两次，风歌唱胜利。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A proud sword, once wielded by heroes defending their
homeland.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 曾由保卫故乡的英雄持用的骄傲之剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This broadsword was found lodged in the back of a
great rockbeast.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 发现时这把阔剑插在巨型岩兽背上。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Wielding a sword such as this is not a warrior's
right. It is his privilege.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 使用这样的剑不是战士的权利，而是荣幸。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
"I drew the sword and heard chanting; a prayer in a
tongue I do not care to hear again."\var2:00\\end\
translation: “拔剑时我听到吟唱，是不想再听到的祷文。”\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Whoever used this sword before must have been
a giant. Pray he doesn't return for it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 前任使用者一定是巨人，祈祷他不会回来取剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Forged from a fallen star, this sword's wan glow
is a fading memory of its former celestial glory.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 用陨星锻造，微光是昔日天辉的残影。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The ninja knows that a blade may make a passing
good ladder, key, or splint; yet he also knows
that it is best used for killing.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 忍者知道刀能当梯子、钥匙或夹板，但最好还是用来杀敌。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Soft rains fell when this sword was forged, and
the dew still rises on it each evening to wash
off the day's blood.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 此剑锻造时细雨纷飞，每晚露珠仍会洗去白日的血。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This fiery sword has kindled the blood-rage in
many. It is a testament to its quality that it
always finds a new owner afterward.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 火剑令许多人陷入血怒，而它总能找到新主人。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The problem with iron helms is the weight and the
heatーand the fact that this sword cuts right
through them.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 铁盔的问题在于沉重闷热，还有挡不住这把剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The last enemy had been slain, the last banner burnt,
yet the sword still rang with the din of battle.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 最后的敌人与旗帜消失后，剑中仍回响战声。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
You may wonder how such a rough-hewn blade cuts so
cleanly. It is because the sword knows no such doubt.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 粗糙刀刃为何切得如此干净？因为剑从不犹疑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sword so beautiful, the thought of using it is
enough to reduce one to tears.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 美得令人想到使用它便不禁落泪。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sacred blade plucked from the tail of a great
dragon, with a hilt carved from its bones.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 从巨龙尾部取出的圣刃，剑柄由龙骨雕成。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This war sword was forged by a master bladesmith
in a faraway land.\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An exquisite wave pattern glimmers down the blade
of this famous sword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 名剑上闪烁着精美波纹。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Wards against evil have been carven deep into this
giant sword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 巨剑上深刻着驱邪符文。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Even should it hew down a hundred men a day for
a hundred years, the blade of this magnificent
sword will not tarnish or notch.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 即使百年里每天斩百人，此剑也不会失色或缺口。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sword of unknown origin. Black flames seem to
trail behind it as it glides through the air.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 来历不明的剑，挥过空气时仿佛拖着黑焰。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is said this sword was inspired by a famed
flower of striking beauty and cutting fragrance.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说灵感来自美艳而香气锐利的名花。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The blade that tops this slender spear is small,
but sharp.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 细长枪上的刃虽小却锋利。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The blade of this fiery spear glows as if it were
made of magma.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 炽热枪刃如岩浆般发光。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Carvings depicting the tale of a half-man, half-beast
hero adorn the shaft of this spear.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 枪杆刻着半人半兽英雄的传说。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A lance of pure ice, kept eternally from melting by
the gigas Shiva's power.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 纯冰之枪，在希瓦之力下永不融化。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This spear has a blade like a giant feather from
a great steel bird.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 枪刃如钢铁巨鸟的巨大羽毛。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This black lance is thought to have once belonged
to a dragoon of legend.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说曾属于传说中的龙骑士。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The noble trident, weapon of the sea-king and any
brave enough to plough his foaming fields.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 高贵三叉戟，是海王与勇闯波涛者的武器。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A spear forged of metal and wyrmscale.
Its tip is said to hold a dragon's breath.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 以金属和龙鳞锻成，据说枪尖蕴含龙息。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This short spear can be swung much as one would
swing a sword.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 短枪可以像剑一样挥舞。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This short staff is the perfect focus for a mage's
magickal energies.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 短杖是魔道士聚集魔力的理想工具。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A troupe of mummers once used these rods to
surround an invading army with wheels of deadly
flame.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 一支戏班曾用这些魔杖的致命火轮包围入侵军。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Insulating resin from a certain gum tree coats the
grip of this rod, that the thunder and lightning
it summons may not destroy the summoner.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 杖柄涂有绝缘树脂，防止召唤的雷电伤及自身。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Some seek shelter from the storm, others call the
storm to them and revel in its icy chaos.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 有人躲避风暴，有人召来风暴并享受冰冷混乱。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A bone from an earthwyrm graces the handle of
this rod.\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Sometimes the right rod is all it takes to
awaken the potential within.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 有时一把合适的魔杖就能唤醒潜力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The techniques used to carve this rod into a likeness
of crystallized flame have long since been lost.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 将此杖雕成结晶火焰的技艺早已失传。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Lightning made still, made to serve the wielder
of this rod.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 静止的雷电，任持杖者驱使。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A fine coating of snow crystals covers the surface
of this delicate rod.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 精致魔杖表面覆着细雪结晶。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Signs of the zodiac adorn this rod.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A rod fashioned from the tail of the lamia Lilith.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 由拉弥亚莉莉丝的尾巴制成。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A rod wielded by the female honor guards of a queen.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 女王的女性仪仗卫队使用的杖。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The perfect gift for the bomb fanatic in your
family: a rod that looks like a bomb arm!\var2:00\\end\
translation: 送给炸弹怪爱好者的礼物：形似炸弹手臂的杖！\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Inverted runes cover this fell-looking rod,
bestowing it with terrible power.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 倒置符文覆盖邪恶魔杖，赋予其可怕力量。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This pure ivory staff was blessed by a white
mage of the highest rank.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 纯象牙杖受最高阶白魔道士祝福。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A band of temple guardians once wielded these in
lieu of shields and armorーand thus was the
first order of monks founded.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 寺院守卫曾用此杖代替盾甲，创立了首个僧团。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The gigas Ramuh himself infused this staff with
a bolt of lightning.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 幻兽拉姆亲自将一道雷电注入此杖。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Some staves are made for harming, others for mending
those who have come to harm.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 有些杖用来伤人，有些则用于治疗伤者。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This staff acts as a conductor, drawing the
impurities of the body into itself, never to
escape.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 此杖如导体般吸走身体杂质并将其封存。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Lift this staff high, knowing that you call a
benediction down not only upon yourself, but
upon all those whom you hold most dear.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 高举此杖，祝福将降临你及挚爱之人。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Marvel at the serpent, how swiftly it glides out of
harm's way. \var2:00\\end\
translation: 看那蛇，能多么迅速地滑离危险。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The engravings upon the staff form a map leading to
a faerie wellspring of unmatched clarity.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 杖上雕纹是一幅地图，通向清澈无比的妖精泉。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The garnet that tops this staff is infused with
great power.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 杖顶的石榴石蕴含强大力量。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This staff is garishly colored like a child's toy.
Using it you feel strangely...happy.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 此杖色彩艳丽如儿童玩具，使用时莫名开心。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Cast aside the doubt in your mind, pick up this
staff, and watch the light of clarity shine down
upon your path.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 抛开疑虑举起此杖，清明之光将照亮前路。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A staff found in an ancient castle, long hidden
from the world. It is said the soul of a great
sage resides within.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 在久藏于世的古堡中发现，据说寄宿着大贤者之魂。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Close-range combatants have used these single-
pronged wooden sticks for centuries.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 近战者使用这种单叉木棍已有数百年。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A light staff hewn from the pliable wood of
the marshes.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 用沼泽柔韧木材制成的轻棍。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Small blades protrude from either end of this
deceptively simple weapon.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 看似简单的武器两端各有小刀刃。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This pole is divided into three sections: one for
holding, the other two for striking.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 长棍分三节：一节握持，另两节攻击。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
"We peered into the storm of sand and there the
raiders stood, whirling their staves, voices raised
in a ululating war cry." ーThe Traveler's Tale\var2:00\\end\
translation: “透过沙暴，我们看到袭击者挥舞长棍，高声呐喊。”——旅人故事\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is rare to find something so handsomely crafted
so efficacious at crushing in skulls.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 如此精美的工艺，竟也能如此高效地击碎头骨。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The children learned the steps of the dance,
colorful batons raised above their heads.
Never did they suspect they trained for war.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 孩子们举起彩棍学习舞步，浑然不知是在备战。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A great monk once blessed this pole with powerful
charms for destroying evil.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 伟大僧人曾为此棍施加强力驱邪符咒。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Merely gaze at the lustrous deep red of this pole,
and you have taken the first step toward madness.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 只要凝视此棍光泽深红，便踏上疯狂的第一步。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
To wield this finely carven tusk is to wield the
fury of its former owner.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 挥舞精雕獠牙，便是挥舞其前主人的怒火。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Being hit by the bladed end of this pole is only
slightly more painful than being hit by the rest.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 被此棍带刃的一端打中，只比被其他部分打中稍痛。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Made of a strange substance, neither wood nor metal,
this pole possesses a lifelike suppleness.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 由非木非铁的奇异物质制成，具有生物般的柔韧。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Taking brawls to the next level, one fist
at a time.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 一拳接一拳，让斗殴更上一层楼。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Say good morning to your enemy's face with these
flaming knuckles. The fires of the sun in your hand.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 用燃烧拳套向敌人的脸问早安，手中握着太阳之火。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
For those whom nature has not blessed with venom,
there are these. Small thorns deliver the goods.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 天生无毒的人可用此物，小刺会替你送毒。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sweet lullaby delivered with the force of a
battering ram.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 如攻城锤般有力的甜美摇篮曲。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
On the right hands, these battle knuckles are capable
of dealing as much damage as a sword or spear.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 用对了手，这副战斗拳套的伤害堪比剑枪。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These knuckles sport short, but sharp, claws.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 拳套上有短而锋利的爪。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Light, sturdy knuckles made for maximum impact.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 轻巧坚固、追求最大冲击的拳套。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
"'The fangs are for luck,' the old smith said. One man
scoffed and lost nine good teeth. None saw cause to
argue after that." ーThe Traveler's Tale\var2:00\\end\
translation: “老匠说牙齿带来好运。一人嘲笑后掉了九颗牙，再无人反驳。”——旅人故事\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
To brawl is human, to crush your foes to a pulp:
divine.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 斗殴是凡人之举，把敌人打成肉泥则是神迹。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Nothing says "carnivore" like a pair of these
bestial knuckles.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 这副野兽拳套充分展现食肉动物的风范。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
"So effective they were at spilling blood, it was
three years before I realized those cruel-looking
claws were actually painted red." ーThe Study of Arms\var2:00\\end\
translation: “它们太擅长放血，三年后我才发现利爪本来就涂着红色。”——武器研究\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Properly braided, even the supplest of materials
can be made deadly.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 柔软材料经过恰当编织，也能变得致命。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Knuckles so powerful, even a glancing blow is
enough to kill.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 强力拳套，擦中便足以致命。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These knuckles are phenomenally light. So much so
that one might forget one was wearing them.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 拳套轻得惊人，甚至会忘记自己戴着。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A double bowstring makes this weapon particularly
lethal.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 双弓弦使这件武器格外致命。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A blackened bow for stealthy night use.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 为夜间隐蔽而染黑的弓。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
"I often thought that, should I run out of arrows
in the midst of battle, I could pull off one of the
thorns and shoot that instead." ーThe Study of Arms\var2:00\\end\
translation: “战斗中若箭用尽，我想可以拔一根刺来射。”——武器研究\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is said that a line of archers with these bows once
loosed a volley into a wood, and when the leaves
settled, there stood a sturdily constructed cabin.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说弓手齐射树林，落叶散去后竟出现一座木屋。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It was the viera who first discovered that a strand
of silver in the wood made the bow fire further and
with far greater power.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 维埃拉族发现木中嵌银线可使弓射得更远更强。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This slender bow is said to have once belonged to
the Goddess of the Hunt.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说曾属于狩猎女神的细弓。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Songs tell of a great warrior in a faraway land
who once wielded this weapon.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 歌谣传说远方有位伟大战士曾使用此弓。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Dedicated machinists toiled for years to create
these reliable bows.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 敬业的机械师耗时多年制造的可靠之弓。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Be thankful this bow does not bear a notch for every
fell fiend vanquished by it, for by now it would be
naught but a string.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 幸好此弓不会为每个被消灭的魔物刻一道痕，否则只剩弓弦。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending
Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Carvings of the moon and stars adorn this bow, said
to be the favored weapon of the Moon Goddess.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 饰有月星雕纹，据说是月之女神钟爱的武器。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Best fired from afar, lest the stench betray you
to your enemies.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 最好从远处射击，以免臭味暴露位置。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This bow fires arrows so swiftly, even the wind
cannot catch them.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 箭速快得连风都追不上。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The high tension of this bow makes it more suitable
for the skilled archer.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 高拉力使此弓更适合熟练弓手。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A king once presented one of these great bows to a
tribe of moogles. Any fewer, and he feared they
would not be able to draw the string.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 国王曾向莫古族赠送此弓，他担心少于一族的人拉不开弓弦。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This bow has been designed specifically for rapid,
repeated firing.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 专为快速连续射击设计。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Another bow might be sufficient to claim a hare,
or wound a hart, but is it good enough to split
a hair, or pierce a heart?\var2:00\\end\
translation: 别的弓能猎兔伤鹿，但能劈开发丝、刺穿心脏吗？\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A light bow, made and favored by the fey folk of
the woodlands.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 森林妖精制作并喜爱的轻弓。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Each arrow it fires points the way to the Underworld.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 射出的每支箭都指向冥界。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A bow blessed by the Goddess of Victory.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A greenhorn would be hard-pressed even to draw
this daunting bow.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 新手恐怕连拉开这把可畏的弓都做不到。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
What oath was sworn to which demon to imbue this
pitch-black bow with such power? Best not to ask.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 究竟向哪个恶魔立下何种誓言，才让黑弓获得此力？还是别问为妙。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A holy bow fashioned by a god to adorn his
highest throne.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 神明为装饰最高王座而制作的圣弓。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The dramatic forward curves at both ends of this
medium-sized bow considerably improve its power.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 中型弓两端显著前弯，大幅提升威力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This legendary bow has slain thousands on the field
of battle. Are you worthy to wield it?\var2:00\\end\
translation: 传说之弓在战场杀敌数千，你配得上它吗？\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An enormous, high-tension bow. Difficult to draw,
but well worth the trouble.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 巨大高拉力弓，虽难拉开，却值得费力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The reverberating thud as the base of this massive
bow is thrust into the earth sends enemies running
in terror. They will have to run very far indeed.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 巨弓底座插入地面的震响会吓跑敌人，而他们必须跑得极远。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending
Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This gun uses special, rounded ammunition.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 使用特殊圆形弹药的枪。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The barrel of this gun has been lengthened for
improved accuracy.\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This gun, developed by a warlord on the eve of
a revolution, soon became the standard weapon
of his new realm.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 军阀于革命前夕研发的枪，后来成为新王国的制式武器。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The smith responsible for producing this gun
attempted to replicate the construction methods
used by ancient machinists.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 工匠试图复刻古代机械师工艺而制造此枪。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This elegantly designed gun is beautiful enough
to hang in a gallery, yet so effective, it'd be
a shame not to use it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 设计优雅，美得可挂进画廊，却又实用得不忍闲置。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The only thing wider than the barrel on this gun
is the hole it leaves in your enemies.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 比枪管更宽的，只有它在敌人身上留下的洞。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A gun so accurate, you could shoot blindfolded
at night and still hit your mark.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 精准得即使夜间蒙眼射击也能命中目标。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A gun with a unique noise-dampening design to
conceal the location of the marksman.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 独特消音设计可隐藏射手位置。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A gun designed by the machinists of Goug.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A little red bell rung by travelers to ward
off demons during the night.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 旅人夜间摇响的小红铃，用以驱魔。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The crystalline harmonies of this glass bell
are truly worth the hearing.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 玻璃铃清澈和谐的声音值得一听。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A trumpet to be sounded on the march to battle.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 行军赴战时吹响的号角。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is said these coiled, hollow shells were once
used by mermen to call attacks on galleons strayed
too far from the bustle of the shipping lanes.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说人鱼曾吹响中空螺壳，召集同伴袭击远离航道的商船。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Spin the crank and an elaborate system of tubes,
whistles, and chimes makes music out of machinery.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 转动曲柄，复杂管道、哨子和铃铛便奏出乐曲。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A black flute, played to send the souls of the
departed on to the next world.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 为逝者送行至彼岸而吹奏的黑笛。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This flute is shaped like the horn of those lovers
of good music and fine wine, the beast-men satyrs.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 形如热爱音乐美酒的萨堤尔兽人之角。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The faeries play these harps of cedarwood and
silver string as they flit through the forests.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 妖精穿梭森林时弹奏的雪松银弦竖琴。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Many noble lips have played this storied flute.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 许多贵族曾吹奏这支传奇之笛。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
When the reverberations of the final clear note
have faded, your heart will know peace.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 最后一个清音消散后，你的心将归于平静。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A lute made to accompany songs of devotion.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 为伴奏虔诚歌曲而制的琵琶。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Though it be played in the dingiest of taverns,
the crisp chords of this instrument sound as
though they echo in a cathedral of ice.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 即使在昏暗酒馆演奏，清脆和弦也如回荡在冰之教堂。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The rich bass notes of this instrument give any
room in which it is played a warm, homey feel.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 丰厚低音为演奏之处带来温暖的家居感。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A standing harp. The song of its strings resembles
that of the lamia.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 立式竖琴，弦音似拉弥亚之歌。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A smaller cannon made for ease of carrying.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This cannon's narrower body makes for increased
muzzle velocity.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 较窄的炮身提升了炮口初速。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Designs of embossed silver curl around the barrel of
this ceremonial cannon.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 礼炮炮管环绕着浮雕银饰。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A rare cannon crafted by mages. Only its creators
know the arcane principles by which it fires.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 魔道士制造的稀有炮，只有制作者知晓其发射原理。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Many a pom-pom has been rocked by the kickback
from this mighty peashooter.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 强力小炮的后坐力震动过许多绒球。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Cannon also named "The Shining Life."
Odd, considering its purpose.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 此炮又名“闪耀生命”，考虑到其用途倒有些奇怪。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This impressive weapon is best fired after
mounting it on firm ground.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 最好将这件强大武器架在坚实地面后发射。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The principles of magickal engineering were applied
in the construction of this unique weapon.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 以魔法工程原理制造的独特武器。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A great cannon so powerful, its use was banned by
kings who feared their enemies might obtain one.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 威力巨大，国王恐惧敌人获得而禁止使用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The techniques used in the crafting of this ancient
weapon have long since been lost. It possesses
almost unimaginable destructive power.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古代武器的制造技艺早已失传，破坏力难以想象。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This ember-red jewel is also called the Tear of the
Sun. It heightens the physical power of its bearer.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 烬红宝石又称太阳之泪，增强持有者的体力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This snow-white jewel is also called the Tear of the
Comet. It strengthens the magicks of its bearer.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 雪白宝石又称彗星之泪，增强持有者的魔法。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This sea-blue jewel is also called the Tear of the
Meteor. Its bearer walks with a light step.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 海蓝宝石又称流星之泪，使持有者步履轻盈。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is said the Moon Maiden once adorned her hair with
this precious spellstone.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说月之少女曾用这颗珍贵魔石装饰头发。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The wide blade of this axe is perfect for chopping
through anything foolish enough to get in your way.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 宽阔斧刃适合劈开任何愚蠢挡路之物。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Flesh and sinew offer no resistance at all to this
axe's slender blade.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 血肉筋骨无法抵挡纤细斧刃。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The head of this axe was designed on the assumption
that what the blade didn't cut, the hammer would
surely smash.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 斧头设计认为刀刃砍不断的，锤头总能砸碎。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Small and sharp, the perfect axe for close encounters
of an unfriendly kind.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 小巧锋利，适合近距离恶斗。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Demons once stormed Ivalice wielding these giant axes.
Had they been larger still, it is like that men could
not have used them to drive the demons back.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 恶魔曾持巨斧进攻伊瓦利斯；若斧更大，人类恐怕无法用它反击。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Pirate kings favor these gilt axes as symbols of
their wealth and power.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 海盗王喜爱用镀金斧象征财富与权力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
"When the call to war came, it was the common
smiths who first raised their weapons in answer."
ーThe Study of Arms\var2:00\\end\
translation: “战争召唤时，普通铁匠最先举起武器响应。”——武器研究\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It takes a muscle-bound warrior to wield this
heavy hammer, and a swift one to avoid it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 需要强壮战士挥动重锤，也需要敏捷战士躲避。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Hammers such as this one are used in the quarries
to sunder large chunks of rock. Imagine what it
can do on the battlefield.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 采石场用这种锤击碎巨石，想想它在战场的威力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Dark faeries trapped a raging storm within this
hammer as they forged it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 暗妖精锻造时将狂暴风暴封入锤中。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A blunt weapon, but no less effective than a sword
in the right hands.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 钝器在善用者手中不逊于剑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Traces of magnetic material in the alloy of this
mace guide it toward the invisible energies
emitted by all living things.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 合金中的磁性物质引导钉锤追寻生物散发的无形能量。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A mace wielded by those who serve a higher
power.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 侍奉更高力量者所持的钉锤。\var2:00\\end\

This mace is more than a weapon; it is the symbol

The design of these thorned battle maces was

notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A mace fashioned from the poisonous root of
the mandragora.\var2:00\\end\

notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A mace with the power to give life, and to
take it away.\var2:00\\end\

The gigas Ifrit wrought this mace of living flame.
\var2:00\\end\

us with the perfect design?" ーThe Study of Arms\var2:00\\end\

One could learn all there is to know of the
techniques of war by reading this weighty tome.
\var2:00\\end\

No mage's training is complete without the
knowledge contained in this tome.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 任何魔道士的训练都离不开书中知识。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The compiled chronicles of the reign of a once-
mighty king.\var2:00\\end\

This book carries the word of the holy god

source_text:
A record of Kuth Castle in the land of Enavia.
\var2:00\\end\

A book detailing the life and affairs of a
notorious woman.\var2:00\\end\

notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

This forbidden book is said to tell of the great

This book of scripture was written many thousands
of years ago. There are thought to be none alive

source_text:
A rounded shield for deflecting attacks.
\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
The luster of this shield is a sight to
behold.\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A slight chill hangs in the air around this
magicked shield.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 魔法盾周围弥漫着微微寒气。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The magickal glyphs that adorn this shield invoke
the fire used to forge it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 盾上的魔法符文召唤锻造它时的火焰。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

"I was alarmed to hear a mighty demon lay trapped
within the shield, yet I know it is stronger for it."\var2:00\\end\

notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A shield from a faraway land, said to match a set
of legendary armor.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 来自远方的盾，据说与传说铠甲成套。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is said this shield was a gift from the world
above to a mortal king.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说此盾是天界赐予凡人国王的礼物。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A mythril shield, made in honor of the Four Gods.
It bears the symbols of the Four upon its surface.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 为纪念四神而制的秘银盾，表面刻有四神印记。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A shield made from the tanned skin of a chocobo.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 用鞣制陆行鸟皮制作的盾。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is said the blackened blood that coats this
demon shield belonged to its former owners.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说恶魔盾上发黑的血来自它的前任主人。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A shield of many colorsーit changes its hue
with every swing of the arm.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 多彩之盾，挥臂时颜色随之变化。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A helm fashioned of leather and bronze.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 皮革与青铜制成的头盔。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
"'Aye,'tis a heavy helm,' the swordsman said, 'but
I'll be carrying it and leaving your corpse behind
if you don't put it on.'" ーThe Traveler's Tale\var2:00\\end\
translation: “是的，头盔很重，但你若不戴，我就带走它，留下你的尸体。”——旅人故事\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sturdy helm, though some complain the narrow
visor ruins their view of the carnage.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 坚固头盔，有人抱怨窄面罩妨碍观赏杀戮。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A helm made to cover the whole face.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This elegant helm is made for military ceremonies
and the like where full battle regalia is required.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 为需要全副礼装的军事仪式等场合制作的优雅头盔。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is hard to overestimate this helm's protective
qualities, nor the means of one who could afford
to buy it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 此盔防护性能极高，买得起它的人财力也不可小觑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Shivering, a blacksmith once woke from a nightmare
about a demon of a faraway land. The next morning,
he crafted the first of these helms.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 铁匠梦见远方恶魔后惊醒，次日打造了第一顶这种头盔。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
"Of the metal and giant's bones used in the helm's
manufacture, the smith found the metal far easier
to work." ーThe Study of Arms\var2:00\\end\
translation: “制造头盔时，铁匠发现巨人骨比金属难加工得多。”——武器研究\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This helm was crafted by a master smith in a faraway
land. So much skill and rare metal are required for
its construction, only one can be made in an age.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 远方大师打造的头盔，所需技艺与稀有金属之多，一代只能制一顶。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A red hairpin, adorned with words of blessing to
keep one's protections close. WOMEN only.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 刻有祝福语的红发饰，仅女性可用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A great hairdo alone can't ward off evil. Leave that
to the magicked stones on this hairpin. WOMEN only.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 光靠发型无法驱邪，要靠发夹上的魔石。仅女性可用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Sticks and stones may break your bones, but this will
protect you from almost everything else. WOMEN only.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 棍石也许能伤身，但此物能防住几乎其他一切。仅女性可用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sturdy hat adorned with a rather garish feather.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 饰有艳丽羽毛的坚固帽子。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A hat for a man or moogle on a mission.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 适合执行任务的人或莫古戴的帽子。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A forehead band for warding off undesirable magicks.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 用于驱除不良魔法的额环。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
There's nothing like a tight headband for keeping
your thoughts from straying too far afield.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 紧实头带能让思绪不致飘远。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Time mages are known to be fond of these pointy
hats.\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Witches of old wore sackcloth and shunned all fancy
accoutrements, save a single gold hairpin.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古代女巫穿粗布衣，唯独不舍得一支金发饰。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A thief steals everything except for a fine cap.
Some things are worth the money.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 盗贼什么都偷，唯独好帽子值得花钱买。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A delicate crown wrought from gold filament,
a lilting song, and a little girl's dream.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 由金丝、轻歌和女孩梦想织成的精致冠冕。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This large pointed hat is sewn of black mage's
thread, yet no needle ever touched it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 由黑魔道士之线织成，却从未被针触及的尖帽。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Sewn of white mage's thread; it is possible to
make one of these hats without the ears, but no one
with any sense at all would consider wearing it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 用白魔道士之线织成；虽能做成无耳款，但没人愿意戴。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This cap is the perfect mage's assistant. Interwoven
golden threads augment your magick, and magick words
are embroidered on the back, should you forget.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 魔道士的得力助手：金线增强魔法，背面绣着咒语以防遗忘。\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
Armor fashioned of tightly woven linen.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Armor fashioned of joined bronze plates.
\var2:00\\end\

notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This heavy armor features a plate of solid iron to
protect the chest.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 用实心铁板保护胸部的重甲。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

of chainmail to form this full-body armor.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 重叠金属板装在锁子甲上构成全身铠甲。\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
"A thief boasted to me that once, in a battle, he'd
scraped enough gilt-leaf off a knight's armor to
go into early retirement." ーThe Traveler's Tale\var2:00\\end\
translation: “盗贼夸耀曾从骑士铠甲刮下足够提前退休的金箔。”——旅人故事\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
"A beautiful piece of armor, to be sure, but compared
to the diamonds that bespeckle it, the rest is rough."
ーThe Study of Arms\var2:00\\end\
translation: “铠甲固然美丽，但与上面的钻石相比仍显粗糙。”——武器研究\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Beautiful curves of silvery metal make this suit of
armor a sight to behold on the battlefield.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 银色金属优美曲线使此铠成为战场焦点。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This remarkably lightweight armor is made of iron
fused with mythril.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 秘银与铁融合，铠甲出奇轻盈。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This thin armor is imbued with powerful Reflect
magicks.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 注入强力反射魔法的薄甲。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The fusing of steel plates with scales in this armor is
a product not of smithing, but of the dragon's diet.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 钢板与鳞片的融合并非锻造所致，而是龙的饮食所致。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This armor bears the crest of the last of the Knights
of the Round.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 铠甲带有最后一位圆桌骑士的纹章。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This suit of armor from a faraway land is truly one-
of-a-kind.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 来自远方、独一无二的铠甲。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:

a beautiful greenish luster.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 金刚石强化铠甲并赋予美丽绿光。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Armor fashioned of materia crystals. It boasts
incredible strength and resistance to attacks.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 魔石水晶制成的铠甲，坚固且极能抵御攻击。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This sturdy armor is fashioned to resonate with the
tides of battle, strengthening in times of direst need.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 坚固铠甲随战局共鸣，在危急时变得更强。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Rugged clothes made from many layers of quality
leather.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 多层优质皮革制成的结实衣服。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A suit of armor made from small, interlinked
iron rings.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 互相连接的小铁环制成的铠甲。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A linen vest fit with an adamant alloy breastplate.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 带金刚合金胸甲的亚麻背心。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The thick cotton in this vest reduces damage taken
from blunt impacts.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 背心中的厚棉可减轻钝击伤害。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This suit of armor is cleverly designed so that no
two pieces of metal rub against each other.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 巧妙设计使金属片互不摩擦。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A fighting suit favored by monks.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This handy accoutrement is meant to take the slack
out of clothing to prevent unwanted snags and tears.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 实用腰带可收紧衣服，防止勾挂撕裂。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This blue clothing has been blessed by the spirit of
the earth.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 受大地精灵祝福的蓝衣。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is said the goddess of victory once wore this
garment. WOMEN only.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说胜利女神曾穿过此衣。仅女性可用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Only the ninja know the techniques required to make
this sturdy, stealthy gear.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 只有忍者知道如何制作坚固隐蔽的装备。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Clothes for blending into the shadows when secrecy
is needed.\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A hero-king of old wore this garment.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古代英雄王曾穿过的衣服。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
When it catches the light, this garment glows with an
unearthly luminescence.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 受到光照时，此衣散发异界般的光辉。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Lightning never strikes twice. This suit's designer
knows even once is too often. WOMEN only.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 雷电不会两次击中同一处，但设计者认为一次也太多。仅女性可用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This garment was made by stitching together the bones
of a beast.\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A coat for a judge, keeper of the law.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 维护法令的裁判所穿外套。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A high quality, rugged tunic. Made to last a
a lifetime.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 高品质耐穿上衣，可穿一生。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The latest from fashion mavens Brint Mea.
A gorgeously refined design.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 时尚名家布林特·梅亚的新品，设计华丽精致。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The latest from fashion house Galmia Pepe.
A chic, understated design.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 时装屋加尔米亚·佩佩的新品，简洁时髦。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This holy coat receives protection from the gods
themselves. Worn by the knights of an ancient,
lost kingdom.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 受诸神保护的圣衣，古代失落王国的骑士曾穿着。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A simple robe woven from coarse thread.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A supple robe woven from the finest silks.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 上等丝绸织成的柔软长袍。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This robe flutters out like a cape; the symbol of
the mage.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 如披风般飘扬的长袍，是魔道士的象征。\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
A lucky robe, dyed with pigment taken from the leaves
of the ivy creeper.\var2:00\\end\
