notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A robe such as this will not burn, even should it be
thrust into a forge-fire.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 即使投入炉火也不会燃烧的长袍。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Strange hoops of magick wire woven into this robe
conduct and hold the power of the storm.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 袍中编织的奇异魔线圈可传导并储存风暴之力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Even on the sunniest of days, a dusting of snow
sits upon the shoulders of this robe.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 即使阳光明媚，袍肩也覆着薄雪。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A robe of the purest white. Better than black magick
for defending one's person.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 纯白长袍，保护自身比黑魔法更有效。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A jet black robe. Lends its power to black magick
incantations.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 漆黑长袍，为黑魔法咒语提供力量。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This lustrous robe has the strange property of
reducing fatigue, both of body and mind.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 光泽长袍能神奇地减轻身心疲劳。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This classy robe was once bestowed upon a great lord.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 曾赐予伟大领主的雅致长袍。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This silvery coat sparkles with sanctified light.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 银色外套闪耀神圣之光。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A robe intended mainly for use by red mages.
The sight of its vermillion whorls in the wind is
breathtaking.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 主要供赤魔道士穿着，朱红花纹随风飘动令人惊叹。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A robe of soft, durable cloth. Sent to those sages
who have walked the paths of knowledge to their end.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 柔软耐用的长袍，赠予走到知识之路尽头的贤者。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These enchanted robes are dyed a cerulean blue.
Said to give their wearer the courage to be humble
and conscientious in their dealings.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 天蓝魔法袍，据说赋予穿戴者谦逊认真的勇气。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Robes so drenched with blood they've turned black.
Their rustling is the sound of a soul in anguish.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 被鲜血染黑的长袍，摩擦声如痛苦灵魂的哀鸣。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Leather boots, tanned to a hard, durable sheen.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 鞣制得坚硬耐用的皮靴。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
With their long metal spikes, these boots were made
for kicking, and that's just what they'll do.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 带长金属刺的靴子，专为踢击而制。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A pair of shoes for fast running over short distances.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The unusually long-lasting dye used in these shoes
is made from a mash of common medicinal herbs.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 鞋上持久染料由常见药草捣制。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An entire flock of pigeons was plucked to make these
boots; so light their wearer may walk on water.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 为制作靴子拔光一群鸽子的羽毛；轻得能水上行走。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These boots are designed for negotiating treacherous
mountain paths with ease.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 为轻松穿越险峻山路而设计。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Brand-name boots. They aren't much for the water,
but they fear no steep slope or sudden dip.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 名牌靴，不擅涉水，却不怕陡坡和骤降。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These winged shoes will fly you wherever you wish to
go.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 带翅膀的鞋，能飞往想去的地方。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These boots were made by the cobblers of an ancient
kingdom. Much beloved of the royal troops.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古代王国鞋匠制作，深受皇家军队喜爱。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Boots of thick cloth, worn by the spies of a faraway
land.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 远方间谍穿着的厚布靴。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The cloth of these armguards is specially fashioned
to resist tearing.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 护臂布料经过特殊处理，抗撕裂。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These gloves are designed for ease of movement,
and are well suited to intricate manual tasks.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 便于活动的手套，适合精细手工。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These leather hand guards are designed to protect
without interfering with the business of combat.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 皮护手既能防护，又不妨碍战斗。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These elegant gloves are possessed of a truly
unique appearance and hue.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 外形和色彩独特的优雅手套。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These long gauntlets protect from the elbow down to
the tips of the fingers.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 从肘部保护到指尖的长护手。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Armlets fashioned from the bones of a beast.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A brilliant ring, set with stones of power.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 镶有力量宝石的灿烂戒指。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The engravings on this ring heighten the magick
potential of its wearer.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 戒指上的雕纹提升佩戴者的魔法潜力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is said the angels themselves made this ring
of benedictions.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说是天使亲手制作的祝福之戒。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A good-luck charm, fashioned in the likeness of a
scintillating desert beetle.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 制成闪光沙漠甲虫形状的幸运护符。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These earrings are the tears shed by a goddess upon
losing her mortal love, frozen forever in time.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 女神失去凡人爱人时的泪水，永远凝成耳环。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It is said this armband draws its power from the stars
that wheel through the heavens above.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说臂环从天上运转的群星汲取力量。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Some call this jewel the "Soul of Minwu," so treasured
it was by its original owner.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 宝石深受原主人珍爱，有人称之为明武之魂。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A charm woven of thinly spun threads of gold.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 由细金线编织成的护符。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A pendant in the form of the gigas Belias, said to
hold within it the very fires of the Underworld.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 形如幻兽贝利亚斯的吊坠，据说内藏冥界之火。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A gift given to Mateus, the Corrupt. What bounty it
might hold is imprisoned forever in unmelting ice.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 赠予腐败者马提乌斯的礼物，其宝藏永封于不融之冰中。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An armlet engraved with the image of Shemhazai, the
Whisperer. It glows brilliantly with each life taken.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 刻有低语者谢姆哈萨的手镯，每夺一命便闪耀光芒。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This hairpin holds the very soul of Hashmal, Bringer
of Order, protecting with the strength of the earth.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 发饰寄宿秩序使者哈修玛尔的灵魂，以大地之力保护持有者。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This pitcher bears the name of Famfrit, the Darkening
Cloud. Its bearer is said to risk watery ruination.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 水壶刻有暗云法姆弗里特之名，持有者据说有溺亡之险。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This brooch fashioned in the form of Adrammelech, the
Wroth brings the light of justice down upon evildoers.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 愤怒者亚德拉米勒克形状的胸针，以正义之光惩治恶人。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A short chain bearing the sigil of Cúchulainn,
the Impure. Protection against poisonous herbs.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 刻有不净者库丘林印记的短链，可抵御毒草。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These earringsーsaid to be keys to the Underworldーare
engraved with an image of Zalera, the Death Seraph.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 刻有死天使扎勒拉的耳环，据说是冥界钥匙。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Lift this ring engraved with Chaos, Walker of the
Wheel on high to summon the spirits of the storm.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 举起刻有轮回行者卡奥斯的戒指，可召唤风暴之灵。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A choker engraved with an image of Zeromus, the
Condemner. Lends its strength only for revenge.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 刻有谴责者泽罗穆斯的颈环，只为复仇提供力量。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An accoutrement cleverly shaped into the form of
Exodus, the Judge-Sal. Fashioned from a fallen star.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 巧妙制成审判者艾克斯迪斯形状，以陨星打造的饰品。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This pin bears a motif of Ultima, the High Seraph.
The front feather is rebirth, the back, destruction.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 饰针以炽天使究极为主题，前羽象征重生，后羽象征毁灭。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A ring in the shape of Zodiark, Keeper of Precepts.
Within it sleeps the power to reduce all to nothing.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 戒律守护者佐迪亚克形状的戒指，沉睡着归零万物之力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A magick concoction that eases pain and heals wounds
in the blink of an eye.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 瞬间止痛治伤的魔法药剂。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A potion mixed for greater strength.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

translation: 现有浓度最高的治疗药。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This tincture restores lost magickal power.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This miraculous tincture completely restores both
health and magickal power to the drinker.
\var2:00\\end\
translation: 完全恢复饮用者生命和魔力的神奇药剂。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A magick feather with the power to revive those
at death's door.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 能复活濒死者的魔法羽毛。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A soothing tonic for the voiceless.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A fruity concoction that works better than its
namesake, or at least, doesn't require convincing
the maiden.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 水果药剂，效果比真正的少女之吻更好，至少无需说服少女。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This magick needle breaks the enchantments that
turn flesh to stone.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 解除肉身石化魔法的神针。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This sanctified water is most efficacious in increasing
resistance to debuffs, with no ill side effects.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 圣水能有效提升负面状态抗性，没有副作用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A tonic that works through the skin, drawing out
and neutralizing toxins within the body.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 经皮肤吸出并中和体内毒素的药剂。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A medicine to lift the veil of darkness covering
eyes afflicted with blindness.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 驱散失明者眼前黑暗的药物。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These strips of treated linen restore feeling to
paralyzed limbs.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 经过处理的亚麻布条，能恢复麻痹肢体的知觉。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A tincture that cures what ails you.
\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This absorptive cloth is ideal for cleaning
up spilt oil.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 吸水布，适合清理洒出的油。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A fused ball of metalworking detritus. Useful as
a thrown weapon, or a doorstop.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 金属加工废料熔成的球，可投掷，也可挡门。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A crystalline fragment discovered in the forbidden
reaches of Eureka. Its power heals wounds and
improves combat performance.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 尤里卡禁地发现的水晶碎片，能治伤并提升战斗表现。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This spellstone once graced the cover of a grimoire
scribed by a witch in ancient times. Known to both
restore and augment magickal power.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古代女巫魔典封面上的魔石，能恢复并增强魔力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A mysterious black substance with no more form than
mist. What's it for? Why, throwing at enemies, of
course.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 如雾般无形的神秘黑物质，当然是用来投敌人的。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A crystal said to have once been the property of
renowned psychic Tarkov. Used to focus the mind.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说曾属于著名灵媒塔尔科夫，可用于集中精神。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This crystal is suffused with raw knowledge.
The entire world can be seen in the swirling
mists within it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 蕴含原始知识的水晶，内部旋雾中可见整个世界。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This crystal is suffused with raw power.
Said to fulfill the wishes of its owner.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 蕴含原始力量的水晶，据说能实现主人愿望。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This crystal reflects not the body, but the soul.
Use it with careーnot all who look can live with
what they've seen.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 映照灵魂而非肉体的水晶，小心使用，有人承受不了所见。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Legend says that a great spirit of the earth lies
trapped inside this crystal. Peer within, and you
will see nothing but endlessly swirling sand.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 传说封着大地精灵，向内望去只有无尽旋沙。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Legend says that a great spirit of the wind lies
trapped inside this crystal. Put your ear to it,
and you will hear the howling of an endless gale.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 传说封着风之精灵，贴耳可闻无尽狂风。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Legend says that a great spirit of the water lies
trapped inside this crystal. Hold it in your hand,
and you will feel a raging current swirl within.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 传说封着水之精灵，握在手中可感到激流盘旋。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Legend says that a great spirit of fire lies
trapped inside this crystal. Touch it, and you
will feel the heat of the blaze within.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 传说封着火之精灵，触摸可感到内中烈焰热量。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Legend says that a great spirit of ice lies
trapped inside this crystal. Turn it upside down
and watch snow form a blizzard within.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 传说封着冰之精灵，倒转可见雪花化作暴风雪。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Legend says that a great spirit of the storm lies
trapped inside this crystal. Violent flashes of
lightning arc through its depths.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 传说封着风暴精灵，深处闪电不断。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Legend says that a holy spirit lies trapped inside
this crystal. Gentle light flickers from deep within.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 传说封着圣灵，深处闪烁柔光。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Legend says that a great spirit of darkness lies
trapped inside this crystal. Do not look upon the
pulsating shadow within overlong.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 传说封着暗之精灵，不要凝视内中脉动阴影太久。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A stone imbued with earth magicks. It's quite heavy,
despite its small size.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 注入地魔法的石头，虽小却很重。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A stone imbued with wind magicks. Hold it to your
ear and hear the howling of the wind.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 注入风魔法的石头，贴耳可闻风啸。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A stone imbued with water magicks. It gushes water
when shattered.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 注入水魔法的石头，击碎后涌出水。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A stone imbued with fire magicks. It's slightly warm
to the touch.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 注入火魔法的石头，触手微暖。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A stone imbued with ice magicks. It's as cold as
the substance from which it takes its name.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 注入冰魔法的石头，冰冷如其名。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A stone imbued with storm magicks. It glows with
a faint, intermittent light.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 注入风暴魔法的石头，间歇闪烁微光。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A stone imbued with holy magicks. Calms a troubled
heart with a single touch.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 注入圣魔法的石头，触摸便可平息烦心。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A stone imbued with dark magicks. The black blotches
covering it are disturbing to behold.\var2:00\\end\

Powerful magicks transformed a wind spirit into this

Powerful magicks transformed a fire spirit into this

Powerful magicks transformed a water spirit into this

Powerful magicks transformed a storm spirit into this

Powerful magicks transformed an ice spirit into this
crystal. How fascinating that something so small could

source_text:
This gemstone contains the soul of a monster.
Its shape and hue are truly unique.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 包含魔物灵魂的宝石，形色独特。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This gemstone contains the soul of a monster.
Another arcana gem can be seen within it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 包含魔物灵魂的宝石，内中可见另一颗秘石。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This beautiful greenish-hued ore is obtained
from the fossilized remains of an adamantoise.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 从金刚龟化石中获得的美丽绿色矿石。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The star-like patterns seen in this rare ore
have been compared to the signs of the zodiac.
Its hardness makes it difficult to smith.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 稀有矿石上的星状纹路形似黄道星座，坚硬难锻。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This ore is used as a base material for alchemy.
Its properties change with the time of day.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 炼金基础矿石，性质随时间变化。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This mysterious ore is rich in magickal energy.
It is known to become poisonous when exposed to
certain alchemical processes.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 富含魔力的神秘矿石，某些炼金工序会使其有毒。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An alloy made from adamant ore; used in the
forging of many kinds of armor and weapons.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 由金刚矿制成的合金，用于锻造各种武器防具。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A sacred alloy, smelted by spirits in hidden kilns.
Only those who are pure of heart are granted its
use.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 精灵在隐秘窑炉中冶炼的神圣合金，只赐纯洁之人使用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A magickal alloy from ancient Mysidia. Few remain who
know the methods for smelting it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古代米西迪亚的魔法合金，掌握冶炼法的人已寥寥无几。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A metal made only with the blessing of the gods.
The secrets of its smelting are unknown to mortals.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 唯有神明祝福才能制成的金属，凡人不知冶炼秘诀。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This metal is immediately recognizable by the unique
pattern of striations on its surface. Often used in
the forging of weapons and armor.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 表面有独特条纹的金属，常用于锻造武器防具。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This metal has the strange property of becoming
solid only at certain times of day. Smiths call it
the phantom metal, and treat it with utmost care.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 只在一天中某些时段凝固的奇异金属，铁匠称其幻影金属，小心处理。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This metal contains veins of potentized skystone.
Often used in the wrighting of airships.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 含强化天石矿脉的金属，常用于制造飞艇。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This alloy can only be worked by magick, though
many a fine hammer has been ruined by stubborn
smiths who believed otherwise.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 只能用魔法加工的合金，许多不信邪的铁匠毁了好锤子。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A flimsy metal, it crumbles at the slightest impact.
Used primarily in alloys with other, sturdier metals.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 脆弱金属，轻撞即碎，主要与坚固金属制成合金。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This metal possesses a faint magickal aura. Used to
coat magickal artifacts.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 带微弱魔力的金属，用于镀覆魔法器物。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This metal sounds a clear tone when struck. Popular
for use in musical instruments.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 敲击时声音清亮的金属，常用于乐器。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A bright golden-colored alloy. Often used as an
inexpensive substitute for gold.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 明亮金色合金，常作廉价黄金替代品。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An alloy enchanted with special regenerative magicks.
Small scratches in its surface mend of their own accord.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 附有再生魔法的合金，细小划痕会自行愈合。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This rare metal has a brilliant silver luster. Its beauty
has made it popular for use in decorative pieces.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 具有明亮银光的稀有金属，常用于装饰。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An extremely malleable metal. Many fine pieces are
sculpted in gikhet lead.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 延展性极高的金属，常用于精美雕塑。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This gear-wheel dampens kickback when the firearm is
discharged. It's crafted from a durable adamant alloy.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 耐用金刚合金制齿轮，可减轻枪械后坐力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A vital part of any timepiece. Its considerable size
makes it suitable for a large clock.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 钟表的重要部件，尺寸适合大钟。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A gorgeous vessel wrought from the purest gold.
Gentlemen and ladies who do not faint at its
beauty will surely faint at the price.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 纯金打造的华美器皿，不被美貌惊倒也会被价格吓倒。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
No surer means is there to reduce any foodstuff
to a heap of black char than to cook it with this
frying pan.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 用这平底锅烹饪，任何食材都能可靠地化为焦炭。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An age-worn coin such as this must surely have
value to a collector, yet it brings nothing but
unhappiness to those who possess it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古币应受收藏家重视，却只给持有者带来不幸。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A bundle of one thousand sharp needles. If you don't
trust its provenance, you're welcome to count.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 一千根尖针组成的一束，不信可以数数。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A small needle treated with a medicinal extract.
Careful not to prick yourself, or you'll go numb.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 涂有药液的小针，注意别刺到自己，否则会麻木。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A metal ring that resonates with the phases of the
moon. It is said the goddess protector of earth
once wore it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 与月相共鸣的金属环，据说大地守护女神曾佩戴。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This pelt is smooth to the touch. Easily obtained,
and always popular at market.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 手感光滑、易得的皮毛，市场上一直受欢迎。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The skin of a chocobo. Some find the scent mildly
offensive.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 陆行鸟皮，有些人觉得气味略难闻。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These skins are small, but very pliable. Their
humble price makes them popular trade goods in
many lands.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 小而柔软的皮，价格低廉，在许多地方畅销。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The patterns on this skin are as brilliantly colored
as they are intricate. Used for making bags and shoes.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 色彩鲜艳、花纹繁复的皮，用于制作鞋包。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These rugged hides are tough to damage. They make
excellent armor, if you can figure out how to cut
them to size.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 坚韧难损的皮革，若能裁切便是上等防具。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These hides have just the right balance of resilience
and suppleness. Their price reflects this, however.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 弹性和柔软度恰到好处的皮革，价格也相应不菲。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An expertly tanned hide. Curing in the sun gives
these hides a fine luster.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 精心鞣制的皮革，日晒赋予其美丽光泽。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The techniques for tanning these large hides have
been passed down by the giants for centuries. The
finished product is a bit tough.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 巨人世代相传大皮革的鞣制技艺，成品略硬。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The tanned hide of a great lizard. The tanning
process removes some of its natural oils, making
it susceptible to water damage.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 大型蜥蜴的鞣皮，鞣制去除部分油脂，使其易受水损。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Trappers know: prime skins make prime hides.
Use for all manner of crafts.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 猎人都知道上等皮毛能制上等皮革，可用于各种工艺。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This short-haired pelt wicks away heat. Highly
treasured in hot climes.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 散热的短毛皮，在炎热地区十分珍贵。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This spotted hide provides excellent protection
against cold weather, though it tears easily.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 御寒极佳但容易撕裂的斑点皮毛。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A long-haired pelt. Many travelers wear these in
place of a tailored cape.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 长毛皮，许多旅人用来代替斗篷。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A beautiful, lustrous, high-quality pelt.
Used for wall-hangings in the homes of the wealthy.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 光泽美丽的高品质皮毛，富人常挂在墙上。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This pelt is light and soft to the touch. Used for
fringes and to otherwise accent clothing.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 轻柔的皮毛，用于衣物镶边和装饰。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The tail of a long-eared rabbit. Thought by many to
bring good luck, though rabbits tend to disagree.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 长耳兔的尾巴，许多人认为带来好运，兔子恐怕不同意。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The long tail of a desert rat. Thought to bring
good luck, provided one isn't a rat.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 沙鼠的长尾，据说能带来好运，前提是你不是鼠。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A mysterious pink tail. Highly treasured as
a token of good luckーwhich is exactly what
you need to come by one of these.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 神秘粉红尾巴，珍贵的幸运象征；得到它本身就需要好运。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This bumpy, warted skin looks terrible, but is quite
well suited for tailoring and other crafts.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 凹凸多疣的皮肤虽难看，却很适合裁缝和工艺。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The tail of a speckled bat. Shunned as a bringer
of bad luck.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 斑点蝙蝠的尾巴，被视为不祥之物。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The tanned hide of a behemoth. Its bright purple
coloration fetches a high price at market.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 贝希摩斯的鞣皮，鲜紫色在市场上价格高昂。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A bone from an unknown animal. Used in the working
of divinatory magicks.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 来源不明的兽骨，用于占卜魔法。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The bone of an adult dragon. It's too large to be
easily carried.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 成年龙的骨头，大得不易携带。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A hard, well-formed bone. Craftsmen are advised to
purify the bone with holy water before carving.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 坚硬完整的骨头，建议工匠雕刻前用圣水净化。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The bone of one who spent her days awash in the
blood of others. Used in alchemy and for the
working of curses.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 终日浴他人鲜血者的骨头，用于炼金和诅咒。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The molted skin of a bomb grown to maturity. It is
still faintly warm to the touch.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 成熟炸弹怪蜕下的皮，触摸仍微暖。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This glass-like scale is so clear as to be almost
transparent. Hold it in the sunlight and it
sparkles with reflected brilliance.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 玻璃般清澈的鳞片，阳光下闪闪发亮。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The fallen scale from an ancient dragon's back.
The mere sight of it is enough to drive away
weaker beasts.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古龙背上脱落的鳞片，弱小野兽见了便会逃走。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These brown, speckled scales are used in a surprising
number of goods.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 棕色斑点鳞片，用途出奇广泛。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A smooth, white scale. Surprisingly beautiful, these
are used to make a variety of accessories.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 光滑白鳞，美丽得可用于制作各种饰品。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The molted skin of a red dirtsnake. Ground into a
powder for concocting tinctures and the like.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 红土蛇的蜕皮，可磨粉制药。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This monster molting is rich in iron and other trace
minerals. The moltings are pulverized, then made into
various alloys.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 富含铁和微量矿物的魔物蜕皮，粉碎后制成合金。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Together with scales, this thick carapace provides
great protection for a dragon. It retains its
strength even after several blows.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 厚甲壳与鳞片共同保护龙，多次受击后仍坚固。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
An insect shell so hard, it seems to be almost metal.
The price of these shells differs depending on pattern
and coloration.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 坚硬近似金属的虫壳，价格依花纹颜色而异。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The carapace of a winged dragon. Lighter than metal,
this material is often used for fashioning armor.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 有翼龙的甲壳，比金属轻，常用于制作铠甲。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This beast's horn tapers to a very sharp point.
Almost entirely hollow; despite its size, it's
quite light.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 兽角尖锐，中空且虽大却轻。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A giant, perfectly straight horn. The sign of a king
among beasts.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 巨大笔直的角，是兽王的象征。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This fang is said to have the power to drive off evil.
Often hung over doorways.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说能驱邪的牙，常挂在门上。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The fang of a blood-sucking bat. Even removed,
it quickly absorbs blood, turning a bright red.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 吸血蝙蝠的牙，拔下后仍会吸血变红。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This fang is hooked like a claw. Once it bites into
flesh, it's hard to get it back out again.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 钩爪般弯曲的牙，咬入血肉后难以拔出。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This giant fang is shaped a litle like a
corkscrew. Strong enough to pierce metal.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 形如开瓶器的巨牙，足以刺穿金属。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These keen fangs are resilient enough to withstand
the wyvern's fiery breath.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 坚韧利牙足以承受飞龙火息。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The tip of this drill is slightly rounded.
A popular crafting tool for children.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 钻头尖端略圆，是儿童喜爱的工艺工具。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The red drill found atop the head of an alraune.
Naturally harvested drills fetch a high price.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 曼德拉草头顶的红钻，自然采集的价格高昂。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This pearl glows with a soft light. Those who deal
in gemstones and other precious materials call
it the "One Love."\var2:00\\end\
translation: 散发柔光的珍珠，珠宝商称之为“唯一之爱”。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Zingu pearls are found in these fua shells.
Used in making shell cameos.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 津古珍珠产自这种贝壳，可用于制作贝雕。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This chunk of rock sparkles and shines.
Said to be a fragment of a fallen star.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 闪闪发光的石块，据说是陨星碎片。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This stone fragment has a striking red color.
Said to lead its bearer to victory in battle.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 醒目的红色石片，据说引领持有者取得战斗胜利。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A piece from a coral found in the Sea of Ewohl.
Too brittle to be much use for crafting.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 埃沃尔海珊瑚碎片，太脆而不适合加工。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A smooth, curved turtle shell. Skill and diligence are
required to preserve its strength during crafting.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 光滑弯曲的龟壳，加工时需技巧和耐心才能保其强度。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This nicely weathered shell has great
value among curio aficionados.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 风化得恰到好处的龟壳，深受古玩爱好者珍视。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This shell is only harvested when properly aged.
A favorite material among certain craftsmen.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 充分陈化后才采集的龟壳，是某些工匠的心头好。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The fragmented shards of monster bones.
Touch them lightly and they will crumble.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 魔物骨碎片，轻触便会粉碎。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A skull of unknown provenance. Not a bad
decoration for a mage's den, if you can
stand the insistent chattering of the teeth.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 来历不明的头骨，若能忍受牙齿喋喋作响，倒适合装饰魔道士巢穴。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This flower shaped like a moth's wings is the
base ingredient for the mixing of elixirs. Blooms
only in places where the soil is just so.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 形如蛾翼的花，是圣灵药原料，只在合适土壤中开放。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This beautiful flower is sometimes called the
shybloom for its tendency to grow in the dark
recesses of caves. Wilts in direct sunlight.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 美丽的羞花常生于洞穴深处，阳光直射会枯萎。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A small pure-white flower used in the mixing
of elixirs. Attention is required for harvesting
as the flowers only bloom for a short period.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 用于调制圣灵药的小白花，花期短，采集需留心。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
It takes many years for these yellow flowers
to bloom. A good thing, as their fragrance is
almost too sickly sweet to bear.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 黄花多年才开放，幸好如此，因为甜腻香气几乎难以忍受。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These small flowers tenaciously cling to whatever
soil they can find. Low to the ground, they are
often mistaken for moss.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 小花顽强生长于任何土壤，贴地而生常被误认作苔藓。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These heart-shaped flower petals are dampened
and worn on the skin in some cultures to attract
happiness and good fortune.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 有些文化将心形花瓣浸湿贴肤，以求幸福好运。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A pure-white, many-petaled flower.
These turn a light purple when picked.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 纯白多瓣花，采摘后会变淡紫。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This pungent smelling flower blooms in a large,
bright red ring of color. The petals are used
for making dye.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 气味浓烈的花开成鲜红大环，花瓣可制染料。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This blue flower glows faintly at night.
Its sweet nectar is a favorite of children.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 蓝花夜间微光，甜蜜花蜜深受孩子喜爱。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Many are the hapless adventurers who wander
aimlessly having eaten of this herb, never knowing
who they were, or how they came to be this way.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 许多不幸冒险者吃下此草后迷失，忘记自己是谁、如何至此。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A plant made from grafted echo grass and
nepenthis. The only known cure for nepenthis-
induced amnesia.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 回声草与猪笼草嫁接而成，是唯一已知的猪笼草失忆症解药。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Strange tubes in the stalk of this plant
can carry the faintest noise across long
distances. Increasingly rare of late.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 茎中奇异管道能将微弱声音传至远方，近来愈发稀少。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The tendrils of this plant wind around
in a tight spiral. Small doses can
restore one's get-up-and-go.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 植物卷须紧密螺旋，少量服用可恢复活力。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The hollow reeds of this plant are perfect for making
into flutes. The resulting instruments are known for
their clear and vibrant tone.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 中空芦茎适合制笛，音色清亮鲜活。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The spores of this marvelous fungus consist
largely of gold. Sprouting once in a decade,
a sighting is a true event.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 神奇菌类的孢子主要由黄金构成，十年一发芽，难得一见。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This fruit is said to enhance magickal
ability, though many complain of its
bitterness.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说能增强魔法能力的果实，许多人抱怨味苦。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This fruit is said to enhance physical
strength. So sweet, only the merest morsel
may be eaten in one sitting.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说增强体力的果实，甜得每次只能吃一小口。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This thick-skinned, bitter fruit is much
better served warm.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 厚皮苦果，加热后更好吃。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Thorns cover the skin of this fruit. Once
cut open, however, it is a lush, slightly
sweet treat for the palate.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 果皮长满刺，切开后果肉丰润微甜。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This mushroom looks like trouble. None yet
have been fool enough to test it and see
if it actually is poisonous.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 看似危险的蘑菇，至今没人傻到试毒。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This white mushroom grows in shady
places. Its rubbery texture has earned it
more than a few fans among gourmands.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 生于阴处的白蘑菇，弹韧口感受到许多美食家喜爱。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The roots of this plant look like tiny dolls
carelessly dropped in the dirt. Rip them
up and they give a bloodcurdling scream.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 根部像遗落泥土的小人偶，拔出时发出骇人尖叫。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A thin, brown skin covers this round bulb.
A bit harsh when eaten raw.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 薄棕皮包裹的圆球茎，生吃略辛辣。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This pollen gives off a faint blue glow which is
known to brighten during spells of cold weather.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 花粉发出蓝色微光，寒冷时更亮。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A pollen used since antiquity for various alchemical
purposes. Liquefies when it comes into contact with
metal.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 自古用于炼金的花粉，接触金属便液化。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This purple pollen is extremely poisonous.
Sometimes called the "dark dust."\var2:00\\end\
translation: 剧毒紫色花粉，又称暗尘。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This malboro tendril was dried in the sun,
removing much of its scent. Used as a material
in basket weaving and other handcrafts.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 晒干后大幅去味的魔界花藤，用于编篮等手工。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A fat child could swing from this vine and
still not break it. Always good to have one
of these handy.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 胖孩子吊在上面荡也不会断的藤蔓，随身带一根很实用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This vine curls naturally into a spiral.
It is thought to act as protection against some
beasts with a natural aversion to the shape.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 自然卷成螺旋的藤蔓，可驱赶本能厌恶这种形状的野兽。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
These small green sprigs are said to bring big luck.
They're rather hard to find, however.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说带来大好运的小绿叶，但很难找到。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This moss grows naturally into a fuzzy green
ball shape. Staring at it gives you a fuzzy
warm feeling.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 自然长成毛茸茸绿球的苔藓，看着就让人暖心。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A variety of lightmoss that grows in damp places.
Useful for making poultices when properly dried.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 生于潮湿处的发光苔藓，晒干后可制敷药。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Eating too many of these stalks induces a
kind of ennui.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 吃太多这种茎会让人产生倦怠感。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A green leaf that gives off a refreshing scent.
Makes an excellent garnish for meat dishes.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 散发清香的绿叶，是肉菜的绝佳配料。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A compound of strawood and divariwood. Soft and
easy to carve, this is the ideal material for
making musical instruments.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 稻草木与迪瓦里木的复合材料，柔软易雕，适合制乐器。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A light, flexible wood. White in color, with
a very fine grain.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 轻柔有弹性的白色木材，纹理细密。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A rigid hardwood. Gives off a unique fragrance
when soaked in water.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 坚硬木材，浸水后散发独特香气。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This cut moontree lumber is soft and easy
to work.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 柔软易加工的月树木材。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This cut danbuk lumber is excellent for
use in crafting weapons and armor.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 适合制造武器和防具的丹布克木材。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This wood emits a faint magickal aura. Used in
fashioning magickal wands and other trappings
of the mage's craft.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 散发微弱魔力的木材，用于制作魔杖等法师用品。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This dry, brittle wood burns long, making it
popular for use in campfires.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 干燥易碎却能久燃的木材，适合篝火。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This cut raw waltwood lumber is naturally
impregnated with tar, making it highly resistant
to water damage.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 天然含树脂的华尔特木，十分防水。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This lumber has a slightly reddish gleam to it.
Used in many handsome crafts for home and table.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 略带红光的木材，常用于精美家居餐具。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Wood from the fast-growing agathis tree.
Its reasonable price has contributed to its
widespread use.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 速生贝壳杉木材，价格合理，应用广泛。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This cut mape lumber exudes a sweet sap known
to attract all manner of insects.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 枫木会渗出甜树液，吸引各种昆虫。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The narrow grain of this wood makes it ideal for
whittling, and popular with carpenters.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 纹理细密的木材，适合雕刻，深受木匠喜爱。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A plentiful wood in colder climes. Paper can be
made from the bark.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 寒冷地区常见木材，树皮可造纸。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This wood cut from quince lumber is often used
to decorate the halls of castles and palaces.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 榅桲木常用于装饰城堡宫殿。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A dense, dark wood. Known for its high quality, and
resistance to the ravages of heat and moisture.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 致密深色木材，品质高且耐热防潮。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This rare wood bears a faint rose fragrance.
Its knotty grain makes it very difficult to work,
but extremely beautiful when carved by a master.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 带淡玫瑰香的稀有木材，节疤难加工，大师雕刻后极美。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This strange wood emits a wan light. Used in the
making of magickal artifacts.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 散发微光的奇异木材，用于制作魔法器物。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Cut gurnat lumber like this has been used for many
years in home building.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 古尔纳特木材多年来用于建房。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This cut pagoda lumber is often chopped into chips,
which are then placed in bags as protective charms.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 宝塔木常被切成木屑，装袋作护符。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A beautiful wood with a remarkable luster.
A rare strain of the same tree is highly toxic.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 光泽非凡的美丽木材，同种稀有变种剧毒。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This twig is kept as a ward against evil for its
peculiar shape, like that of a dragon soaring
to the sky.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 形似飞龙升天的树枝，被当作驱邪护符。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This wood was thought to have come from a tree
that grew in the realm of the gods. The entire
piece emits a holy aura.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 据说来自神界树木，整块木材散发神圣气息。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This sludgy, viscous green liquid emits a cloying
stench that assaults the nostrils.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 黏稠绿色污液，散发刺鼻恶臭。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This yellowish liquid bubbles and foams. Its color
fades with exposure to air.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 冒泡起沫的黄色液体，接触空气会褪色。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A rare metallic liquid. Gives off noxious fumes
when mixed with any other metal save iron.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 稀有金属液体，与铁以外的金属混合会产生有毒烟雾。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This liquid is harvested from a malboro's mouth.
Anything exposed to it rots in a matter of moments.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 从魔界花口中采集的液体，接触之物瞬间腐烂。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
The foulest, most odorous liquid known.
It is said the smell is enough to wake the dead.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 已知最恶臭的液体，据说气味足以唤醒死者。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A scintillating liquid, lighter than air itself.
Under light, it sparkles with all the colors of
the rainbow.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 比空气还轻的闪光液体，光下呈现彩虹色。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This tonic temporarily heightens combat prowess.
However, the side effects can be severe, and
sometimes even fatal.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 暂时提升战斗力的药剂，副作用严重甚至致命。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Drinking this tonic gives the imbiber temporary
superhuman strength. Use caution: an overdose
is fatal.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 饮用后暂获超人力量，过量致命。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This bluish-green drink is made from a blend of
a dozen medicinal herbs. Refreshment guaranteed.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 混合十余种药草制成的蓝绿饮料，保证提神。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This odd liquid gives off a bracing odor that tickles
the nose and stings the eyes. In the right amounts, it
can melt metal.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 气味刺激鼻眼的奇液，适量可熔化金属。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
As pure as it gets. Commonly used for mixing tonics
and in alchemy.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 极纯净的水，常用于调药和炼金。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This water is rich in minerals. Can cause indigestion
in those not accustomed to drinking it.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 富含矿物质的水，不习惯的人饮用可能消化不良。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This dark red soup boils and bubbles. It is said
that those who drink deep turn into beasts.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 沸腾冒泡的暗红汤，据说喝多会变成野兽。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A single pickled malboro tendril floats at the
bottom of this bottle of wine. Please, drink
responsibly.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 酒瓶底部漂着一根腌魔界花藤，请理性饮用。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A colorless water-like liquid. It tastes slightly
sweet to the tongue.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 无色水状液体，味道微甜。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This light amber liquid is sweet like honey.
Boiled down, it makes syrup and candies.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 浅琥珀色液体，甜如蜜，熬煮可制糖浆和糖果。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
Pinpricks of light sparkle from within this
milky white liquid. Often used as a fuel on
account of its high oil content.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 乳白液体中闪着微光，含油量高，常作燃料。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
This liquid has clouded to a brownish color and
congealed to the consistency of gelatin. Some use
this in place of more traditional glue.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 浑浊棕色液体凝成胶状，有人用它替代传统胶水。\var2:00\\end\
notes: Terra draft; encoding, capacity and runtime gates pending

source_text:
A thread infused with black magick.
Wrapped around staves and rods to enhance their

source_text:
You can dispatch clan members to complete certain
quests for you.\endPage\\end\The number of clan members that can be dispatched
and the destinations vary from quest to quest.\endPage\\end\Start by selecting a destination and assembling
a dispatch party to send out.\var2:00\\end\

source_text:
The unit placed on the red tile will be the leader
of the dispatch party.\endPage\\end\The leader is responsible for seeing the quest
through to its completion.\endPage\\end\The other members, if any, will work with the leader
to meet the goals of the quest.\endPage\\end\Organize a dispatch party that meets the required
size for the quest.\var2:00\\end\
translation: 红色格子上的单位将担任派遣队长。\endPage\\end\队长负责完成任务。\endPage\\end\其他成员将协助队长达成目标。\endPage\\end\请按任务要求人数组建队伍。\var2:00\\end\

source_text:

so don't miss your chance!\var2:00\\end\
