avail. Somebody do somethin', please! You don't
need to kill 'im, just drivin' 'im off will do.
  Heriward, Wood Village Hunter\var9:00\\end\
translation:
塔格森林出现怪物！

村里的猎人试着阻止它，
可都没成功。谁来帮帮忙！
不用杀死它，赶走就行。
  森林村猎人 赫里沃德\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
What's in the woods? Wolves, that's what! And
my chocobos are so put out, they're molting early.
Somebody, rid us of these horrible howlers!
  Chocobo Corral "Sasasha"\var9:00\\end\
translation:
森林里有什么？狼！
我的陆行鸟被吓得提前换羽了。
谁来赶走这些可怕的嚎叫怪！
  陆行鸟牧场“萨莎莎”\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Drive off those brigands, the Yellow Wings,
before I lose what little business I got left!
They've been squatting the highroad, demanding
gil from all what pass by.

If I can't use that highroad, I can't get to Camoa;
and if I can't get to Camoa, I'm finished!
  Kagran, Merchant\var9:00\\end\
translation:
快赶走黄翼强盗团，
不然我剩下的生意也没了！
他们占着大道，向过路人收钱。

走不了大道，就去不了卡莫亚；
去不了卡莫亚，我就完了！
  商人 卡格兰\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
You say tomato, I say kill them all!

Why kill vegetables, you ask? Har!

Did I mention quivering stalks, or slavering fangs?
I was out for a stroll the other day and one bit
clean through me britches! I doubt me or me
britches are the only victims here. Help!
  Gusah, Greengrocer\var9:00\\end\
translation:
你说是番茄，我说全杀光！

为什么杀蔬菜？哈！

它们有颤动的茎和流涎的尖牙！
前几天散步时，一只咬穿了我裤子！
受害的肯定不止我和我的裤子。救命！
  蔬菜商 古萨\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
ー WANTED! ー
Wanted: Ugohr, a green-colored shelling, last
spotted on Baptiste Hill.

One reported case of injury arising from contact
with said beast. Payment to be made by injured
party.
  Jylland Defenders of the Peace\var9:00\\end\
translation:
通缉！

通缉绿色甲壳怪乌戈尔，
最后出现在巴蒂斯特山。

已有一人因接触该兽受伤。
报酬由伤者支付。
  休兰德治安维护队\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
ー WANTED! ー
Wanted: Gilmunto, possibly a variant strain of
nidhogg, known to lurk in the foothills of the
Aldanna Range.

Vicious and violent, should be considered
dangerous in the extreme!

Those without faith in their sword arm, give
this one wide berth.
  Jylland Defenders of the Peace\var9:00\\end\
translation:
通缉！

通缉吉尔蒙托，疑似尼德霍格变种，
常潜伏于阿尔达纳山麓。

此兽凶暴无比，极度危险！
剑术不精者切勿靠近。
  休兰德治安维护队\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Zedlei Forest has been bombed!

Looking for a clan to rid our woods of an
infestation of bombs!

With auction season upon us, who doesn't
want a few more clan points in the bank?
  Society for Woodland Preservation\var9:00\\end\
translation:
泽德雷森林遭炸弹怪侵袭！

寻求氏族清除森林中的炸弹怪！

拍卖季就要到了，
谁不想多赚些氏族点数呢？
  森林保护协会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Tis the season: zingu pearl season in the
Galerria Deep!

All those who wish to go pearl hunting must
register by accepting this quest.

WARNING:
Unregistered pearl hunters will be caught
and tried as poachers.
  Galerria Jewelers\var9:00\\end\
translation:
加雷里亚深处的金古珍珠季到了！

所有采珠者必须接受本任务登记。

警告：未登记者将以偷猎罪逮捕审判。
  加雷里亚珠宝商会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Kuknir Travel is looking for guards to escort
touring groups headed for the Rupie Mountains.

The Marsa Wayfarers Association has been
gaining on them of late. Kuknir want safety as a
selling point, most like.
  Shink, Pub Patron\var9:00\\end\
translation:
库克尼尔旅行社招募护卫，
护送旅行团前往鲁皮山脉。

最近玛萨旅行协会迎头赶上，
他们大概想以安全招揽客人。
  酒馆常客 欣克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Airship malfunction due to mechanical sabotage
and inspections resulting from same have grounded
our regular flight to Fluorgis.

The party or parties responsible have yet to be
apprehended. Calling all clans to aid us!
  Moorabella Aerodrome Security\var9:00\\end\
translation:
由于机械遭到破坏，飞空艇出现故障，
检查期间飞往弗洛吉斯的定期航班停飞。

犯人尚未落网，恳请各氏族协助！
  摩拉贝拉飞空艇场保安\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Rumors whisper of an unimaginable treasure
sleeping deep within Tramdine Fens.

Some say it is the Dozen-and-One Knights of
Aisen's hoard, others that it is a cache of
Rozarrian wealth... Whets the palate, does it not?

Well? In the mood for a treasure hunt?
  Kanaq, Pub Regular

*No evidence has been found to support above
  rumors. ーThe Management\var9:00\\end\
translation:
传闻特拉姆丁沼泽深处
沉睡着难以想象的宝藏。

有人说是艾森十三骑士的宝库，
也有人说是罗扎利亚的财富……
是不是让人心痒？要去寻宝吗？
  酒馆常客 卡纳克

*以上传闻尚无证据。——店方\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My dreams have been troubled of late.

It started the night after my visit to Nazan
Mines. I cannot sleep, my arms and legs are
leaden, and even plump Bisga game-hen
tastes like ash.

They say a creature within the mines weaves
ill-omened dreams. I fear...I fear I may be a
victim. Please, stop it before I go mad.
  Dabool, Geologist\var9:00\\end\
translation:
最近噩梦不断。

自从去过纳赞矿山，我夜不能寐，
四肢沉重，连肥美的比斯加猎鸡也味同嚼蜡。

听说矿中有生物能编织噩梦。
我怕自己已受害。请在我发疯前阻止它。
  地质学家 达布尔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The timber of the strawood trees growing near
Fluorgis makes the best instruments, kupo!

You'll get some for me, won't you, kupo?
Oh, thank you! Thank you!
  Hurdy, Itinerant Bard

*Oh, if you find some flutegrass too, that'd be
awful nifty, kupo!\var9:00\\end\
translation:
弗洛吉斯附近的草木树木材
最适合制作乐器，库啵！

能帮我弄些来吗？太感谢了！
  流浪吟游诗人 赫迪

*如果还能找到笛草就更好了，库啵！\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I search for a piece of magicite the color of silver.
I'm sure it was in my laboratory just the other
day...

Please, if you know somethingーanything at allーlet
me know. My laboratory is in the Bisga Grasslands.
  Narph, Magick Akademy Scholar\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我在寻找一块银色魔石。
前几天明明还在实验室里……

如果知道任何线索，请告诉我。
我的实验室在比斯加草原。
  魔法学院学者 纳尔夫\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Apprehend the sky pirates Vaan and Penelo!

Those scurvy scum of the skies infiltrated the
Beltorey Manse and made an attempt on the
baron's life. A commensurate reward is promised
the one who can bring them in.
  House Beltorey\var9:00\\end\
translation:
缉拿空贼梵与潘妮罗！

这些空中恶徒潜入贝尔托雷宅邸，
企图谋害男爵。捉拿他们者必有重赏。
  贝尔托雷家\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
For Clan \varA:01\, a request.

I must speak with you.
I await in the Ruins of Delgantua.

P.S.
  I trust you enjoyed my gift?\var9:00\\end\
translation:
致\varA:01\氏族：

我有事与你们商谈。
我在德尔甘图亚遗迹等候。

附：希望你们喜欢我的礼物。\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
It's the 410th Goug Mines Salvage Run!

Ancient machineries lie in the dark depths below
Goug, and we're going to dig 'em up, kupo!

You never know what you might find, kupo!
  Goug Machinists Alliance\var9:00\\end\
translation:
第410届古格矿山打捞行动！

古格地下深处沉睡着古代机械，
我们要把它们挖出来，库啵！
谁知道会发现什么呢！
  古格机械师联盟\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Monsters have settled in to the area around
the ancient stone heads of Kthili Sands.

Not only are our surveys being delayed, I fear
there may be nothing left to survey if those
monsters have their way with the ruins!

Please, somebody, rid us of them!
  Rothwall, Archaeologikal Survey Team\var9:00\\end\
translation:
怪物盘踞在克提利沙地古石像附近。

调查进度受阻；再让怪物肆虐，
恐怕遗迹都会毁掉！请帮忙清除它们！
  考古调查队 罗思沃尔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
"Lord Eden, was it?
Heard you're in possession of that rarest of
treasures, the 'Black Cat,' and we're coming to
Camoa for it! See you soon!
  Swiftest of the Sky Pirates,
    Vaan & Penelo"

Wanted: Someone to deal with sky pirates.
  Fohgginus Eden\var9:00\\end\
translation:
“伊甸大人，是吧？听说您有稀世珍宝‘黑猫’，
我们要去卡莫亚取走它！很快见！
  最迅捷的空贼 梵与潘妮罗”

招募对付空贼的人。
  福吉努斯·伊甸\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
At last, the day when all my dreams shall know
fruition is nigh! Just a few finishing touches
remain. I trust you'll be on hand to celebrate?
I'll be waiting at the ruins.
  Illua\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我的梦想终于即将实现！
只剩最后几笔收尾。
你会来庆祝吧？我在遗迹等你。
  伊露娅\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Kupo!!! I've been had, kupo, had!!!

"Super special hammer," my pom-pom! This is just
an ungainly lump of iron! That alchemist pulled a
fast one on me!

Someone get that ne'er-do-well and take back my
20,000 gil, kupo! His name's Nezzel!
  Craftsmoogles' League Foreman\var9:00\\end\
translation:
库啵！我被骗了！

什么“超级特别锤”，根本是笨重的铁块！
那个炼金术士骗了我！
谁去抓住叫内泽尔的骗子，
帮我拿回两万吉尔，库啵！
  莫古工匠联盟工头\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I am an itinerant black mage, kupo.

I've come all this way alone, but now I feel it's
time to take on some traveling companions.

Meet me on Baptiste Hill if you think you're
right for the job, kupo!
  (Unsigned)\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我是流浪黑魔法师，库啵。

一路独行至今，现在想找旅伴。
觉得合适的话，请来巴蒂斯特山见我！
  （未署名）\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Got a strange letter today at the pub from
someone named Gade. Whoever Gade is, it sounds
like a friend of his named Shoofa is lost on a
"snowy plain." I'm pretty sure the letter came to
us by accident, but now it's got me curious.\var9:00\\end\
translation:
今天酒馆收到一封奇怪的信，
寄件人叫盖德。他的朋友舒法
似乎在“雪原”迷路了。
信大概寄错了，但我有点在意。\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We got a letter today from a man named Wermut,
some old guy who hurt himself out in the swamp.
He wants us to bring him a potion, so let's
make sure we've got at least one to spare
before heading out there.\var9:00\\end\
translation:
今天收到一位叫维尔穆特的老人来信。
他在沼泽受伤，想要一瓶药水。
出发前要确保至少带上一瓶。\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Came across a worrying notice in the pub about
a woman surrounded by monsters in the woods.
If she's still there, and still alive, she may well
need help.\var9:00\\end\
translation:
酒馆的告示令人担心：
一名女子在森林被怪物包围。
如果她还活着，可能需要帮助。\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Read a tale about a man who possessed a terrible
power. Those he knew turned against him, and
over time he became a beast. If the story's
true, maybe he still stalks Aisenfield?\var9:00\\end\
translation:
读到一个拥有可怕力量的男人的故事。
熟人都敌视他，最终他变成了野兽。
如果是真的，也许他还在艾森原游荡？\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Came across a worrying notice in the pub about
something strange happening at the shrines of the
Paling Gods in Tramdine Fens. It sounds like there
has been a growing number of monster sightings
in the area. Might be worth looking into.\var9:00\\end\
translation:
酒馆告示说，特拉姆丁沼泽
苍白诸神的神殿发生怪事，
附近目击怪物的次数越来越多。
或许值得调查。\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Came across a worrying notice in the pub about
a creature threatening the town of Goug.

Hard to know whether this prophet Hilo can be
trusted, but it may be a good idea to take a
look, just to be on the safe side.\var9:00\\end\
translation:
酒馆告示说，有怪物威胁古格镇。

先知希洛是否可信还不好说，
但为了保险起见，最好去看看。\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Came across a curious notice in the pub about
a new tunnel discovered in the Neslowe Passage.
A little exploration may turn up the treasure
the passage is rumored to hold.\var9:00\\end\
translation:
酒馆告示说，内斯洛通道发现新隧道。
探索一番也许能找到传闻中的宝藏。\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I had been courting the Lady Bcja for some
time, and had finally arranged for a proper...
rendezvous, shall we say. When the day arrived,
however, she told me she'd made other plans with
another suitor!  I seek a champion to fight this
philanderer on my behalf and uphold my honor.
I must have satisfaction!
  Marnot, Pride of Fluorgis\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我追求比佳小姐许久，
终于安排好一场正式约会。
没想到那天她却说要与另一个追求者见面！
我要找勇士替我教训那花花公子，
维护我的荣誉！我必须讨回公道！
  弗洛吉斯的骄傲 马尔诺\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Looking for a new clan member to round out
your roster? Your search is ended! The more the
merrier, to be sure, but we go one further,
providing you with a companion chosen to suit
your clan's needs. Seek us out in Targ Wood.
  Clan Mates Adventurer's Guild\var9:00\\end\
translation:
想招募新成员充实队伍？
不用再找了！人多固然好，
我们还能为你挑选符合氏族需求的伙伴。
请到塔格森林找我们。
  伙伴冒险者公会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The muskmallow, favored herb for treatment
of ague, is again in season. Seeking herbalists
to venture into Targ Wood and procure a supply.
No previous experience required.
  Jylland Apothecary's League\var9:00\\end\
translation:
治疗寒热病的药草麝香葵又到了采集季。
招募草药师前往塔格森林采集，
无需经验。
  休兰德药师联盟\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Who will you find at the front line of any army
worth its salt? Fighters, and plenty of 'em.

Prove yourself worthy. Best us in combat, and
we'll teach you the ways of the sword and fist.
  Jeorge, Mailed Fist Regular\var9:00\\end\
translation:
优秀军队的前线是谁？
当然是战士，而且有很多。

在战斗中证明实力，打败我们，
我们就教你剑与拳的技艺。
  铁拳常备队 乔治\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Clan \varA:01\!

The might of your clan is renowned throughout
Jylland. We have traveled from a land beyond
where the sun rises in hopes of testing that
might against our own. Will you face us in battle?
  Zengen, The Eastwatch\var9:00\\end\
translation:
\varA:01\氏族！

你们的实力名扬休兰德。
我们从日出之地以东远道而来，
希望与你们切磋。可敢应战？
  东望队 曾根\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
There's trouble brewing in Targ Wood!

Came across a young bangaa run afoul of a band
of ne'er-do-wells. Thinking I'd be little good
against so many, I ran, hoping to find some as
might defend him well and proper.
  Ksava, Woodcutter\var9:00\\end\
translation:
塔格森林出事了！

我碰见一名年轻邦加族被恶徒围住。
人太多我不是对手，只得跑来找人救他。
  伐木工 萨瓦\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The Tri-Bangaa Temple welcomes novices
seeking guidance in the martial arts.

Handed down over many hundred years, the
martial arts are considered by many the pinnacle
of melee combat. Temper body and mind as we
share with you the secrets of these arts.
  Monks of the Tri-Bangaa Temple\var9:00\\end\
translation:
三邦加寺欢迎寻求武艺指导的新手。

武术传承数百年，被视为近身战斗的巅峰。
请与我们一起锤炼身心，学习武艺奥秘。
  三邦加寺僧侣\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Mocedad's the name, leader of the Bangaa
Brotherhood. We're looking to get our hands
on a fire stone and a piece of zinconium.

If anyone happens on any they'd be willing to
part with, they can find us camped along the
highroad in the Bisga Greenlands for a time.
  Mocedad, Bangaa Brotherhood\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我是邦加兄弟会首领莫塞达德。
我们想要火之石和一块锌石。

愿意割爱的人，可到比斯加绿地
大道旁的营地找我们。
  邦加兄弟会 莫塞达德\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Tricksters by name and trade are weーmasters
of sleight of hand. Beat us at our own tricks and
the tricks of the trickster trade are yours for the
trick...er, taking!
  Glackta, Trickster Extraordinaire\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我们是戏法师，精通手上功夫。
用戏法打败我们，就把戏法秘诀传给你！
  卓越戏法师 格拉克塔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Never become attached. The rules on this are
clear. But it is not so easy to leave one who has
fought so long at your side. A dreamhare I had
ensorceled lamed its leg and lies wounded in the
mountains near Camoa. Will you help me rescue
the poor creature?
  Ceva, Beastmaster\var9:00\\end\
translation:
驯兽师不能产生感情，规矩很清楚。
但长期并肩作战的伙伴怎能轻易抛下？
我驯服的一只梦兔伤了腿，
倒在卡莫亚附近的山中。请帮我救它。
  驯兽师 塞瓦\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I am called Madreth, clan leader of the
Nu Mou Nobles. I seek a kind soul to fetch
a phial of healing water and a sheaf of recall
grass. We wait beneath the lone tree on
Baptiste Hill.
  Madreth, Nu Mou Nobles\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我是努穆贵族氏族长马德雷斯。
希望好心人帮忙取一瓶治愈水和一束回忆草。
我们在巴蒂斯特山的孤树下等候。
  努穆贵族 马德雷斯\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I'm always seeking to broaden my collection of
books, and with it, my knowledge.

Should you come into possession of the following
volumes, please contact me. I promise to make it
worth your while:
ーUrutan Annals
ーThe Arnath Glyphs
  Otach, Scholar\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我一直希望扩充藏书与知识。
如有以下书籍，请联系我，必有重谢：
——《乌鲁坦编年史》
——《阿尔纳斯文字》
  学者 奥塔赫\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I am Veis, a warrior pilgrim traveling the world
and taking such wisdom as she will give.

I have come to Jylland to train for a time with
House Bowen, a hunter clan of some renown.
I request a guide to show me to them.
  Seeker Veis, Assassin\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我是武者维斯，周游世界寻求智慧。

我来到休兰德，想向著名猎人氏族
鲍恩家族修行。请找人带我去见他们。
  求道者、刺客 维斯\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
There's talk of a strange group gathering in
Targ Wood. They stand in a circle chanting
of a "green dominion" and something they
call a "Njrg." Look into this, and see what
they're about.
  Domis Streetears\var9:00\\end\
translation:
听说塔格森林聚集了一群怪人。
他们围成一圈，念叨“绿色统治”
和一个叫“尼尔格”的东西。
请调查他们的目的。
  街头耳目 多米斯\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Magick and steel: two paths seemingly at odds.
Yet both heed the spellblade and her will.
One may not undertake the trial to become a
spellblade alone, and I would have you fight at
my side.
  Hana, Red Mage\var9:00\\end\
translation:
魔法与钢铁，看似对立的两条道路，
却都听从魔法剑士的意志。
魔法剑士的试炼不能独自完成，
希望你能与我并肩战斗。
  赤魔法师 哈娜\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Kupo! Some members of our department went to
field-test our latest prototype, but they haven't
returned, kupo! We need someone to see if
they're all right. If that gun were to fall into the
wrong hands...well, let's not think of that!
  Goug Consortium
  Department of Ranged Mutilation\var9:00\\end\
translation:
库啵！部门成员去测试最新原型后
一直没有回来！请确认他们是否平安。
如果那把枪落入坏人手中……
还是别想了！
  古格联合企业 远程破坏部\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Strange noises punctuate the night. There's
naught but trees and the occasional abandoned
well for many leagues, yet the din of "kupo"s
and firearms is quite overwhelming.

I can scarcely focus, never mind study, and so
I find myself turning to frivolous fictions.

Predictably, my schoolwork has begun to suffer
and my very future is now in peril. Please find
the cause of this nuisance and put a stop to it!
  Orposi, Sophomore (again)\var9:00\\end\
translation:
夜里总有怪声。附近只有树和废井，
却不断传来“库啵”和枪声，吵得厉害。

我无法专心学习，只好看闲书消遣。
结果学业下滑，前途岌岌可危。
请查明并制止噪音！
  二年级生（又一次）奥尔波西\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Kupo! My precious chocobos have all run off!
Every last one of them! It looks like they've
headed for the mountains in the Aldanna Range.
I need someone to find them before the monsters
do, kupo!
  Popocho, Chocobo Knight\var9:00\\end\
translation:
库啵！我心爱的陆行鸟全跑了！
它们似乎去了阿尔达纳山脉。
请在怪物找到它们之前把它们找回来！
  陆行鸟骑士 波波乔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Something horrible has happened: a great affront
to my family I cannot let stand! Though it's only
a few days before the next Prima Donna
concertーI've never missed one yetーI find
myself contemplating selling my tickets and going
to face those responsible for said affront!

In short, I have resolved to confront them, and
I need someone to stand witness.
  Viva Prima Donna! ーDevotee\var9:00\\end\
translation:
出大事了！有人严重冒犯了我的家族！
虽然再过几天就是我从未错过的
歌姬演唱会，我却考虑卖掉门票，
去找那些人算账！

总之，我决定面对他们，需要见证人。
  歌姬万岁！——忠实粉丝\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
You be wanting that rare gem of gems, the
noble pearl, eh? Perhaps I might part with it
for 10 million...no, 30 millionーwait, 50 million!
A good price, no? Bwa ha ha!

Come to the wharf in Graszton. Bring yer money
and nothing else...'cept maybe a few wheelbarrows
to carry it in! Bwah ha!
  Lord Grayrl, Gentleman Trader\var9:00\\end\
translation:
想要稀世珍宝——高贵的珍珠？
我或许愿意以一千万……不，三千万，
等等，五千万卖给你！好价钱吧？哈哈！

来格拉斯顿码头，只带钱……
也许还得带几辆手推车装钱！哈哈！
  绅士商人 格雷尔大人\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This is terrible! A tragedy! A travesty!

My concertina is nowhere to be found! How can
I possibly perform without it? I can't!

I need someone to help me find it! Come with
all haste!
  Mayhew, Prima Donna\var9:00\\end\
translation:
糟了！悲剧！太惨了！

我的手风琴不见了！没有它怎么演出？
根本不行！谁来帮我找？快来！
  歌姬乐团 梅休\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
To Clan \varA:01\,

Think you're all that? Prove it! I'm waiting in the
Galerria Deep!
  Tigrina, Ravager\var9:00\\end\
translation:
致\varA:01\氏族：

觉得自己很厉害？来证明吧！
我在加雷里亚深处等你！
  掠夺者 蒂格丽娜\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Geomancers bend nature to their will.
Our society has established a series of trials for
prospective geomancers to determine whether
they are worthy to share in our knowledge.

The Trial of the Sun is the first of four trials.
When you are ready to be tested, come.

source_text:
Happy New Year from the Bonga Bugle!

We're doing a special on New Year's resolutions,
and what better place to conduct a survey than
where all the people are: in Moorabella!

Calling all those willing to assist this noblest of
causes.
  Head Editor, Bonga Bugle\var9:00\\end\
translation:
《邦加号角》祝大家新年快乐！

我们正制作新年愿望特辑，
调查地点当然要选人最多的摩拉贝拉！

招募愿意协助这一崇高事业的人。
  《邦加号角》主编\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Greetings! Bonga Bugle Head Editor here!

This month's special: the Working People! We're
taking a look at daily life in a shop that's part of
-our- daily life.

Reporting assistants wanted.
  Head Editor, Bonga Bugle\var9:00\\end\
translation:
大家好！我是《邦加号角》主编！

本月特辑：劳动者！我们将走进
日常生活中熟悉的商店，看看店员的生活。

招募采访助手。
  《邦加号角》主编\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:

Reporting assistants wanted.
  Head Editor, Bonga Bugle\var9:00\\end\
translation:

This month, we're taking a look at haunted spots,
starting with that most forbidding of places,
Shadeholme!
...Um, someone go with me, please!
Note: the actual location of our report will be top
secret!
  Head Editor, Bonga Bugle\var9:00\\end\
translation:
大家好！我是《邦加号角》主编！

本月探访闹鬼地点，首先是最可怕的
暗影之乡！呃……请来个人陪我！
注意：实际采访地点绝对保密！
  《邦加号角》主编\var9:00\\end\

source_text:

beneath the ground...all by themselves!

Reporting assistants wanted.
  Head Editor, Bonga Bugle\var9:00\\end\
translation:
大家好！我是《邦加号角》主编！

source_text:

This month, I'll be reporting on Galmia Pepe,
fashion mavens known for their novel designs
and commitment to quality.

We'll be conducting some stealth interviews to get
to the bottom of their unparalleled popularity!

Reporting assistants wanted.
  Head Editor, Bonga Bugle\var9:00\\end\
translation:
大家好！我是《邦加号角》主编！
本月采访以新颖设计和优良品质
闻名的时尚品牌加尔米亚佩佩。
我们将秘密采访，探寻其人气的秘密！
招募采访助手。
  《邦加号角》主编\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:

This month's special feature: Unlimited Power!
What power? Power in battle! What battles?
Clan battles! We'll be measuring clan power,
comparing the clans, and posting our results!
Looking for clans to participate in this event!
  Head Editor, Bonga Bugle\var9:00\\end\
translation:
大家好！我是《邦加号角》主编！
本月特辑：无限力量！什么力量？战斗力！
什么战斗？氏族战斗！我们将测量并比较
氏族实力，公布结果！招募参赛氏族！
  《邦加号角》主编\var9:00\\end\

may be distinguished by its unusual coloration.
  Jylland Defenders of the Peace\var9:00\\end\

members of the Arbiters of Death, a clan to which

and the youngest brother, a wielder of magicks.
  Jylland Defenders of the Peace\var9:00\\end\

长兄是猛士，次兄擅使短刀，
三弟是名射手，幼弟使用魔法。
  休兰德治安维护队\var9:00\\end\

source_text:
ー WANTED! ー

Big Eyes possess a single large eyeball and
generally travel in packs.
  Jylland Defenders of the Peace\var9:00\\end\
translation:
通缉！

source_text:
I was out walking my pet scarab beetle, Nero,
and I lost him! I only took my eyes off him for
a second, but he managed to scamper off
somewhere. A friend of mine gave him to me
before he moved away, and Nero's all I have
to remember him by now.

Please help me get him back! I polish him real
good every day, so his shell really shines. Just
look for something shiny on the ground and you
should find him in no time!
  Letty\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我带宠物圣甲虫尼禄散步时弄丢了它！
只是稍微移开视线，它就跑得不见踪影。
这是搬走的朋友送我的唯一纪念。
请帮我找回来！我每天都把它擦得发亮，
找地上闪闪发光的东西就能找到它！
  莱蒂\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I awoke one morning to find my drake, Goud,
missing without a trace. I haven't the slightest
notion where he might have gone.

Well, that's not entirely true. I've heard rumor
that a drake was recently sighted in the Aldanna
Range. I need someone to venture there and
discover whether or not it is my dear Goud.
  Mr. Grann\var9:00\\end\
translation:
一天早上醒来，我的飞龙古德不见了。
我完全不知道它去了哪里。

其实，也不完全是这样。我听说最近
有人在阿尔达纳山脉看到一只飞龙。
请前往确认是不是我心爱的古德。
  格兰先生\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My pet's gone and run away again. How many
times does this make? I've lost count! Her name's
Chari, and I saved her from the other bloody orbs
that picked on her because she was a different
color. You'd think she'd be a little more grateful,
but she just keeps running away. Someone help
me find her! She has a beautiful white...coat?
It should make her easy to tell apart.
  Fes\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我的宠物又跑了。这是第几次？我都数不清！
她叫查莉，以前因颜色不同被其他血球欺负，
是我救了她。她该懂点感恩，却总是逃跑。
谁帮我找找！她有一身漂亮的白色……毛？
应该很容易认出来。
  菲丝\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I was taking one of the cockatrices for a walk
in the Menagerie grounds when it flew into a
frenzy and lashed out at me with its beak.
Before I knew what had happened, it had
fluttered over the pen fence and run away.
This is the second time one of our monsters
has gotten away from me in recent days, and if
Mr. Grann finds out, I won't hear the end of it!
I need someone to recover the cockatrice
before anyone notices it's missing. It answers to
the name of Okta.
  Keeper Lloyd, Grann's Menagerie\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我在动物园带一只石化鸡散步时，
它突然发狂啄我，随后飞过围栏逃跑了。
这是最近第二只从我手里逃走的怪物；
让格兰先生知道，我就没完没了了！
请在别人发现前找回它。它叫奥克塔。
  格兰动物园饲养员 劳埃德\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My pet shelling, Titoise, has run away, kupo, and
I need someone to find him for me! You see, I've
been keeping him in secret, kupo. If Mr. Grann
finds out, this little moogle is going to be in big
trouble. Kupo!

If that wasn't bad enough, Mr. Grann's daughter,
Fes, can't stand shellings. So I'm sure to catch
a pom-pom lashing from both of them, kupo!
  Keeper Pirillo, Grann's Menagerie\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我的宠物甲壳怪提托伊斯逃跑了，库啵！
请帮我找回来！我一直偷偷养着它，
要是格兰先生发现，我就惨了。
更糟的是，他女儿菲丝最讨厌甲壳怪，
我肯定会被两人骂惨，库啵！
  格兰动物园饲养员 皮里洛\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I was cleaning out Helda's penーone of our
hellhoundsーand when I finished she was gone!
She must have broken free of her chain, but
I know who they'll blame!

Helda's one of Mrs. Zamaree's favorites, and you
can be sure that if she finds her missing, there
will be, well, hell to pay. I need someone to find
Helda and bring her back before she's missed!
  Keeper Leena, Grann's Menagerie\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我打扫地狱犬赫尔达的围栏后，
发现她不见了！一定是挣脱了锁链，
可大家肯定会怪我！
赫尔达是扎玛丽夫人的心头好，
请在她发现前找回赫尔达！
  格兰动物园饲养员 莉娜\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Oh, it's terrible! Simply terrible!
My poor little Carrot has gone wild all of a sudden
and hied off to gods know where! Her eyes...
Oh, her eyes were like unto a malboro's!
I hope you can bring her back, but if you can't,
perhaps you could put her out of her misery?
  Mrs. Zamaree, A certain menagerie owner's wife\var9:00\\end\
translation:
太可怕了！我可怜的小卡萝特突然发狂，
跑得不知去向！她的眼睛……
哦，她的眼睛像极了魔界花！
希望你能带她回来；如果不行，
请结束她的痛苦好吗？
  某动物园主人的妻子 扎玛丽夫人\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I need someone to catch these really rare
antlions for me. They're supposed to be different
colors from the other antlions. I never seen them
myself, but they're supposed to live in the forest,
or grasslands, or something like that. Oh, and
I heard of one being seen near Moorabella once,
too.
  Eckt, Bug Collector\var9:00\\end\
translation:
请帮我抓非常稀有的蚁狮。
据说颜色与普通蚁狮不同。
我没亲眼见过，但听说它们住在森林
或草原之类的地方，摩拉贝拉附近也有人见过。
  昆虫收藏家 埃克特\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My most treasured family heirloomーa gil snapper
shellーhas broken clean in two! That shell has
been handed down for generations as a charm to
bring good fortune to our family business. That
it's broken is an affront to my ancestors, and
I fear it may bring ill luck on my trade.

I seek someone to catch a gil snapper and replace
the broken shell! Money's no objectーI don't need
gil, I need a gil snapper!
  Maat, Dealer of Antiquities\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我最珍贵的传家宝——金币龟壳——
竟然断成两半！它是代代相传的生意护符。
这不仅有辱祖先，我还怕生意会倒霉。
请抓一只金币龟来替换！钱不是问题，
我不要吉尔，我要金币龟！
  古董商 马特\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
You know the shelled beasts that walk this land
with their long-forgotten foes' swords lodged in
their backs? One such beast is the toughskin,
and it is rare, for few blades can so much as
scratch its reddish hide, said to be the hardest of
all its ilk.

And yet there are rumors that one has been
spotted, and with sword! I would very much like to
see such a sword. Bring it to me!
  Metallurgist Steeling\var9:00\\end\
translation:
你知道背上插着古老敌人之剑的甲壳兽吗？
其中的硬皮兽十分罕见，它的红皮据说
是同类中最坚硬的，几乎没有刀剑能划伤。
但听说有人见过一只背上插着剑的！
我很想见识那把剑，请带给我！
  冶金师 斯蒂林\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I'm big on chocobos. So big, I decided to
build a chocobo ranch. All well and good, right?
Wrong! I spent so much on the ranch, I didn't
have anything left to buy chocobos!

That's why I need you to go out and catch me
a wild one. Yellow should do just fine.
  Yew, Chocobo Rancher\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我太喜欢陆行鸟，决定建个牧场。
听起来很好？错了！建牧场花光了钱，
根本没剩下买鸟的钱！
请帮我抓只野生的，黄色的就好。
  陆行鸟牧场主 尤\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My fields are overrun with cockatrices! I need
someone to save my tomatoes!
I can't offer much in the way of a reward, but I'm
desperateーthose tomatoes are special!

Oh, and cockatrices spook real easy, so don't
bring a whole bunch of folk, or they'll just run off
and hide.
  Farmer Colt\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我的田被石化鸡占了！快救救我的番茄！
报酬虽然不多，但那些番茄很特别！
石化鸡容易受惊，别带太多人，
否则它们会逃去躲起来。
  农夫 科尔特\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
*****Help Wanted!*****

It's seeding time again, and each year we lose
crops to raiding monsters. We seek hardened
adventurers to stand between our livelihood and
their fiendish claws!
  T. K. Corral\var9:00\\end\
translation:
招聘！

又到播种季，每年都有怪物袭击庄稼。
招募经验丰富的冒险者，保护我们的生计
免受怪物魔爪侵害！
  T.K.牧场\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The time has come, kupo, to propose to the one
I love! Oh, she's very cultured and ladylike, so
I must be a gentleman, kupo.

I've heard that eating the kupoppy flower makes
one more refined and elegant, kupo! Could you
get one for me?
  Kolulu, Moogle in love\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我要向心上人求婚了，库啵！
她知书达理、举止优雅，我也得做绅士。
听说吃库波比花能变得文雅，
能帮我找一朵吗？
  恋爱中的莫古 库露露\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The creatures of Tramdine Fens are on the
brink of catastrophe! A swell in the number
of antlions has driven the native cockatrices
into decline. If something isn't done, they'll
disappear from the fens altogether. Please
travel to Tramdine Fens and thin the antlion
population.
  Baran, Society for the Protection of Monsters\var9:00\\end\
translation:
特拉姆丁沼泽的动物面临灾难！
蚁狮数量增加，导致当地石化鸡锐减。
再不行动，它们就会从沼泽消失。
请去沼泽减少蚁狮数量。
  怪物保护协会 巴兰\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Natural habitats in the Tramdine Fens are in
danger! Cockatrice wattles blot out the sun, and
they're eating everything in sight!

We need someone to eradicate those cockatrices.
They are a blight upon the land.
  Goran, Friends of the Fen\var9:00\\end\
translation:
特拉姆丁沼泽的自然栖息地告急！
石化鸡多到遮天蔽日，吃光所见的一切！
请消灭这些危害土地的石化鸡。
  沼泽之友 戈兰\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
ーTrade Requestedー
I will trade my Ocktor Tome of Medicine for your
cactus fruit! We will do the deal in Targ Wood.
  Mack, White Mage\var9:00\\end\
translation:
交换请求
用《奥克托医书》交换仙人掌果实！
交易地点在塔格森林。
  白魔法师 麦克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I seek someone to deliver medicine to a small
village in Targ Wood. I would go myself, but
there are those who would steal my secretsーas
one who crafts potent potablesーand it is
deemed dangerous for me to go out and about.
Please, this one favor I beg of you.
  Mack, Salve-maker\var9:00\\end\
translation:
请帮忙把药送到塔格森林的小村庄。
我本想亲自送去，但有人觊觎我制作
强效药剂的秘诀，外出十分危险。
恳请帮我这个忙。
  药剂师 麦克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I seek someone to escort me to Targ Wood,
providing protection as necessary. I am off to
work for the Imperial League of Physicians in
Rozarria, and I would like to visit the places
dear to my heart one last time before I leave.
Thank you.
  Mack, Scholar at large\var9:00\\end\
translation:
请护送我前往塔格森林，必要时保护我。
我将去罗扎利亚帝国医师联盟工作，
离开前想最后看看心爱的地方。谢谢。
  游学者 麦克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
ーTrade Requestedー
I will trade my magickal earrings for the Ocktor
Tome of Medicine in your possession. We will do
the deal in Targ Wood.
  Mack, White Mage\var9:00\\end\
translation:
交换请求
用我的魔法耳环交换你的《奥克托医书》。
交易地点在塔格森林。
  白魔法师 麦克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We've been so busy with our singing we've
entirely neglected our stage combat. Sparring is
well and good, but our adoring public wants
authenticityーonly a proper melee with beasts
and blood will do! I'm sure we can handle
ourselves, but we are out of practice, so a
bodyguard would be welcome. Will no one come to
our aid?
  Prima Donna\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我们忙于唱歌，完全疏忽了舞台战斗。
练习虽好，但观众想看真功夫——
必须有怪物和鲜血的真正混战！
相信我们能应付，但毕竟生疏了，
希望有保镖随行。有人愿意帮忙吗？
  歌姬乐团\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I'm...not feeling well of late.
A bit under the weather, you might say.
Could someone bring a potion...and a
hi-potion to Tramdine Fens for me?
Many thanks.
  Lotice, Friend to no physician\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我……最近身体不太舒服。
可以说有些不适。
能给我带一瓶药水和一瓶高级药水
到特拉姆丁沼泽吗？多谢。
  不爱看医生的洛蒂丝\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Night after night monsters plague the lands
surrounding our home. Something must be done,
but I'm too frightened to do anything myself.
Please, find the source of these monsters and
drive them from our lands!
  Tod Hapwell\var9:00\\end\
translation:
怪物夜夜侵扰我们家附近的土地。
必须做点什么，但我太害怕了。
请找出怪物的来源，将它们赶走！
  托德·哈普韦尔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
A fiend hunts me. Each time I think I've slain
it, I turn to find it stalking me once more. I fear
I am lost. I seek help in ending my nightmare
once and for all. I never want to look on this
creature again.
  Scared Sleepless\var9:00\\end\
translation:
有只魔物追猎我。每次以为杀死了它，
一回头却又看到它跟踪我。
我恐怕撑不住了。请帮我彻底结束噩梦，
我再也不想见到它。
  吓得失眠的人\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I'm not what you would call a morning person.
I'm always oversleeping and missing my classes.
I've heard that malboro draught might help me
wake up on time. It's made from malboro vine
and foul liquid, and the Witch of the Fens is said
to know how to prepare it. Once you have the
draught, bring it to me in Fluorgis.
  Geldran the Drowsy\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我早上总起不来，经常睡过头误课。
听说魔界花药剂能帮我准时醒来。
它由魔界花藤和恶臭液体制成，
沼泽女巫知道配方。请带药剂到弗洛吉斯给我。
  瞌睡虫 盖尔德兰\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I once had trouble oversleeping and missing my
classes, but a certain draught I'd rather not recall
put an end to that. Oh how I miss those mornings
spent drowsing in bed! I wish to return to my
layabout ways, and prim draught is said to be
just the thing I need. Please bring a succulent
fruit and some sweet sap to the Witch of the Fens
and have her prepare the draught for me!
  Geldran the Once Drowsy\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我曾经睡过头误课，一剂不愿回想的药
治好了我。唉，我好怀念赖床的早晨！
听说端庄药剂能让我恢复懒散。
请带多汁果实和甜树液给沼泽女巫，
让她替我配药！
  曾经的瞌睡虫 盖尔德兰\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I seek a guide to escort me to Neslowe Peak.
There I intend to stand beside a river of
boiling magma and feel its heat on my skin.
So inspired, I will paint a picture to capture
that heat, making it real for all who look on it!
You will be well rewarded for your trouble.
  Master Painter Kismunt\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我需要向导护送我去内斯洛峰。
我要站在沸腾的岩浆河边，感受热量，
再画出那种热，让观画者也能感受到！
报酬丰厚。
  绘画大师 基斯蒙特\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The most charming man visits my shop each
morning. I think he's interested in me, and I want
to bake him a special cookie to show him how
I feel. Please bring me a bat tail so I can bake
him a treat he'll never forget!
  Mille, Love-struck Maiden\var9:00\\end\
translation:
每天早上都有位迷人的男士来店里。
我觉得他对我有意，想烤特别的饼干
表达心意。请给我带蝙蝠尾巴，
我要做让他终生难忘的点心！
  恋爱少女 米勒\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
That Killan has done it again! He's thrown my
final exam papers out the window. If anyone
learns the mark I received, I'll never be able to
show my face in the Akademy again.

I think the papers are still in the forest behind
the school. Gather them and return them with
all haste!
  Udite, Second Year Akademy Student\var9:00\\end\
translation:
基兰又干了！他把我的期末考卷扔出窗外。
要是有人知道我的成绩，我在学院就没脸见人了。
考卷应该还在学校后面的森林里，
请赶紧收集起来还给我！
  学院二年级生 尤迪特\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Ah, the sweet lips of my love. My one pleasure
in this life. But the vile Balfonne has stolen
a kiss from my darling Preme, and with it, her
love. I could not let such a slight go unanswered!

I immediately challenged Balfonne to a duel to
settle this point of honor, but sadly, urgent
matters prevent me from dealing with the
scoundrel myself. I seek someone to do battle
in my place.
  Hseaunon, Preme's True Love\var9:00\\end\
translation:
爱人的甜吻是我生命中唯一的快乐。
可恶的巴尔丰偷吻了我的普雷姆，
也偷走了她的爱。我不能忍受这羞辱！
我立刻向他提出决斗，但有急事无法亲战，
请人代我迎战。
  普雷姆的真爱 休农\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We're up to our ears in shipping orders.
It's getting so bad, I've even thought about
taking on baknamy! As it is, the freight keeps
piling up, and we don't have enough hands to
keep it moving. If you aren't afraid of a little
hard work, we've got a job for you.
  Noy, Long-ear Freight\var9:00\\end\
translation:
货运订单多得忙不过来，
我甚至考虑雇巴克纳姆族了！
货物越堆越多，人手不足。
不怕辛苦的话，这里有份工作。
  长耳货运 诺伊\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My husband's forgotten his lunch again! After all
the work I put into making it... I need someone to
take it to him while it's still fresh.
  Chermie\var9:00\\end\
translation:
丈夫又忘带午饭了！我辛辛苦苦做的……
请趁还新鲜帮我送给他。
  切尔米\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I've always been weakーill suited for
physical labor. As my luck would have it, I was
chosen to join an expedition to dig for licra ore.
I really don't think I'm up to the task, and so
I seek a group of hunters to go in my place.
  Cain the Frail\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我身体一向虚弱，不适合体力活。
偏偏被选去参加利克拉矿挖掘队。
我实在干不了，请猎人们代我前往。
  虚弱的凯恩\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
It's nearly my mother's birthday, and I want to
give her some flowers as a gift, kupo.
I need someone to gather some pretty, pink
flowers for the bouquet.
  Genne, Devoted Son\var9:00\\end\
translation:
妈妈生日快到了，我想送她花，库啵。
请帮我采一些漂亮的粉花做花束。
  孝子 杰恩\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I am a songstress. My voice is my livelihood.
I have a series of performances scheduled,
but I've come down with a terrible sore throat.
I can't possibly perform in this condition.
I've heard sweet sap can soothe the pain.
Would you bring me some?
  Teis, Songstress\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我是歌手，嗓子就是饭碗。
接下来有一系列演出，我却喉咙疼得厉害，
这样根本无法演唱。听说甜树液能止痛，
能帮我带一些吗？
  歌手 泰丝\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I want to fight against a monster and know
the thrill of battle for myself. Father tells
me to put such thoughts from my mind, but
I will have none of it. Will you fight alongside
me? I wait in the Rupie Mountains.
  Syrenead Sie Hyskaris\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我想亲自与怪物战斗，体验战斗的刺激。
父亲让我打消念头，但我绝不放弃。
能与我并肩战斗吗？我在鲁皮山脉等候。
  西雷妮德·希·希斯卡里斯\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I'm exhausted. Work keeps me so busy
I can scarcely find time to eat, let alone
rest. But now's no time to pack it in. If
someone could bring me a pick-me-up,
something to put the spring back in my step,
I'd be very grateful.
  Bease, Overworked and underappreciated\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我累坏了。工作忙得几乎没时间吃饭，
更别说休息。但现在还不能放弃。
谁能带些提神的东西，让我重振精神？
我会非常感激。
  辛苦工作却不受重视的比斯\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I saw it with me own eyes! A white cat as big
as a man if it was a foot, it was. Leastwise,
I think it were a cat. Prowling about the
Rupie Mountains plain as day. Well, strutting
about in a place with monsters like that will
get it eaten alive in no time flat. Will you go
and save it?
  Maerwynn, Cat Lover\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我亲眼见到一只人那么大的白猫！
至少我觉得是猫。它在鲁皮山脉四处走动。
那儿有怪物，它很快会被吃掉。
请去救救它！
  爱猫人士 梅尔温\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I had a fight with my father the other day,
and we haven't spoken a word since. I wanted to
make up with him by baking one of my special
carrot cakes for his birthday...but a monster took
all six pages of my recipe! Please, someone, get
them back for me!
  Lea, Who is in truth fond of her father\var9:00\\end\
translation:
前几天和父亲吵架，之后一直没说话。
我想在他生日时烤拿手胡萝卜蛋糕和好，
但怪物抢走了六页食谱！请帮我拿回来！
  其实很喜欢父亲的莉娅\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I went collecting ingredients to make my
grandmother's special cake, and I've
gone and tired myself out completely.
Would someone be kind enough to procure
the final ingredient, a hedychium bloom?
  Lea, Who is in truth not a good cook\var9:00\\end\
translation:
为了做祖母的拿手蛋糕，我去收集材料，
结果累得精疲力尽。好心人能帮我
拿来最后的材料——姜花吗？
  其实不擅长做饭的莉娅\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
It took me five days, but I finally finished baking
my grandmother's special cakeーbut on my
way to deliver it to my father, I was set upon by
a monster like a great ball of feathers, and it
stole the cake, box and all! Won't someone please
get it back for me?
  Lea, Who is often set upon by monsters\var9:00\\end\
translation:
花了五天，我终于烤好了祖母的蛋糕，
送给父亲时却遇到一只像大羽毛球的怪物，
它连盒子一起抢走了蛋糕！请帮我拿回来！
  经常遭怪物袭击的莉娅\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Father didn't believe I defeated a wyrm
in my first battle. Perhaps if I capture it
and show it to him he will not find it so easy
a claim to dismiss. Will you assist me?
I wait in the Rupie Mountains.
  Syrenead Sie Hyskaris\var9:00\\end\
translation:
父亲不信我首次战斗就打倒了巨龙。
也许抓住它给他看，他就不能轻易否认。
请助我一臂之力，我在鲁皮山脉等候。
  西雷妮德·希·希斯卡里斯\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Haven't tried Culinary Crusade's latest
gastronomical triumph, Amarette Malbonara
yet? Now's your chance! Just be careful
not to burn the ingredients when you harvest
them. Heat muddles the flavor.
  Grosso, Culinary Crusade\var9:00\\end\
translation:
还没尝过美食远征队的新作
杏仁魔界花意面？机会来了！
采集食材时小心别烧焦，受热会影响风味。
  美食远征队 格罗索\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Never tasted the delicious tears of devils
brought to a simmer by the scalding heat
of fire and brimstone? Then you've never
tasted Imp Stew, a sinfully tasty dish!
It must be eaten while piping hot, or it
loses its punch, so don't dawdle once you've
ladled a bowl or three!
  Grosso, Culinary Crusade\var9:00\\end\
translation:
没尝过在硫磺烈焰中炖煮的恶魔眼泪？
那就没吃过罪恶美味的小恶魔炖汤！
必须趁热吃，凉了就没味道。
盛上几碗后可别磨蹭！
  美食远征队 格罗索\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Fisherman's Tortoria is an old Graszton
favorite of lightly seasoned turtle meat.
Simple, and simply delicious! The trick to
preparing this dish comes not in the kitchen
but on the battlefield. Bring down the turtles
with bladed weapons, and the entire dish
tastes of metal, so best to avoid using them
entirely. Are you up to the task?
  Grosso, Culinary Crusade\var9:00\\end\
translation:
渔夫龟肉料理是格拉斯顿的传统美食，
龟肉稍加调味，简单又美味！
诀窍不在厨房，而在战场。
用刀剑打倒龟会让整道菜染上金属味，
所以最好完全不用刀剑。你能做到吗？
  美食远征队 格罗索\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Zedlei Flan, a specialty from the forest of the
same name, is a delicate desert that melts in
one's mouth, before melting one's heart. Only
the freshest ingredients will do for this treat!
  Grosso, Culinary Crusade\var9:00\\end\
translation:
泽德雷布丁是同名森林的特产，
入口即化，令人心醉。
这道甜点只能使用最新鲜的食材！
  美食远征队 格罗索\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
A connoisseur of fine cuisine is always
in search of the next great meal. I am happy
to tell you that meal is here, my friends!
If you think you have what it takes to
appreciate the finest of gastronomical
delights, meet me in Aisenfield!
  Grosso, Culinary Crusade\var9:00\\end\
translation:
美食鉴赏家总在寻找下一顿佳肴。
朋友们，好消息：它就在这里！
如果你认为自己能欣赏顶级美味，
就在艾森原见我！
  美食远征队 格罗索\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
In response to monster attacks in the
regions outlying the city proper, we set a
number of traps to rid ourselves of the
beasts once and for all. Alas, the traps
had no effect. Worse still, they now pose
a danger to our citizenry. Please destroy
these traps before they can do any real
harm.
  Camoa Ministry of Wildlife\var9:00\\end\
translation:
为应对郊区怪物袭击，我们设下许多陷阱，
希望一劳永逸消灭它们。可惜陷阱毫无效果，
反而危及市民。请在造成实际伤害前摧毁陷阱。
  卡莫亚野生动物管理局\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We hired a group of parivir to protect
our precious city from outside attacks,
but those very same parivir have started
wreaking havoc -inside- the city, kupo!
We need a group of hunters to come and
take care of the troublemakers.
  Zupp, Goug Youth Alliance\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我们雇了一群剑豪保护城市免受外敌，
他们却在城内大肆破坏，库啵！
需要猎人来解决这些捣乱者。
  古格青年联盟 祖普\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Those parivir we hired to watch over our
town were nothing but trouble, kupo. But we
learned our lesson. If we want something done
right, we have to do it ourselves!

We've formed a town watch to protect the city,
but what we have in determination we lack in
experience. We need someone to help us harden
up, kupo!
  Zupp, Commander of the Goug Watch\var9:00\\end\
translation:
雇来守城的剑豪只会惹麻烦，库啵。
我们吸取教训：要做好一件事，就得自己来！
我们成立了守卫队保护城市，
虽有决心却缺乏经验。请帮我们锻炼！
  古格守卫队队长 祖普\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The parivir driven out of Goug are holding
a grudge, kupo. They're back, and they've
brought friends! The Goug Watch is ready to
move, but this is our first real battle, and
having someone to watch our backs would
really be a comfort, kupo.
  Zupp, Commander of the Goug Watch\var9:00\\end\
translation:
被赶出古格的剑豪怀恨在心，
这次带着朋友回来了！守卫队已准备好，
但这是我们的首次实战，有人照应就放心多了。
  古格守卫队队长 祖普\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This past night I saw another falling star in the
direction of Sant D'alsa Bluff. There had been
another the night before last, and the night
before that, too! I can't rest with the sky falling
down around me. All I want is a good night's
sleep! Would someone travel to Sant D'alsa Bluff
and see if there's anything that can be done?
  Manuela, Insomniac\var9:00\\end\
translation:
昨晚我又看到流星落向圣达尔萨断崖，
前晚和大前晚也是！天上不断掉东西，
我根本睡不安稳。只想睡个好觉！
谁能去断崖看看有没有办法？
  失眠者 玛努埃拉\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We were digging a shaft in the Nazan Mines
when it collapsed, trapping me and my friends in
the darkness. Up until a few days ago I could
hear my friends' voices, but now I hear only the
cries of spirits. I'm placing this note in a bottle
and casting it in one of the underground rivers
that runs through the mine in the slim hope it will
be found in time.
  Rasgow, Nazan Miner\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我们在纳赞矿山开凿竖井时发生坍塌，
我和同伴困在黑暗中。几天前还能听到
他们的声音，如今只听见幽灵的哭声。
我把纸条装进瓶子，投入地下河，
希望它能及时被人发现。
  纳赞矿工 拉斯高\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Bombs have been streaming out of the crater on
Firewyrm Mount. We're in the process of forming
a brigade of mages to deal with the threat, but
we need more time. Hold back the bombs for us
until we've finished our preparations!
  Jank, Goug Firehouse\var9:00\\end\
translation:
炸弹怪不断从火龙山火山口涌出。
我们正在组织魔法师队伍应对威胁，
但还需要时间。请在准备完成前挡住它们！
  古格消防站 扬克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
This rivalry has gone on for many longs years...
high time we finished it once and for all!
Those cowards in the Nu Mou Nobles have
had it coming, and with a little extra muscle
from you, we'll see they get it! The battlefield
will be the Rupie Mountains. Come prepared!
  Mocedad, Bangaa Brotherhood\var9:00\\end\
translation:
这场竞争持续多年……该彻底了结了！
努穆贵族那群胆小鬼早该受教训。
只要有你们助阵，我们就能做到！
战场在鲁皮山脉，做好准备！
  邦加兄弟会 莫塞达德\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Our rivalry has gone on many long years...long
enough. I want it to end. We must vanquish into
shame those musclebound Bangaa Brotherhood
goons once and for all!

Seeking warriors with faith in their mental acuity
to aid our cause in battle. The battlefield will be
the Rupie Mountains.
  Madreth, Nu Mou Nobles\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我们的竞争已经持续太久，该结束了。
必须彻底击败那些头脑简单的邦加兄弟会！
招募对智慧有信心的战士协助作战。
战场在鲁皮山脉。
  努穆贵族 马德雷斯\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The Rupie Mountains are ours...but someone
apparently forgot to tell those interlopers that!
Come and see us stomp out this latest threat to
our territory!

We'll show themーand the worldーthat we of the
Bangaa Brotherhood aren't to be trifled with!
  Mocedad, Bangaa Brotherhood\var9:00\\end\
translation:
鲁皮山脉是我们的……显然那些闯入者
还不知道！来看看我们如何粉碎这次威胁！
让他们和全世界知道邦加兄弟会不好惹！
  邦加兄弟会 莫塞达德\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My Dear Montblanc,

I have long admired you from afar, and now
I wish to see you and profess my feelings in
person.

Yours,
  Cois, Maiden of the Wood\var9:00\\end\
translation:
亲爱的蒙布朗：

我仰慕你很久了，希望亲自见面，
向你表白我的心意。

爱你的
  森林少女 科伊丝\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I seek the love of my life! My search has led me
through city streets and far abroad. I have even
taken up the pen, and met two charming ladies
in my correspondence. Ah, but I've made a mess of
things by scheduling a rendezvous with each of
them on the same day! I need someone to meet
one of the lucky damsels in my stead. Only the
dashing need applyーI've a reputation to
consider!
  Marnot, Pride of Fluorgis\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我正在寻找一生挚爱！走遍街头远方，
还通过书信认识了两位迷人女士。
可我竟把两次约会安排在同一天！
请人替我见其中一位。只招英俊人士，
我还得顾及名声！
  弗洛吉斯的骄傲 马尔诺\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
You have flown aboard an airship? Seen the
world from above the clouds and felt the
cool wind on your face? I too wish to know
what it is to feel this, but heights terrify me.
I seek a companion to accompany me aboard
an airship and help keep my fears at bay.
  Arna the Superstitious\var9:00\\end\
translation:
你坐过飞空艇吗？从云端俯瞰世界，
感受凉风拂面？我也想体验，但我恐高。
请人陪我乘坐飞空艇，帮我克服恐惧。
  多疑的阿尔娜\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I've recently taken up crafting figurines in the
likeness of monsters and fantastic beasts. Not
easy getting them to look like the real thing.

To finish the piece I'm working on now, I require a
faerie wing. Bring one to me, and you'll be well
rewarded.
  Maddock, Perfectionist\var9:00\\end\
translation:
最近我开始制作怪物和奇兽模型，
要做得逼真可不容易。
为了完成手头的作品，我需要妖精翅膀。
请带给我，必有重谢。
  完美主义者 马多克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I've been thinking of getting a gift for my
employer. A little treat of sortsーbut something
healthy. They say succulent fruit has a number
of benefits. But not too many, I hope. If he
were any healthier, he would work me to
death!
  Tagore, Aspiring Apprentice\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我想送雇主一份礼物，最好是健康的点心。
听说多汁果实好处很多，但愿别太多。
要是他更健康了，非把我累死不可！
  有抱负的学徒 泰戈尔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My dear friend Meena has moved 'cross the
sea. I seek a courier to deliver a letter to her.
  Riddim\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我的好友米娜搬到了海对岸。
请信使帮我送一封信给她。
  里迪姆\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I was developing a love philtre for my studies,
but a classmate drank the potion before I could
complete it and has come down with a terrible
fever. I need someone to ask the Witch of the
Fens to make a potion to cool the fever before
my classmate's condition grows worse. The
ingredients needed are silk bloom and malboro
wine. Thanks! (And hurry!)
  Kuleek, Moorabella Magick Akademy\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我在研究中配制爱情药水，同学却在
完成前喝掉了它，现在发着高烧。
请找沼泽女巫配退烧药，免得病情恶化。
材料是丝花和魔界花酒。谢谢！（快点！）
  摩拉贝拉魔法学院 库利克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My unfinished love philtre seems to have taken
premature effect, and my classmate has become
infatuated with me!

Though I must confess I am somewhat pleased by
this, I am left feeling strangely unwholesome.

I need someone to ask the Witch of the Fens to
make an antidote to the philtre! The ingredients
needed are cactus fruit and malboro wine.
Thanks! (And...don't hurry too much.)
  Kuleek, Moorabella Magick Akademy\var9:00\\end\
translation:
未完成的爱情药水似乎提前起效，
同学竟然迷恋上了我！
虽然我有点高兴，却又觉得不太对劲。
请找沼泽女巫配解药！材料是仙人掌果实
和魔界花酒。谢谢！（不用太急……）
  摩拉贝拉魔法学院 库利克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Ever since my husband passed away, I've been
having this recurring dream in which he tells me
he wants to come home.

My husband met his end in Tramdine Fens, but
his wedding ring was never found. Perhaps this is
why he cannot find his way? Someone, please
recover it!
  Widow Maleen\var9:00\\end\
translation:
丈夫过世后，我反复梦见他说想回家。
他死在特拉姆丁沼泽，但婚戒一直没找到。
也许因此找不到回家的路？请帮我找回戒指！
  寡妇 玛琳\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Ever heard the story of the "one red phial of
antidote"? Where that guy traded one phial of
antidote for something, and then traded that and
so on until he had a chocobo? Well, I decided to
give it a go, too!

I'm up to a bottle of silver liquid now, and I want
to trade it for a chunk of adamantite. C'mon, you
know you want it!
  Aerning the Lazy\var9:00\\end\
translation:
听过“一瓶红色解毒药”的故事吗？
有人不断交换，最后换到一只陆行鸟。
我也决定试试！现在换到一瓶银色液体，
想换一块精金。来吧，你肯定想要！
  懒人 艾宁\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Tis the season again...the season for those horrid
mimics to start spawning.

Oh, I want to get rid of them this year in the
worst way, but it will take a while to activate my
magickal device that should put an end to the
infestation. I need someone to hold them off until
it gets going!
  Center for Mimic Control Research
  Assistant to the Chief\var9:00\\end\
translation:
又到了可怕的宝箱怪繁殖季。
我很想今年彻底消灭它们，但启动魔法装置
需要时间。请在装置启动前挡住它们！
  宝箱怪防治研究中心 主任助理\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I saw some unfamiliar folk in the Ruins
of Delgantua. It's just a feeling, but I don't
think they're from around here. I don't think
they're even from Jylland!
They looked like they were planning something.
...Maybe someone aught inquire further?
  Perna, Professor of Archaeology\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我在德尔甘图亚遗迹看到一些陌生人。
只是直觉，但我觉得他们不是本地人，
甚至不是休兰德人！他们似乎在谋划什么。
……也许有人该深入调查？
  考古学教授 佩尔娜\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
There's a forest not too far from where I live,
and at night I see, well, shapes flitting through
the trees...or something. I've gone during the
day, but no one's there.

Could someone go and look into it? I get this
feeling there're more of them every day...
  Mooshe the Timid\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我家附近有片森林。夜里我看到
树间有影子闪过……或者类似的东西。
白天去看却什么都没有。
谁能调查一下？我觉得它们越来越多了……
  胆小的穆舍\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
There's a ship coming in to port soon
I got a bad feeling about. The chief says
the paperwork checks outーno problem.
No problem with the paperwork? That's
suspicious right there! You show me a
seaman's shipping writ, and I'll show you
a document not fit for feeding to a goat!
Someone look into this, would you?
 Anonymous, Graszton Port Authority\var9:00\\end\
translation:
一艘即将进港的船让我很不安。
主管说文件没有问题。文件没问题？
这本身就可疑！船员的货运文书
连喂山羊都不配！谁来查查？
  格拉斯顿港务局 匿名\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Foodstuffs needed. You will be required to catch
specific monsters at a specific location. The details
are as follows:
— Must have fluffy white fur.
— Enough to feed two.
— To be used as an appetizer, one per serving.
Too many is no good. Too few is also no good.
  Poison Tasters Guild "The Iron Stomach"\var9:00\\end\

需要食材。请在指定地点捕捉特定怪物：
——必须有蓬松白毛。
——供两人食用。
——作为开胃菜，每人一只。
太多太少都不行。
  试毒师公会“铁胃”\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

— One finger per serving.
Too many is no good. Too few is also no good.
  Poison Tasters Guild "The Iron Stomach"\var9:00\\end\

需要食材。请在指定地点捕捉特定怪物：
——藏在宝箱中。

source_text:
Someone's after me, I'm sure of it. But why?
I haven't a clue. I'm so very frightened.

Please, someoneーprotect me! If it's gil you want,
I can pay!
  Dayvis the Meek\var9:00\\end\
translation:
有人在追我，我确定。可为什么？
我毫无头绪，害怕极了。
求求谁来保护我！想要钱的话，我付得起！
  胆小的戴维斯\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
One of my house's products-in-development
was stolen when bandits intercepted a shipment.
It contained special materials, and should it be
resold to another house, all the time and energy
we spent creating it will have been for naught.
Seeking information as to its whereabouts!
  Margot, Executive Squire, House Camelot\var9:00\\end\
translation:
家族一件研发中的产品在运输途中
被强盗劫走。它含有特殊材料，
如果转卖给其他家族，我们的心血就白费了。
请提供其下落情报！
  卡米洛特家高级侍从 玛戈\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I've heard there are many robbers about
these days, and I'd rather not travel alone.
Seeking an armed escort!
I've heard good things about Clan
\varA:01\ーthey'd really be best.
If you see this posting, please come to the
Galerria Deep. We will meet there!
  Fayk the Somewhat Timid\var9:00\\end\
translation:
听说最近强盗很多，我不想独自旅行。
招募武装护卫！听说\varA:01\氏族很出色，
他们最合适。看到告示请到加雷里亚深处，
我们在那里见面！
  有点胆小的费克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
It will be Silversun soon, and in Camoa
Silversun means the Great Land Festival!
We're looking for people to join in the
festivities and help decorate our town!
The work will last for ten days, with lodging
and board provided! Come one, come all!
  Camoa Great Land Festival Committee\var9:00\\end\
translation:
银阳节快到了，卡莫亚将举办大地祭！
招募参加庆典、协助装饰城镇的人！
工作为期十天，提供食宿！欢迎大家！
  卡莫亚大地祭委员会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
While traveling through the Aldanna Range
I mistakenly dropped several traps meant for sale.
I'm afraid the shock of the drop has likely
released their safety mechanisms, making them
quite dangerous! Deactivating them would be
hazardous at this point, so I just need someone
to destroy them. It's the only way to be sure.
  Esther, New Hire\var9:00\\end\
translation:
穿越阿尔达纳山脉时，我不慎丢下
几个待售陷阱。撞击可能解除了保险，
十分危险！现在拆除也很危险，
所以请直接摧毁它们，这是唯一稳妥的办法。
  新员工 埃丝特\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Clan \varA:01\,

We are in pursuit of an infamous monster that
promises to be quite a handful... Would you aid
us in driving this menace away?
  Bowen of House Bowen\var9:00\\end\
translation:
\varA:01\氏族：

我们正在追踪一只难缠的恶名怪物……
能帮我们赶走这个威胁吗？
  鲍恩家族 鲍恩\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Clan \varA:01\,

I beg your assistance! No sooner had we
succeeded in tracking down Klesta's demesne than
Bowen disappeared!

I fear he has gone to deal with the beast himself.
We make haste to intercept him before it is too
late, but I would ask that you secure for us some
cloudy sap...it is a vital piece of our strategy for
dealing with our flighty foe once and for all.
  Tweigel of House Bowen\var9:00\\end\
translation:
\varA:01\氏族：

请助我们一臂之力！刚找到克莱斯塔的巢穴，
鲍恩就失踪了！恐怕他独自去对付野兽。
我们正赶去拦住他，请你们帮忙取得浑浊树液，
这是彻底对付这只善飞敌人的关键。
  鲍恩家族 特威格尔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We of Cinquleur seek battle with the strongest of
warriors! Defeat me if you can, and you shall be
rewarded!
  Red King Ruuj of Cinquleur\var9:00\\end\
translation:
五色王寻求与最强战士交手！
有本事就打败我，必有奖赏！
  五色王之红王 鲁吉\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We of Cinquleur seek battle with the strongest of
warriors, kupo! Defeat me if you can, kupo, and
you shall be rewarded!
  Black King Nware of Cinquleur\var9:00\\end\
translation:
五色王寻求与最强战士交手，库啵！
有本事就打败我，必有奖赏！
  五色王之黑王 诺瓦尔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:

Salutations from Carm Mercantile.
We would like to share with you our experiences
protecting endangered monsters. While monsters
can be dangerous in their own right, they can also
be used for food and the making of medicines.
Please make a donation to help us prevent the
overhunting of monsters, and ensure a prosperous
future for all.
  "From Shipwrighting to Foodstuffsー
  We're Carm Mercantile."\var9:00\\end\
translation:
卡姆商会向您问好。
我们愿分享保护濒危怪物的经验。
怪物虽危险，却也可用于食物和药品。
请捐款帮助防止过度捕猎，确保美好未来。
  “从造船到食品——我们是卡姆商会。”\var9:00\\end\

source_text:
There's a monster on a nearby hill and, well, it's
completely out of control! They say it lost its
children, and being a mother I can understand how
it must feel, but it's causing landslides right and
left... I'm sorry, but could someone deal with it?
  Concerned Mother\var9:00\\end\
translation:
附近山丘上有只怪物完全失控！
听说它失去了孩子，身为母亲我能理解，
但它到处引发山崩……抱歉，谁能处理一下？
  忧心的母亲\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

dragging this little monster off somewhere...
I wonder if it weren't one o' them endangered
monsters?

A Carm Mercantile fella was only telling me
about 'em the other day. Made a donation right
there and then, I did! Anyway, that little monster
I saw matched the description of one of 'em!
Maybe someone could go and help?
  A Passerby\var9:00\\end\
translation:
前几天看到可疑的人拖走一只小怪物……
莫非是濒危怪物？卡姆商会的人刚向我
介绍过，我当时还捐了款！那只小怪物
符合描述。谁能去帮帮它？
  路人\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
They took her away! They took Calea away!
I'd been wounded in battle, and she went
to the woods to pick herbs for a poultice,
when she saw themーshe saw those
endangered monster poachers doing a deal!
That's why they took her!

Someone, please help her in my place!
 Leeger, Warrior-in-training\var9:00\\end\
translation:
他们把卡莉娅抓走了！我在战斗中受伤，
她去森林采草药敷伤，看到了那些
偷猎濒危怪物的人交易！所以他们抓走了她！
求谁代我救救她！
  见习战士 利格\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Illegal monster gambling has been going on in
Graszton, right on Baron Beltorey's doorstep.
It is my belief that this has something to do
with the poaching of endangered monsters which
we hear so much about of late. If you know
anything, please tell me.
  Anrias, Reporter of the Truth\var9:00\\end\

格拉斯顿正在进行非法怪物赌博，
就在贝尔托雷男爵眼皮底下。
我认为这与近期频繁听闻的濒危怪物偷猎有关。
知道线索请告诉我。

over me?

wayfarer's log? It might serve well enough
to bring back the memories...
  Old Man Boiboi\var9:00\\end\
translation:
啊！我弄丢了年轻时的旅行日志！
不见了！带着这遗憾我怎么瞑目？
谁愿意把自己的旅行日志给我？
也许能唤起我的回忆……

也许他们在她夺冠的选美比赛上看到了她……

I can. If it means breaking every bad habit they
have one by one, so be it!
  Chita, Chita's Weaponers\var9:00\\end\
translation:
呐啊！
教会年轻人一件事，他们就忘掉十件！
教他们专注，结果他们只会专注一件事！
只能继续教，把坏习惯一个个改掉！
