notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Even among wares as fine as Galmia Pepe's
there are distinctions. Of late, a large number
of counterfeit De'vine Ribbonsーone of our
finest productsーhave made their way to
market.

The counterfeiters are trying to pass off ribbons
from the cassie variant of malboroーa vastly
inferior specimen. We must act quickly if we are
to protect the reputation of our house. Look into
the matter with all haste.
  Galmia Pepe, Office of Quality Assurance\var9:00\\end\
translation:
加尔米亚佩佩的优质商品中也有精品。
最近大量仿冒的顶级商品“神藤丝带”流入市场。
造假者用劣质卡西变种魔界花的藤蔓冒充。
为保护商誉必须迅速行动，请立即调查。
  加尔米亚佩佩 品质保证部\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The counterfeiters recently remanded to our
custody have divulged the source of the fake
De'vine Ribbons. We'll find no lasting solution
to the problem until we've stopped it at the
source. Please follow up on this information and
take such action as you deem appropriate.
  Galmia Pepe, Office of Administration\var9:00\\end\
translation:
最近拘捕的造假者供出了假神藤丝带的来源。
不从源头制止就无法彻底解决问题。
请跟进情报，采取适当行动。
  加尔米亚佩佩 管理部\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We've exhausted our supply of materials needed
to make De'vine Ribbons, and we need someone to
bring in the latest harvest.
  Galmia Pepe, Office of Procurement\var9:00\\end\
translation:
制作神藤丝带的材料耗尽，
请人运来最新采集的一批。
  加尔米亚佩佩 采购部\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
A member of our troupe has been injured and
won't be able to perform at the music competition
in Fluorgis. We've been preparing so long for this,
it would be a shame to miss out now, kupo!

Please, help us find a replacement in time. We'll
need them for no less than six days if we're to
have enough time to rehearse!
  Pompo, Troupe Leader\var9:00\\end\
translation:
剧团一名成员受伤，无法参加弗洛吉斯
音乐比赛。准备了这么久，错过太可惜了！
请及时帮我们找替补。排练至少需要六天！
  剧团团长 蓬波\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Lyze, my beloved, has left to travel the world
seeking riches. He says he'll return when he's
wealthy enough for us to be married. But it's
not wealth I want, it's him! My only wish is that
he return safely. I seek someone to bring him a
charm to keep him safe.
  Remie, Waiting anxiously\var9:00\\end\
translation:
心爱的莱兹为了财富出门周游世界，
说赚够结婚的钱就回来。可我要的不是钱，
是他！我只希望他平安归来。
请替我送他一枚保平安的护符。
  焦急等待的蕾米\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I love someone whom I can never have.
The very thought haunts me each moment
I draw breath. It is more than I can bear.
And so I wish to quit this mortal life.
There is a substance known as zombie
powder which may grant me the relief
I so desperately seek. Please, find this
and bring it to me. End my suffering.
  Glefein\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我爱着一个永远得不到的人，
这念头每时每刻折磨着我，实在无法忍受。
我想结束生命。听说僵尸粉能让我解脱，
请找来给我，结束我的痛苦。
  格莱芬\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I require an ether. Bring me one, won't you?
  Master Metallurgist\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我需要一瓶以太，能带给我吗？
  冶金大师\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Have you heard of the "Stone with No
Name"? Those philistines at the Akademy
won't hear a word of it, but I think the Stone
bears a message from the distant past.
According to legend, holding the Star Seal
to the Stone takes one to a hidden land,
protected by watchful guardians.
I ask you to find the truth.
  Mauri, No-name researcher\var9:00\\end\
translation:
听过“无名石”吗？学院那些俗人不肯听，
但我认为石头承载着远古的信息。
传说将星之印对准石头，就能进入
由守护者看守的隐秘之地。请查明真相。
  无名研究者 毛里\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The Stone with No Name was no mere stone!
What wisdom did the ancients leave for us to
find? I'll need to know more in order to decipher
their message to us.
The legend tells of three seals. I want you to try
the second, known as the Moon Seal.
  Mauri, No-name researcher\var9:00\\end\
translation:
无名石绝非普通石头！古人留下了什么智慧？
我需要更多信息才能解读。传说有三枚印章，
请试试第二枚——月之印。
  无名研究者 毛里\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I begin to grasp the message within the Stone,
yet only dimly... Perhaps I have erred, made some
fundamental mistake in my research. I need you to
try the Sun Seal to know if I am right or wrong.
  Mauri, No-name researcher\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我开始隐约理解石中的信息……
也许研究中犯了根本错误。
请试试太阳印，确认我的想法对不对。
  无名研究者 毛里\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My teacher, Mauri discovered the message within
the Stone with No Name, yet he passed away
before he could see his research through till the
end. He once told me that the "Stone with No
Name is three stones in one, the magickal
instrument of antiquity that sealed off an
Otherworld from our knowledge." He told me
never to go near the Stone, nor pry too deep
into its secrets. But...I would see his research
completed.
  Taura, Favored pupil\var9:00\\end\
translation:
老师毛里发现无名石中的信息，
却在完成研究前去世。他曾说：
“无名石是三石合一的古代魔具，
封闭了不为我们所知的异世界。”
他叮嘱我不要靠近，也不要深究秘密。
但……我想完成他的研究。
  得意门生 陶拉\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Oh, fie on him!
I chased down a marked thief, and almost had
him, too, when one of his traps tripped me up!
Someone please bring him in!
  Finnes, Watch Chief\var9:00\\end\
translation:
可恶！
我追上通缉的盗贼，眼看就要抓住，
却中了他的陷阱！请帮忙抓住他！
  守卫队长 芬尼斯\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
What are the Judges, really? My beauーhe's in an
adjudged clanーsaw the ceremony of the pact
when they were initiating him. They say if you
swear, you will never die. But isn't that strange?
I mean, it's unnatural. I don't trust it.

Someone please explain to me what this is all
about!
  Millemaila, Concerned for her beau\var9:00\\end\
translation:
裁判官究竟是什么？我的恋人加入了
受裁判官守护的氏族，见过缔约仪式。
据说宣誓后就不会死。可这不奇怪吗？
太不自然了，我不相信。请谁解释一下！
  担心恋人的米勒梅拉\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I am an itinerant merchant, and on my travels
have seen much of this world.

I wandered the Empire of Rozarria for a time,
and upon coming to Jylland found myself
uncustomarily surprised. What are these
"Judges" that affix themselves to the clans
in this land?

They are no doubt different from the keepers
of the law that I knowーyet perhaps there is
some connection?
  Aega, Traveling Merchant\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我是游商，走遍了世界。
在罗扎利亚帝国游历一段时间后来到休兰德，
我惊讶地发现这里的氏族都有“裁判官”。
他们与我认识的执法者显然不同，
但也许有所关联？
  旅行商人 艾加\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I heard once from an Esper that there exists
something greater than themーthe scions.

What are these scions to whom the Espers
bow and make obeisance? If there is someone
who knows, I would have them teach me!
  Scytha, Summoner\var9:00\\end\
translation:
一位召唤兽曾告诉我，
世上有比他们更强大的存在——圣裔。
让召唤兽俯首致敬的圣裔究竟是什么？
知道的人请教教我！
  召唤师 斯赛莎\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I'm going to fail this year, I know it. I can't fail!
Please, could someone explain about grimoires
to me in really simple terms?

After that, if they could tell me about the Four
Great Spirits, and the... (amended for length)
  Parore, Akademy Student\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我今年肯定要不及格了，不能这样！
请谁用最简单的话给我讲讲魔导书？
然后再讲讲四大精灵，还有……（因篇幅删节）
  学院学生 帕罗尔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I've been reading some old theses of late, and
was intrigued by mention of the Ultimate Book
of Magick. I know its very existence may only
be a legend, still, if you have any information
I would be most eager to hear it.
  Terad, Magickal Historian\var9:00\\end\
translation:
最近读旧论文时，我对“究极魔法之书”
产生了兴趣。虽然它可能只是传说，
但若有任何情报，我都很想听。
  魔法史学家 泰拉德\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
To assist with the Great Land Festival in
Camoa, we are currently on the look out for
attractive barmaids. During the month of the
festival, you will be provided with lodging at
the pub. Let's see those applicants!
  Targ Barman\var9:00\\end\
translation:
为协助卡莫亚大地祭，我们正在招募
漂亮的酒馆女招待。庆典期间提供酒馆住宿。
欢迎报名！
  塔格酒馆老板\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
There is a well about which strange rumors
always spring up around this time of year.
They say it glows in the depth of night, when
all lies sleeping, or that monsters not usually
seen in these parts appear, even that there are
sometimes more wells, or fewer. Could someone
please find out the truth?
  Typical Camoan Housewife\var9:00\\end\
translation:
每年这个时候，总有关于某口井的怪传闻。
有人说深夜万籁俱寂时它会发光，
有人说附近会出现罕见怪物，
甚至井的数量也会增减。请查明真相。
  普通卡莫亚家庭主妇\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My master suddenly left the dojo the other
day, leaving behind a note that said he was off
to fight his sworn enemy! I am worried for my
master. Could someone go and see if he is all
right?
  Anis, Grant's Pupil\var9:00\\end\
translation:
前几天师父突然离开道场，只留下一张纸条，
说要去与宿敌决斗！我很担心他，
谁能去看看他是否平安？
  格兰特的弟子 阿尼斯\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
You're not going to believe this, but I saw
tons of these eyeball monsters coming out
of this old mineshaft...and they were headed
for Goug!

I know I say a lot of things that aren't exactly
true, but this time is different! Someone hold
those eyeballs off while I alert the watch!
  Riger, The Boy Who Cried Eyeball\var9:00\\end\
translation:
说出来你可能不信，但我看到大量眼球怪
从废矿井涌出，正朝古格进发！
我知道自己经常说谎，但这次是真的！
请在我通知守卫时挡住它们！
  喊眼球来了的男孩 里格\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
ー The Game Is On! ー
Wanted: Participants for the greatest game in
Ivalice! This time, it's the Jylland Hunt. To the
victor go the spoils.

ー Rules of the Game ー
* Remove the tag from your quarry to score
* Time limit: One year
  Bronkrise Gamer's Guild\var9:00\\end\
translation:
游戏开始！
招募伊瓦利斯最伟大游戏的参加者！
本次是休兰德狩猎，胜者获得战利品。

规则：取下猎物的标签得分。
时限：一年。
  布隆克里斯游戏公会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I seek a talented home tutor for my son, for
seven days during the summer holidays.
The successful applicant will have a good
attitude, and be willing to live in our home for
the duration.
  Marianne, House Havemille Head Maid\var9:00\\end\
translation:
为儿子招聘优秀家庭教师，
暑假工作七天。要求态度良好，
并愿意在工作期间住在家中。
  哈维米尔家女仆长 玛丽安\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
That old man dressed up as a lady was fighting,
oh, and he was strong. Real strong! And the clan
that lost got dragged off somewheres. I cried a
little then, and he gave me a sweet. But I thought
I should tell someone anyway.
  Crybaby Kocott\var9:00\\end\
translation:
一个扮成女士的老爷爷在打架，
他好厉害！输掉的氏族被拖走了。
我哭了一会儿，他给了我一颗糖。
不过我觉得还是该告诉别人。
  爱哭鬼 科科特\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Bandits! Bandits in the Kthili Sands!
Help!
  Griv's Caravan\var9:00\\end\
translation:
强盗！克提利沙地有强盗！
救命！
  格里夫商队\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We've been after a certain mark for some time
now, but have been foiled in our efforts to stop
it. Who better to aid us than everyone's favorite
swords-for-hire, Clan \varA:01\?
Come, fight with us!
  Clan Serpentina\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我们追踪某个目标已有一段时间，
却一直无法阻止它。还有谁比大家喜爱的
雇佣剑士\varA:01\氏族更适合帮忙？
来，与我们并肩作战！
  蛇形氏族\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We're under attack in Sant D'alsa Bluff from some
mean-looking sorts. Send help, quick!
  Pie-Thon Caravan\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我们在圣达尔萨断崖遭到凶恶之徒袭击。
快派人救援！
  派松商队\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Clan \varA:01\!
Exactly what is your relationship to Duelhorn?
Show us. We wait in the Bisga Greenlands.
  A Mysterious Organization\var9:00\\end\
translation:
\varA:01\氏族！
你们和双角到底是什么关系？
让我们看看。我们在比斯加绿地等候。
  神秘组织\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
A missive containing Duelhorn's strategic
plans for the near future has been intercepted.

ーThree-Point Strategyー
Launch coordinated attacks on Camoa, Graszton,
and Moorabella, using the confusion thus
generated to.......Kh.......headquarters.....

*A word from the pub:
  Poster unknown, some sections illegible.\var9:00\\end\
translation:
截获一封包含双角近期战略计划的信。

三点战略：
同时袭击卡莫亚、格拉斯顿和摩拉贝拉，
趁混乱……Kh……总部……

*酒馆注：张贴者不明，部分字迹无法辨认。\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Clan \varA:01\,
Please, stop Maquis. He's taken it upon himself
to do everything alone.

I would go, were it not for my wounds...
Please, help.
  Alys\var9:00\\end\
translation:
\varA:01\氏族：
请阻止马奎斯。他决定独自承担一切。
若不是受伤，我本会亲自去……
拜托了，请帮帮他。
  艾丽丝\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I must slay a certain monster for the reagents of
a potion I require, and seek allies to join me
on the hunt.
  Maquis\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我需要一种药剂的材料，必须猎杀某只怪物。
招募同伴一起狩猎。
  马奎斯\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I am afflicted with a terrible disease that eats
away at my body each day. A kind man named
Maquis brings me medicine to slow its effects,
but he's begun to behave strangely. He's had
dealings with the Witch of the Fens, and I think
there may be a connection between her and his
behavior. I need someone who knows the witch
to look into this matter on my behalf.
  Cyda\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我身患重病，身体日渐衰弱。
一位叫马奎斯的好心人送药延缓病情，
但他最近举止古怪。他与沼泽女巫有往来，
我觉得这与他的变化有关。
请认识女巫的人替我调查。
  西达\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Maquis cared for me when I was ill. I owe him a
debt of kindness that can never be repayed.
So when he left with a grim look on his face
muttering something about a snake, a great fear
took me. I feel I may never see him again.
Someone, please, see that he's all right.
  Cyda\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我生病时马奎斯悉心照顾，
这份恩情我永远还不完。
他神色凝重地离开，嘴里念叨着蛇，
我非常害怕，觉得可能再也见不到他。
请谁确认他是否平安。
  西达\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Clan \varA:01\,
I wish to speak with you. Would you meet me
at the Moorabella Aerodrome?
  Alys\var9:00\\end\
translation:
\varA:01\氏族：
我想和你们谈谈。
能在摩拉贝拉飞空艇场见面吗？
  艾丽丝\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Some of our younger clan members have
been carrying on in the pub, disturbing the
peace, as it were. I reckon it's best to teach
them a good lesson now, and nip the problem
in the bud. That's where you come in. Give 'em
a good thrashing for me!
  Criek, Clan Criek leader\var9:00\\end\
translation:
氏族里几个年轻人在酒馆闹事，
扰乱了秩序。我觉得该给他们点教训，
防患于未然。这就要靠你们了，
替我狠狠揍他们一顿！
  克里克氏族长 克里克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Help! My chocobo corral's been taken over by
a ruffian calling himself the Swordking and his
band of cohorts! Problem is, they're good. Quite
good. They claim they've never been bested!
I cannot protect my beloved chocobos...
Someone help me, please!
  Yew, Chocobo Rancher\var9:00\\end\
translation:
救命！自称剑王的恶棍和同伙占领了
我的陆行鸟牧场！问题是他们很强，
据说从未败过！我保护不了心爱的鸟……
谁来帮帮我！
  陆行鸟牧场主 尤\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
To Clan \varA:01\:
I would fight the blademaster returned from
death's threshold. One on one. Come to the ruins
in the north.\var9:00\\end\
translation:
致\varA:01\氏族：
我想与从死亡边缘归来的剑术大师
一对一决斗。来北方遗迹吧。\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I've penned a reply to my dear friend Riddim
'cross the sea. I seek a courier to deliver it to
her.
  Meena\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我给海对岸的好友里迪姆写了回信。
请信使替我送给她。
  米娜\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The wyrm I keep at our home is well-behaved
and docile, but a group of our neighbors have
voiced complaint. Such ignorance...

To appease them, I've resolved to cut off my
poor pet's hornーthat should make him appear less
fearsome. This is easier said than done, however,
and I shall require help.
  Syrenead Sie Hyskaris\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我养在家里的巨龙温顺乖巧，
邻居们却提出抗议。真是无知……
为安抚他们，我决定切掉可怜宠物的角，
让它看起来不那么可怕。
但说来容易做来难，我需要帮助。
  西雷妮德·希·希斯卡里斯\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My precious chocobos will begin laying eggs
soon, and I want to take on an additional hand
to work in the hatchery.
 -No experience required
 -All applicants welcome
 -Room and board to be provided
 -Duration: 15 days
  Yew, Chocobo Rancher\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我心爱的陆行鸟很快要下蛋，
需要多招一人照料孵化场。
——无需经验，欢迎所有人
——提供食宿
——期限：15天
  陆行鸟牧场主 尤\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Wanted: Researchers to assist with geological
survey of the Galerria Deep.

Please survey the area assigned and report your
findings.
  Jylland Geological Survey Committee\var9:00\\end\
translation:
招募研究人员协助加雷里亚深处地质调查。
请调查指定区域并汇报发现。
  休兰德地质调查委员会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Wanted: Researchers to assist with geological
survey of Nazan Mines.

Please survey the area assigned and report your
findings. Transportation fees will be provided.
  Jylland Geological Survey Committee\var9:00\\end\
translation:
招募研究人员协助纳赞矿山地质调查。
请调查指定区域并汇报发现，提供交通费。
  休兰德地质调查委员会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Wanted: Researchers to assist with geological
survey of the Neslowe Passage.

Please survey the area assigned and report your
findings. Transportation fees and hazard pay (x2)
will be provided.
  Jylland Geological Survey Committee\var9:00\\end\

招募研究人员协助内斯洛通道地质调查。
请调查指定区域并汇报发现，
提供交通费及双倍危险津贴。
  休兰德地质调查委员会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Wanted: Researchers to assist with geological
survey of Zellea, the Forbidden Land.

Please survey the area assigned and report your

  Jylland Geological Survey Committee\var9:00\\end\

招募研究人员协助禁地泽莱亚地质调查。
请调查指定区域并汇报发现，
提供交通费及三倍危险津贴。
  休兰德地质调查委员会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I need an assistant to assist me in the laboratory
with my research, kupo. But not the dangerous
kind of assisting with explosions and fires, kupo.
Oh no. I'll only need you for seven days, and
you'll only be required to work a mere eight hours
each day. I'll provide your lunch and afternoon
tea, as well as colognes and perfumes to help mask
the smell, kupo!
  Malbolabs Alchemical Research\var9:00\\end\
translation:
招募助手协助实验室研究，库啵。
不是会爆炸起火的危险工作，当然不是。
只需七天，每天仅工作八小时。
提供午餐、下午茶，以及遮掩气味的香水！
  魔界花实验室炼金研究部\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I just received word that my grandmother
hurt herself, kupo. She needs someone to
take care of her, but I won't be able to go
for another week. Will you go and see that
she's all right until I arrive, kupo?
  Karm\var9:00\\end\
translation:
刚得知祖母受伤了，库啵。她需要人照顾，
但我还要一周才能过去。你能先去照顾她吗？
  卡姆\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My roof's about to collapse under the
weight of all this snow. If I don't shore
it up soon, that'll be the end of the whole
thing! But the job is bigger than I can
manage on my own, so I'm gonna need a
second pair of hands to finish it up.
I figure she'll take about five days to get
squared away.
  Bique, Retired Woodworker\var9:00\\end\
translation:
积雪快把屋顶压塌了。再不加固，
整间房子就完了！但我一个人干不完，
需要帮手，估计五天左右。
  退休木匠 比克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The Lord of Camoa has decreed that
several trees be cut from the nearby woods.
As his personal carpenter, I will oversee
your work as you fell the trees. The work
should only take two days to complete.
  Coerfantl, Carpenter\var9:00\\end\
translation:
卡莫亚领主下令砍伐附近森林的几棵树。
作为他的私人木匠，我会监督砍伐。
工作应只需两天。
  木匠 科尔凡特尔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We have an unexpected opening in the roster of
our forthcoming tourney. We do not often invite
outsiders, but if the tourney is to go ahead, we
must. Combatant with experience in a clan
tourney preferred.
  Shadow Tourney Overseer\var9:00\\end\
translation:
即将举行的锦标赛意外出现空缺。
我们很少邀请外人，但为了比赛顺利进行，
不得不如此。优先考虑有氏族锦标赛经验者。
  影之锦标赛监督\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Need someone to head over to Kithili Sands
and look for my treasure. Buried it out there a
chocobo's age ago, and now I can't remember
where it's at. Went looking for it myself, but
didn't have any luck. Maybe you'll do better.
  Ricard, Former treasure hunter\var9:00\\end\
translation:
请去克提利沙地寻找我的宝藏。
很久以前埋在那里，现在忘了位置。
我自己找过，没找到。也许你运气更好。
  前寻宝猎人 里卡德\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
There was an...incident the other day while I was
out making a delivery, and the load of potions
I was meant to deliver ended up scattered along
the ground. Will you help me collect them?

Oh, and...let's keep this between you and me. The
fewer people that know about this, the better.
  Trader for a certain potion manufactory\var9:00\\end\
translation:
前几天送货时发生了点……意外，
要送的药水散落一地。能帮我收集吗？
还有……这事你知我知，知道的人越少越好。
  某药水制造厂商人\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I need someone to bring me an ice stone. You
see, my daughter Coryn has taken ill, and wants
to eat shaved ice. True, ice from places such as
the Rupie Mountains would do, but I want only the
best for my daughter.
  Matieu\var9:00\\end\
translation:
请帮我带一块冰之石。女儿科琳生病了，
想吃刨冰。鲁皮山脉的冰也行，
但我只想给女儿最好的。
  马蒂厄\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The skies along the shipping lanes to Loar have
been teeming with floating eyes. They've even
infested the aerodrome. If something isn't done,
they'll wreck the airships, and could even spill
out into the town. Stop them before it's too late!
  Jaq, Airship Pilot\var9:00\\end\
translation:
通往洛亚尔的航线天空中满是浮游眼，
连飞空艇场都被占据。再不处理，
它们会毁掉飞空艇，甚至涌入城镇。
请及时阻止！
  飞空艇驾驶员 杰克\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
A pack of bombs from Sant D'alsa Bluff is posing
a threat to the aerodrome. If they detonate near
even one of the airships moored there, the entire
fleet could go up in flames. Destroy them all
before it's too late!
  Ash, Airship Pilot\var9:00\\end\
translation:
来自圣达尔萨断崖的一群炸弹怪
正威胁飞空艇场。只要在一艘停泊的
飞空艇旁爆炸，整个舰队都可能起火。
请及时消灭它们！
  飞空艇驾驶员 阿什\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
There are murmurings among our passengers
that there are ghosts aboard the airships.
Though understandably concerned, we are yet
mindful that rumor is not fact. We need someone
trustworthy to investigate, and, in the event that
there is a ghostly infestation, remedy the problem
with all haste.
  Jylland Airship Inspection Board\var9:00\\end\
translation:
乘客议论飞空艇上有幽灵。
我们虽担心，但传闻毕竟不是事实。
请可信之人调查；如果确有幽灵，
请迅速解决。
  休兰德飞空艇检查委员会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
A local watch hired us to set traps to help them
deal with their monster problem. Unfortunately,
I set my traps in the wrong place.

If word of my mistake gets out, I'll be in serious
trouble. That's why I need someone to destroy
the traps for me without causing a big stir.
  Esther, New Hire\var9:00\\end\
translation:
当地守卫雇我们设置陷阱对付怪物，
不幸的是，我设错了地方。
要是错误传出去，我就惨了。
请悄悄帮我摧毁这些陷阱。
  新员工 埃丝特\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Clan \varA:01\,

You've kept yourselves busy since our last
meeting. Care to test your sword arm against us
in a speed battle? Or have you lost your edge?
  Bowen of House Bowen\var9:00\\end\
translation:
\varA:01\氏族：

上次见面后你们一直很活跃。
想不想与我们进行速度战，试试身手？
还是说你们已经生疏了？
  鲍恩家族 鲍恩\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I was sent to remove some old traps,
but the local monsters had other ideas.
They're very territorial, and don't welcome
"interlopers." I was lucky to escape with
my life, and I have no intention of going
back! It should be enough to destroy the
trapsーwill you go in my place?
  Esther, New Hire\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我被派去清除旧陷阱，但当地怪物不同意。
它们领地意识很强，不欢迎“入侵者”。
我侥幸逃命，绝不想再回去！
只要摧毁陷阱就行，你能代我去吗？
  新员工 埃丝特\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We seek someone to supplement our ranks for
a short time and aid us in our fight against a
powerful foe. Our strength is in melee, so we
need a recruit to provide artillery support.

Once the barrage has broken their ranks, we'll
move in and mop up what's left. Ten days
should be enough to finish the campaign.
  Bedeviled, Daemons of Battle\var9:00\\end\
translation:
招募短期成员，协助我们对抗强敌。
我们擅长近战，需要新人提供炮火支援。
炮击打乱敌阵后，我们会冲上去收拾残局。
十天应该足够完成战役。
  战斗恶魔队 贝德维尔德\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We've begun development of a new gun,
kupo! But developing and testing are two
very different things. We need an experienced
marksman to evaluate the gun for us.
We think five days of testing should be
enough, kupo.
  Goug Consortium
  Department of Ranged Mutilation\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我们开始开发新枪了，库啵！
但开发和测试是两回事。需要经验丰富的
射手评估，测试五天应该够了。
  古格联合企业 远程破坏部\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Ngaaa!
I'm short-handed! Don't have anyone to polish up
these maces! You interested? If you can so much
as hold a mace, you're the right one for the job!
Ten days or so ought to help me clear out the
backlog.
  Chita, Chita's Weaponers\var9:00\\end\
translation:
呐啊！人手不够！没人打磨这些钉头锤！
你有兴趣吗？只要拿得起锤就能干！
大约十天就能清完积压。
  奇塔武器队 奇塔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I'll be taking the children in my class on a picnic
soon, but now I hear monsters have been sighted
near our picnic spot, and frankly I'm a little
concerned. Could someone go ahead and make
sure it's safe?
  Thil, Child Warder-in-Training\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我很快要带班上孩子去野餐，
却听说野餐地点附近出现怪物，实在担心。
谁能先去确认安全？
  见习儿童看护员 希尔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Every night I hear what sounds like a woman's
voice calling to me from the rear garden. I've just
moved residences, and don't care to move
againーnor do I have the funds if I wanted to.
It's rather disturbing to say the least, and I'd
appreciate it if someone would look into this.
  Lacado, Townsperson\var9:00\\end\
translation:
每天夜里，后花园似乎都有女人的声音
呼唤我。我刚搬家，不想再搬，
也没钱再搬。这实在令人不安，
希望有人帮忙调查。
  镇民 拉卡多\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Monsters are chewing on the tree where my
brother and I used to compare heights as children.
I fear it will soon die if nothing is done. Could
someone drive off the monsters for me?
  Celestine, A Good Sister\var9:00\\end\
translation:
怪物正在啃我和弟弟小时候比身高的那棵树。
再不管它恐怕就要死了。能帮忙赶走怪物吗？
  好姐姐 塞莱丝汀\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Some old creeps moved in on our playground!
The place with the cool old well! Now my old
woman's sayin' it's a good opportunity for me to
study and stuff. Can you believe it!? Someone
drive those creeps away!
  Obuta, Camoa Kids Leader\var9:00\\end\
translation:
一群怪老头占了我们的游乐场！
就是有那口酷炫古井的地方！
现在老妈说正好让我学习。你能信吗！？
谁来赶走那些怪人！
  卡莫亚孩子王 奥布塔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The ultimate fisherman needs no rod, line, or
hook. All he needs is what he was born with.
I am in training to become such a master, but
monsters keep intruding on my fishing hole.
Someone drive them off!
  Enchan, Aspiring Fisherman\var9:00\\end\
translation:
究极钓鱼高手不需要鱼竿、鱼线或鱼钩，
只靠与生俱来的东西。我正在修炼成为大师，
但怪物不断闯进我的钓场。请赶走它们！
  有志钓手 恩尚\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The ultimate fisherman needs no rod, line, or
hook. All he needs is what he was born with.
I am in training to become such a master, but
I seem to have attracted something most
unfortunate. Somebody help me!
  Enchan, Perspiring Fisherman\var9:00\\end\
translation:
究极钓鱼高手不需要鱼竿、鱼线或鱼钩，
只靠与生俱来的东西。我正在修炼成为大师，
但似乎引来了不得了的东西。谁来救救我！
  汗流浃背的钓手 恩尚\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I have to deliver some merchandise, and the road
promises to be treacherous. Guards needed!
Pay: 2,200 gil
The successful applicant will have confidence in
their sword arm, be passionate about their work,
and love to quaff potions.
  Komodo Potions\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我要运送货物，道路险恶，招募护卫！
报酬：2200吉尔。
要求剑术自信、热爱工作、喜欢喝药水。
  科莫多药水商会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
One of the mooglewalkers we use for transporting
goods has overturned! It was full of valuable
gemstones, kupo! If someone makes off with the
load, we're finished for sure! Bankruptcy, kupo!!!
Retrieve the load as soon as you can! Save our
house, kupo!
  Moogle Porters\var9:00\\end\
translation:
运货用的莫古步行机翻车了！
车上满是珍贵宝石，库啵！
要是被人抢走，我们就破产了！
请尽快找回货物，救救我们！
  莫古搬运工\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I saw someone fly over a volcano the other day!
Flitting through the air right over the hot flowing
lava, they were! My mom says I'm full of it, but
I know what I saw. Could someone go check it
out?
  Uwattyo, Adventurous Boy\var9:00\\end\
translation:
前几天我看到有人飞过火山！
就在滚烫的岩浆上空飞！妈妈说我瞎编，
但我知道自己看到了。谁能去看看？
  爱冒险的男孩 乌瓦乔\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Help! Someone's in my storage shed!
What if it's a thief? I can't go out there alone to
check...someone come with me!
  Mayhew, Prima Donna\var9:00\\end\
translation:
救命！有人在我的储物棚里！
万一是小偷呢？我不敢独自去看……
谁来陪我！
  歌姬乐团 梅休\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
No one's noticed yet, but an airship sitting in the
dock has been hijacked. I don't want to contact
the watch and cause a commotion, so I'm posting
for help here.
  Neah, Accidental Witness\var9:00\\end\
translation:
停在码头的一艘飞空艇被劫持了，
还没人发现。我不想通知守卫引起骚动，
所以在这里求助。
  偶然目击者 妮娅\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We've received word that one of our merchant
ships is being pursued by pirates. They're likely
after her cargo of gemstones. She's docked in
Graszton Portーsomeone go to her aid!
  Galerria Jewelers\var9:00\\end\
translation:
收到消息，我们的一艘商船正被海盗追赶，
他们可能盯上了船上的宝石。
船停在格拉斯顿港，请去救援！
  加雷里亚珠宝商会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I can't get word to Prima Donna, and I've tried
everything! We've got a concert coming up, too...
Surely they haven't been kidnapped...have they?
Oh, gods, they have! Someone look into this,
please!
  Manager, Prima Donna\var9:00\\end\
translation:
怎么都联系不上歌姬乐团！
演唱会就要开始了……难道她们被绑架了？
天啊，一定是！请谁调查一下！
  歌姬乐团经纪人\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I am a mushroom chef by trade. Know any dish
with fungi in it? I cook it. So you can imagine why
I'd want one of those fabled Baptiste mushrooms.
Careful, though, there are poisonous mushrooms
growing in the same place. I'm sure you'll be fine,
of course. Just try them when you're out there
and you'll know the difference.
  Sawah, Mushroom Chef\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我是蘑菇厨师，所有菌类菜肴都会做。
你可以想象我多想要传说中的巴蒂斯特蘑菇。
小心，同一地点也有毒蘑菇。
当然你肯定没问题，尝尝就知道区别了。
  蘑菇厨师 萨瓦\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Finally! We've arrived in Moorabella! I've done it,
Celestine! Except...now there's a problem. Can
someone come and help me, please?
  Komodo Trader\var9:00\\end\
translation:
终于！我们到摩拉贝拉了！
我做到了，塞莱丝汀！可是……现在出问题了。
谁能来帮帮我？
  科莫多商人\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We've found evidence of trespassing at a ruins
site not yet cleared for excavation. We suspect
grave robbers. If left to their own devices, it
could mean the loss of priceless and irreplaceable
cultural artifacts. Our society would like to request
that someone put a stop to this activity at once.
  Naturalist Society\var9:00\\end\
translation:
一处尚未批准发掘的遗迹发现有人擅闯，
疑似盗墓贼。放任不管可能失去
无价且无法替代的文物。
本协会请求立即制止这种行为。
  自然学者协会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Nyeh heh heh heh!
Know what I want? A darklord crystal!
It's valuable, oh, it's valuable...but I'll pay the
price! The drop off will go down in the Zedlei
Forest. Nyeh heh heh! I'll be waiting!
  Zedlei Consortium\var9:00\\end\
translation:
嘿嘿嘿嘿！知道我想要什么吗？
暗黑领主水晶！它很珍贵，哦，很珍贵……
但我付得起！在泽德雷森林交货。
嘿嘿嘿！我等着！
  泽德雷联合会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I don't know when or how these bombs got in
here, but they made a real mess of the town,
kupo! Our machines got blown to smithereens!
Kupo-po! I'd pick up the pieces, but I can't see
for the tears! Could someone collect what's left?
  Sheni, Machinist\var9:00\\end\
translation:
不知道炸弹怪何时怎么进来的，
但它们把城镇弄得一团糟，库啵！
机器全炸碎了！我本想收拾，
却哭得看不见！谁能收集剩下的零件？
  机械师 谢妮\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We're at the mercy of some pretty bad
customers... I don't think we're going to make it!
Help!
  The Yellow Wings\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我们被很难对付的客人欺负……
恐怕撑不住了！救命！
  黄翼团\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
My ranch is up and running, but with only one
chocobo, it seems even emptier than before!
That's why I'm asking you to catch another
wild chocobo for me! A black chocobo should
do nicely.
  Yew, Chocobo Rancher\var9:00\\end\
translation:
牧场开张了，但只有一只陆行鸟，
看起来比以前更空！请再帮我抓一只野生的！
黑色陆行鸟就很好。
  陆行鸟牧场主 尤\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I'd like to have a green chocobo at my ranch
to raise along with the others, but they're so
fast, all of my own attempts to catch one have
failed. Seek fleet-footed hunters to find and
catch a green chocobo for me!
  Yew, Chocobo Rancher\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我想在牧场养一只绿色陆行鸟，
但它们太快，我每次都抓不到。
招募脚步敏捷的猎人帮我捕捉！
  陆行鸟牧场主 尤\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The other day I made to catch a brown chocobo
to add to my herd, but I didn't expect the fierce
beaking that was in store for me. I was lucky to
make it back in one piece!

I seek stalwart hunters to capture a brown
chocobo and return it to meーI'll stick to
raising them.
  Yew, Chocobo Rancher\var9:00\\end\
translation:
前几天我想抓一只棕色陆行鸟加入鸟群，
没想到它啄得那么凶，我能全身而退算幸运！
招募勇敢的猎人帮我抓一只，
我还是负责饲养吧。
  陆行鸟牧场主 尤\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I was tending my chocobos in the field whenーto
my unending surprise and delightーa white chocobo
appeared! I tried to catch it, but it seemed to
guess my intent and darted off before I could get
anywhere near it. Perhaps I should be content to
merely have been in the presence of such a rare
beast, but I'm not! I mean to add it to my herd,
and I want you to catch it for me!
  Yew, Chocobo Rancher\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我在野外照料陆行鸟时，惊喜地见到
一只白色陆行鸟！我想抓它，它似乎察觉意图，
不等我靠近就跑了。也许见到这种珍兽
就该满足，但我不！我要它加入鸟群，
请帮我抓回来！
  陆行鸟牧场主 尤\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Some fellow chocobo aficionados and I went
chocobo-watching in the hope of seeing a red
chocobo. We had spotted one and were settling
in for a good viewing, when without warning it
lashed out at us with a choco meteor!

Our number must have spooked the poor thing.
I knew I should have gone alone! Would you
catch one for me?
  Yew, Chocobo Rancher\var9:00\\end\
translation:
我和几位陆行鸟爱好者去观鸟，
希望看到红色陆行鸟。我们发现一只，
正准备好好观赏，它却突然用陆行鸟陨石攻击！
一定是人太多吓到了它。我该独自去的！
能帮我抓一只吗？
  陆行鸟牧场主 尤\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Wanted: The criminals known as the Devotees!
— Duo responsible for several acts of theft.
— Thought to be involved in arms deals.
— Thought to be followers of a certain band of
musicians.
  Jylland Sovereignty Society\var9:00\\end\
translation:
通缉“狂热信徒”！
——两人组合，犯有多起盗窃。
——疑似参与军火交易。
——疑似是某乐团的粉丝。
  休兰德自治协会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Looking for helpers to swab an airship.
We haven't had the crew to properly clean her
for some time now. It would be a shame to put her
out of service, so we'll have you cleaning her mid-
flight. Oh, and watch out for the rats.
  Jylland Airship Inspection Board\var9:00\\end\
translation:
招募人员擦洗飞空艇。
我们很久没有足够船员彻底清洁了，
停飞又太可惜，所以请在飞行中清洗。
另外，小心老鼠。
  休兰德飞空艇检查委员会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Looking for helpers to swab an airship.
We haven't had the crew to properly clean her
for some time now. It would be a shame to put her
out of service, so we'll have you cleaning her mid-
flight. Oh, and watch out for the rats.
  Jylland Airship Inspection Board\var9:00\\end\
translation:
招募人员擦洗飞空艇。
我们很久没有足够船员彻底清洁了，
停飞又太可惜，所以请在飞行中清洗。
另外，小心老鼠。
  休兰德飞空艇检查委员会\var9:00\\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
You know the old chocobo pasture out in
Muskmallow Field? Well, the other day I saw me a
chocobo thereabouts what had a pom-pom on its
head! I ain't see the like of that before.

I suppose there might've been a moogle a-ridin'
on its back, but who's to say?
  ーWord About Town\end\
translation:
知道麝香葵原野的旧陆行鸟牧场吗？
前几天我看到一只头上长绒球的陆行鸟！
以前从没见过。
也许是背上骑着莫古，谁知道呢？
  ——街头传闻\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
You need every advantage to succeed on the
battlefield. Your equipment could spell the
difference between victory and defeat.

To be sure, the strength of your weapons and
armor is important. But their true power lies in
the abilities they possess. Simply readying a piece
imbued with an ability allows you to use that
ability. Why, wear it long enough and you'll even
master the ability.

For the adventurer seeking ever more obscure
abilities, having a variety of equipment at the
ready is essential. Will your equipment lead
-you- to victory?
  ーYour Local Shopkeeper\end\
translation:
战场上要争取一切优势，装备可能决定胜败。
武器和防具的强度固然重要，
真正的力量却在于其附带的能力。
装备后即可使用能力；使用足够久还能掌握。
想学习更多稀有能力，备好多种装备很重要。
你的装备会带你走向胜利吗？
  ——当地店主\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Attention Hunters!

Traders at the bazaar seek loot both common
and rare. In exchange: unique arms and armor,
to be made available for purchase through your
local shopkeeper.

Interested parties should visit their nearest
shop without delay. Don't let the spoils of war
go to waste!
  ーShopkeepers' Guild\end\
translation:
猎人们注意！
集市商人收购普通及稀有战利品，
以此制作独特武器防具，由当地店主出售。
有意者请尽快前往商店，别浪费战利品！
  ——店主公会\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
You can't travel far without bumping into
someone looking to join a clan.

But did you know that it's not just -where- you
go but -when- that determines which race you're
most likely to bump into?

ーSeek out humes walking Targ Wood at the turn
  of the new year.

ーAs spring approaches, you'll find many a bangaa
  wandering Baptiste Hill.

ーNu mou seeking to join the ranks of a clan show
  up near Graszton between spring and early
  summer.

ーThe soft chirping chatter of moogles comes to
  the Bisga Greenlands at the height of summer.

ーThe viera gather quietly in the woods near
  Camoa as the leaves turn in autumn.

Now you know where to go when you're looking
to fill out that clan roster.
  ーPub Patron\end\
translation:
旅途中经常碰到想加入氏族的人。
但你知道吗？遇见哪个种族不仅取决于地点，
也取决于时间。
——新年时在塔格森林寻找休姆族。
——春天将至时，巴蒂斯特山有许多邦加族。
——春至初夏，格拉斯顿附近有求职的努穆族。
——盛夏的比斯加绿地有莫古欢快的声音。
——秋叶变色时，维埃拉族聚在卡莫亚附近森林。
现在知道该去哪里招募成员了吧。
  ——酒馆客人\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I've heard some say that earnin' a prestigious
title through them clan trials brings out people
looking to join up.

Can't say as I'm surprised. A choice between joinin'
a famous clan and one you never heard of ain't
no choice at all.
  ーBarman's Tip\end\
translation:
听说通过氏族试炼获得有名望的称号，
会吸引人前来加入。
这也难怪。知名氏族和无名氏族，
换谁都知道怎么选。
  ——酒馆老板的建议\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
When you're hurrying from one place to the next,
the last thing you need is to come across a road
that's been blocked off. But sooner or later it
happens, and there's no sense getting in a huff
over it.

Times like that, I pass a few days walking back
and forth, taking in the sceneryーwhat else can
you do? The road's usually open by the time I
come back.
  ーPatient Traveler\end\
translation:
急着赶路时最怕道路封闭。但迟早会遇到，
生气也没用。
这种时候我就来回走几天，看看风景；
不然还能怎样？回来时道路通常就通了。
  ——耐心的旅行者\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
There are as many ways to travel as there are
travelers. Even so, there are two broad groups
into which most would fit: those who think getting
there is half the fun, and those who only think
about getting there.

To be sure, there are many joys to be had by
traveling from one location to the next, stopping
to smell the proverbial roses.

But when time is of the essence, it can be best
to dispense with the details and travel by area.
Which you choose is up to you.
  ーTraveler's Almanac\end\
translation:
旅行者各有旅行方式，大致分为两类：
享受旅途的人，和只想着到达目的地的人。
逐地旅行、停下欣赏风景自有乐趣；
时间紧迫时，按区域旅行则更合适。
选择由你决定。
  ——旅行者年鉴\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Heard of speed battles, I wager. Don't know who
thought 'em up, but it's not every battle you can
win without laying a finger on your opponent.

The rules are simple enough: the side that
lands the killing blow on the mark wins. But just
'cause the rules are simple don't mean the battles
are.

More like than not, the mark in question's a
beast foul enough to curdle the blood of even a
seasoned hunter. Take on one of their ilk, and
you take your life in your hands.
  ーDomis Streetears' Guild\end\
translation:
听说过速度战吧？不知道是谁发明的，
但它能让你不碰对手也赢得战斗。
规则很简单：对目标给予最后一击的一方获胜。
但规则简单，战斗可不简单。
目标往往是连老猎人都胆寒的野兽，
挑战它们等于拿命冒险。
  ——多米斯街头耳目公会\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Racing chocobos begin and end with the yellow.
Why? They're the easiest to look after, that's
why!

Must be that Choco Cure of theirs. Practically
take care of themselves!

I go out at least once a year to wrangle some
wild yellows. Where? Where they always is!

Targ Wood during Greenfire. Goug during Ashleaf
and Skyfrost. You wouldn't believe the size of
the herds around Goug during autumn!
  ーMusings of a Chocobo Wrangler\end\
translation:
竞速陆行鸟首选黄色。为什么？最好照顾！
它们会陆行鸟治疗，几乎能照顾自己。
我每年至少去捕一次野生黄鸟。
绿火月去塔格森林；灰叶月和天霜月去古格。
古格秋天的鸟群大得惊人！
  ——陆行鸟捕手随想\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Once you've ridden a red chocobo, there's no
going back. With fire in their eyes, fire in their
hearts, and fire in their Choco Meteor, there's no
need to ask why!

But mounts this fine don't come cheap. You'll need
deep pockets to count even one red in your
stable. That is, unless you know where to look!

Head over to Kthili Sands during the month of
Ashleaf. You won't have any trouble catching a
wild red of your own!
  ーMusings of a Chocobo Rider\end\
translation:
骑过红色陆行鸟就回不去了。
它们眼中有火、心中有火，
陆行鸟陨石也带火，理由还不够吗？
但好坐骑价格昂贵，养一只红鸟要花不少钱，
除非你知道哪里能抓。
灰叶月去克提利沙地，就能抓到野生红鸟！
  ——陆行鸟骑手随想\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
If you ask me, nothing compares to a black
chocobo. Nothing! Soaring through the air,
raining Choco Flame down from above...what more
could you ask for?

My dearest and I each have oneーboth caught in
the wild, of course. He caught his two years past,
during Plumfrost in the Rupie Mountains. I caught
mine just this year, in Greenfire near the Galerria
Deep.
  ーMusings of a Chocobo Rider\end\
translation:
我认为没有什么比得上黑色陆行鸟！
翱翔空中，从天上降下陆行鸟火焰……
还能要求什么？
我和爱人各有一只，都是野生捕获。
他两年前梅霜月在鲁皮山脉抓到，
我今年绿火月在加雷里亚深处附近抓到。
  ——陆行鸟骑手随想\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I'm a chocobo knight, newly knighted, kupo!
I haven't been riding long. But I have the most
wonderful green chocobo!

Her Choco Esuna saved an ailing friend just
the other day. She is starting to look a little
patchy on the plumage front, though. Kupo...

I -could- try to find a perkier one in Zedlei
Forestーthey like it there in Greenfire.

But let's be honest, I wouldn't part with this
one for the world!
  ーMusings of a Chocobo Knight\end\
translation:
我是新晋陆行鸟骑士，库啵！
虽然骑术还生疏，但我的绿鸟棒极了！
前几天她用陆行鸟治愈救了生病的朋友。
不过她的羽毛开始有些斑驳了，库啵……
我倒可以绿火月去泽德雷森林找更有精神的，
但说真的，什么也换不走她！
  ——陆行鸟骑士随想\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
1st of Greenfire

Set out for Aldanna Range today. Brown chocobo
is in season. Must make best use of opportunity
to study this most aggressive variety of the
bird in its natural habitat.

Of particular interest is so-called Choco Guard
ability used to defend against predators.
Also said to possess a truly singular scent.
  ーChocobo Scholar's Journal, Excerpt\end\
translation:
绿火月一日

今日出发前往阿尔达纳山脉。
棕色陆行鸟正值活跃季，必须抓住机会，
在自然栖息地研究这种最具攻击性的鸟。
尤其关注它用来防御天敌的陆行鸟防护能力。
据说它还有独特的气味。
  ——陆行鸟学者日志摘录\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Have you ever seen a white chocobo? They're
quite rare, kupo. I once saw one in the snows of
northern Kerwon, but I've heard they live in the
Rupie Mountains of Jylland, too. There's a flurry
of sightings each year in the month of Greenfire.

They say the breed in Jylland can draw Mist from
the air to restore magickal energy... What I
wouldn't give to see one just once, kupo!
  ーChocobo Aficionado\end\
translation:
见过白色陆行鸟吗？它们很稀有，库啵。
我曾在北凯尔文的雪地见过，
听说休兰德的鲁皮山脉也有。
每年绿火月都有许多目击报告。
据说休兰德的品种能吸收空气中的雾恢复魔力……
真想再看一次，库啵！
  ——陆行鸟爱好者\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
There's a lot for a new hunter to wrap his head
around, but at the end of the day, you won't
quest long before you find yourself in battle.

Luckily, the more you fight, the more experience
you gain and the more abilities you learn, so you
go into each new battle a little better prepared
than the last. What doesn't kill you makes you
stronger, eh?
  ーBarman's Tip\end\
translation:
新猎人要学的东西很多，但任务做不了多久
就会遇到战斗。
幸运的是，战斗越多，经验越多，
学会的能力也越多；每次都会准备得更充分。
大难不死，必有后福，对吧？
  ——酒馆老板的建议\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
We learn by doing. Experience is the key to
growing more powerful. Everyone you bring with
you onto the battlefield will gain experience for
their contribution. The greater the contribution,
the greater the experience gained.
  ーBarman's Tip\end\
translation:
实践出真知，经验是变强的关键。
带上战场的每个人都会根据贡献获得经验，
贡献越大，经验越多。
  ——酒馆老板的建议\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Unlike experience, everyone in your clan gains
ability points whether they participate in battle
or not.

Ability points enable you to master the abilities
imbued in equipment. Once mastered, you'll be
able to use these abilities even if you switch
equipment.

If you've mastered all the abilities conveyed by
a piece of equipment, best equip something new so
those points don't go to waste.
  ーBarman's Tip\end\
translation:
与经验不同，氏族每位成员无论是否参战，
都能获得能力点数。
能力点数可用于掌握装备附带的能力。
掌握后，即使更换装备也能使用。
若某件装备的能力全部掌握，最好换新装备，
免得点数浪费。
  ——酒馆老板的建议\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
You can't use any abilities until you've readied
themーeven using items in the heat of battle
requires preparation. Now, most abilities fall
into one of three flavors: action, reaction, and
passive.

Action abilities let you act in battle. You can
attack without readying any action abilities, but
not much else.

On the other hand, reaction abilities trigger
automatically when someone else does something to
you.

Finally, passive abilities are always around,
helping you out. Some might let you use equipment
you normally wouldn't be able to, or boost the
damage you deal.

Choose your abilities well, and even the toughest
tussle's as easy as wyrdhare pie.
  ーBarman's Tip\end\
translation:
能力必须先设置才能使用，
战斗中使用道具也需要准备。
能力大致分为行动、反应和被动三类。
行动能力让你在战斗中采取行动；
不设置也能普通攻击，但其他行动有限。
反应能力在别人对你采取行动时自动触发。
被动能力始终生效，例如使用原本不能装备的
物品或提升伤害。选好能力，艰苦战斗也能轻松。
  ——酒馆老板的建议\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Soaring mountains and desolate tracts of
desertーyou'll find all this and more in Jylland,
the vast region that spans the continents of
Loar and Ordalia.

When planning a trip, it's important to note that
the Jylland calendar uses unique names for the
months that make up the typical 240-day year.

Greenfire, Bloodfire, and Rosefire are the spring
months. The eastern skies glow bright in their
predawn light.

Coppersun, Goldsun, and Silversun, the summer
months, are renowned for their brilliant skies.

Ashleaf, Mistleaf, and Emberleaf are the months
of autumn. The turning leaves burn amber and
gold in the dying light.

Plumfrost, Blackfrost, and Skyfrost are the
winter months, when fields of snow shine
brilliantly beneath the clear morning sun.
  ーThe Sights of Jylland, Excerpt\end\
translation:
高耸群山与荒凉沙漠，休兰德应有尽有。
这一广阔地区横跨洛亚尔与奥达利亚大陆。
计划旅行时请注意，休兰德一年通常240天，
各月有独特名称。
绿火、血火、玫火是春月，东方黎明明亮。
铜阳、金阳、银阳是夏月，天空灿烂。
灰叶、雾叶、余烬叶是秋月，落叶金黄。
梅霜、黑霜、天霜是冬月，雪原在晨光下闪耀。
  ——《休兰德风光》摘录\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Gil may make the world go round, but I ain't
seen much come round my way. Questing and
adventuring are all well and good if you're in
a clan, but where does that leave me?

Thought I'd try my hand at these clan trials,
since I heard they don't cost a bloke gil.
Turns out you need bleedin' clan points for 'em!

Aye, it's a clan's world and don't let no one
tell you different. Time I found one to join, eh?
  ーLayabout Seeq\end\
translation:
都说有钱能使鬼推磨，可我没见钱到手。
有氏族的人可以做任务冒险，我怎么办？
听说氏族试炼不花钱，便想试试，
结果还需要氏族点数！
唉，这是氏族的天下，我也该找个加入了吧？
  ——闲汉锡克族\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I hadn't set foot on a battlefield since I don't
know when. There was so much going through
my mind I'd completely forgotten items were
forbidden and I drank an ether. Well, there went
our judge in one gulp!

That's when things went from bad to worse.
My mates were dropping left and right, and I
couldn't even use a phoenix down or magick to
raise them.

At that point, there wasn't much the rest of us
could do but turn and run. We took the quest
again and it went well enough the second time,
but my clanmates still haven't forgiven me.
  ーRusty Hunter\end\
translation:
很久没上战场，脑子一乱，
竟忘记禁止使用道具，喝了一瓶以太。
裁判官就这么被我一口喝走了！
事情越来越糟：同伴接连倒下，
凤凰尾巴和复活魔法都不能用。
我们只好逃跑，重新接任务后第二次倒是成功了，
但同伴至今没原谅我。
  ——生疏的猎人\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Our clan leader likes everything to go by the
book. We check the enemies' weaknesses, what
magicks they're using, and then launch a
coordinated attack. It's all about efficiency
with her.

Which is fine, except that she's an assassin,
and assassins move fast. Sometimes I think she
forgets not all of us -can- dash about the
battlefield. I have to keep a close eye on her
just to keep up. Maybe it's time I got a new
job to put some spring back in my step.
  ーDisgruntled Clan Member\end\
translation:
氏族长喜欢按规矩办事。
我们先检查敌人弱点和使用的魔法，
再配合攻击，一切讲究效率。
这本来很好，可她是行动迅速的刺客，
有时似乎忘了我们不是人人都能飞奔。
我得紧盯着她才能跟上，
也许该换个职业，让脚步快些。
  ——不满的氏族成员\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
I prefer traveling alone, kupo. I can go where
I want, when I want. But that's not always easy
for a black mage.

Preparing for battle takes tremendous
concentration. That means starting out each
battle with no Mist to use for magick. Having
to wait before casting my first spell can be
scary, kupo!

And that's not the worst part. It's much easier
to end up surrounded when you're on your own.
Fending off attacks from the front is hard
enough, but what's to keep some footpad from
sneaking up behind me and clubbing me on the
pom-pom? That hurts, kupo!

At least you can rest after a battle. I was in a
tournament just the other day that involved a
series of back-to-back melees. I had to drink an
elixir just to stay on my feet, kupo! Lucky I had
one handyーelixirs don't grow on trees!
  ーLonely Black Mage\end\
translation:
我喜欢独自旅行，库啵，想去哪就去哪。
但对黑魔法师来说并不容易。
备战需要极大专注，因此每场战斗开始时
没有雾可施法。等第一道魔法时很可怕！
更糟的是独自行动容易被包围。
正面防御已够难，还得防贼从背后敲绒球，
很疼的，库啵！
至少战后可以休息。前几天我参加了
连续战斗的锦标赛，只能喝圣灵药才能撑住。
幸好带着——圣灵药可不是树上长的！
  ——孤独的黑魔法师\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
It is not enough to know the eight elements:
Fire, Ice, Lightning, Water, Earth, Wind, Holy,
and Dark. One must also know the subject's
resistance, or lack thereof, to these elements.

Some beasts have weaknesses to specific elements,
taking greater damage from attacks of a certain
nature. Others show resistance but are not wholly
immune, these taking half the damage one might
usually expect. Still others demonstrate perfect
immunity, shrugging off even the mightiest of
magicks. Finally there are those so in tune with
a given element that they feed on its power,
using that power to restore themselves.
  ーNotes of a First Year Akademy Student\end\
translation:
光知道火、冰、雷、水、土、风、圣、暗
八种元素还不够，还要了解目标的抗性。
有些怪物弱于特定元素，会受到更多伤害；
有些具有抗性但不完全免疫，伤害减半。
还有完全免疫者，连最强魔法也无效。
最后，有些生物能吸收某种元素的力量
恢复自身。
  ——学院一年级学生笔记\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Looking to make a name for your clan? You might
try the clan trials.

Yeah, it'll cost you a few clan points, but what
do you have to lose? Pass the trial, and you'll
improve your clan talents. What's more, you can
earn new clan privileges.

There's no other way to get new privileges.
Ask me, that alone's worth the price of entry.
  ーPub Patron\end\
translation:
想让氏族出名？可以试试氏族试炼。
虽然要花一些氏族点数，但通过后能提升
氏族才能，还能获得新的氏族特权。
没有其他方法获得新特权；光这一点就值回票价。
  ——酒馆客人\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
So you've done a quest or two and think you
know what you're about, eh? Well, you may not
know everything just yet. Let me give you a few
pointers to see you stay in one piece.

First is mimics. Who isn't taken in by the promise
of untold riches that magicked urn or chest might
hold? Well, mimics take advantage of that desire
for all things golden, springing out to take eager
adventurers unawares. So don't go pokin' around
unless you're ready for a fight.

Second is traps. Without a keen eye and the
proper skill, you won't know where they are until
it's too late. But with the right preparation you
can avoid traps, and even use them to your
advantage by luring enemies into them.

Third, if you have trouble remembering the first
two and worst comes to worst, you can always use
a phoenix down to bring someone back to their
feet.

Take care in choosing the spot to revive them,
though, or you'll be right back where you started.
  ーBarman's Tip\end\
translation:
做过几个任务就觉得自己什么都懂了？
让我给你几条保命建议。
第一，宝箱怪。魔法壶或宝箱可能藏着财富，
但宝箱怪会利用贪心突袭冒险者。
没准备战斗就别乱碰。
第二，陷阱。没有敏锐眼力和适当技能，
发现时往往已太迟。准备充分则能避开，
甚至引敌人踩陷阱。
第三，万一忘了前两条，情况最糟时，
仍可用凤凰尾巴救起同伴。
不过要选好复活地点，否则又会重蹈覆辙。
  ——酒馆老板的建议\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Once you've got a clan with more than a few
members you can rely on, you can dispatch them
to take care of quests while you tend to other
more pressing matters.

You can dispatch them straight from the pub,
or accept the quest and dispatch them later.
Makes no difference.

If you're sending people off on a quest they're
likely to see battle in, make sure they're
equipped good and proper first. They'll only get
experience for completing the quest, not for the
battle. But they'll get ability points, same as
always.
  ーBarman's Tip\end\
translation:
氏族有了几个可靠成员后，
可以派他们执行任务，自己处理更紧急的事。
可以直接从酒馆派遣，也可先接任务再派遣，
没有区别。
若任务可能发生战斗，出发前要装备妥当。
他们只会因完成任务获得经验，不会因战斗获得；
但仍会照常获得能力点数。
  ——酒馆老板的建议\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Afflictions and Ailments

There are a great number of debilitating magicks
at the mage's disposal. Learning their various
effects is the first step toward mastering them.

KO
  The victim is unconscious and can neither move
  nor act.
Stone
  The victim has been turned to solid stone and
  can neither move nor act.
Toad
  The victim has been turned into a toad and can
  only move.
Berserk
  The victim loses all control and mindlessly strikes
  out at his foes.
Charm
  The victim mistakes friend for foe, attacking his
  allies.
Confuse
  The victim acts erratically, attacking friend and
  foe alike.
Poison
  Poison courses through the victim's body, slowly
  depleting his health.
Blind
  The victim cannot see and has difficulty landing
  physical attacks.
Silence
  The victim cannot speak, preventing the use of
  magick.
Sleep
  The victim is in a magicked sleep and can neither
  move nor act.
Immobilize
  The victim cannot move.
Disable
  The victim cannot act.
Addle
  The victim forgets all knowledge of abilities.
Slow
  The flow of time is slowed for the victim,
  increasing the delay between actions.
Stop
  The flow of time is stopped for the victim,
  preventing him from moving or acting.
Oil
  A flammable oil covers the victim, rendering him
  vulnerable to fire-based attacks.

  ーThe Forgetful Mage, Excerpt\end\
translation:
异常与疾病

魔法师可使用许多削弱对手的魔法。
了解效果是掌握它们的第一步。
战斗不能：昏迷，无法移动或行动。
石化：变成石头，无法移动或行动。
青蛙：变成青蛙，只能移动。
狂暴：失去控制，盲目攻击敌人。
魅惑：敌我不分，攻击同伴。
混乱：行动紊乱，敌友皆攻击。
中毒：毒素缓慢消耗生命。
黑暗：视力受阻，物理攻击难以命中。
沉默：无法说话，不能施法。
睡眠：陷入魔法睡眠，无法移动或行动。
定身：无法移动。
禁用：无法行动。
遗忘：忘记所有能力。
缓慢：时间流动减慢，行动间隔增加。
停止：时间停止，无法移动或行动。
油：身上沾满易燃油，容易受到火属性攻击。
  ——《健忘的魔法师》摘录\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The Lesser Undead

The dark hills and woods of the land abound
with all manner of undead fiend. Zombies and
ghosts are two of the more common, if not
more deadly, variety.

Both zombie and ghost are possessed of the
ability to rise after being struck down, but only
ghosts can teleport where they will, attacking
their quarry from all sides.

Cunning and luck are needed in equal measure
to defeat a group of the creatures, as they
must all be defeated at the same time in order
that rites might be performed to prevent their
rising again.

Those with knowledge of burial might inter a
corpse during battle, and placing a phoenix down
on the remains will likewise release the spirit to
eternal rest.

All would be wise to employ curative magicks and
the holy healing powers of potions and the like
when facing these minions of the dark.
  ーBestiary of Creatures Fantastic and Rare\end\
translation:
低等不死者

黑暗的山丘和森林中遍布不死魔物，
僵尸和幽灵是较常见的两种。
二者被打倒后都能复活，但只有幽灵能随意
传送，从各方攻击猎物。
对付它们既需计谋也需运气：必须同时打倒
所有敌人，才能举行仪式防止复活。
懂得埋葬的人可在战斗中安葬尸体；
对遗骸使用凤凰尾巴也能让灵魂安息。
面对这些黑暗爪牙，治疗魔法和药水等
神圣治愈力量十分有效。
  ——《奇异珍稀生物图鉴》\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Everyone knows that, these days, clans use the
auction house to stake out their turf. But few
remember how it came to be so.

Back in the day, clans would battle one another
to settle their claims. Well, you don't need much
of an imagination to know how that tune went. It
was bleedin' chaos.

Walking wounded everywhereーbad for the peace.
So the auction houses were set up to put an end
to all that. Gave the clans a way to flex their
muscle without lettin' blood.

The authority of the auction houses is recognized
across Jylland, so clans that earn champion status
over an area have tremendous influence.

Manage to claim all the areas in a region, and a
clan becomes the region master. Not every day
that happens, though. Been years since the last
time. Always a big deal when it does!
  ーPub Patron\end\
translation:
人人都知道氏族如今通过拍卖行划分地盘，
但很少有人记得缘由。
以前氏族用战斗争夺地盘，结果一片混乱，
伤者遍地，和平无从谈起。
于是拍卖行应运而生，让氏族不流血也能较量。
拍卖行的权威获全休兰德承认，
成为某地区冠军的氏族影响力巨大。
若拿下一个区域的全部地区，就能成为区域霸主。
这种事多年难见，每次都是大事件！
  ——酒馆客人\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
The job of a chocobo knight is like no other.
They're able to mount weakened chocobos and
use the chocobo's inborn abilities.

Pretty useful, eh? Only catch is, they have to
concentrate so hard on controlling the chocobo,
they can't use any abilities of their own.

'Course, once they dismount, they can use abilities
same as anyone else. But wild chocobos will bolt
the first chance they get, and what's a chocobo
knight without a chocobo?

Unless you're switching to a better mount, you
had better think twice before letting your current
one get away.
  ーJob Connoisseur\end\
translation:
陆行鸟骑士的职业独一无二：
能骑乘虚弱的陆行鸟，使用它的天生能力。
很有用吧？但骑士必须专心控制坐骑，
无法使用自己的能力。
下马后能力恢复，但野生陆行鸟一有机会就会跑。
没有陆行鸟还算什么陆行鸟骑士？
除非要换更好的坐骑，放走之前最好三思。
  ——职业鉴赏家\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Don't let their name fool you. Passive abilities
can play a very active role in battle. Here are
some of my personal favorites.

Dual Wield
  A powerful ability that enables you to equip
  two one-handed weapons. Just remember that
  you can't dual wield polearms, claws, rapiers, or
  spears.

Monkey Grip
  Enables you to equip a two-handed weapon with
  only one hand, freeing the other to hold a
  shield. Won't work with bows, crossbows, or
  hand-cannons, naturally.

Doublehand
  Holding a one-handed weapon in both hands will
  let you put more power behind the swing. Not
  much point when it comes to gloves or guns,
  though.

  ーBarman's Tip\end\
translation:
别被名字骗了，被动能力在战斗中
也能发挥积极作用。以下是我的最爱。
二刀流：可装备两把单手武器，
但长柄武器、爪、刺剑和枪不能双持。
单手握：单手装备双手武器，另一手持盾；
弓、弩和手炮自然不行。
双手握：双手持单手武器可增强攻击力，
但手套和枪没什么效果。
  ——酒馆老板的建议\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Trinkets and baubles that can summon mighty
scions to do their possessor's bidding?

I have heard such as these exist. Yes, powerful
artifacts that can claim victory for their bearer
when all hope seems lost.

The power to call on creatures of myth and
legend is no trivial one. One must be worthy of
such power, or one will succumb to it.
  ーTraveler from the East\end\
translation:
能召唤强大圣裔听命的饰品和小物件？
我听说确有此物。即使希望渺茫，
这些强大遗物也能为持有者带来胜利。
召唤神话传说生物的力量非同小可，
必须配得上它，否则会被力量吞噬。
  ——东方旅行者\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
There are places in Jylland that aren't...right.
Not fully connected to our world, you might say.
Step in, and in the span of a breath, a month has
passed. A frightful thought, that.

Still, you could put a place like that to use,
if you had a mind to.
  ーPub Patron\end\
translation:
休兰德有些地方不太……正常。
可以说它们与世界的联系并不完整。
踏进去，只一眨眼就过去一个月，真可怕。
不过有心的话，这种地方也能加以利用。
  ——酒馆客人\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Watch enough auctions, and you start to learn
how to read people's "tells": movements that
give away what they're planning to do.

When they're going to play a 5-coin token,
they let out a cry.

When they're going to play a 3-coin token,
they strike a defensive posture.

When they're going to play a 2-coin token,
they walk back and forth.

When they're going to play a 1-coin token,
they get very pushy.

When they're going to pass, they shake their
head.

If you can learn to read your opponents, you'll
be sitting with the high rollers in no time.
Not everyone has a tell, though, so don't rely on
it too much. That's what keeps things interesting.
Am I right?
  ーAuction Aficionado\end\
translation:
看多了拍卖，就会读懂人们泄露意图的小动作。
出五枚硬币时，他们会喊叫。
出三枚时，会摆出防御姿势。
出两枚时，会来回走动。
出一枚时，会咄咄逼人。
放弃时，会摇头。
学会观察对手，很快就能跻身大玩家。
但不是人人都有小动作，别过分依赖。
这才有趣，对吧？
  ——拍卖爱好者\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Talents are one measure of a clan's success.
It's important to know what each one means.

Negotiation — how well you work with people.

Aptitude — how handy you are with machinery.

Teamwork — how well you work with your fellow
  clan members.

Adaptability — how well you deal with changing
  situations.

The higher your clan is rated, the better.
Some petitioners won't even let you accept their
quests if they don't think you're talented enough
to get the job done.
  ーLemme, Swordsman\end\
translation:
才能是衡量氏族成就的标准，
了解每项含义很重要。
交涉：与人打交道的能力。
资质：操作机械的能力。
协作：与氏族同伴合作的能力。
适应：应对变化的能力。
评级越高越好。有些委托人认为你才能不足，
甚至不会让你接受任务。
  ——剑士 莱梅\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated

source_text:
Remember what I said about finding recruits from
different races in different seasons? Well, I've
figured out a few more things to go along with it.

'Round year end, the more rotund adventurers
come out in the Aldanna Range. And if it's winged
companions you're after, make for Fluorgis.

If that doesn't help you find the right person for
your clan, I don't know what will.
  ーPub Patron\end\
translation:
还记得我说过不同季节能招募不同种族吗？
我又发现了一些事。
年末时，身材圆润的冒险者会出现在
阿尔达纳山脉。想找有翅膀的伙伴就去弗洛吉斯。
如果这样还找不到合适的人，我也没办法了。
  ——酒馆客人\end\
notes: Terra machine translation; encoding and layout not validated
